Offences to the Name, the dhama, service, Vaishnavas and the guru can seem overwhelming. The key is to be compassionate, humble, appreciative and grateful for Krishna's mercy; then the Lord in the heart keeps us from offences.

🎙 Maharaj at 88:03 (auto-transcript): “Next, don't be overwhelmed. There are so many apparatus. Nam apparatus, offenses to living. Dham apparatus, offenses to the holy places. Without humility and compassion it is very rare to be free of offences. The neophyte can offend anyone, anytime, especially when close to devotees, so we should raise our standard to the intermediate level. — “Because medium is safe.”

🎙 Maharaj at 89:42 (auto-transcript): “humility If you don't have compassion, it's very, very, very, very rare for a person to be free from offenses in this category. Very, very rare. The contemplation: before chanting, check compassion ('they are trying, I am trying'), humility, appreciation and gratitude ('I didn't find you, you found me'); and journal each evening where these were lost.

Two questions on visiting the dhama.

🎙 Maharaj at 96:30 (auto-transcript): “we will move on to question and answers if there are any please raise your hand Gurudev we have one question in the chat box yes let's start from there ok it's from Resika Preeti Mataji she's saying had a question when visiting a holy place like Shri Dham with family or…”

Prepare people's consciousness before taking them. It is said everyone in Jagannatha Puri has four arms, yet we see people spitting tobacco and pandas pulling at shirts; the dhama is covered and reveals itself only by the mercy of its residents and protectors such as Lord Siva.

🎙 Maharaj at 97:23 (auto-transcript): “Before we take people to the Dham, it is good to prepare the consciousness. we are going to Mayapur, we are going to Dharm, we are going to Jagannathpuri Dondavan Dasakura said Jagannathpuri, everyone has four hands that is but when we get today we don't see people with four…”

With faith, full conviction and freedom from offences the acaryas can reveal the dhama. Politely tell critics not to judge, and follow Prabhupada's advice that those not yet mature stay no more than three days in Vrindavan.

🎙 Maharaj at 106:36 (auto-transcript): “Yeah, so we groom the devotees we are taking for the dam so that they have a better understanding where we are going and what to expect. So, yeah, we need to be free from expenses. We need to have faith. We should believe that what the scripture says is true, what our child…”

children.topic: Q2 · Why isn't the dham revealed?
children.note:
Most devotees are careful not to offend the guru, so why is the dhama not revealed to everyone?

🎙 Question from the floor at 109:05 (auto-transcript): “There is one more question from Kamala Kshimata Ji. She's saying, Hare Krishna Gurudev. Gurudev, as you're told, that first offense to the holy dham is offending guru. So Gurudev in general, all devotees are very careful to offend Gurudev, either in Dham or outside. So then…”

Many visit Loi Bazaar and Banke Bihari and come to their guru only on the last day — is that respect? Minimizing the guru's disciples is also guru-aparadha, since he is connected with them.

🎙 Maharaj at 109:40 (auto-transcript): “We should be free from offenses. How many of us are free from offenses? to be free from offenses not only to the good and also I'm not sure that everyone is free from offending I'm not sure either we're doing it mentally or grossly we talk behind or disrespectful many people…”

Jiva Gosvami arrived full of Nityananda consciousness and everything was revealed. If it is not happening to us, we are not free from offences and lack faith.

🎙 Maharaj at 111:57 (auto-transcript): “We just mentioned that Srila Jeeva Goswami, he was coming full of Netanyahu consciousness, full of Mahapu consciousness. He prepared, and exactly when he got it there, that's what happened. That means he's free from offenses. If we are free from offenses, the same thing will…”

Maharaj asks who has never felt Krishna did not answer a prayer. When a devotee claims Krishna always answers yet admits crying easily, he sternly corrects her: one who believes in Krishna cries only from joy. He explains he raised his voice so all would understand — his guru did not leave him in ignorance. — “A person who has belief in Krishna”

🎙 Maharaj at 114:27 (auto-transcript): “please raise your hand we have been we have been anyone here please share share with us i'm free from the thought that christian never answer my prayer christian don't answer my prayer i'm free from that thoughts that 100 sure christian is answering all my prayers and have…”

maps.title: Radha Sunya · Session 16 · Jahnava Devi and Women Gurus

nodeData.topic: Session 16 · Jahnava Devi and Women Gurus
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Answering the question 'where are the women gurus?', Maharaj shows how the material and spiritual worlds are run by feminine potencies, culminating in Srimati Radharani, and explains why the word 'less intelligent' is misunderstood. Through Jahnava Devi, who never campaigned to be a guru yet united and protected the Vaishnavas, he warns against politics and cheating religion in devotional life. In the questions he speaks on staying balanced when hurt, not meditating on others' faults, darshan with phones, a Vaishnavi's focus, and how faith grows. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Outsiders ask why a movement that teaches 'we are not these bodies' seems to have only male gurus. Maharaj calls the issue a very big concern in the movement.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:34 (auto-transcript): “Where are the women gurus? A question we often hear. Sometimes people inquire from us and ask, Are the Christians? I see that you people have gurus, but they all seem to be men. Where are the women spiritual masters? We talk about the fact that we are not these bodies and…”

Citing Srila Prabhupada, Maharaj explains that disagreement and argument in a spiritual movement come from leaning towards material things; false ego sustains them, not bhakti. Those really leaning towards Krishna do not fight.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:52 (auto-transcript): “And it is a big concern, only because, according to Tersilapau Pad, disagreement in the Christian movement proper said, it is because we are leaning towards material things, not Christian consciousness. All forms of disagreement, disagreement and arguments are maintained by…”

By his 'little understanding', Maharaj says this should not even be an issue: a spiritual organisation must decide everything by devotional criteria, not by material ability and politics.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:03 (auto-transcript): “there is no need according to my little understanding. Little. Because we're not very intelligent, we're not so powerful, and we don't know much of the scripture, but it was simple, simple common sense from what we have understood from our scriptures and our chariots. This…”

children.topic: The power behind, like a backbone
children.note:
The backbone keeps the whole body straight, yet it is at the back, so foolish people give it no credit. Maharaj says we should care about the wise, not the foolish.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:14 (auto-transcript): “And generally, we see that for anyone, man or woman, to sit straight, for us to be able to sit straight, to have our body to sit straight, or to use this body as it's functioning, we need, they say, the back bone. It is what is keeping the whole body the back bone. But the…”

Durga, a woman, superintends the prison of this world and binds every conditioned soul with the modes; Sarasvati is the minister of education and Lakshmi of finance. 'So where do men belong in this?' Maharaj asks.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:15 (auto-transcript): “So when we look carefully at the material structure, and also we look at the spiritual structure, the whole of this material world is under Durugadevi, a superintendent of what? Punishment, punishment, chastisement for wrongdoers. And Durugadevi is a woman. So that means that…”

Maharaj remembers an elderly Mataji who served with him in West Africa, taught him cooking, deity worship and Bhagavatam study, and brought him her deities' bathing water every day. When she told him he would become mad one day, he said he was waiting for it — mad after Krishna and Vrindavan, not after sense enjoyment.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:14 (auto-transcript): “When he saw the nurse, Bhatia Maharaj brought her to West Africa, she was serving with us, and she taught us so many things, so many things, cooking, dating worship, studying the Bhagavatam. Actually, she introduced me to a study in Bhagavatam Al Chaitanya. She gave me those…”

In the spiritual world the gopis are the best devotees, with no method of worship higher than theirs, and the supreme among them is a woman: Srimati Radharani, placed even above Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:41 (auto-transcript): “Then if you want to go further, you can go beyond this, you can go beyond this material and enter into the spiritual world of all the devotees of Krishna all the devotees of Krishna who are the best the best no other devotional devotees compared to they are the gopis they are…”

children.topic: Krishna downstream, waiting at the gate
children.note:
Krishna stands downstream so the kumkum and fragrance from Radharani's bath touch him, calls it the best day of his life, sends his friends home to wait at the town gate for her to pass, and spends sleepless nights hoping to see her.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:25 (auto-transcript): “we have been told about chariots when Simatiranda is beating in the river Krishna is going to the downstream so the the kumkum from Simatidhani's body and the aroma and everything flowing from downstream to Krishna, when he touches Krishna's body, Krishna becomes very happy.…”

Millions of perfected beings worship Krishna, but Krishna worships Srimati Radharani, so all his devotees are eternally her servants.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:59 (auto-transcript): “And Krishna said, all of them worship me, but I worship Srimati Radarani. Therefore, all my devotees who are worshipping me, we are eternally the worshipper and servant of Srimati Radarani. We hear all this in so many things. Krishna is waiting at the gate. Christian has…”

The desire to enjoy is natural to the soul and comes from Krishna. Radharani is Krishna's enjoyment personified, and just as the food and drink we enjoy control us, she controls Krishna. — “Enjoyment is natural.”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:27 (auto-transcript): “Why? What does it really mean? We should try to understand. All of us here like to enjoy. All of us like to enjoy. That tendency to enjoy is part of the spirit. Spirit. It's part of the soul. Spirit soul. It is natural. Enjoyment is natural. Suffering is not natural.…”

Every morning we sing, mostly without understanding, begging to be accepted into her groves as her maidservant. If that is our ultimate desire, where is the place for gender pride?

🎙 Maharaj at 39:23 (auto-transcript): “and every morning we are singing every morning we are singing we are singing every morning we are singing to be what this is what we are singing every morning although we are singing this without understanding the meaning that is fortunate we are singing we don't understand…”

If we are disturbed by the whimsical opinions of foolish, uneducated people, it shows we too do not understand. Pure devotees, connected with Krishna within, are not shaken by such talk. — “It means that we are foolish also.”

🎙 Maharaj at 40:41 (auto-transcript): “Why are we distraught by foolish people who do not know what is the reality? Why are we disturbed by their whimsical activity? Why should someone be disturbed by a whimsical activity of foolish people, uneducated, indetripe people who are fools, who don't know anything? Why…”

Women stand behind in the temple to protect the men, not because they are less important. 'Less intelligent' means not knowing how to use one's great power to become a pure devotee faster than men.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:25 (auto-transcript): “So when we say women are less intelligent, it's because they don't know how to use what they have. to become pure devotee faster than men. They don't know this. Therefore, the word less intelligence is used. And this word, it is not understood in our movement. Many people…”

Many have become offensive to Srila Prabhupada over this word. Maharaj points out that in the scriptures the statement comes from women themselves — he names Kunti, Devahuti, Urvasi, Tulasi Devi and Lalita — and only one man; Prabhupada simply quoted them. — “This word, it is not used by Prabhupada.”

🎙 Maharaj at 44:53 (auto-transcript): “And people have become offensive to Srila Prabhupada. This word, it is not used by Prabhupada. Srila Prabhupada has only quoted it. People who say that women are less intelligent are women themselves, not men. The only one male is Dhruvamaras in the seventh canto of…”

Women are the most important, and with their power they support the men; even materially it is said that behind the successful man stands a woman.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:01 (auto-transcript): “It is not a discrimination because they are less important. Women are not less important. They are most important. And because of that, their power, they are supporting the man. Even materially, it is said, behind the social sphere, man is a woman. If one is going to fight…”

Women usually live longer, so men will depend on their wives at the end of life — and the wives will remember how they were treated. What goes around comes around.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:44 (auto-transcript): “Yes, women live longer than men. Therefore, we should be very, very careful how we treat them because they are going to be present to take care of our body. And they will remember, they will pray. They will pray that, thank you, Krishna, that you have liberated me from the…”

It is unfortunate when a widow thanks Krishna for freeing her from the prison of her husband. Maharaj says she should feel the loss because of the love, protection and shelter she received. — “It should not be like this.”

🎙 Maharaj at 50:19 (auto-transcript): “This is unfortunate. It should not be like this. It should not be like this. It should be that they feel bad that we have left them behind. And then they would like to enter into our fire, the funeral fire, instead of continuing to live. Because of the love and the dealings…”

Jahnava Devi, the wife of Lord Nityananda, was so prominent that Vaishnavas from all over India came for her blessings and philosophy, and she was relied on to mediate disputes among the followers of Mahaprabhu.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:21 (auto-transcript): “Janaba Devi was the wife of none other than Loli Jananda. There was a time in Vaisenamah history when she was so prominent and powerful that Vaisenamahs from all over India, She was eager to have her daughter, to get blessings from her, and to hear her explain philosophical…”

Robbers who came at night to kill and rob her party wandered confused through the forest all night, and the next day came to take initiation. Durga worshippers who vowed to kill her followers were likewise baffled and chastised.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:48 (auto-transcript): “Some group of Dacotts, they came and they wanted to come and rob her. She was traveling with a huge crowd. And it came, so some of these fortunate people, they wanted to come and attack her in the night and kill them and take their properties and also kill her because they…”

Jahnava Devi and the other great Vaishnavis who led the movement and saved the parampara did not lobby, negotiate or politic. The service came to them naturally by their practice and qualities, and they did it perfectly. — “They did not campaign to become gurus.”

🎙 Maharaj at 53:32 (auto-transcript): “So something I would like to mention here is that Janava Devi, Ganga Devi, this exalted devotee who led this Krishna consciousness movement, like it's mentioned here, and saved the whole parampara till today, they did not campaign to become gurus. They did not campaign to…”

If some men lobbied to get positions, should we copy their mistake? Maharaj asks that the organisation function spiritually, so there is peace instead of endless fighting. — “This is my only concern.”

🎙 Maharaj at 54:46 (auto-transcript): “This thing came naturally. This is a spiritual organization. Why can't we function spiritually and allow things to happen naturally as it has been? This is my only concern. This is my only concern. Then somebody can say, well, but when would that happen? Because what about…”

Kaitava-dharma — using religion for materially motivated ends — has become the norm. The devotees reflect in groups on whether they have used position or knowledge to push their own agenda.

🎙 Maharaj at 58:25 (auto-transcript): “kaitawa dharma chiti religion. Using religion to achieve some materially motivated goal is not uncommon. In fact, this kaitawa dharma chiti religion has become the norm. Materially motivated people use whatever they can to gain leverage for their ideas. Since they are aware…”

Group reports name signs like chanting with mobile phones, kirtan for an audience and expanding material comforts 'for bhakti', and remedies like honest introspection, writing to the spiritual master and stronger sadhana.

🎙 Maharaj at 77:56 (auto-transcript): “So there was this question, the first question, have I ever used my devotional position, knowledge or service to push my own agenda? In my personal case, I have never used it. I came to Krishna conscious for peace and until now I am able to stick to it. However, there was…”

children.topic: Jahnava Devi or the Durga worshippers?
children.note:
Maharaj asks each to check: do I use my power to unite or divide, serve or control, uplift or feel superior, serve Krishna or my ego? True spiritual power serves and unites.

🎙 Maharaj at 99:31 (auto-transcript): “Now ask yourself, am I more like General Devi or the diligent worshipers? General Devi, you use her power to unite people, to mediate disputes, self-Christians mission and uplift others. I use my power, knowledge, position to unite people or divide people, serve others or…”

Questions from the chat and from the previous day, on hurt, others' misbehaviour, darshan, a Vaishnavi's focus and faith.

🎙 Maharaj at 101:10 (auto-transcript): “and answer session so if you have some questions that you'd like to ask There's already one that was shared in the group. So perhaps I can start with this one as we have more people getting their questions ready. So Raj Lakshmi Mataji asks, what do we do in front of cheaters?…”

children.topic: Q1 · Too hurt to unite others
children.note:
Sometimes we are so hurt that we just want to protect our own health. What then?

🎙 Question from the floor at 102:09 (auto-transcript): “from Veshali Mataji in the chat box she's asking Hare Krishna Maharaj Ji Please accept my humble obeisances. Sometimes we are so hurt that we no longer want to unite others with others and just want to save our spiritual, mental and physical health. What should we do in that…”

Keep up your practices and services; otherwise the person has succeeded in throwing you off balance. Regain balance, see where you slipped, and be careful whom you associate with. — “We shouldn't forget that we are servant.”

🎙 Maharaj at 102:32 (auto-transcript): “Yeah, we shouldn't become disorganized or turn apart because someone has done something. We shouldn't forget that we are servant. because that is how we are going to get purified. So, yeah, although someone has taught us, we should continue with our practices, services, our…”

children.topic: Q2 · Noticing misbehaviour in the dham
children.note:
Should I use others' misbehaviour to check myself, and how can I see only good?

🎙 Question from the floor at 104:05 (auto-transcript): “One is from Her Grace Rastasundari Mataji. She asks, Krishna Shilagurudev, please accept my humble obeisances at your lotus feet. We should focus on our behavior in dham and our temples and tirthas. But because I'm still conditioned, I still find myself noticing some…”

Pure devotees see everything, but others' nonsense does not change their Krishna consciousness. If we are disturbed, it shows our practice and understanding are weak, so we must keep upgrading ourselves.

🎙 Maharaj at 104:47 (auto-transcript): “It is not that the pure devotees have no feeling. They don't see our nonsense. It's not like that. They are conscious, prepared, pure, and they see everything. But they are so pure and conscious that other people's nonsense doesn't affect them. It does not change their result…”

children.topic: Q3 · Why does Krishna show deviations?
children.note:
Is it an offence to focus on gross or subtle deviations around us?

🎙 Question from the floor at 106:44 (auto-transcript): “okay so it says please accept my humble obeisances always to shila prahupad What happens when we live in a sacred dam or in a local temple, but there are people around us doing nonsensical things and behaving inappropriately? It could be gross deviations like breaking…”

children.topic: You become what you meditate on
children.note:
If we meditate on others' nonsense we absorb their qualities and imperceptibly join their group; thinking of pure devotees gives their qualities. Remember why we came and check ourselves. — “We came here to a purpose”

🎙 Maharaj at 107:22 (auto-transcript): “it is not our duty to continue meditating on the nonsensical things that people do because if we continue to meditate about all the nonsense things that people are doing when are we going to meditate on the good things that we have come here for and why should we contaminate…”

children.topic: Q4 · Phones at the altar opening
children.note:
At festivals devotees rush to the altar with phones instead of offering obeisances. Is it ecstasy or offence?

🎙 Question from the floor at 110:25 (auto-transcript): “Maharaj, my question is from yesterday, the apparatus we committed in the temples and the dam. So, especially when a festival is going on, or like Jamastami, Radastami, or Festival of Flowers, what I notice is that when the altar is closed and it's a time for the water to…”

children.topic: Take his picture into your heart
children.note:
The same deity is there at quiet times, yet people push to film when others are watching. A mechanical picture does not stay; the picture of the Lord taken in the heart remains eternally.

🎙 Maharaj at 112:24 (auto-transcript): “the thing is that many people are acting musically when people have gathered, at the time everybody is pushing others to go and take pictures, but the same data is there at other times when nobody is there you can peacefully take a picture, make a communication, you can press…”

children.topic: Q5 · What should a Vaishnavi focus on?
children.note:
If women can become pure devotees faster, what should a Vaishnavi engage herself in?

🎙 Question from the floor at 115:12 (auto-transcript): “on the slide where um we were discussing the vedic understanding and it was mentioned by param gurudev that women are predominantly uh controlled by the modes but if they use the very same energy for the spiritual side they can become pure devotee faster you commented so I…”

Men and women alike chant sixteen rounds and serve. The goal and principle are the same; the attention we give decides whether we go by plane, train, bicycle or on foot.

🎙 Maharaj at 116:31 (auto-transcript): “the spiritual potency that we can have thank you every one of us are eternal servant to a christian everyone we are eternal servant to a christian and we are preparing ourselves now we condition so we are preparing ourselves now by this process of training to become qualified…”

Begging, praying and practising purify us until the mind itself chants and hears with taste. Attraction to higher things comes naturally — no special initiation is needed — as guru, Krishna and the holy name keep giving to one who receives.

🎙 Maharaj at 121:26 (auto-transcript): “Then as we are practicing or we are begging and praying and practicing, the power of this sadhana will get us purified, that we will come to the second stage of start doing the physical thing we are doing now mentally for the mind. That is what you call Raga Bhakti. now it…”

children.topic: Q6 · How does faith keep growing?
children.note:
How can we develop unflinching faith like Prahlada, Kunti and Srila Prabhupada?

🎙 Question from the floor at 126:15 (auto-transcript): “Prabhu is saying his question comes from yesterday's class wherein you mentioned that our faith should be like Prahlad Maharaj's Kunti Devi's Shila Prabhupada's and our spiritual master's faith so how is it that we can keep increasing our faith because you mentioned that…”

Faith comes by continuously hearing from a person who has faith in Krishna, by chanting nicely, which purifies, and by keeping the association of faithful devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 126:51 (auto-transcript): “life after life so how will this unflinching faith come and keep increasing the faith comes by hearing that's how we get faith by hearing continuously and fortunately you hear from a faithful person i mean if you do what the papa said i hear from the right source means a…”

maps.title: Radha Sunya · Session 17 · Begging Forgiveness from the Offended

nodeData.topic: Session 17 · Begging Forgiveness from the Offended
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. On Srila Prabhupada's disappearance day Maharaj warns that pretenders take shelter in religious institutions, and that the demons succeed because they know their goal while devotees often do not. Through Jahnava Devi's attackers, Haridasa Thakura and Srivasa Thakura's offender, he shows that the fortunate are corrected and freed only by begging the offended devotee and obtaining their mercy — through an intermediary if needed. In the questions he speaks on hurt from managers, apologising freely, effort and mercy, anger in the family, working wives, and living with a non-devotee parent. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
The most dangerous people create false appearances of authenticity and enter religious fellowships to destabilise them, so that sincere people flee.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:48 (auto-transcript): “To be honest, the most prominent, cruel, and sinful people are those empowered for destruction and who often take shelter in religious institutions. Your most powerful soldiers or your most powerful warriors are those who engage in espionage. They may not only be good at…”

In Kali-yuga the easiest way for anyone to rise demonically is through religion, since other fields are already crowded with powerful people. One who is not a devotee hides under the guise of religion.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:50 (auto-transcript): “Especially in Kali Yuga, we see this phenomenon, very common. Because in Kali Yuga, the easiest way for anyone to rise demonically is through the process of religion. because in the social world, so many people already do occupy the spaces that if someone tries today, their…”

Sincere seekers get discouraged when their efforts are frustrated at every step by such people, who pretend a lot and accept every austerity to reach the position from which they can act out their real desires.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:58 (auto-transcript): “Many people get discouraged when they find out that their attempt to be God-conscious is being frustrated at every step. Because these people, they pretend a lot. They pretend a lot. In the beginning, they do everything as various parts. Because they have an ulterior motive,…”

children.topic: Demons succeed: they know the goal
children.note:
Yogis in the forest often fall, but Maharaj says no demon in history failed in his austerities, because demons know exactly what they want and plan for it.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:00 (auto-transcript): “So, you see, many times, yogis, the people who go to the forest to perform austerity, they have to challenge the difficulty when they fall. But no demon in history ever felt in their austerity to achieve them on their goals. All the demons who perform austerities, they are…”

Many of us struggle and are easily deceived because the goal of Krishna consciousness is not clearly defined in our consciousness; knowing the goal lets us expect the obstacles and resist temptation. — “because the goal is not clearly defined in our consciousness.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:55 (auto-transcript): “Many people have difficulty to attain the goal because the goal is not clearly defined in our consciousness. The demons have the goal of their demonic desire. Their goal is clearly defined in their head. Before any demon go, undergo any austerity, they know exactly what they…”

When he was warned he would die in America and was too old to go, Srila Prabhupada kept pressing until he was given the ticket, because his spiritual master's order was on his head. — “He knows the goal.”

🎙 Maharaj at 29:30 (auto-transcript): “Even when Sumati Moralji was telling Prabhupada, Swamiji, you will die in America. Don't go. Prabhupada said, I will go because that is the order of my spiritual master on my head. He knows the goal. When the workers of Sumati were also suggesting that he shouldn't go because…”

The Durga worshippers who planned to kill Jahnava Devi's followers each dreamt that Durga throttled and scolded them and revealed Jahnava Devi as the Lord's eternal consort.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:52 (auto-transcript): “It's a continuation from this video. These followers of Durga were not as demonic as they initially appeared to be. However, they did not understand real dharma. Certainly, not certain dharma, eternal religion. They were self-righteous. They had actually made plans to kill…”

Maharaj observes that many people never get the fortune of being chastised and stopped, so they go on offending devotees all their lives, destroying themselves and their families. — “They are not going to change.”

🎙 Maharaj at 33:20 (auto-transcript): “From observation, we have seen that there are so many unfortunate people who does not have this fortune to be chastised and corrected. They will continue to do so many sinful things, so many offenses to Vaishnavas continuously the whole of their life. They are not going to…”

Shaken, the worshippers immediately begged forgiveness and took shelter of Jahnava Devi. Those who never receive such correction are bereft of fortune.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:47 (auto-transcript): “After having this dramatic encounter with Durga Devi, the shaken followers awoke. They were so overwhelmed with fear and remorse that they immediately built forgiveness and took shelter of Janaga Devi. They are fortunate. As we said before, there are so many who never and who…”

Robbers planning a night raid on Jahnava Devi's large party ran for hours yet mystically never reached her camp; realising she was extraordinary, they begged forgiveness and became her disciples.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:49 (auto-transcript): “Nora Hari tells another story about Dhanava Devi. There was another group of worshippers who were robbers by profession. Jennifer David was so powerful and prominent that wherever she would go, there would be a large crowd of followers. When the decorates observed this…”

One way to be freed from an offence is to go to the offended devotee and sincerely take up their service. The very fortunate do not only apologise; they surrender and take initiation, as happened with Narottama dasa Thakura, Srinivasa Acarya, Advaita Acarya and others. — “That is for those who are very fortunate.”

🎙 Maharaj at 39:31 (auto-transcript): “That is for those who are very fortunate. This is what we have seen, that those two people who are very fortunate, they always beg forgiveness and surrender. Not only they just beg for forgiveness, They surrounded themselves and taken initiation from the person. In history,…”

People criticised Advaita Acarya for honouring Haridasa Thakura. At Advaita's request Haridasa showed his power and no fire would light in Santipura — no cooking, no puja — until the offenders begged Haridasa, who restored it, and they bowed down to him.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:32 (auto-transcript): “At one time, Harada Sakura was with Adwita Acharya in some people. And they saw that Lord Adwita Acharya was showing some respect to Harada. And the people became offended. They started offending, criticizing publicly Lord Adwita Acharya. So, to help them, to help them, Lord…”

Maharaj laughs at offenders who, urged to go and beg forgiveness, said the devotee would never forgive them. The great devotees always forgave when begged; refusing to beg is our misfortune. — “This is misfortune.”

🎙 Maharaj at 43:46 (auto-transcript): “I have a particular experience, one devotee came to tell me one day, he came to tell me some devotees who have been very, very offensive, so one devotee was telling them, you people have offended devotees, you people have been offending these devotees for long time, please,…”

A man kept telling devotees not to hear a great Vaishnava because he did not wear neck beads. Krishna warned him in a dream not to disturb his devotee; he came the next day, begged forgiveness and stopped blaspheming.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:13 (auto-transcript): “I remember also one devotee this one is a devotee what he didn't he didn't understand Siddha Bhakti Nautakura. He didn't understand him. So he was discouraging other devotees. They should not go to Bhakti Nautakura. They should not attend his lecture. He's not a devotee. He's…”

children.topic: Groups name shame, ego and fear
children.note:
Group reports note not knowing how to apologise, not realising we offended, and fear of being taken for granted. In one case a devotee simply began serving the person, and the tension gradually washed away.

🎙 Maharaj at 77:58 (auto-transcript): “some of us have shared that in regards to asking for forgiveness maybe some of us don't even know how to beg for forgiveness in case we are offending another Vaisnava so some of us feel that we need to learn how to beg for forgiveness these are the signs of our ego, our…”

In the journal devotees list times Krishna protected them by not giving what they wanted. What we call no answer is his answer, because Krishna gives nothing that will harm his devotee. — “Because Krishna never said no.”

🎙 Maharaj at 84:24 (auto-transcript): “After listing right, looking at this list at a less Krishna protects me by sometimes the thing I am currently chasing that he might be protecting me from peace and instead of being frustrated I should feel happy because even even the thing we feel Krishna has not answered…”

children.topic: Wait, something better, or take it
children.note:
Krishna answers in three ways: wait until the right time, I have a better plan, or yes, take it. 'God's time is the best', but we do not wait for it; Maharaj cites a man who waited until sixty for a child.

🎙 Maharaj at 86:20 (auto-transcript): “Three ways Christian answer everything. wait have a better plan or you take it three things three ways Christian do this so we should try to understand Christian position even my traditional people say God's time is the best but we don't wait for God's time that is where the…”

A friend of Maharaj, happily heading a deity department, was told by his guru to go preaching; years later he found he was happier. Following instructions brings the best in every situation.

🎙 Maharaj at 87:47 (auto-transcript): “A guru knows that. A devotee wants to go somewhere. A guru says, no, don't go. They do this service. You know the best. By doing that, you become specific. children.topic: Go through the offended one's friend
children.note:
Some don't know how to approach the person they offended. Not asking someone who knows is false ego.

🎙 Maharaj at 89:16 (auto-transcript): “Some devotees have mentioned that they didn't know how to approach a person and whom to approach. When Indra had a serious, Indra had a serious love for the Lord Kirsten and he knew that what he did was really, very, very disturbing, Indra didn't go directly. He went to Loh…”

After offending Krishna, Indra went to Brahma, who sent him to Surabhi. When Krishna saw Surabhi he smiled, and the matter was over before Indra could speak. — “we should ask people who knows.”

🎙 Maharaj at 89:33 (auto-transcript): “When Indra had a serious, Indra had a serious love for the Lord Kirsten and he knew that what he did was really, very, very disturbing, Indra didn't go directly. children.note:
The offending brahmana was sent by Mahaprabhu to Srivasa; another offender went to Brahma, Shiva, Narada and finally Narayana, and was sent back to the devotee, who said he had been waiting all along and was not offended.

Hey, my son is here. He needs a job. That position. Can I keep it? Please tell him to come. That's all. So her son…”

Questions from the chat and from devotees present.

🎙 Maharaj at 93:37 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna, Guru Dev. There is one realization from Raksha Bhatmataji in the child box. She's mentioned, Hare Krishna, my dear Srila Gurudev, please accept my most humble obeisances unto your lotus feet. Gurudev, my reflections are that personally with me what happened is…”

What should a devotee do when hurt by what the managers say?

🎙 Question from the floor at 94:21 (auto-transcript): “He's asking, if from management, if they are telling something to the devotee and the devotee gets hurt, then what should we do? If the man is telling us something, we get hurt by what they are telling us? Yes, Guruji. Yes, Guru, there. So, well, it depends on that thing…”

First see whether the hurt comes from our own ego — as when corrected for coming late. If they are wrong but it does not stop our chanting and service, forget it; if it does, seek advice and address it properly.

🎙 Maharaj at 94:57 (auto-transcript): “So, well, it depends on that thing they're telling you that you get hurt. Maybe we are getting hurt because of our ego or because the manager, they are wrong. Which one? My ego may make me to get hurt because he told me that this morning, I came late on the program, so he…”

My mind says I'm right and that apologising again will let people take me for granted. Should I take my stand?

🎙 Question from the floor at 96:41 (auto-transcript): “One question. Hare Krishna Maharaj. Please accept my humble obeisance Maharaji, when some disagreement happens with non-devotees, my mind always gives reasoning why I am right. And when I humbly apologize to confront, my mind says, how many times apologize and what if they…”

Saying sorry a hundred times costs nothing and builds humility. Holding our stand only expands the problem; a humble, tolerant person is protected and never truly taken for granted. — “Don't listen to your mind.”

🎙 Maharaj at 97:10 (auto-transcript): “Don't listen to your mind. Don't listen to your mind. the mind will always talk nonsense don't mind, don't mind the mind neglect the mind if you if you offend somebody a hundred times, say a hundred times sorry, do not remove one hair from your body rather it will give you a…”

Refusing to apologise has broken marriages, relationships and even empires; even demons spare one who says sorry. Srila Prabhupada and Maharaj's own spiritual master said sorry many times, and Maharaj recalls a Vrindavan pastime where Krishna apologised to his pujari.

🎙 Maharaj at 99:21 (auto-transcript): “we have mentioned many times that many people never say sorry and so as devotees their life is very dangerous not to say sorry very dangerous position so we should say sorry and we have said how destructive this mentality I'm not saying sorry, yes. How does someone who never realises his mistakes come to accept correction?

🎙 Question from the floor at 102:20 (auto-transcript): “Shilagurudev, um one of my questions was when you were mentioning um about uh some of ours are very unfortunate and we are cursed actually to be never um getting some message or the corrections like uh today's cases all the people we saw they were like grossly very very…”

Such people have been told; they are stubborn. When we suffer enough for our nonsense, Krishna shows compassion. Shiva once dropped a gift into a beggar's hand at Parvati's request; the beggar gave it away and stayed poor, because he had not suffered enough to value it.

🎙 Maharaj at 103:12 (auto-transcript): “our nonsense, then Christians will show compassion and remove that. Then we also have the fortune to be able to respond to the correction. These people who never agreed to go and beg for forgiveness, they have been told. I give an example. One collaborator was telling me he…”

Saying 'it's my karma, I must suffer more' and skipping the programme is laziness. The whole month of Kartik celebrates just two things, effort and mercy, which Krishna teaches by example in his Damodara pastime. — “try and try.”

🎙 Maharaj at 107:44 (auto-transcript): “but one can say that yeah, it's my karma to suffer like this I don't have to struggle to challenge my karma I'm not suffering enough yet so let me continue, if I don't go into program yeah, that is okay because I say I have to suffer more that is foolishness that is…”

When a family member keeps repeating a mistake and we keep anger in the mind, is that an offence?

🎙 Question from the floor at 110:13 (auto-transcript): “Gumaraz, referring to the reflection, the discussion that was just devoted that participated. In family life, very often one member or some family member, they continue to do their mistake. They're not trying to rectify it, but they still keep on doing the same mistake. Then…”

Negativity kept in the mind matures into mental, then verbal, then gross and even fatal offences, leaving both wounded. Address it maturely, forget it, or keep your distance. — “it will become a mental offense”

🎙 Maharaj at 111:13 (auto-transcript): “it's an offense because when we keep things in the mind negatively it will continue to progress it will be maturing it will be progressing negatively it will become an offense it will become a mental offense it will become verbal offense and it will become gross offense it…”

Times are complicated, so make the best of a bad bargain: if it is truly needed, a wife may help for a time by agreement. Maharaj rebuked a man who would marry only a working wife — that is business, not marriage. — “It should not be a force.”

children.topic: Q6 · A non-devotee mother disturbs me
children.note:
Misunderstandings with my mother ruin my whole day and I can't remember Krishna. How to overcome this?

🎙 Question from the floor at 117:50 (auto-transcript): “the daily activities we will be spiritually we will be progressing nicely and suddenly the interactions comes and there is some like a major like a balcony it will be Rais Maharaj so in that situation the day itself will be totally collapsed so in the devotee side it's not an…”

nodeData.topic: Session 18 · Rupa Kaviraja's Fall from Bhava
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj tells how Rupa Kaviraja, an empowered speaker already at the stage of bhava, let a seed of envy grow when the assembly honoured Krishnapriya Thakurani, whose tongue never stopped chanting — and lost his empowerment, preached a bogus philosophy, died of leprosy and became a ghost. He warns against repeating sins after initiation and against scholarly pride that dismisses simple devotees. In the questions he speaks on behaviour in the dham, over-checking for offences, false accusation, true humility, public displays of 'ecstasy', envy and the restless mind. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Rupa Kaviraja was a powerful scholar blessed by great devotees, whose explanations enthralled the Vaishnavas.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:33 (auto-transcript): “once there was a great scholar and devotee called who had also been blessed by and other great pure and advanced devotees he was a powerful pundit and sastry the vajstamas were enthralled when he would explain the philosophy of Krishna consciousness that's what happened…”

To be empowered is to be invested with extra energy beyond our own strength, so that we can do what is beyond our ability. — “beyond our ability and we can act in a wonderful way”

🎙 Maharaj at 20:01 (auto-transcript): “that's what happened that's the meaning of empowerment and when he's empowered means what we have been invested with extra energy beyond our own strength it's not we have been invested energy have been added to us a vision a vision a vision we've been powered a special…”

He was no neophyte or intermediate devotee but at the stage of bhava, where sinful reactions are already gone, just one step from prema. Maharaj stresses that until prema one must still be very careful not to spoil all one's effort through an offence.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:39 (auto-transcript): “He's not on the Bremer stage. He had not reached the Bremer. But he was just one step, only one step before. entering. So it's on the power stage. Very, very, very high. Very, very high. We are here to let us understand how dangerous a power is. That even on this level of…”

children.topic: A seed of envy in the assembly
children.note:
As he spoke on the Bhagavatam one could feel his spiritual master's presence. When Krishnapriya Thakurani entered and the devotees honoured her, he ignored her and threw himself harder into his talk.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:01 (auto-transcript): “It was said that when the Rupa Kavala Goswami is speaking, one can see the manifestation, the presence of the spiritual master speaking to him. As we mentioned, the experience one always has, when the empowerment is what's on it. So one could feel it. often feel that his good…”

He resented the respect going to someone else — 'why has she come to disturb my class?' Maharaj marks this as where the contamination began. — “So that was the beginning of the contamination”

🎙 Maharaj at 25:41 (auto-transcript): “Robert Kaviraj was not happy because he felt the envy of giving respect to someone else instead of him. He felt that. So that was the beginning of the contamination, the seed of contamination he planted. just by the presence of Christian Priyata Kureni and the respect she…”

A speaker on the vyasasana need not rise for others, except for his own spiritual master. But she stood on the platform of prema, above him, and was neglected because she had a woman's body.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:09 (auto-transcript): “When it is on the asana, one doesn't have to get down to offer respect to someone who has also come inside. But if one spiritual master enters, one must get down from the person of a respectful of the senses. And in this case, Rupa Kavari is on the platform. Christian Pranip…”

She had come only to hear, for one in prema never tires of hearing about Krishna. Her one 'fault' was that her tongue chanted the holy name softly day and night, even while eating and sleeping. — “She cannot stop chanting.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:02 (auto-transcript): “She only came to hear. Because as a pure devotee, she can hear. She can hear from anybody. Because a sign of Krishna Pramita is that one is not tired of hearing of Krishna. One is not tired of hearing of Krishna. Krishna Pramita currently has one fault. Only one fault. A…”

children.topic: Pure devotees do everything at once
children.note:
When he rebuked her she humbly apologised and asked him to continue. Conditioned souls cannot hear two things at once, but a pure devotee can hear, chant and see together. No one else even heard her chanting; only his envy did, and he shouted at her to be quiet.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:28 (auto-transcript): “A condition, so some of us conditions, although we have two ears, we cannot hear two things at the same time. But that is not with the pure devotion. Christian Prima Takurani can hear and can chant. She can see. She can do everything. at once because it's on the brain level.…”

Scorning her as a sentimental woman, he went on speaking — but no longer from his guru's empowerment. The ripe fruit of envy makes one unfit for anything auspicious; this is Radha-sunya, the absence of Srimati Radharani's blessing. — “Now it is coming from envy.”

🎙 Maharaj at 35:04 (auto-transcript): “Now he cannot speak again because the envy has germinated and is producing results now. So whatever I will speak now, it's not coming from the empowerment of the spiritual master and other exalted. Now it is coming from envy. When the seed of envy grows and becomes mature,…”

He began teaching that only sannyasis can be gurus, though Nityananda, Advaita Acarya and Srinivasa Acarya were householders — Srinivasa and Advaita with two wives each — and had many exalted disciples.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:08 (auto-transcript): “Srinivas Acharya has married two wives, not even one, but two. He has two wives. And he has so many disciples. Adwita Acharya, many disciples. two wives also many disciples two wives many disciples two wives all of them back to North Dakota he was going for two wives he also…”

Offence is like an investor pulling his capital out of a company: it can no longer pay its workers and crumbles. Likewise Indra became ordinary when his guru Brihaspati's mercy left him, and the demons, noticing, defeated him.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:09 (auto-transcript): “Yes, this is, now one is eating the fruit of envy. This is what will happen. One becomes completely depleted. Intelligence is gone. The empowerment, the empowerment, that empowerment, that investment is taken away. Adashunya. The investments have been withdrawn. Like someone…”

children.topic: What will you remember without hearing?
children.note:
He claimed hearing and chanting were unnecessary and only remembrance mattered — the argument of ordinary jnanis. But to remember or meditate one must first hear about the object. — “What will one remember?”

🎙 Maharaj at 39:53 (auto-transcript): “This is what the Gyanis do. Now he has come back to ordinary Gyanis. No more a Baba Bhakta. Not a Baba Bhakta. Now he's just a Gyanis. Their argument is that chanting and hearing is inferior to remembering. But they forgot that. What will you remember if you don't hear? What…”

children.topic: Leprosy, a ghost, and fame that precedes
children.note:
He became a sahajiya, justified himself more and more, died of leprosy and became a ghost. Wherever he ran, the news of his offences arrived first, just as a pure devotee's fame runs ahead of him; as a ghost he haunted those who offend Vaishnavas, as atonement.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:58 (auto-transcript): “He's now speculating. Wherever he goes, before he... Okay, now, I have been identified as a fallen soul. So he ran away from one place. before you go to the place he's going, his news has already been waiting for him there. As soon as he gets the people, oh, this is Rupa…”

Mahaprabhu took Jagai and Madhai's sins and his body turned dark; after their bath in the Ganges he ordered them never to repeat their old life. Maharaj calls this the instruction for every initiated devotee.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:27 (auto-transcript): “a ghost and his service was to hunt those persons who offended Vaishnavas. So it's somehow Mahaprabhu said that after he took all the sinful activities of Jaga and Madai, and then he asked devotees, how am I looking like? Lord Adhita says, oh, you are now Shama Sundara. Grace…”

One repeated sin brings back the memory of all the others, and Mahaprabhu sends Jagai and Madhai's sins to those who blaspheme devotees. That load is why we struggle to keep principles, chant our rounds and keep vows.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:11 (auto-transcript): “So we should be careful so that we don't start having difficulties, while we don't make advancement in our Christian consciousness, it's because of offenses. and Chitam Ho is sending the sinful activities of Jagad Madai to us so that load is weighing us down that we have…”

The Lord revealed himself to devotees who were free of offence, fully convinced and faithful. If it is not happening to us, either scripture and the acaryas are wrong or we are — the lack is in our faith. — “We don't have confidence, we don't have the faith.”

🎙 Maharaj at 48:57 (auto-transcript): “you have to have faith and be fully convinced that what our chariots and the scripture are teaching are perfect and complete. Otherwise, if anyone of us say that I am fully convinced and I have faith and free from offenses and then nothing is revealed to us, it means that the…”

The reflection asks: does my knowledge or position make me feel superior to simple devotees, have I called someone sentimental who was more absorbed than me, and if he could fall from bhava, how vulnerable am I?

🎙 Maharaj at 52:13 (auto-transcript): “Examining our own scholarly pride and dismissiveness, ten minutes, personal contemplation, policy-based devotion. Do I ever feel that my knowledge, my service, or my position makes me superior to simple devoting? Have I ever thought someone was merely sentimental when they…”

A group reports that new devotees, often less offensive, feel genuine emotion for Krishna as special mercy; seniors who call it sentimentality should instead feel happy and correct themselves.

🎙 Maharaj at 72:35 (auto-transcript): “In regards to the first question, one devotee shared that for new devotees that are coming to the movement, it is common to see their amazement and awe with Krishna. and sometimes some of us who were in the movement for longer might feel this is mere sentimentalism whereas it…”

Pure devotees never feel accomplished. Brahma had knowledge yet could not understand Krishna; Vyasadeva had compiled the Vedas yet was despondent; neither Jiva Gosvami nor Srila Prabhupada called himself accomplished. — “it is empty boasting”

🎙 Maharaj at 86:37 (auto-transcript): “I feel spiritually accomplished. Pure devotees never feel accomplished. Of course, Babakita, I guess I use that word. Babakita, 4.30. that is those who have attained success and knowledge, but still, we see that there are many devotees who have full knowledge. Brahma has…”

children.topic: The proud scholar and the boy
children.note:
Keshava Kashmiri nearly died of shame when defeated by a boy and cried to Sarasvati; she told him the 'boy' was her master and he should take his shelter. Those who feel spiritually accomplished are doomed to fail.

🎙 Maharaj at 89:11 (auto-transcript): “Keshavakasmi almost died he almost died he cried to Saraswati. Why do you describe me before a boy? Why not a man? He almost died. Saraswati had to chastise him until he distant to me. That person you are calling a boy is my master. Better go and take his shelter. So, and we…”

What we are absorbed in when alone and not performing reveals our state. Looking honestly, Maharaj says, many of us find we are mostly not Krishna conscious inside. — “Our internal dialogue is negative.”

🎙 Maharaj at 90:29 (auto-transcript): “and check carefully, we see that we are 99%, some of us, 99% not Krishna conscious. Our internal dialogue is negative. Part two, the reflection plan, five minutes. Approaching those who are dismissed, choose one simple devotee whose devotion is undervalued. This week,…”

Questions from devotees present and from the chat.

children.note:

🎙 Question from the floor at 92:47 (auto-transcript): “Gurudev, my question is that how an exalted devotee like Rup Kaviraj who is in Bhava stage he still has envy in his heart because any devotee can reach on the level of Bhava when he finished all his unearth nivritti completely then only he can reach on that so how a devotee…”

children.note:
It is a rare, extreme case recorded to show how dangerous offences are; until prema we are still at risk and must be careful. — “So this is an extreme case.”

🎙 Maharaj at 93:31 (auto-transcript): “uh there are situations there are situations we call extreme case extreme extreme case not normal this is an extreme case that in history you don't see many people don't bother as far as i know it's only people i know in the whole uh it's only people like i remember there is…”

children.topic: Q2 · How to behave in the dham
children.note:
What attitude brings the full mercy of the dham? Maharaj says to cultivate the mood of the devotees discussed earlier, like Jiva Gosvami, before even setting out: 'I am not going to an ordinary place.'

🎙 Question from the floor at 95:28 (auto-transcript): “Yes, Gurudev my second question is that when you are discussing the topic of offenses to the holy dham, then you mentioned that first offense is to offend your spiritual master who reveals the dham so my question is that knowingly or unknowingly every one of us do some kind…”

In 1997 Maharaj and a godbrother climbed to Barsana while boys pulled at them for money all the way. He said nothing but grew angry inside, could not pray and left; afterwards he was warned not to think the place ordinary, and learned his lesson. — “In my mind, I was angry.”

🎙 Maharaj at 98:32 (auto-transcript): “So two of us, we went and we climbed all the steps and climbed and climbed and got there. As soon as we started climbing, our test started. More than 10 boys left and right, dragging hand, dragging shirt, money, money, money. I was tolerating. so I'm going to see some…”

Asked about pushing away begging children, Maharaj says not to do it. Even a mental reaction there is an offence; we are fortunate to be warned before it grows into a chronic disease. — “Quietly go your way.”

🎙 Maharaj at 103:36 (auto-transcript): “I just mentioned. So, it's not doing like that. So, Guru Deh, what should we do if they are very much begging? Just quietly go your way. Quietly go your way. But Guru Deh, they are continuously pinching us. So, break their hand and go to hell. Break their hand and go to hell.…”

Going through the day suspecting offences is useless. The series aims to understand the danger so we can avoid it; we become what we meditate on, so check yourself and do the right thing. — “If we meditate on offenses, then we become offenses.”

🎙 Maharaj at 107:16 (auto-transcript): “are over checking ourselves if you are going to go the whole day thinking I will make an offense okay I two percent on this one I'm feeling very sleepy oh Oh, I've offended somebody. That is useless. That is useless. We are becoming conscious of the aparada and not into the…”

🎙 Question from the floor at 109:17 (auto-transcript): “Maharaj, my question is from yesterday. For instance, if you are, you are accused wrongly like severely uh i'll give an example like when we give a class about lashman and ram when ram went to the bush and he uh lashman want to take off uh sita and he accused him that oh you…”

children.topic: Accept it, let time defend you
children.note:
Don't justify or explain; accept it as past karma and thank Krishna, and you are purified. Haridasa Thakura would not curse such a person. Time will prove you right. — “let the time prove it”

🎙 Maharaj at 111:12 (auto-transcript): “Don't break your head. Don't break anybody's head. Just accept it whatever it is I didn't do it this lifetime but I was done in the past and now it has come thank you Krishna don't justify don't try to explain just accept it you get purified by that but Maharaj the question…”

How to remove hidden pride behind outward humility?

🎙 Question from the floor at 113:12 (auto-transcript): “like a question from Vaishali Mataji is Hare Krishna Maharaj sometimes we are humble outside but feeling superior inside, we may say but internally somewhere the pride is there how we should eliminate this kindly enlightened Maharaj that is not humble that is not humble a…”

That is not humility but false pride, which one day explodes. A servant must be a servant inside too; that is Krishna consciousness and character. — “Character is power.”

🎙 Maharaj at 113:32 (auto-transcript): “that is not humble that is not humble a person who is humble will be eastern and outside it's true humility will be eastern and outside that is false ego do you know how humble I am can you see you are doing nonsense you are so whimsical how much I am very humble that is not…”

A newcomer at a Sunday feast shook and beat her head on the deity's feet until she bled. Was it wrong to call it sahajiya?

🎙 Question from the floor at 116:35 (auto-transcript): “So, Gurudev, Mataji is saying that one day on Sunday Feast, there was a Mataji who came with her Laddu Gopal and also she do not chant and she is very new to scorn also but she started dancing and by calling Prabhu and Prabhu she started shivering also and she started beating…”

Neither the Gosvamis nor Srila Prabhupada behaved like that; Mahaprabhu's ecstasies in the Gambhira were in private. Gaura Kishora dasa Babaji drove away a 'premi' who could not walk but could eat: a pure devotee no more displays prema than a chaste woman shows her body — and a true one would not have run away.

🎙 Maharaj at 117:33 (auto-transcript): “When you see Rupa Goswami, I was Goswami. When you see them go like that? Did you see our Goswami like that? They all have deities. Did you see Prabhupada like that? We don't see them. We don't see them behave like that, bringing their deity and beating their heads. Only to…”

If I still feel envy for someone Krishna keeps putting before me, should I keep my distance?

🎙 Question from the floor at 124:24 (auto-transcript): “mataji you can unmute in your seat my question is how dangerous and we earlier also even knowing but today we saw it a little little that it can we can fall from the bhava stage also so my question is still we feel enviousness in ourselves like I feel enviousness for not for…”

Don't run away: do practical, physical service for the person you envy, and keep doing it, not just once, and you will be purified. — “you should go and do physical service”

🎙 Maharaj at 125:30 (auto-transcript): “you go and serve the person you should go and do physical service for that person you envy you should do physical service for that person you will get purified it's not running away you have to do something practical to do that do service that I try to do I try to do yes you…”

My mind creates offensive pictures while I try to meditate. How to overcome this? A second question asks how to replace the urge to be master with the mood of a servant.

🎙 Question from the floor at 126:49 (auto-transcript): “Please accept my most humble obituary. My question is, how can we overcome the offenses cursed by mind something like happen it happens with me single that i try to meditate on something else but the crooked mind it creates some other picture i get i really feel frustrated…”

Ignore the mind and engage it practically in planning services. It took ages to make the mind this way, so tolerate the results joyfully, pray for strength and persist; Krishna releases us when he sees sincerity. As Rupa Gosvami says, be patient but enthusiastic.

🎙 Maharaj at 127:34 (auto-transcript): “Yes. We ignore the mind. Given the principle, we have to ignore the mind. Engaging the mind in just something practical, something physical. In the beginning of Christian consciousness, the mind has to be physically engaged in something. We have to engage in planning our…”

Is initiation in the Gaudiya Matha also in the sampradaya? Maharaj says Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati Thakura established a pure process, from which Srila Prabhupada also comes; what matters is following properly.

🎙 Question from the floor at 131:33 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna Maharaj, thank you to take my last question. I started crying. I thought maybe I couldn't able to ask my question. so my question was about initiation that when i went to kolkata maharat so when i was preaching there i met some devotees who were initiated from…”
