maps.title: Radha Sunya · Session 26 · Bhrigu Muni Tests the Deities

nodeData.topic: Session 26 · Bhrigu Muni Tests the Deities
nodeData.note: SB 10.89 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj tells how Bhrigu Muni tested Brahma, Shiva and Vishnu with a mental, a verbal and finally a physical offence, and how only Lord Vishnu answered with humility. The power of humility is accepting responsibility; like turning on a light that makes a thief run, increasing devotion dissolves conflict instead of fighting it. In the questions he speaks on tension with one's guru, offending people who later become devotees, and how hearing turns the goal of life into reality. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Day 26 looks at Bhrigu Muni's search for the Supreme. Sages gathered for a sacrifice could not agree whether Brahma, Shiva or Vishnu should be worshipped as supreme.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:19 (auto-transcript): “Brighamuni was deported by an assembly of sages. to make an appreciation of the three predominating deities in the universe Brahma, Shiva and Vishnu to discover which of them is supreme it is said that the great sages Narada Muni saw these great sages assembled together for a…”

A heated scriptural argument broke out, and since everyone quoted scripture no one could settle it. Narada Muni, always eager to help, proposed Bhrigu, whom he felt had some pride.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:28 (auto-transcript): “And there were a heated scriptural argument. Heated scriptural argument among the sages. And there were no conclusions because they were all quoting from Sarsus. Therefore, Narimuni, who is always interested in helping living entities. He wanted to help his brother, whom he…”

The sages declared full confidence in Bhrigu: whomever he found to be supreme, they would accept without doubt and follow exactly.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:25 (auto-transcript): “According to Chetan Bhagwat, all the sages said, we have confidence we faith in you that whomever you will come to declare as supreme we will never have any doubt about that we will follow you exactly please go we are waiting for you so now Brighamuni sorry yeah Brighamuni…”

Bhrigu first approached his own father, Brahma, without any mood of respect, and Brahma was disturbed and angered.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:06 (auto-transcript): “a mental offense He first came in contact with his father, the Brahma. In spiritual culture, respect is always offered to elders because elders pass down wisdom and serve as mentors or role models. Brugamuni approached his father, but he did not approach him in a mood of…”

In spiritual culture elders are respected because they pass on wisdom and act as role models. Maharaj asks what disrespect is: a lack of gratitude and a lack of culture. — “Disrespect is what? A lack of gratitude, a lack of culture.”

🎙 Maharaj at 21:16 (auto-transcript): “In spiritual culture, respect is always offered to elders because elders pass down wisdom and serve as mentors or role models. Brugamuni approached his father, but he did not approach him in a mood of respect. So Brahma was distinctly disturbed and angered by the disrespect,…”

Brahma is a mahajana and a teacher, so he expected his son to behave properly. Maharaj imitates the casual 'hello, daddy' many people use today and calls it real disrespect.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:08 (auto-transcript): “The woman, he said, hello, daddy. This is a real disrespect. Because many people are doing this, this. Hello, daddy. So Brahma was not expecting this. Just like even demons. Even Akashivu was not expecting from his son to be a devotee of the vision. So when he asked Prahlad…”

Every father expects his son to be the best by his own standard. Hiranyakasipu expected a demon like himself, and Prahlada's answer about taking shelter of the Lord was a death blow to him.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:24 (auto-transcript): “Just like even demons. Even Akashivu was not expecting from his son to be a devotee of the vision. So when he asked Prahlad Maharaj, his son, to tell him what is the best thing he has learned, to his surprise, Prahlad Maharaj was saying something which he never did. He never…”

Brahma wanted to kill Bhrigu but forgave him because he was his son. Bhrigu concluded that this anger showed Brahma was not the Supreme.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:42 (auto-transcript): “Brigumuni survived only because the Brahma forgave him. Well, it's my son. What should I do? It's my son. Brigumuni took notice. He didn't kill me because I'm his son. So, I don't think this is supreme. So, he has committed a mental offense to his father. Now he has come to…”

Next Bhrigu went to his brother, Lord Shiva, and spoke harshly, calling him filthy and situated in ignorance.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:19 (auto-transcript): “Now he has come to Lord Shiva, his own brother. Here he made verbal offense. Next, Brigul approached Lord Shiva and made a verbal offense. He spoke harshly, describing him as filthy, ditty, and situated in a mode of ignorance. When Brigulini came to Lord Shiva, Lord Shiva,…”

Shiva came forward to embrace his brother, but Bhrigu recoiled, mocking the ashes of dead bodies on his body. Furious, Shiva raised his trident, and only Parvati's plea that he was his brother saved Bhrigu.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:46 (auto-transcript): “When Brigulini came to Lord Shiva, Lord Shiva, seeing his brother and Amuni, the same way he's expecting his brother to be a well-behaved mune. So Lord Shiva wanted to hug him. Don't touch me, dirty smelly. Look, just look at you. Good scripture approved I want to wear. It's…”

A person can be judged by how he reacts when his ego is challenged; where there is attachment, agitation erupts. Ideal circumstances do not show how deep our commitment and understanding really are.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:01 (auto-transcript): “sometimes a judgment can be made by watching a person's reaction after his or her ego had been challenged. When there is fructive attachment, agitation would erupt. The love between spouses is not shown as much when everything is going well, but more so when the face of evil.…”

children.topic: Who stays when things go bad
children.note:

children.note:

maps.title: Radha Sunya · Session 27 · Mother Sachi's Offence

nodeData.topic: Session 27 · Mother Sachi's Offence
nodeData.note: Caitanya Bhagavata · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. During the Mahaprakasa pastime Caitanya Mahaprabhu gave prema to everyone but refused his own mother, Sachi, because in her mind she had called Advaita Acharya 'Dvaita' for drawing her sons away. Maharaj stresses that unspoken thoughts are recorded by the Supersoul and in time become words and actions, and shows how Sachi was rectified by taking the dust of Advaita's feet. In the questions he explains why we suffer, how to help a wayward mother, and how to stop offensive thoughts at the level of the mind. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: Mahaprakasa: prema for all but Sachi
children.note:

children.note:
If thoughts become words and then actions, how do we reject them at the level of the mind?

🎙 Question from the floor at 97:10 (auto-transcript): “So, in the lecture you have mentioned that from the mind, it comes to the words and one day it will come to the action. So, how to reject that thoughts, Maharaj, from the mind level itself? A devotee will practice rejecting all the offerings of the mind by engaging the mind…”

We may not have the power simply to stop thinking, but we can engage the mind in hearing and talking about Krishna and planning devotional service. Keep repeating a negative thought about someone and one day you will say it to them. — “That's how we'll change it.”

🎙 Maharaj at 97:27 (auto-transcript): “A devotee will practice rejecting all the offerings of the mind by engaging the mind in planning about Krishna conscious activities. We don't have the power to today, no more. We cannot do like that. But we can engage the mind in spiritual activities by not keeping thinking…”

Thinking the other person cannot hear our thoughts is a mistake; the Supersoul hears and arranges for them to come out. What we constantly meditate on becomes our future — this society exists to transform the mind into Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 99:08 (auto-transcript): “so you're not going to respond. In Krishna, since the super soul is hearing, it is the super soul who arrange it and one day it will come out so we should not keep those things in the mind and we have discussed many times if we keep them in the mind we are culturing nations…”

Tomorrow ends Bhishma Pancaka and Kartik, with the rasa-lila festival. Maharaj asks everyone to cook sweet rice and leave it under the moon overnight.

🎙 Maharaj at 101:30 (auto-transcript): “Tomorrow is the last day of Bishma Panchakar, the end of Karatek. A wonderful, a wonderful celebration, like Tulsi, Viva Ha, Salagam Sila, Bishma Day of Living, the material was for spiritual world, Numbaraka Acharya, and Rasa Lila. rasalila rasalila goes with sweet rice so i…”

Tired after the rasa dance, Krishna and the gopis will enjoy it; Maharaj wants to see their finger marks in the remnants. He playfully warns that forgetting will earn a punishment, and recalls Mother Yasoda's loving cooking for her son. — “i want all of you to make sweet rice for krishna”

🎙 Maharaj at 102:04 (auto-transcript): “rasalila rasalila goes with sweet rice so i want all of you to make sweet rice for krishna and i want to see after tomorrow morning krishna's lotus fingers inside the sweet rice because that is the way we offer we'll offer you from the mind Oh, cookie, put it under the moon.…”

maps.title: Radha Sunya · Session 28 · Perfecting the Yajna

nodeData.topic: Session 28 · Perfecting the Yajna
nodeData.note: Mahabharata · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. On the last day of the series Maharaj tells how the bell at Yudhisthira's great sacrifice would not ring because Draupadi had mentally criticised a simple Vaishnava brahmana's way of eating. However perfect our arrangements, success depends on pleasing Krishna and on the quality of our relationships; offences withdraw from our spiritual bank account faster than we deposit. In a long question session he explains why mental offences still count, how faith grows, and what a real service attitude is — love, not salary. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
As Maharaj relates from the Mahabharata, at the close of Yudhisthira's great Rajasuya sacrifice a bell in the arena was to ring by itself to show that everything was perfect. The ceremony ended, but the bell stayed silent.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:22 (auto-transcript): “The bell did not ring. The Mahabharata described how Yudhisthira Maharaj was once performing a very elaborate Sahaja Shuiar sacrifice. At the close of the Yagya, something very special was expected to happen. A bell situated in the center of the arena was supposed to ring of…”

Pale with anxiety — an imperfect sacrifice can bring inauspiciousness — Yudhisthira turned to Krishna. Krishna said one party had not been honoured: a humble, pure, simple, austere Vaishnava brahmana.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:45 (auto-transcript): “Krishna's Diagnosis Yerusha was shocked and pale. And turning to Krishna, he called out, Hey Govinda, what happened? Krishna looked at him in a very grave way and said that all the parties meant to be honoured and served, and the sacrifice had not been honoured and served.”

Arjuna found such a brahmana in a hut in a nearby village. He declined to come to so much pomp, until he heard that Krishna would be there and saw a chance for darshan.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:52 (auto-transcript): “Arjuna, upon hearing this, immediately tried to find such a Brahmana Vaisnava. He ran to a nearby village and in a little hut found a very pure Brahmana, who he then invited to the Grand Raja Surya ceremony. The Vaislama Brahmana was not interested in being around so much…”

Draupadi cooked a wonderful feast for the brahmana, yet after he ate the bell still did not ring. Krishna explained that someone in the family had offended him.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:06 (auto-transcript): “Dhopadhi's mental offense. At the Jagya, they worshipped the Brahmana. Dhopadhi made a wonderful feast. And after the Brahmana had eaten, they bailed stilt in notary. Now Yudhisthva was really in anxiety. Hey, Govinda, what shall I do? What happened? Krishna explained that.”

As part of his austerity the brahmana always mixed all his food together, and he did the same with Draupadi's gorgeous, carefully arranged plate.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:05 (auto-transcript): “The Brahmana had an unusual habit that went hand in hand with his austerities. Whatever he ate, he made all the preparations together. Even though Draupadi had prepared a gorgeous plate of food, he still followed his usual practice. Although he made an opulent and aromatic…”

After so much effort Draupadi thought: this uncultured village man is mixing everything up. That mental offence blocked the perfection of the sacrifice.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:14 (auto-transcript): “Doppadi, after so much elaborate preparation and effort, became angry when he saw his habits, thinking, this uncut village boy is merging everything together, running the mill, running the mill. What a fool, uncultured person.”

children.topic: Everything in place but one heart
children.note:
Maharaj describes how Draupadi, expert in deity worship, arranged each preparation in order, and how the brahmana mixed khichri, sweet rice, halava, sabji and puris together. The place, the ingredients and the mantras were perfect — only one person had been offended, and that was enough.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:38 (auto-transcript): “Dhopadi cooked so nice preparations and arranged them systematically. He arranged them nicely, systematically, in all different places, as you can see in the picture. He was nicely assembled, perfect, in order, because he knows how to worship deity, so he followed the deity…”

Have I judged a devotee's eating, dress or manners as uncultured? What thoughts arise, and how can I turn critical thoughts into appreciative ones? Why was Draupadi's unspoken criticism powerful enough to stop the sacrifice?

🎙 Maharaj at 24:36 (auto-transcript): “Personal Reflection Have I ever judged a devotee's eating habits, devotee's dress, or mannerisms as of cultures? What thoughts arise when I see these devotees who don't exist? How can I transform critical thought into appreciative wants?”

Arjuna begged the brahmana to return. Draupadi served an even grander feast; he mixed everything again — and when he finished, the bells rang and the devotees were in ecstasy.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:02 (auto-transcript): “thing The perfect second attempt Arjuna went back to the Brahmana and begged please He must come again. This time, Draupadi made an even more fantastic feast and placed it before the Brahmana. When he sat down, he once again mixed everything together and against fire.”

We may have so many things in place, but we must always be careful about the quality of our relationships.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:20 (auto-transcript): “The purpose is rather easy to understand. We may have so many things in place but we must always be careful about the quality of our relationships. In Kali Yuga we are not held responsible for offensive thoughts. Otherwise, we will all be finished. As a matter”

In Kali-yuga, Maharaj's text says, Krishna is lenient with offensive thoughts — otherwise we would all be finished — and gives credit for healthy thoughts even when we cannot complete the service.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:41 (auto-transcript): “not held responsible for offensive thoughts. Otherwise, we will all be finished. As a matter of fact, it is quite the opposite. In Kaluga, if we think healthy thoughts, Krishna will give us credit even if we cannot finish service. That is true. Think big, not small. This is…”

Small thinking and acting bring small results. When Krishna is pleased, miracles can and must happen beyond our intellectual or financial resources. — “Think big, not small.”

🎙 Maharaj at 53:15 (auto-transcript): “credit even if we cannot finish service. That is true. Think big, not small. This is another reason why we must be careful not to think small. If we think and act small, then there will be small results. We should try to realize that when Krishna is pleased, miracles can…”

Results that match our resources are simply good management. When results go far beyond our effort, Krishna's sakti is active; when Krishna and guru are not pleased, great effort brings diminishing returns.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:13 (auto-transcript): “resources, we can call this good management, but it's not necessarily spiritual. When there's a high level of spirituality, things happen even beyond our normal capacity and resources. It means that Krishna is coming through and the Krishna Shakti is present and active. We…”

Taking darshan, offering water to tulasi, chanting our rounds — through devotion we keep depositing credits in a spiritual bank account.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:46 (auto-transcript): “Taking inventory. We are engaging in devotion and constantly depositing and receiving credits. We take darshan, take terranalit, water to sea, and churn our arms. We should not think fructively about these activities. But by this process, we are actually building up our…”

When we commit offences against others we withdraw faster than we deposit; whatever strength we had whittles away and we become different persons, drying up where once we had taste.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:17 (auto-transcript): “As we are committing upon others, even though we are depositing, we are also withdrawing even more quickly. We started to withdraw more than we deposited. And after a while, even though we may have had the world's strength and opulence, It all whittles away and we become…”

At a low ebb, immediately investigate whether offences are making us lose focus and appreciation for what our acharyas have given.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:11 (auto-transcript): “It is so important to revisit and investigate our practice when we find ourselves at a low ebb. In our devotional service, we should immediately start taking an inventory to see if our paradigms are causing us to lose focus and appreciation for what our good and greater…”

List recent mental criticisms and turn them into appreciation; weigh deposits against withdrawals; ask what may stop the bell of success in a current project, and which relationship needs healing.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:50 (auto-transcript): “Continue your 30-day notebook with today's focus on perfecting our spiritual tagger Mental Offense Inventory 4 minutes Write about recent times you mentally criticize other devotees' habits or mannerisms Hydropody Identify thoughts how uncultured or how inappropriate commit…”

Questions from devotees on the last day of the series.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:43 (auto-transcript): “is a I'm going to do this question she's asking, because some days ago, your holiness mentioned that a devotee was saying that in this Kali Yuga, if we commit some offense in the mind, but we don't act improperly, this is not going to count so much as used to be in other…”

A devotee asks Maharaj to clarify whether offences made only in the mind count in Kali-yuga.

🎙 Question from the floor at 63:43 (auto-transcript): “is a I'm going to do this question she's asking, because some days ago, your holiness mentioned that a devotee was saying that in this Kali Yuga, if we commit some offense in the mind, but we don't act improperly, this is not going to count so much as used to be in other…”

Maharaj has already answered: Sachi said nothing aloud, only in her mind, yet the Lord declared she would not get prema until she begged Advaita's forgiveness. She is an eternal associate who came to teach us; she cannot really offend.

🎙 Maharaj at 64:32 (auto-transcript): “I did, I did already. We interrupted the past time of Sachimata. Anyone remember, we mentioned Sachimata. She didn't say anything outside to Adwita Chari. in her mind. Who says he's a dueter? For me, he's dueter Maya. He's not a dueter. He's duplicitous. That was in the mind.…”

Yudhisthira lost everything at dice to teach us not to gamble; Sita stepped out of Lakshmana's circle and suffered in Lanka to show what disobeying an instruction brings. And Krishna stayed with Yudhisthira in his palace, not with the austere yogis in the forest. — “For us, this is a teaching.”

🎙 Maharaj at 67:31 (auto-transcript): “For Advaita, Acharya, Sachi Mata, Chita Mahaprabhu, and all is associated, this is their pastime. For us, this is a teaching. Do you understand? For us, it is teaching. For them, it is a pastime. It is not a teaching. Because a teacher must know what is teaching. If you don't…”

A devotee asks, in Hindi, how to get rid of bad thoughts that come and go.

🎙 Question from the floor at 73:06 (auto-transcript): “she's asking that mentally we have these thoughts sometimes they are good sometimes they are bad but the bad thoughts how can we get rid of them mentally if mentally you get rid of them by practice only a pure devotee will be free from this thing until you become a pure…”

Only a pure devotee is free of them; they are old impressions cultivated since time immemorial. When one comes, ask Krishna's forgiveness, don't meditate on it, let it go, and keep practising until the karmic account is empty. — “until you become a pure devotee”

🎙 Maharaj at 73:17 (auto-transcript): “mentally if mentally you get rid of them by practice only a pure devotee will be free from this thing until you become a pure devotee they will come sometimes and go now what we should do is not to keep such that thumb when they come we should say ah a demon Christian please…”

A devotee confesses that her faith in Krishna consciousness, and even in Maharaj, is not yet strong, though she is trying.

🎙 Question from the floor at 75:31 (auto-transcript): “Shiloh Gurudev she's saying that she is constantly also thinking about everything you say like in one of the classes you said that our problem is that we are not Krishna consciousness and her faith is not strong yet she's also confessing that in you also her faith is still…”

Faith grows as we practise in good association. A neophyte's faith is like a candle a hand can put out; continued step by step it becomes immovable like a mountain, as the pure devotee's. — “That's how the faith comes, as we continue to practice.”

🎙 Maharaj at 76:01 (auto-transcript): “The faith continues to grow as we continue to practice. That's how the faith comes, as we continue to practice. We don't have faith for anything in this ministry. We don't have faith for anything. But when we continue to practice in good association with pure devotees, then…”

A devotee asks what a service attitude is and how to increase it. Service is what connects us to Krishna and the spiritual master — indeed it is the glue in every relationship.

🎙 Question from the floor at 77:29 (auto-transcript): “please accept my humble obeisances thank you um so what does it mean by uh sincerity of purpose is it like service attitude in whatever we do maharaj and like we're knowing why we are doing what we are doing and how we are doing is it uh the same thing uh or i mean basically…”

Both lust and love seek satisfaction; the difference is for whom. A worker who serves only for salary leaves when it stops — that is lust. A disciple who serves the spiritual master without expectation, just to please him, has love. — “for love i'm doing it for you not for me”

🎙 Maharaj at 79:15 (auto-transcript): “who is explaining the difference between the lost and love so proper give example lost and lost all of them contains the same thing all again have the same thing sanctification but lost sanctification love sanctification so what's the difference the difference is that for…”

When Mahaprabhu came to Ramakeli, the ruler heard of a crying Bengali sannyasi. A servant belittled him, but the ruler said: millions follow this man without salary — only God can do that, so let no one disturb him.

🎙 Maharaj at 80:49 (auto-transcript): “sanctification for me lost love so when a lot of time harper visited ram kelly and a push and sha now a push in the shower he got the news that one sanyasi from Bengali is here. He's always crying. Maybe he has no food to eat. He's always crying. Hunger cannot allow him to be…”

Maharaj recalls nine devotees sent to open a temple in Ibadan, Nigeria. He was the pujari; returning from sankirtan he had to pick flowers, and a godbrother always excused himself — 'that is your service.' The joy at an opportunity to serve shows a good servant.

🎙 Maharaj at 84:35 (auto-transcript): “I remember I was telling some devotees some of our sweet good memories in our bhakti days sweet good memories in our bhakti days in the good day of sent us to one city here in Nigeria. We were nine devotees. We were sent to a place called Ibadan. So we went to start the…”

Krishna told Narada only the dust of a devotee's feet would cure his headache. Others refused for fear of hell, but the gopis at once offered theirs; Narada fell silent in contemplation of what pure love is.

🎙 Maharaj at 88:12 (auto-transcript): “And Krishna was very happy that he started teaching many devotees about their life. One day, Krishna told, I'm bleeding, my head is going to split any moment from now. Why? Terrible headache. My headache is going to split now. Krishna is telling to Narada Muni. Narada Muni,…”

children.topic: Without service a devotee is dead
children.note:
In the Damodara-lila the boiling milk, seeing it had no service, wanted to die. Love is action: 'can I do it tomorrow?' is lip service, and for those who don't know service, it feels like punishment. Jatayu fought Ravana knowing he would lose, and left his body in glorious service.

🎙 Maharaj at 91:34 (auto-transcript): “We're talking about Damodara Lila. We're talking about Damodara Lila. Not in this class. It's outside the class. Moraya Soda was boiling the milk on the fire. And when Krishna came and was sucking the breast milk, there was a serious competition that the milk, Moraya Soda's…”

Three more questions, from Zoom and the chat.

🎙 Maharaj at 98:17 (auto-transcript): “Gurudev, what we have done first, when we are connected to the scorn like when we have seen someone eating or wearing style which we have seen and because of what we have done so how will we be able to do that? Hare Krishna. Thank you, Mataji. Srila Gurudev, she's asking that…”

children.topic: Q5 · Offences from my early days
children.note:
How can we be free of offences made in our first days in ISKCON, judging how people ate or dressed?

🎙 Question from the floor at 98:41 (auto-transcript): “Srila Gurudev, she's asking that in the initial days in ISKCON, we have made offences when it came to seeing people, the way they eat or dress. But those happened in the past. But how can we get rid of those past offences? She repents. Repentance. She repents and prays the…”

Repent and pray to the deities for forgiveness: we did not know, now by your mercy we understand; please take this away. A repentant heart is a very powerful purification.

🎙 Maharaj at 98:58 (auto-transcript): “She repents. Repentance. She repents and prays the deities for forgiveness. This we didn't ignore and we don't know Because we don't know all these things We have misbehaved Now, by your mercy, you are letting us understand all these things So we are grateful, we are thankful…”

children.topic: Q6 · Enthusiastic only when you visit?
children.note:
When Maharaj visits India devotees are eager for service, then become lax after he leaves. Is that purification or show?

🎙 Question from the floor at 101:25 (auto-transcript): “Shrila Gurudev, she's asking that every time you come for a yatra to India, we are all very enthusiastic, we're all very happy, we're all always up for services. but when as soon as you leave and when we go back home we become laid back but on the other hand even mindfully…”

children.topic: Practise when the teacher is absent
children.note:
It is purification either way; only its quality differs. A good student keeps practising when the teacher is not physically present — that is why the notebook was kept every day, to stay connected rather than living a Sunday-only spirituality. — “You should remain devoted all the time.”

🎙 Maharaj at 102:16 (auto-transcript): “Purification, whether you do it, anyhow, it is purification. The only difference is the quality of the purification is to make the difference. Otherwise, it's purification. So, a good student, So, learn when the spiritual master, the teacher is there, you should learn when…”

What can we do when we feel offensive towards management whose decisions go against us?

🎙 Question from the floor at 104:53 (auto-transcript): “he's asking what can we do when we have offensive mindset towards the management when the decisions are not in our favor? It is it is the nature of condition shows that anything that doesn't go with our ego, we don't we don't value we don't appreciate it, we don't look at it…”

The conditioned ego dislikes whatever goes against it. Since we cannot change their decision, do not disturb yourself or offend them; no one took the holy name from you. Advancing, we will see the same things differently. — “Let me do the right thing.”

🎙 Maharaj at 105:07 (auto-transcript): “It is it is the nature of condition shows that anything that doesn't go with our ego, we don't we don't value we don't appreciate it, we don't look at it nice Well, there's something we can do. There's something we can always do at all times. Either the judgment is favorable…”

Maharaj asks who cooked sweet rice for the rasa-lila and whether Krishna's fingers were seen in it; one who only tasted it is told that means Krishna ate it. He thanks everyone for their offering and asks them to continue forever.

🎙 Maharaj at 107:03 (auto-transcript): “and we should do it did you cook your should rise yes how many of us did i sent you a photo you know what what's up how was it tasty did you see christian's hands on it getting soft did you see no i couldn't see oh how was the test taste only okay that means yeah krishna ate…”

nodeData.topic: Session 29 · Gratitude and Transformation Offerings
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. The first of two closing sessions is a festival of gratitude: lamps and garlands for Maharaj, the Radhikastakam, and devotees' offerings describing how the series uprooted hidden offences and taught them to beg forgiveness, stay humble and value relationships. A recording of Bhakti Tirtha Swami's 'beggar' meditation is played, the service teams are thanked, and Maharaj closes by thanking everyone and praying that all will see their promotion in Krishna consciousness. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
The session opens with every devotee on screen offering a ghee lamp to Maharaj together.

🎙 Maharaj at 00:00 (auto-transcript): “Offer your Ghee Lamps and we request the devotees who came forward and all the devotees as well, please feel welcome. Let's light our Ghee Lamps and offer it. Hare Krishna.”

Devotees who made or bought garlands come forward on screen to offer them for Maharaj's pleasure.

🎙 Maharaj at 02:40 (auto-transcript): “We would like also to call the devotees who would like to offer you gallons, please. Dear Vishwan Barthar Burjee, Hari Lila Mataji, and Dear Rupashan Mataji, come forward. and all those devotees who would like to join, please bring your own sweet garlands for the pleasure of…”

The garlands are received with appreciation for the beautiful world of devotees and their nice garlands.

🎙 Maharaj at 03:35 (auto-transcript): “Beautiful world. Beautiful. Wonderful people. Very great. Nice garland. Thank you. Nice. Thank you so much, dear beloved devotees for the wonderful garlands. So now, dear devotees, we would like you to invite you to also recitate along while Mataji will recite.”

A devotee sings the Radhikastakam, eight verses glorifying Srimati Radharani, and its translation is read; each verse ends with the prayer to be given the service of her lotus feet.

🎙 Maharaj at 04:28 (auto-transcript): “I would like to kindly call Her Grace Madhuri Manjuri Mataji to please recite the most beautiful Radhikashtakam for all of us. Hare Krishna, dear Gurudev. Please accept my most respectful obeisances at your divine lotus feet. we are humbly attempting to offer this small…”

The prayer is introduced as Krishnadasa Kaviraja Gosvami's, from the Govinda-lilamrta.

🎙 Maharaj at 04:53 (auto-transcript): “by Krishnagas Kavirajpur Swami Prabhupada from the book Govinda Leela Amrita Shukar Shahri Stava All Glories to you, All Glories to His Holiness Bhakti Tiddha Swam Maharaj All Glories to Guru Parampara Thank you Kunku Mata Kanchanab Jagar Vahari Gaurabha Pita nanchi tap…”

The host explains why this prayer opens the day: the series is Radha Sunya, and Radharani is the mistress who can free us from aparadhas and fill us with her mercy.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:27 (auto-transcript): “Dear devotees, I'm very sorry, I forgot to remind you that this prayer is connected to our Radha Shulia series, glorifying the mistress who can make us completely devoid of our paradise and filled with all her mercy. Devotees share three-minute gratitude offerings. One recalls Maharaj saying the key is what matters in a house — without it the house is useless.

By his mercy they were given the golden key of japa and the maha-mantra, to escape birth and death and go back to Godhead, and one family across opposite sides of the world.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:46 (auto-transcript): “once you said what is important in a house is the key without the key the house is useless by your by your costless mercy we give us the shelter to your divine lotus feet and give us the precious golden key which is your japa and maha mantra to escape birth and death so that…”

The devotee learned how to stay away from offences, to ask forgiveness even when in the right, and to be humble and compassionate with devotees and non-devotees — and thanks Maharaj for chastisement that purifies.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:31 (auto-transcript): “A lot has been digested and learned, especially how to stay away from offenses and how to ask for forgiveness even if I am right and how to be humble, love and compassion towards devotees and non-devotees thank you dear for your questless mercy thank you for your chastisment…”

Another devotee calls the series a deep cleansing that turned over a stone-like heart to reveal weeds, moss and dirt beneath — mental offences long dismissed as mere impressions. She realised she had read about the ten offences but never understood them.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:23 (auto-transcript): “um Radha Sunya this uh last uh few days of Radha Sunya this hardcore deep-rooted cleansing program has really turned my heart art stone-like heart around only to find there's so much weeds and moss and dirt under it um so many years we are living uh I am living with these…”

As Krishna killed demons in Vrindavan and Balarama ploughs with his plough, Maharaj showed the demons in the mind and pulled out the weeds so the bhakti-lata seed can be sown in a clean heart.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:10 (auto-transcript): “how Krishna is killing the demons during his Vrindavan past times just like that you Srila Gurudev are showing us who are these demons in our minds and hearts and then expertly guiding us to remove them and then how Balaram he has the plow and how he is going to be how he is…”

One devotee prayed silently to be able to ask her question when the session was closing, and Maharaj smiled and allowed two more questions; she felt he hears her prayers.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:12 (auto-transcript): “we can wind up here and then you sweetly smiled and said another two questions we can go and I could ask my question and then I really understood you you could hear my heart whenever I'm praying every day you could hear all my prayers and I when I was writing this I…”

She recalls a story of a devotee who only obtained Ramanujacharya's signature and yet attained the Lord. With weak sadhana, she too relies on Maharaj's blessings to go back to Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:36 (auto-transcript): “time where there was one devotee where there was one devotee known by Gullah Bhama and she was serving as she when she got to know that ramanujacharya is coming and she she was so happy she just asked to the servants can i meet once to ramanujacharya and then when she met she…”

A devotee presents a recorded song for Maharaj about a forgotten soul learning to beg and being touched by mercy; it is received as very inspiring.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:49 (auto-transcript): “like to have a presentation of a song for Pram Grudev by Matsya Prabhuji just allows one one minute to share the screen”

A second round of offerings lists lessons from the month.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:25 (auto-transcript): “Now we will have another session of gratitude by our dear universities. I would like to request you to raise your hands. Dear Vishwambharap Prabhuji, Shuddha Bhakti Mataji, and Matanmohi Nirabha Mataji, please raise your hands. Kindly inspire us with your gratitude and share…”

One devotee thanks Maharaj for opening eyes blinded by ignorance, and describes the spiritual master as the medium of the Lord's mercy for those burning in material life.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:16 (auto-transcript): “i offer my respectful obeisances unto the most my most revered and most beloved silvudev whom has opened my eyes which were blinded by the darkness of ignorance with the torch light of knowledge dear silvudev you are the given giver of divine wisdom you are the friend of…”

He learned the difference between sin and aparadha; that pride can cause a fall at any time; that offending a great Vaishnava drains spiritual potency and taste for chanting; and that disobeying the spiritual master begins the uprooting of the bhakti creeper.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:25 (auto-transcript): “i would like to follow the instruction of silburdeva i have learned that earlier i was not knowing about the difference between uh what is seen and what is abroad so i were using some places seen some places abroad i will not know miss i was not aware of that abroad how we…”

children.topic: A poem: when the bell will ring
children.note:
A devotee offers rhyming lessons: say sorry from the heart, never envy, serve selflessly, keep sadhana strong when the mind offends, treat everyone with love, and keep relationships healthy so that the bell of success rings.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:22 (auto-transcript): “Though I am very weak, but I will try to follow according to the instructions given by Sri Gurudev. So my offering goes like this. Always be ready to say sorry with feel in your heart. Never feel envy with anyone because they are also our part. Always be ready for selfless…”

Another learned that offences thought small have a deep and lasting impact, and that devotees in our own family deserve the same respectful vision we give devotees outside.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:10 (auto-transcript): “Okay. Sometimes we do not really understand what constitutes our inner offensive. We used to think that these are small mistakes that don't affect our bhakti much, but now we have learned that these offenses actually have a deep and lasting impact on our spiritual progress,…”

Devotees hear the words of Maharaj's spiritual master, Bhakti Tirtha Swami, introduced as the embodiment of a perfect beggar, praying to Lord Shyam.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:03 (auto-transcript): “Now, dear devotees, we would like to hear some words from Paramgurudev's Beggar Meditation. We would like to enter into this beautiful mood. So, our Paramgurudev is the embodiment of a perfect beggar. And he taught, he's teaching us with all of his actions how to beg. beg so…”

He begs that every word he speaks, everything he sees, hears and eats, and every thought, lead to remembrance and glorification of the Lord, calling himself a wandering, envious fool asking to be taken back home.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:17 (auto-transcript): “My dear Lord Shyam, today I, the beggar, even though I have no right, I am pleading for a moment of your attention. Please arrange that every word that comes out of my mouth, directly or indirectly, glorifies you. I am one of those who has misused his free will. I have asked…”

Having misused his free will, he gives it back and asks the Lord not to let him loose again, for given the slightest freedom he would abuse it.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:01 (auto-transcript): “I am the one who has misused his free will and has fallen into this material world, becoming a slave of my mind, body, and intelligence. I have given back my free will to you, and now I wait for your forgiveness to accept me back as a resident of the spiritual world. My dear…”

He laughs at his attempts to bribe the Lord with surface renunciation; having handed over his will, nothing else remains to renounce.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:57 (auto-transcript): “My dear Lord Shyam, please arrange that I give up all false renunciation, surrendering everything to you. Sometimes I have tried to bribe you by false renunciation. What a joke! You do not need anything from me. Even though I had renounced in the past It was all on the…”

He admits he does not fully mean his submissions and begs to be allowed to mean them, accepting even rejection if it pleases the Lord, and asking that every trace of envy be removed.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:01 (auto-transcript): “My dear Lord Shum, you have allowed me to write these submissions to you, although you know I do not really mean them fully. So just as you have allowed me to come this far, I beg you also to allow me to go so far as to mean them all. After all, I have petitioned to be your…”

Representatives thank the teams behind the month-long series, offering the credit to Srila Prabhupada, Bhakti Tirtha Swami and Maharaj.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:10 (auto-transcript): “and we will make a quick thankful session to credit all the devotees who contributed. We will have representative devotees here with us. So I would like to ask you to just raise your hands and start joining us. So for the Bajans team, we have Aman Prabhuji. For the content…”

A team met weekly to choose songs matching each lecture's theme and the day's festival, and a group of singers offered them.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:41 (auto-transcript): “Our heartfelt thanks to the Bhajan Selection team who carefully searched for the songs carrying the perfect mood and message as per the theme of the lecture, coupled with the festivals, if any, on that particular day. One to two meetings were held every week Where the…”

Earlier in the year Maharaj chose the book Radha Sunya; a content team reviewed it and a design team turned it into the daily slides.

🎙 Maharaj at 58:37 (auto-transcript): “So on behalf of the content creating team led by Anirudh Prabhu and Pritimaya Mataji, earlier this year, Shulukur Dev, you picked this most wonderful book, Radha Shunya. So Anirudh Prabhuji and Priti Mahi Mataji started working on it, reviewing the content. Then that was…”

The tech, MC and posting teams kept the sessions running through internet trouble, and interpreters carried the classes into Hindi and Portuguese — so that, like the holy name, these classes are heard in every town and village.

🎙 Maharaj at 62:12 (auto-transcript): “And just like the prediction of and request of Lord Chaitanya Mahabrabhu, the holy name would be chanted in every town and village. Also, Sri Lugurudev's classes can now be heard in every town and village thanks to your service. And furthermore, hopefully we will expand even…”

Maharaj thanks everyone for everything. — “I thank all of you very much for everything.”

🎙 Maharaj at 63:54 (auto-transcript): “I thank all of you very much for everything. Particularly to my Anula Prabhu. They suggested the team that worked tirelessly to bring out the hidden treasures in Radha Sunya of His Holiness, Bhatia Maharaj. And also they went into organizing all the team getting all the…”

He thanks the team that worked tirelessly to bring out the hidden treasures in Bhakti Tirtha Swami's Radha Sunya, and all who served wholeheartedly for the devotees' satisfaction.

🎙 Maharaj at 64:09 (auto-transcript): “They suggested the team that worked tirelessly to bring out the hidden treasures in Radha Sunya of His Holiness, Bhatia Maharaj. And also they went into organizing all the team getting all the devotees together we are internally grateful to all of you and all the devotees who…”

children.topic: Kartik ends on a sweet note
children.note:
No one can avoid the mercy of Kartik and of Srimati Radharani, so kind a mother. The month ended sweetly with Bhishma Pancaka and feeding Krishna and the gopis after the rasa dance — something beyond comparison in this world.

🎙 Maharaj at 65:11 (auto-transcript): “avoid you cannot avoid the mercy of kharitik the the most suspicious time of the year and the the preceding date of Karthik Simachi Radharani, who is so basically so kind, he's a great mother. And everything was ended in a very sweet note, Bishma Panchakura, and feeding…”

Maharaj is sure everyone has been promoted in Krishna consciousness and wants each of them to see it; he expresses eternal gratitude to his spiritual master.

🎙 Maharaj at 66:02 (auto-transcript): “we're sure all of you are promoted in your christian consciousness i want to see all of you want all of you to see this promotion in your christian consciousness eternally grateful to his holiness what it is we must ask very question thank you we can't thank you enough we are…”

maps.title: Radha Sunya · Session 30 · Gratitude, and Going Forward Together

nodeData.topic: Session 30 · Gratitude, and Going Forward Together
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. In the final session devotees offer lamps, garlands and heartfelt gratitude for the Radha Sunya series, and Maharaj answers each offering with a short teaching. A 'long way to go' has no meaning when Krishna is pleased; a sincere sorry brings peace; a grudge burns the one who holds it; fortune is found only among devotees, who make others fortunate; and every situation, even a problem, can be used to serve Krishna. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
The last session of Radha Sunya opens with devotees offering lamps and then garlands to Maharaj on screen.

🎙 Maharaj at 03:22 (auto-transcript): “Now we'll start and request all the devotees who are going to offer lamp, please be ready. We'll share the screen and you can offer your lamps to Shrila Gurudev. Thank you. Maybe Mataji can also call out those who have. Yeah, sure, sure. So I'll call out the names of the…”

The host explains that each lamp stands for the heart the devotee is offering; one garland is offered from Mayapur.

🎙 Maharaj at 07:13 (auto-transcript): “to Srila Gurudev lamp was indicating their hearts which they were offering to Srila Gurudev now we I think all the devotees have offered their garlands also like there were Shivdu Bhakti Mataji, Vishambar Prabhuji, Suresh Prabhuji if they are left we can have them otherwise…”

children.topic: 'A long way to go' means nothing
children.note:
The first offering thanks Maharaj for a Kartik spent with him from japa through deity worship to the evening classes — like a mother who never leaves her two-year-old, holding the finger to teach.

🎙 Maharaj at 09:06 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna, Hare Krishna to everybody. Hare Krishna, Shilagurudev, please accept my humble obeisances and to the dust of your lotus feet again and again. Thank you. Shilagurudev, I want to give you lots of thanks because before starting Kartik, you took a class to inspire…”

The devotee calls Bhakti Tirtha Swami's book a surgery without scissors, which she could never have understood alone, and says untreated offences would have spread like cancer and stopped her bhakti creeper.

🎙 Maharaj at 10:50 (auto-transcript): “First of all, I want to offer my gratitude to Param Gurudev, whose deep meditation gave us this book, which really acted like surgery without scissors. And I want to give thanks to whole team who gave us all the realization, all the meditations and gave us and prepared our…”

children.topic: Sorry even when not at fault
children.note:
Through Rupa Gosvami's example she learned that if another is offended, one should ask forgiveness even without having made a mistake — this changed her whole philosophy.

🎙 Maharaj at 11:51 (auto-transcript): “But by giving Srila Roop Goswami Paz's example, you told us, if you have not made any mistake and another person is offended, then you are also guilty. You need to ask for forgiveness. This changed my whole philosophy. By chastising me, you made me understand how my faith was…”

Maharaj replies that 'a long way to go' has no meaning in Krishna consciousness: if we please the acharyas, ten million births can become a moment. That is the purpose of austerity — to collapse the long journey and the accumulated karma into an express way back to Godhead. — “A long way to go has no meaning”

🎙 Maharaj at 14:16 (auto-transcript): “A long way to go is not it's not it has no meaning in Krishna consciousness. A long way to go has no meaning in Krishna consciousness. Because Krishna can make it now. the time we did to mokon now 10 million births became now that is christian consciousness so our long way to…”

A devotee says she learned to say sorry from often hearing 'thank you' and 'sorry' from Maharaj, and apologised to two devotees even when they said she had done nothing wrong.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:33 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna Duda Maharaj, Dandrat Pranam. Although I haven't attended many classes, I would like to share something based on what I have attended. By your mercy, I have received great help in improving my sadhana. I have learned to say sorry for my mistakes and offenses. And…”

She shares the meaning she learned: apa-radha is moving away from Srimati Radharani, so by offending we move away from Krishna. She also now repeats any mantra she spoke only halfway.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:48 (auto-transcript): “that we should remain alert regarding offenses abroad the meaning of abroad is up away and rather trimati Radha Rani which teaches us that by committing offenses we move away from Krishna therefore we should always avoid offenses and the moment we feel we might by committing…”

Maharaj confirms: when you say sorry sincerely from the heart, peace, happiness and joy flow through you. No one needs to tell you. — “You will feel it.”

🎙 Maharaj at 21:41 (auto-transcript): “nice offering yes recite the mantras and always always be considered to tell someone sorry and you see see when you say sorry it's sincerely from your heart. You see, how the flame of peace just flow through you. Nobody will tell you. You will feel it. You will feel the…”

Offerings come from Mauritius, Brazil, India and elsewhere, in English, Portuguese and Hindi.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:53 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna, dear Guru Dev please accept my most humble obeisances at the desk of your lotus feet all glories to Param Guru Dev particularly to Swami all glories to Srila Prabhupada first and foremost I wish to thank you from the core of my heart for your constant dedication…”

A devotee who kept Ekadasi prasada through Kartik is praised by Maharaj for being present for japa, deity worship and classes, and encouraged to continue on the way back to Godhead.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:44 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna, Ramroop Prabhu. Thank you for following. I was there for Japa. I was there for Dati worship. I was there for classes. This is very, very good. Please continue like that. And surely, Krishna will help your guests. Thank you much. With the way back home, back to…”

children.topic: Staying in the boat of bhakti
children.note:
A devotee from Brazil, in her second year of these Kartik studies, leaves with reflections to keep her in the boat of bhakti on the way to prema.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:53 (auto-transcript): “I will do the translation. Gurudev, please accept my humble obeisances. So please accept my humble obeisances, dear Maharaj. I come to thank you for the mercy that you have bestowed upon us during this Radha Shunya seminar this is the second year that I have participated in…”

A Hindi offering compares the month to daily bathing purer than the Ganga, and the devotee to an insect lifted onto flowers. Maharaj asks her to practise everything. — “Please practice everything and surely you will get a difference.”

🎙 Maharaj at 35:26 (auto-transcript): “Mataji says Shilagurudev so Mataji says Hare Krishna my beloved Shilagurudev please accept my humble obeisances at your lotus feet Shilagurudev during this most auspicious month of Karthik you have bathed us every single day in purifying water of heart cleansing a…”

A devotee who had never heard of Radha Sunya learned that holding a grudge is like holding fire, that intolerance is passion and anxiety while tolerance is goodness, and to be always ready to serve.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:16 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna, everyone. Thank you. Thank you so much, Shreela Gurudev, for this wonderful session. So before this session, I never knew there is some concept like Radha Shumya. After attending these sessions, I got to know that how important is this concept and how important…”

children.topic: It is me who gets burnt
children.note:
Maharaj adds that we think the other person will pay for our grudge, but whoever holds the fire is burnt — even the one who encouraged us to hold it is not. — “if i'm holding fire it is me who will be burnt”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:18 (auto-transcript): “yes it is very very difficult for you to to understand that sometimes we are doing ourselves wrong thing and in in our minds we're thinking that that person is going to pay for it but actually it is with who favorite if i'm holding fire it is me who will be burnt not the…”

After cooking delicious sweet rice, like that offered for the rasa dance, who would add salt? Holding something negative against anyone salts our service and relationships — and we are the ones who must eat it.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:52 (auto-transcript): “as i said like a good example if you are you're going to cook uh after cooking a very tasty nice sweet rice like like it did for the rest of the sad dance they after cooking so nice should rise like that then you add Sun into it will anyone enjoy it if you will cost you…”

Keep nothing negative in the mind about anybody. Citing the Bible's 'no weapon formed against you shall prosper', Maharaj says no weapon works against one who has blocked it with love. He wants to see everyone a different person in Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:13 (auto-transcript): “and you see how powerful that tool is according to the Bible no weapon raised against you will prosper, today in the Bible like that, no weapon any weapon shawed on you will never function because you have blocked it with love so we thank all of you for participating. I want…”

A devotee in Brazil tells how her dry sadhana revived after she took shelter of Maharaj as a siksa disciple; now relationships with devotees feel sweet.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:04 (auto-transcript): “I am feeling extremely grateful for the opportunity to participate in this Radha Shunya seminar and also I would like to say that I am praying for Nittai Mercy that I feel in my heart that I should surrender myself to someone and I was praying to find someone and then I…”

She asks to be engaged in his service for eternity, and Maharaj laughingly promises unlimited services — she won't have time, twenty-four hours a day.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:26 (auto-transcript): “Yes, we'll engage in many, many, many services. Unlimited services. You don't have time. 24 hours. I'm happy to know. Thank you, Gurudev. Thank you so much, Tulsi Kripavati Mataji. Before inviting Kamita Prabhuji I just want to give a gentle reminder To all those who were…”

Another devotee thanks Maharaj for constantly travelling — India, Brazil, Mauritius, Nairobi — to give association, and for insisting that bhakti be taken seriously rather than floating shallowly.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:48 (auto-transcript): “Sheila Gurudev, I'd like to express just a bit of gratitude and a few reflections and realizations about these specific Karthik sessions that we had. I'll begin with a general gratitude towards you. um i'd like to very deeply from a very intense deep part of my heart um thank…”

Hearing about offences again and again for thirty days, with practical stories, made the point sink in where a single hearing fades. He prays for the strength to keep the intensity wherever he is, and Maharaj promises his prayers.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:14 (auto-transcript): “how emphasizing again and again for 30 days the very detrimental effect that offenses have has helped to make that point sink deeper. Yes, we hear a lot about offenses, but when you hear one time and then you stay for a long time without having to remember them, then they…”

A long offering on the gifts of a sadhu's association: the series felt like being reborn and re-initiated into Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:29 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna, dear Shri La Prudek Please accept my most respectful obeisances at your divine lotus feet. All glories to you. All glories to His holiness, Magdhiti Daswami Maharaj All glories to Shri La Prabhupada and all glories to all our Guru Paramparant previous acharyas…”

The devotee confesses a 'dog mentality' with near ones and 'cat mentality' with outsiders, and says Maharaj gave two sets of eyes: one to see and correct her anarthas inside, one to see everyone outside as related to Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:20 (auto-transcript): “And you have opened my eyes through these heart surgeries that how I am a greatest duplicitous. I have a dog mentality with near and dear ones and cat mentality with outsiders. And I have been always making false promises to Lord and Gurudev that I will never commit offenses…”

Maharaj says fortune is not found with politicians, scientists or philosophers — only devotees are fortunate, and by associating with them we become fortunate. — “it's only with devotees”

🎙 Maharaj at 56:29 (auto-transcript): “yes one of my favorite is the same one back to not a color is where where we will find our fortune where where we'll find our fortune it's only with devotees it's only what you will find and first for fortune you cannot find it with politicians they are not fortunate i will…”

The sign of the fortunate is that they work with compassion to make others fortunate. Recalling the Gundica pastime, Maharaj says the Lord tells devotees not just to remain but to teach others and expand it.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:11 (auto-transcript): “fortunate that those are very fortunate they always work with great compassion to make other people fortunate so let's let us always remain together we remain together sharing christian consciousness with each other and learn from each other and grow with each other because…”

We are all going to the same place, so we should stay together, share Krishna consciousness, learn and grow with each other — and the journey will be very short.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:36 (auto-transcript): “it's the same place all of us are going so we have to um encourage all of us to go together this is what the time we were teaching us one of the teachings that i was giving us in the past time of the Gundi Chan. He sees devotees who are collecting more. So very good, very…”

An absent devotee's offering is read: from Daksha, Saubhari Muni and others he saw how offences cause falls, felt his spiritual account was nearly empty, and begs to begin his bhakti anew. Maharaj praises his faithful participation despite many services.

🎙 Maharaj at 58:54 (auto-transcript): “Before we start with Deepa Mataji's offering, I would like to offer the gratitude from Vishnu Murti Sevak Prabhuji. Prabhuji is not present here because of some reasons. So Prabhu Ji says,”

A devotee whose father had died recalls Maharaj's video call that day, which left her smiling. Maharaj says she had every reason not to practise, but being sincere and fortunate she found every reason to practise — and he will always be available.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:48 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna, Srila Gutev, please accept my humble obeisances and to the dust of your lotus feet, Gutev. Thank you. Gutev, after listening to all the devotees, I'm not in a position to say anything because I think I heard your first session and that was a very good energy…”

To a devotee who moved from inner pain to peace, Maharaj says it is illusion to think we will one day be free of problems in this world — that is only in Goloka. We are hungry because we have a material body.

🎙 Maharaj at 66:17 (auto-transcript): “I appreciate that. In this material world it is illusion when I want to think that one day I will be free from problem. That is a great illusion. It is a matthew. What do you want to do? Yeah, not in Goloka. In Goloka, we can think like that. But in this material world. And…”

The fortunate person uses whatever situation he is in to serve Krishna; looking at the problem keeps us down, using it to serve lifts us up. Krishna consciousness will not be handed to us — we must make it available. — “use every situation”

🎙 Maharaj at 67:03 (auto-transcript): “this is how the material is designed a beauty of Christian consciousness and a fortunate person is that whatever our situation we use that to serve Christians, that is our fortune use every situation we have to serve Christians if you are going to look at the problem you will…”

Maharaj prays that everyone applies what they learned and experiences the result. Echoing a devotee who felt reborn, he says we are now beginning our Krishna consciousness afresh, like rejoining the movement.

🎙 Maharaj at 71:03 (auto-transcript): “Yes. We pray that everything we have learned and had here, pray to Guru that all of you will participate very nicely and experience the result. So, our new life, my second place like uh what he said i'm not born again born again and gurudev said all of us like he said you…”

The hosts note the one thread running through every offering — the spiritual master's mercy — thank all who served and joined each day, and close with the Guru-astakam of Adi Sankaracarya.

🎙 Maharaj at 73:47 (auto-transcript): “So, collectively, I think something that we all are resonating to and one thread we are all strung in is the mercy of our spiritual master and there is no use of this body, no use of this mind. if our minds cannot be attached to the instructions of the spiritual master. So…”

nodeData.topic: Class 31 · A Devotee Never Burns Out: Here's Why!
nodeData.note: SB 11.2.42 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Using the verse's image of a hungry person eating, Maharaj shows that devotion, direct experience of Krishna and detachment grow together and are real, tangible experiences, not fiction. Natural detachment means using everything for Krishna, since nothing is ours to renounce, so a devotee is free, nourished and satisfied and cannot burn out. Peace comes only to one who stops obeying the senses. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The verse uses the image of a hungry person eating to show three fruits of surrender growing together: devotion, direct experience of the Lord, and detachment from everything else.

children.topic: The nine Yogendras speak to Nimi
children.note:
Maharaj introduces the setting: King Nimi meets the nine Yogendras, sages who answer his questions on devotional service.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:29 (auto-transcript): “Mahajni meet the nine agendas. This is the text of my book. Chayisa, Chayisa, Tinka, Eka Kala, Eka Kala, Prabha Dhyamana Shya, Prabha Dhyamana Shya, Yathas Nota, Yathas Nota, Shush,”

After the reading Maharaj asks whether the devotees enjoyed it — this is nectar. He speaks of two ways of eating: with hunger and without it.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:24 (auto-transcript): “Did you enjoy it? Did you enjoy it? Did you enjoy it? This is nectar. This is nectar. Two ways to eat. To eat. You can eat. You can eat. The second way to eat. And that really goes for you, for what you eat, for what you eat, for what you eat, for what you eat, for what you eat.”

When you are not hungry no food tastes good; when you are very hungry, even plain food is delicious. Without hunger, the same plate seems unfit even for animals.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:25 (auto-transcript): “This is true, this is true, you know, when you don't have food, no food is delicious. Is it not? Yes. Is it not? Yes. But when you are hungry, it is when you are so hungry.”

children.topic: The advancing devotee can't stop eating
children.note:
Similarly, for those advancing in Krishna consciousness, the meal of devotional service tastes like nectar and they cannot stop.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:33 (auto-transcript): “Those who are making advancement in Krishna consciousness. Aqueles que estavam fazendo um avalço da consciência de fecha, o mal também é saboroso. É muito bom. Nectaria. E um não pode parar de comer. E aí, uma pessoa que nós não conseguimos parar de comer. Você diz, We are ready.”

Krishna, bhakti and the experience they bring are not from this world; they came from the spiritual world and are a tangible substance you can perceive.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:25 (auto-transcript): “There are three things. Bhagavad Gita. Bhagavad Gita. Bhakti. Bhakti. Bhakti. Three. They are not in this world. They came from the spiritual world. They are real. They are tangible. Tangible substance. It is a tangible substance. So you can feel it. I can feel it. So, for…”

Maharaj feels what he is doing even as he speaks into the microphone, and asks devotees to feel what they practise too. It is not fiction. — “You should feel it.”

🎙 Maharaj at 43:08 (auto-transcript): “So, you also have to feel what is that you are practicing. You should feel it. You have to feel it. Not fiction. Bhakti. Krishna. Bhakti. Bhakti. Bhakti. Not fiction. Not fiction. So here is devotion. So the devotion will bring us the vision of the supernatural. So, the…”

Devotion gives direct perception of Krishna as the natural result of one's practice.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:39 (auto-transcript): “So the devotion will bring us the vision of the supernatural. So, the bhakti, the emotion, will give you a direct perception, direct, direct, and it will be the result of your practice. So, the result of your practice is going to show Krishna directly. the moon, and how much,…”

Maharaj contrasts two words the acaryas explain carefully: detachment and renunciation. The verse speaks of natural detachment, not renunciation.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:53 (auto-transcript): “see two words our acharya have explained it beautifully Did you hear my mind? Did you hear my mind? Did you hear my mind? A big distinction between relative statement and realization. Did you see it? Distinction is not mentioned, the detachment is mentioned.”

There is a big difference between a theoretical statement and realisation; the detachment in this verse comes from experience.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:14 (auto-transcript): “A big distinction between relative statement and realization. Did you see it? Distinction is not mentioned, the detachment is mentioned. So, devotion to Krishna,”

To renounce something you must first own it. Everything, including our body, belongs to Krishna — so what do we have to renounce? Giving things up when they could be used in Krishna consciousness is not approved.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:26 (auto-transcript): “First of all, if you want to renunciar a something, you have to be the one, you have to be the one. You have to do something. You have to do something. But if you don't have anything, how do you renunciar a something? Everything. Everything, including our body, that pertence…”

Perfect renunciation is using everything in Krishna's service, giving nothing up.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:18 (auto-transcript): “Use everything. Use everything. Everything. When I say everything. For the nation. For the nation. That is a problem. Because it's perfect. Pure nation. So we use everything in the service of Christ. That is the question. No giving of anything. That's not a negotiation.…”

Maharaj appears to recount Maya-devi coming to tempt a devotee who stayed absorbed in hearing and chanting about Krishna; after three days she herself was changed.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:43 (auto-transcript): “tomo se volou depois de 3 dias somente 3 dias raridaz mudou and maya confess maya confess maya raridaz maya raridaz you”

children.topic: There is no problem for devotees
children.note:
Why do devotees have no problem? They never separate Krishna's energy from Krishna. — “There is no problem for devotees.”

🎙 Maharaj at 53:56 (auto-transcript): “What's the problem? There is no problem for devotees. No devotees. Why? They separate Christa's energy from Krishna. They don't have a problem. Few devotees. They don't suppress Krishna from this energy. They use Krishna's energy. So, not separated from Krishna. Utilize the…”

children.topic: Using Krishna's energy, they are free
children.note:
Pure devotees do not suppress Krishna's energy or keep it apart from him; they use it to serve Krishna, and so they are completely free.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:20 (auto-transcript): “Few devotees. They don't suppress Krishna from this energy. They use Krishna's energy. So, not separated from Krishna. Utilize the energy of Krishna and serve Krishna. So, the devotees are free. They are completely free. They are completely free. So, here, they are free. For…”

Following Jiva Gosvami, Maharaj walks through what happens to someone eating: satisfaction, nourishment and less hunger with every bite.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:02 (auto-transcript): “What is it? Tushy. Tushy. Tushy. Satisfy. Satisfy. Satisfy. Tushy. Satisfy. Satisfy. So there's a... What is the first appearance that a person is engaged in the world? Tushy. Tushy. Satisfy. Satisfy. Satisfy. Satisfy. Nutrição, a pessoa se está nutrindo, para quem está…”

As one eats or drinks, the hunger and thirst go down; that is natural for one who is eating, and the same happens in devotional life.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:44 (auto-transcript): “What happened? The taste of hunger goes down. If I drink water, the more you drink, The taste goes down. The hunger goes down. Why? Because that is meaningless. Why? Because that is meaningless. This is natural. For one who is eating.”

Jiva Gosvami pairs each result of devotion with a result of eating. Bhakti is paired with satisfaction because both take the form of pleasure. — “This is Bhakti mathematics.”

🎙 Maharaj at 57:33 (auto-transcript): “Shri Matipakushone has explained this analogy. Bhakti, or devotion, can we compare to Tushi and Satipastas? He's pairing them. This is Bhakti mathematics. He's pairing them. Bhakti is compared to trusty satisfaction. Why?”

One who practises pure bhakti cannot become depressed or burn out; Maharaj asks the translator for the Portuguese word for burnout, and says that is Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 58:25 (auto-transcript): “One cannot Una persona no puede practicar pure bhakti bhakti puro y ficar así depresivo no puede morrer mozo nunca no no es posible o de nuevo no puede ficar morrer mozo tempato In English, it is born, born out, born in.”

Experience of the Lord is paired with nourishment because both sustain life. Devotees become fresh, and someone once remarked on a devotee's glow — it comes not from food but from being happy in Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 60:37 (auto-transcript): “so yes, what happens become fresh if you become fresh if you become fresh you become fresh because you are nutrition in your body yes, indeed one devotee told me one devotee told me it's the sign because I don't see it I don't see it I don't see it it's the sign even though…”

Relief from hunger is paired with peace, since both free one from other longings. Whoever wants peace in this world must stop running after the senses.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:54 (auto-transcript): “Finally, the judgment ensured by cessation of hunger. may be compelled because both free one from other handkerchief so that when my experience I'm here if one wants to be peaceful in this world forget to submit A person who is not disturbed by the insensate flow of desires”
Maharaj reads the Gita verse on the ocean that stays steady while rivers flow in, the picture of a person undisturbed by desires.

children.topic: The attendant who answers every bell
children.note:
A shop assistant or flight attendant must answer every customer who presses the button — a drink, a coffee, something sweet, something to chew. One who always responds to the senses' demands like that can never be peaceful.

🎙 Maharaj at 66:26 (auto-transcript): “I'm going to show you another example. Shop boy. Shop boy. Shop girl. Shop. Supermarket. Store. If, for example, a lochista. Shop girl. Yeah, a job boy. Yes, a job boy. He's treating the feminine as a masculine. Or like in the plane. Or, for example, if you're in a plane.…”

Only one who disobeys the senses becomes peaceful. — “That is the secret of success.”

🎙 Maharaj at 68:34 (auto-transcript): “Disoper the senses. Disoper the senses. Disoper the senses. Is it not? That is the secret of success. Read it. Read it. You know, the mantra”

At weddings and birth ceremonies people chant 'shanti, shanti' — but do they get peace? As long as one keeps wanting something, there is no shanti.

🎙 Maharaj at 69:29 (auto-transcript): “When I'm doing wedding. Do you know when I'm at the ceremony of the nascimento? Do you know when I'm at the ceremony? Shanti, shanti. Shanti, shanti. Do you get shanti? Do you get shanti? Do you get shanti? Do you get shanti? I can't say. He's always a sacrifice. Shanti,…”
