nodeData.topic: Class 23 · Piety Is Not Necessarily Bhakti
nodeData.note: SB 11.21.7–8 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Krishna sets what is proper and improper among times, places and things in order to restrain materialistic life; such piety makes one eligible but does not qualify one for Krishna's abode — only Krishna consciousness does. Maharaj explains why real good tastes bitter first, how places become pure or contaminated and how Mahaprabhu's devotees sanctify every land, why deities at home are fully present, and how 'working on ourselves' means becoming considerate human beings first. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Class 22 · The Conception of Good and Bad
nodeData.note: SB 11.21.5–6 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. All bodies are made of the same five elements coming from Krishna, so good and bad are decided by the Lord's will, not by matter itself — giving grains on Ekadasi looks pious but is not. Maharaj explains that the problem is godlessness, that varnasrama gives names and forms so each person can work according to nature and progress, and that approaching the absolute good, Krishna, makes one good. Questions cover Ajamila's chanting, weakness versus deliberate sin, and when spiritual knowledge becomes visible. children.topic: 11.21.6 — Names and forms for our goal
children.note: Though all bodies are made of the same elements, the Vedas give them different names and forms so that living beings can reach the goal of life — the varnasrama system.

Krishna created the four divisions by quality and work so that we can function and progress; it is material, not spiritual. Society is like a body with four departments, and the self-controlled brahmana is naturally the head.

nodeData.topic: Class 21 · What To Do and What Not To Do? How to Decide?
nodeData.note: SB 11.21.3–4 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Material ideas of pure and impure, good and bad, auspicious and inauspicious are necessary but relative, shifting with time, place and person; only Krishna can say what is truly good. Mundane religion with endless rules becomes a burden and breeds doubt, while devotion depending on Krishna's mercy is joyful for the pure soul. In the questions Maharaj speaks on truth, regulated enjoyment, Indra's envy of serious practitioners, and why Krishna waits until we are tired of sin. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: After a sound check, Maharaj continues Canto 11, chapter 21, Krishna's explanation of the Vedic path to Uddhava, from text 3.
The verse explains that to know what is proper one must evaluate things within each sphere: purity in religion, good and bad in ordinary dealings, auspicious and inauspicious for bodily survival.

What is good for me may be bad for you, and what I call auspicious you may not. These dualities are imperfect because they change with time, place and circumstance — even philosophies. — “anything which is affected by time and place or circumstances is relative”

Even acaryas seem to differ: one says a pastime took place on the bank of the Yamuna, another on the Ganga. Both are correct, because at that spot the two rivers flow together.

Each sphere has its own language: in social dealings we say good or bad; of water we say pure or impure; in religious life we say an activity is auspicious when it helps our practice, and a holy place is called sanctified, not merely good.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:51 (auto-transcript): “understood in our social dealings, in our social dealings, in a civil way, in a civil way we say you is good we say the best we say is not the pure water in Canada we'll say good and bad but there's something like water we don't say good”

children.topic: Krishna waits until we are tired
children.note:
While we are enjoying sin, Krishna will not take it away; when we are tired of it and seriously beg, he takes it. He forces no one.

🎙 Maharaj at 68:03 (auto-transcript): “if we are enjoying our sinful life we are attached to the simple thing we do christian will not take it out only when christian sees that we are tired of it then christian will take it out if christian see we are tired and we are seriously begging and freeing freeing the…”

When Maharaj's guru received a chief's title in Nigeria, a visitor said, you are a king now — don't you need a queen? He laughed: I have seen everything inside; there is nothing there for me.

🎙 Maharaj at 69:30 (auto-transcript): “But when one is tired, one devotee, his grace said, Sureshwarafam, he was telling him how When Guruji was given a cheap tensile title in Nigeria, so he came to Guruji family and he said, Maharaj, you have become a king now. Don't you think that you need a queen? a queen also.…”

A senior disciple told how, as a young American girl into everything, she dropped it all the moment Prabhupada said it was dangerous, and never went back. Why can't it happen to us?

🎙 Maharaj at 72:17 (auto-transcript): “So in the lectures, she told us how, as an American girl, I was into everything, everything, everything. But the moment Prabhupada said this is a dangerous thing, she said give it up. she dropped everything completely till today why it happened to her cannot happen to us…”

We tell ourselves, nobody has ever had my problem, so the solutions do not apply to me. Maharaj asks how special we really are. — “But how special are you that your problem is the only in the whole universe?”

🎙 Maharaj at 73:38 (auto-transcript): “You don't know, you don't know my problem. Nobody has ever had my problem. My problem is different from your problem. So Christian answer, yeah, yeah, because you don't know my problem, Prabhu. If you know my problem, don't talk like that. The situation is different. I'm such…”

nodeData.topic: Class 20 · Check Where You Are in Spiritual Life
nodeData.note: SB 11.21.1–2 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Krishna names three ways of rising — devotion, philosophical analysis and regulated duty — and warns that those who drop them for sense gratification keep falling. Maharaj explains how duty purifies, purification brings knowledge and knowledge brings renunciation, and he warns against artificial renunciation: we should honestly see that we are still at the stage of rules and regulations, and engage our senses practically. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: The chapter: Krishna explains the Vedic path
children.note: Srimad-Bhagavatam Canto 11, chapter 21, in which Lord Krishna explains the Vedic path to Uddhava. This class begins from text 1.

children.topic: 11.21.1 — Three ways up, one way down
children.note: The verse contrasts those who take up devotion, analytic philosophy or regulated duty with those who give them up for petty sense pleasure and keep turning in material existence.

Maharaj cites the Gita's description of how one falls step by step through sense gratification, and adds that we are already falling, because sense gratification is meant for lower species, not for human beings.

Citing the Gita's third chapter, Maharaj calls lust the soul's eternal enemy: it keeps the conditioned soul in prison, just as prisoners are kept behind bars.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:45 (auto-transcript): “three the enemy the pure soul nature virena nature virena the eternal enemy of the soul sanctification the proper proper said christian keep conditional soul in prison by lost just as prisoners are kept behind bars a disobedience or deviance now so”

These three processes are the way up, and there is no second way. No one can say, I am just neutral: either we are going up, or we are staying conditioned and extending our suffering. — “either we are following the process of going up”

🎙 Maharaj at 21:42 (auto-transcript): “educational prescribed duties these three processes are for going up there is no second way about it there's no question of imagine I'm not there I'm not there i'm just neutral this that does not exist either we are following the process of going up or we are following the…”

Those who are tired of suffering will hear this and take up Krishna consciousness; those not yet tired will not hear it and will carry on as before.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:18 (auto-transcript): “tired of suffering they will take the christian consensus they will hear this and take the issue those who are tired of suffering but those who are not tired of suffering yet will not hear this we will continue with our sinful process so we should know very carefully the…”

Maharaj says no one can enjoy the senses better than the animals, for whom it is designed — like a language you learn but can never speak as well as one born to it. Animals do not cook meat; we must cook and salt it to bring it to our level, and still it is never the same. We are trying to become animals by force.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:29 (auto-transcript): “we will continue with our sinful process so we should know very carefully the question of sanctification we cannot do it better than the animals it's for saying education no one can do it more than the animals it is meant for them it is meant for them no one can do it better…”

children.topic: Human by consciousness, not by body
children.note:
One is considered human only when one voluntarily and happily avoids what is meant for animals and does what is meant for human beings. — “We are not human beings because we carry the body.”

🎙 Maharaj at 24:39 (auto-transcript): “avoid activities meant for animals and activities that we should do, we should voluntarily, happily follow the path. That is when one is considered to be a human being. We are not human beings because we carry the body. We are human beings because we have the consciousness of…”

Analytic philosophy and prescribed duties are both laborious, and that austerity is what purifies.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:14 (auto-transcript): “analytic philosophy Sankhya studying all the material element that make this universe it is a laborious part but eventually one will come to who is the owner of all this element that is the conclusion of analytic story eventually one come to this point who is the master the…”

Studying the material elements in detail is a long road, but eventually one asks who the owner and master of all of them is, and then takes to Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:27 (auto-transcript): “universe it is a laborious part but eventually one will come to who is the owner of all this element that is the conclusion of analytic story eventually one come to this point who is the master the Lord of all this as a conclusion when one study this philosophy you come to…”

When the senses are satisfied according to the Vedas, one advances; outside the scripture there is no advancement. The Vedic way has austerity in it; sense gratification on its own has none. — “the part of sense gratification there is no austerity”

🎙 Maharaj at 26:06 (auto-transcript): “are designed for human beings in the vedas if one gratified essence is based on the scriptures you make advancement if you gratify the senses outside the scripture will be condemned no advancement because the vedas will theorize it why because one is fooling the vedas there…”

children.topic: A king who followed the scripture
children.note:
Maharaj gives the example of a king (apparently Pracinabarhi) whose activities were all based on scripture and who therefore received the blessing. By these processes one attains Krishna's mercy; by other ways we only continue our suffering.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:13 (auto-transcript): “so it is regulated prescribed duties prescribed duties in the scripture it was this prescribed duties that Prachina Barai Sallamahara was doing and he got the blessing of the community he was doing that all his activities were based on the scripture so he got the message…”
The verse defines piety as remaining fixed in one's own position and impiety as deviating from it.

Material or spiritual, nothing succeeds without steadiness. Steady practice will succeed; deviation is the opposite.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:05 (auto-transcript): “Steadiness. Variegated location I recommend being steady. 1426. I want to be steady in anything that we do, material is spiritual if we are not steady we cannot succeed steadiness in our position steady in our practice will succeed deviation is the opposite in the previous…”

Maharaj traces the progress: duty performed and offered to Krishna, even with some expectation, purifies; purification brings knowledge; knowledge brings renunciation; renunciation helps one become a pure devotee who understands his relationship with Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:02 (auto-transcript): “this is the progress from karma yoga when one to perform his prescribed duty offering the result of fund the result fructively to Krishna with some expectation there is purification the purification that brings one to the stage of knowledge by regulated devotion series it…”

Real renunciation is not ignorance; one knows why one gives something up and why one does something else. — “Renunciation is due to knowledge.”

🎙 Maharaj at 33:15 (auto-transcript): “will bring us to the stage of renunciation. Renunciation is true wisdom, proper said. It is not ignorance. Renunciation is due to knowledge. Why should I give up this? Why should I do this? Why shouldn't I do this? And prescribed duty brings us to knowledge. Knowledge takes…”

Tell someone, give me your paycheck, and they will ask why — who are you in my life? One who has knowledge never asks Krishna why, because he knows that by giving everything to Krishna, Krishna removes his sins and takes care of him.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:53 (auto-transcript): “that why should I do that if you tell someone give me your paycheck why naturally the question be why why should I give to you who are you in my life I will give you my paycheck why are you going to take care of my necessities who are you but one who has knowledge one will…”

Krishna did not simply tell Arjuna to fight; he gave him the reason and showed him the result, and asked him to think of him while doing his duty.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:14 (auto-transcript): “our prescribed duty how to how to perform a prescribed duty what what kind of consciousness christian explained it by gita christian thought that june while you are doing your duty you should think of me should think of me christian did not just tell adjun to fight he gave…”

Devotional service is taken up by greatly fortunate persons. When piety accumulates to a very high level, it becomes the fortune that gives us the chance to practise Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:55 (auto-transcript): “devotional service is performed by greatly fortunate persons not people who have piety when our piety accumulates to a high level then one becomes fortunate that fortune will give us chance to practice this unconsciousness yes he then sees that his conditional life as well as…”

children.topic: Disgust is a sign of advancement
children.note:
As one advances, sense gratification looks abominable, something a human being should not do. Looking back, one wonders how one spent so long competing with animals and calling it human life. — “If we are still appreciating, it means we are still low, very low in consciousness.”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:20 (auto-transcript): “consciousness this is the process material sanctification will be considered obnoxious activity we considered this eating stew they will be considered an abomination the thing which a human being should not do. When we look at sanctification, we are disgust. And this is a…”

A devotee told Maharaj he only wanted to sit and read and hear about Krishna, doing nothing else. Maharaj asked: will you also eat? Then you should chant and preach too. Artificial renunciation does not come from realisation, and it will uproot you into something worse.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:18 (auto-transcript): “One devotee asked me, I just want to sit down and read, just read about Krishna, not doing anything else. want to read about krishna just hear krishna continuously no other activities i say will you eat also will you eat just read i would eat then if you will eat you should…”

children.topic: Krishna's pastimes are not for imitation
children.note:
Krishna performed his intimate pastimes for himself and his qualified friends; they are shown to attract the fortunate. Thinking we are there simply by hearing is artificial, and it ends up fuelling our own sense gratification.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:36 (auto-transcript): “is called artificial it is not real so it is not recommended when one hear about krishna's transcendental activities yesterday we explained krishna did not perform this thing for us he didn't do it for us he did it for himself and his intimate friends who are qualified for…”

children.topic: Envy shows we are not there
children.note:
No one is envious when everyone has the same plate. Asking why Krishna does this or that comes from envy: it is his property, and nobody asks why I use my own phone or my own glasses.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:52 (auto-transcript): “because they are qualified they are participating one does not become envious of someone who is eating the same food to others right because on this one someone is eating more than what we oh it has a other preparation which is not my plate thank you what is that if…”

children.topic: Where are we? Yama and niyama
children.note:
Yoga begins from rules and regulations, before posture and breath control. Maharaj asks the room where we stand — and our bodies are not getting younger. — “yama niyama that is where we are we still struggling with principles”

🎙 Maharaj at 43:50 (auto-transcript): “of transcendence and we're explaining look at our stage what are we doing in our christian consciousness yoga begins from where yoga begins from where yama and niyama right rules are regulations before you go to to asana to then to pranayama right where are we where are we at…”

Our senses have been dulled by sense gratification, so we do not yet appreciate Krishna consciousness. Maharaj recalls Mahaprabhu's teaching that karma and jnana dull the senses while bhakti makes them sharp.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:33 (auto-transcript): “dealing with the detection of the senses which is mastered by the mind this is what we're still dealing with the mind is not clear about anything what is christian consciousness our senses are not sharp about christian consciousness our senses have been dull due to…”

We are only beginning to see how dangerous sense gratification is; we still plan it seriously, and Krishna consciousness becomes secondary while the chanting beads hang unused. — “The bead is hanging there, starving.”

🎙 Maharaj at 47:30 (auto-transcript): “the illusion of entire life beginning beginning not realizing just trying to realize how dangerous is sanctification still is deeply appreciated single person is deeply appreciated and we meditate and plan seriously how to execute it by doing that no time for most devotees…”

Do something practical: learn to cook, to clean, to present Krishna consciousness. The mind's old training is sense gratification, our addiction; we should do what eventually leads to bhakti — deity worship and chanting.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:36 (auto-transcript): “we should do something practical engage the senses in many activities learning how to cook learning how to clean learning how to present question consciousness many things many activities technically did this in this way the senses are engaged and even while we are doing all…”

We can begin from offensive chanting; the holy name is so powerful that even that has great effect.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:38 (auto-transcript): “bhakti engage in deity worship so practice how to chant the holy name at least we begin from offensive chanting at least beginning from it the holy name is so powerful that even offensive chanting is very powerful very boss no nothing compared harida securie cannot campaign…”

Maharaj tells how Haridasa Thakura said that even a glimpse of the holy name surpasses the highest impersonal realisation, and a proud brahmana mocked him as an illiterate. Haridasa answered humbly that he had heard it from them — they recite the scripture but do not hear it.

The stage of Brahman, Haridah's…”

Someone may speak the Bhagavatam without any ecstasy, without knowing what it is, and Maharaj says this happens even in our movement. Parrots memorise and repeat perfectly, but without bhakti they do not go back to Godhead. — “they repeat it perfectly but they're not going to go”

🎙 Maharaj at 51:15 (auto-transcript): “it i i had it from the scripture the same thing happened to them they were not born it he was speaking the bhagwatan but no ecstasy cerebral ponytail had this everything he felt they couldn't understand it who is this food that is disturbing oh god who can't understand…”

children.topic: The godbrother who left his family
children.note:
In Maharaj's early days a godbrother, married with two children, abandoned them to live in the temple. Years later his family brought the wife and children, and the wife said she was ready to follow; he refused, quoting philosophy. Some years later he married again improperly, broke the principles and was caught.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:16 (auto-transcript): “stage of directly practicing christian consciousness yes during our early days one god brother he was married before he came to know about christian consciousness he was married yeah with two kids so when he came to understand christian consciousness he abandoned the wife and…”

He called it Maya and asked whether they wanted him to take back his vomit. Maharaj, new then, admired his philosophy and was ashamed — but it was whimsical, and whimsy was punished. — “Prabhu, you want me to take my vomit?”

🎙 Maharaj at 59:10 (auto-transcript): “This devotee said he would never. He was quoting philosophy. Prabhu, you want me to take my vomit? That's what you are telling me to do? You are encouraging me to take my vomit? Prabhu, what is this? Maya! What are you talking? Krishna saved my life. You want me to go back?…”

In anything, and especially in Krishna consciousness, we must learn from the acaryas and those who have succeeded. Pure devotees share their realisations; following them we succeed. — “Those who are successful in the process, we should learn from their wisdom.”

🎙 Maharaj at 61:52 (auto-transcript): “So we should learn from what experienced devotees, we should learn from those who are experienced in anything that you want to do, especially in Christian consciousness, we must learn from our chariots. Those who are successful in the process, we should learn from their…”

One question from the floor.

🎙 Maharaj at 62:43 (auto-transcript): “So we understand the traditional bhakti and when they are trying to force ourselves to don't know, they look the same? Do you understand the difference between artificial practicing and genuine practice? Because they look the same. And even if you look carefully, the…”

children.topic: Q1 · Real or artificial — how to tell?
children.note:
Genuine and artificial devotion look the same, and the artificial is often more prominent. How do we identify which is real?

🎙 Question from the floor at 62:43 (auto-transcript): “So we understand the traditional bhakti and when they are trying to force ourselves to don't know, they look the same? Do you understand the difference between artificial practicing and genuine practice? Because they look the same. And even if you look carefully, the…”

It is not difficult. Krishna in the heart directs even the conditioned soul; a sincere person will be shown who is doing right and who is not. If we are crooked, everything becomes difficult. — “We don't need perfection yet, just sincerity.”

🎙 Maharaj at 63:12 (auto-transcript): “So how do you identify which is real, which is artificial? Not difficult. A devotee who is very, very sincere. We don't need perfection yet, just sincerity. Krishna will direct us. We don't need to become a pure devotee before Krishna direct. Christian's duty in staying with…”

children.topic: Both are placed together on purpose
children.note:
Krishna deliberately keeps the genuine and the artificial in the same place so that we can make our choice, because many of us are not clear about what we want.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:42 (auto-transcript): “Christian's duty in staying with the heart is to direct us at the conditional stage or at the professional stage. It's always directing. The person who is very sincere Christian will show you who is doing the right thing and who is doing the wrong thing. And Christian leave…”

A snake charmer sang a mantra glorifying Ananta; Haridasa Thakura heard it and fell unconscious in ecstasy. The charmer stood aside respectfully until he recovered. Then a brahmana, envious that a 'sudra' was honoured, threw himself on the ground imitating — and the charmer beat him until he ran away.

🎙 Maharaj at 65:12 (auto-transcript): “and when harida sakura was passing after he was after he finished with the kazi and then He came upon a snake charmer, a snake charmer. He was chanting, the mantra he was chanting, just like the devil and pundit also. This is another one. The mantra he was chanting is for…”

Asked why he respected one and beat a brahmana, the charmer said everyone had felt the first was real, a pure devotee responding to the Lord's mantra; nobody felt anything for the second, who was envious of a pure devotee and interrupted his service. — “I beat him because he interrupted”

🎙 Maharaj at 66:57 (auto-transcript): “people question the same question the first person you did nothing you were very respectful and he's not a brahmana why did you beat a brahmana it's an offense why why did you leave the time when you beat this one is the next time i said all of you should be very sincere when…”

nodeData.topic: Class 19 · Guru, the Disciple's Life and Soul
nodeData.note: SB 11.3.22 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj explains what it means to accept the spiritual master as one's life and soul: a disciple has offered his head and no longer acts for himself, hears with an attentive mind, and deals without duplicity. Krishna, who sells himself to his devotees, gives himself to such a faithful disciple — real life begins there, and only then is the Bhagavatam truly revealed. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Prabuddha's instruction to Nimi: accept the spiritual master as one's life and worshipable deity and learn from him the devotional service that satisfies the Lord, who then gives himself.

children.topic: Guru as one's life and soul
children.note:
Everyone has heard 'accept a spiritual master'. Maharaj asks: with what attitude? The verse says — as one's life and soul. That is the disciple's state of consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:56 (auto-transcript): “If you look at this verse carefully, the recommendation is given here that one should accept the spiritual master. What condition? It's a common word which we use. Accept the spiritual master. We have heard this many times. Accept the shelter of the Guru Pada Ashraya. who…”

The relationship between guru and disciple is not mechanical or merely physical; if it is only external it is hero worship, not guru worship. — “hero worship is different from guru puja”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:17 (auto-transcript): “If we want to experience what exists between the Guru and if we want to experience it, it is not a mechanical thing. thing it is not just a physical thing it is not if it is physical it is not guru worship it is hero worship hero hero worship is different from guru puja a…”

Like a sacrificial lamb already offered, the disciple has given himself to the guru. 'I am not for myself now; I am for you.' He can no longer do as he likes. — “the bona fide disciple has no independence”

🎙 Maharaj at 23:33 (auto-transcript): “will give himself to the Christians completely. In the Christians they say a sacrificial lamp. Understand? Sacrificial lamp. What is already given to God, you take this stage. Sacrificial lamp. The disciple is one who has given himself or has saved to Guru. This is for you.…”

Mahaprabhu told Murari Gupta to stop worshipping Ramacandra and worship Krishna. Murari answered that his head was already offered at Ramacandra's feet and he had no power to take it back. Mahaprabhu glorified him and warned that anyone who thinks otherwise of Murari will never be purified.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:41 (auto-transcript): “When Chita Mahāprabhu Vādi Guptā, stop worshiping Sitara, worship God Shamsu. I don't have power to do that. I don't have power to do it. my head my head is already given to regular what power do i have again to take it out”

Like Hanuman's devotion, this is what accepting a spiritual master means — not only an initiation ceremony. Our difficulty in advancing comes from missing this.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:00 (auto-transcript): “attitude of Hanuman, the time who glorified as one's life and soul. That is acceptance of a spiritual master. That is the nature of God. Not just a ceremonial initiation in which way. The initiation is there, but not the external thing we are doing. That is different. We are…”
Maharaj confirms the point from the Gita's list of the qualities that make up knowledge, where approaching a bona fide acarya appears, and reads Prabhupada's purport on it.

Arjavam means straightforward dealings, without duplicity. What Prabhupada describes is not hearsay; this relationship is a powerful science, something tangible one can feel. — “it is tangible substance one can feel it”

🎙 Maharaj at 33:17 (auto-transcript): “not deceit. Arjaman. Arjaman means straight, straight, straight, straightforward, straightforward dealings. Straightforward dealings. Did you see? You understand what it means to have a spiritual master? What the prophet said is not reassure. This is what it means. It is not…”

Maharaj voices the doubter: we served for years, and see so many falling down — how do I know you won't be next? How long must I stay a fool? He admits the experience is real.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:27 (auto-transcript): “they are our object of worship we can and say we have served we have been doing these things for years what is the result all falling down how am i sure that you are not going to be the next person what is the proof that you are not the next person how long am i going to…”

If you were cheated by many doctors and conclude there are no qualified doctors, that is your problem. It is your job to find the qualified one.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:48 (auto-transcript): “what you are saying is true but the problem is if you think you have been cheated by many doctors therefore no qualified doctor you have a serious problem it is your problem to check which of the doctors have got to check that if you cannot check that it is not someone's…”

Nobody can eat or sleep on another's behalf. You have to take up the process yourself.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:34 (auto-transcript): “nobody eat for anybody tell your dog just go and sleep i will just sleep and tomorrow i will sleep for you also does it work like that to eat for yourself to debate for yourself you have to say”

The verse says the disciple should learn from the guru. Maharaj's experience: we stay together, but we are not learning — the mind is clouded by too much worldly education.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:31 (auto-transcript): “the process that christmas is given accepting the bona fide spiritual master as one's life and soul and worshipable deity the disciples should learn from him the process of pure devotional service to learn my experience my experience is that we are not learning we are not…”

children.topic: The essence of association is hearing
children.note:
Prabhupada said the essence of association is to hear. One should go to the spiritual master to learn by hearing.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:35 (auto-transcript): “should go to a special master to learn from hearing sir papa said the essence of association is to hear that's the essence so here which is mentioned here right here we should hear hear attentively with the mind christian asks did you hear me with an attentive mind this is a…”

Krishna did not just ask Arjuna whether he heard, but whether he heard with an attentive mind. One who does finds his illusion destroyed and his original position regained — he does not need anyone to tell him transformation is happening.

Coming to the guru with doubts is fine at first. But after hearing detailed, scientific explanation and proof, continuing doubt is no longer intelligence. — “if you still have doubt, that becomes a stumbling block.”

🎙 Maharaj at 40:27 (auto-transcript): “We are going to the spiritual master with doubting. Which is okay in the beginning, it's okay. But after hearing scientifically with detailed explanation and proof, if you still have doubt, that becomes a stumbling block. It's not a sign of intelligence anymore. It's a…”

children.topic: Krishna gives himself to his devotees
children.note:
The verse says Hari is inclined to give himself to his pure devotees. Maharaj gives example after example.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:58 (auto-transcript): “The Supreme Presence of Godhead, Hari, who is the soul of all souls, he has saved the nature. What is that nature? He's inclined to give himself to his pure emotive. He's inclined to give himself to his pure emotive. Chetan Mahavadou, he did. He told Srivast Pandit, If you…”

children.topic: 'If you sell me, I am sold'
children.note:
Mahaprabhu told Srivasa Pandita: I am your property; if you sell me, I am sold. He said the same to others who served him.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:19 (auto-transcript): “Chetan Mahavadou, he did. He told Srivast Pandit, If you sell me, I am sold. I am your property completely, completely. if you sell me, I'm sold. He told, what should you do with that? I'm your property. If you sell me, I'm sold. There's no doubt about that. I'm sold. He told…”

Krishna says he is not independent; his devotees own him. He tells Narada that he is not found in Vaikuntha or in the yogis' hearts, but wherever his devotees sing his names — and he is not ashamed to announce it.

children.topic: The lady who gave her heart
children.note:
Recalling something from the day before at a Jagannatha festival: a lady gave her heart to Jagannatha, and Jagannatha gave himself to her. She purchased the Supreme Lord.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:26 (auto-transcript): “krishna from the core of their heart they have given their heart yesterday what happened on jaganath the lady see donated her heart to the jaganath and jaganath forget her jaganath forget her no juggernaut gave himself to her she purchased the supreme lord this is the process…”

Pleased by Bali's surrender, Lord Vamana became his doorkeeper and remains so. Maharaj tells how, when a demon attacked Dvaraka, the Lord would not leave without Bali's permission — and when Bali refused, he stayed.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:16 (auto-transcript): “We mentioned we mentioned yes so we mentioned Lord Vaman Day he is till today a doorman. He is so devoted to his devotee that when his own personal kingdom was attacked by demons”

'Faithful' appears again and again in the verse. Without faith in the spiritual master there is no success; Krishna speaks of faith in Gita chapters 3, 4, 9, 17 and 18. — “A faithless soul has no presence, no future.”

🎙 Maharaj at 46:34 (auto-transcript): “faithful, faithful is mentioned here many times. So you have faith in the body of high spiritual. If you don't have faith, you will not succeed. There is no success. There is no success. A faithless soul has no presence, no future. That is chapter 4. In chapter 9, Christian…”

children.topic: Why are we surprised we suffer?
children.note:
Prabhupada said one who is surprised at his suffering is a fool. Duplicity is deeply rooted in our consciousness, and Krishna consciousness is the filter that cleans it.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:52 (auto-transcript): “Prabhupada said, why are we surprised that we are suffering? Who is surprised is a fool. Why am I suffering? It's foolishness. We should know why we are suffering, Prabhupada said. Because duplicity is so deep in our consciousness. It is deeply rooted in our consciousness,…”

Knowing very well we have a serious problem and hiding it until someone has joined their life to ours — that is duplicity, and devotees are doing it. And we do the same with the spiritual master.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:25 (auto-transcript): “and we have filter filter water this is the pressure of filter duplicity if i know i know very well that i have some some i say some deficiency i am not telling you what i'm calling you to come to me after coming to me before you get to know that i have this problem how do…”

Each regulative principle carries much more: stock-market speculation is a branch of gambling, dirty things on the internet go against the principle of no illicit sex. No one forces anyone to stay here, so why duplicity in a place meant for Krishna consciousness?

🎙 Maharaj at 51:07 (auto-transcript): “So we keep, we are taking vows to keep the photographic principle. The photographic principle, it is not just, it's not just, say for example, we say no alcohol. there's so many things that goes with with alcohol we say no intoxication alcohol many things i go with it the…”

children.topic: Real life begins with the guru
children.note:
Following Jiva Gosvami, the spiritual master is the very life of the disciple; real life begins when one is accepted by a bona fide guru.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:05 (auto-transcript): “Real life begins at initiation. That's the real life, beginning of life. That I'm a human being, it begins, a disciple has been accepted. Please, when we say initiation, don't think that if you have taken initiation now, I'm having that experience. Don't think like that. We…”

Don't think taking initiation alone gives this experience. It comes only with a deceit-free life with the spiritual master, straightforward dealings, and accepting him as life and soul.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:22 (auto-transcript): “Please, when we say initiation, don't think that if you have taken initiation now, I'm having that experience. Don't think like that. We can also have this experience only if we have this deceit-free life with the spiritual master. Stress forward dealing with this. We accept…”

children.topic: Position without guru is a dream
children.note:
Whatever position or fame we may have in this world, without the spiritual master it is a dream with no value — like becoming emperor in a dream.

🎙 Maharaj at 59:02 (auto-transcript): “you understand what jiva goes on is saying we may have big positions in this material world we have fame whatever position you may have in this material world if we are not initiated by a special master it is what it's a dream it's a dream it has no value although one may…”

Maharaj gives the meditation from the eleventh canto's description of deity worship: Jagannatha in front, behind, above, below, right and left — and with him our spiritual master, not seen as separate.

🎙 Maharaj at 60:44 (auto-transcript): “It is in the same level of time. It is in the level of time. He gave a vision. So the juggernaut is in our front. Understand? This is how we should meditate. So, juggernaut is, in the front, juggernaut is, at the back, juggernaut is, above, juggernaut is, below is, by right,…”

Connect with a pure devotee and his experience becomes ours, as anyone travelling with a king shares the royal treatment. The driver goes wherever the king goes. — “You're in the same car. In fact, you are in the front.”

🎙 Maharaj at 64:43 (auto-transcript): “It's like if you travel with the king, what will happen to you? If you travel with the king, you will experience all the royalties given to that king. You will experience all. If you're a driver with the king, where will you be? You're in the same car. You're in the same car.…”
Rupa Gosvami's preliminary duties — shelter of the guru, initiation and learning, faithful service, following the acaryas — qualify one to relish the Bhagavatam. Then the Bhagavatam reveals Krishna.

After seven days of hearing from Sukadeva, Parikshit said Krishna had been placed in his hand. That is Bhagavatam — not reciting verses for money or prestige.

🎙 Maharaj at 72:34 (auto-transcript): “Sukadev Goswami spoke for seven days. What happened to Parishit Mahal? He said, you planted Krishna in my hand. He saw Krishna directly. Here is Krishna. That is Bhagavatam. Not just speaking to get money, to get prestige, You recite the shurokas and now you are qualified.…”

Kalindi felt no separation after Krishna left, and the other queens asked her secret. She pointed them to Uddhava, found in the grass of Vraja through kirtan, who then spoke the Bhagavatam to them.

🎙 Maharaj at 73:19 (auto-transcript): “You will enjoy him and Bhagavatam like Kalindi. Kalingi enjoys Bhagavata. She had Bhagavata from all that. So she doesn't feel suppressed from Krishna. Even though Krishna is not physically present, she doesn't feel the difference. She was having Krishna directly. So the…”

Hearing the Bhagavatam extinguishes lamentation, illusion and fear at once. — “So we say Bhagavatam is fire extinguisher.”

🎙 Maharaj at 76:39 (auto-transcript): “So we say Bhagavatam is fire extinguisher. You will know that. Bhagavatam is fire extinguisher. Yes. At once to extinguish the fire of lamentation, illusion, and fearfulness. Soka, moha, baya, apaha. One should hear Simad Bhagavatam from a bona fide spiritual master who can…”

Maharaj knew a sannyasi friend who recited the Bhagavatam well but did not chant his rounds; when his servant told him, Maharaj was ashamed. A show without the practice will not give the result.

🎙 Maharaj at 79:15 (auto-transcript): “I know someone who was reciting Bhagavatam, he never chanted Sisyah, he reciting Bhagavatam, but he did not chant Sisyah, he's a Swani, he's a Swani and he's a proper recital Bhagavatam, but he did not chant Sisyah. His servant came to complain to me, he's my friend, I know…”

Taking beads and hearing is not enough by itself; we must also work on ourselves, praying to Krishna to take away the habits we feel bad about — like cleaning hands and utensils before eating healthy food. — “We should work on ourselves.”

🎙 Maharaj at 81:12 (auto-transcript): “We should work on ourselves. It is not just sufficient for us to take a beat and be chanting or to hear or do whatever we are doing in Christian consciousness. should work on ourselves along with doing what we're doing if we don't work on ourselves what does it mean if if you…”

maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 18 · Pingala Day 09 · Cut Off the Sinful Desires

nodeData.topic: Class 18 · Pingala Day 09 · Cut Off the Sinful Desires
nodeData.note: SB 11.8.43 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Pingala cuts off her desire and sleeps in peace. Maharaj shows that material desire never lets anyone 'make ends meet' — the next one is never better — and that the best way to satisfy the senses is Krishna consciousness, learned from those who have already seen it all. In the questions he explains how much material desire a devotee needs (zero: everything is for Krishna), where Pingala found the strength (a devotee's mercy, received by hearing), and why demigod worship is a secondary thing. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The avadhuta describes Pingala, her mind made up, giving up her hopes of pleasure from lovers and lying down peacefully — desire is the cause of misery, freedom from it the cause of happiness.

These verses show both the cause of our suffering and the cause of happiness. Every conditioned soul has a strong desire to enjoy the senses and struggles hard for it.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:00 (auto-transcript): “So we see in this verse, these two verses, the causes of our suffering and also the causes for happiness. Tingala is representing all of our conditions. Every conditions have a strong desire to enjoy the senses.”

People speak of making ends meet, but no one ever has, because desires have no end. — “Nobody has ever made the ends meet.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:02 (auto-transcript): “They have the language, what to make the ends meet. Who has ever made the ends? Nobody has ever made the ends meet. Because until their desires have no end. One of my music friends has one song. He is not a devotee, but he has a material experience.”

A musician friend, not a devotee, named an album after a gambler: the more you get, the more you want. That is the struggle — we are never satisfied.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:38 (auto-transcript): “One of my music friends has one song. He is not a devotee, but he has a material experience. So he named this album Norman the Gambler, Norman the Gambler, N-O-R-M-A-N, Norman the Gambler. is a gambler the name of his friend the more you get the more you want so there”

The newest phone has just arrived; we think we will be completely happy when we get it — and once we have it, we are miserable again.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:16 (auto-transcript): “Apple, the latest Apple 15. Just arrived. When you get this, you are completely happy. When you get it, you are completely miserable. Nobody has ever made the ends meet in this world. Because they are all sources of misery. our desire to gratify the senses because of our…”

children.topic: The next one will be better
children.note:
Pingala changed partners again and again, never satisfied; material energy makes us think 'this one is no good, the next will be complete'.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:14 (auto-transcript): “so Pingala who is representing all of us has a strong desire to gratify the senses and they have been changing different, different men, different men every day, no satisfaction, always miserable, but material energy is so strong that makes us think This one is not good. The…”

Maharaj recalls the Peugeot cars of West Africa — 304, 404, 504 and on. Each new number was 'the best', yet underneath it was the same car. — “engine is the same only the name is different”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:06 (auto-transcript): “Yes, all the same thing. You don't have Pujokas in West Africa. you have three or four four or four five or five five or six five or seven the engine is the same only the name is different so when you have three or four is the best”

No material desire can make anyone happy. When Pingala realised this she cut off the desire completely, became happy and slept peacefully.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:54 (auto-transcript): “It is true that material desire cannot make anyone happy in this world. when Pingala realized this, he changed his mind, he said here he completely cut off the desire to enjoy all of us then she became completely happy she went to sleep happily so if we want to be happy in this”

children.topic: Learn from those who've seen it all
children.note:
If we want to be happy, we should learn from those who walked the road before us.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:02 (auto-transcript): “We should learn from those who have started it before us. In a movement we have Ambarish, the grandson of the number one American believer. He has seen all varieties of same notifications.”

Ambarisa Prabhu, from one of America's wealthiest families, had seen every variety of sense pleasure, concluded it was not the way to happiness, and took to Krishna consciousness — now he is completely happy.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:06 (auto-transcript): “In a movement we have Ambarish, the grandson of the number one American believer. He has seen all varieties of same notifications. So he concluded that this is not the way to be happy.”

Preaching in an Indian village, he told the crowd: where you are trying to go, I have come back from; there is nothing there. Our system is to learn from those with experience. — “don't waste your time if you learn from us we have seen it all”

🎙 Maharaj at 36:08 (auto-transcript): “So he told in one of his lectures, we were in India, in a village, we were preaching in a village. So many people like this were there. Baris Peribou said, all of you here should listen to me, where you are trying to go, I'm coming from the end, I have seen it all, there's…”

The best way to gratify the senses is to become a devotee: the prasadam, the dancing, the philosophy, the scripture and the altar are all the best.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:45 (auto-transcript): “The best way to gratify the senses is to become a devotee. A devotee, prasadam is the best, dancing is the best, philosophy is the best, Scripture is the best, the altar is the best. I have seen many altars, their deities eat only coconuts, and they change their dress after…”

Maharaj has seen altars where the deity gets only coconuts and a new dress every few months. In a Krishna temple he saw the deities' dress changed five times in a day, ending with a nightdress.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:16 (auto-transcript): “Scripture is the best, the altar is the best. I have seen many altars, their deities eat only coconuts, and they change their dress after three months or after one year. When Krishna comes in every day, sometimes, the deities change dresses five times in the day.”

Prasadam, philosophy, deity — all of it is sinless and complete. So don't waste time anywhere else. — “You have everything without sin.”

🎙 Maharaj at 41:03 (auto-transcript): “The solution is to be a devotee of Krishna. You have everything without sin. The Prasada is sinless. The philosophy is sinless. The deity is sinless. Everything is complete. So if we want to be happy Don't waste your time anywhere Not even demigods”

Not even the demigods are free; they are full of anxiety. Who is the greatest person in the universe? Brahma.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:35 (auto-transcript): “So if we want to be happy Don't waste your time anywhere Not even demigods They are not free All wasteful of anxiety Who is the greatest person in the universe? Who is the greatest person? Who? The Brahma. This is our Brahma and other Brahmans.”

Two demons existed before Brahma began creating. When they appeared Brahma had to run. Is that peace? If the greatest being is not peaceful, our anxiety is immeasurable.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:28 (auto-transcript): “In this creation, there were two demons that were existing before the Brahma started his creation. they are not created by Brahma they are not created by Brahma they were existing before Brahma so once once the Brahma he saw this big sky big sky cloud”

So approach only one who is completely free from misery: the Supreme Lord and his pure representatives. Pingala was miserable until she met a pure devotee and was transformed.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:00 (auto-transcript): “We should not approach any person. We should approach a person who is completely free from misery. The Supreme Personality of Godhead and His pure representatives. They can make us completely happy. Like Pingala. Pingala has been gratified in his senses but she has always…”

Take shelter of Gaura and Nitai, who brought the holy name. Their business is to dance and to get all of us dancing; serving them makes us happy.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:30 (auto-transcript): “And especially, taking a sort of Gauranitaya Who are the teacher of the inaugurator of the holy name of Krishna Panchatatua appeared in Moïse. The business is to dance. And to engage all of us in dancing. So we will do them service.”

Two questions: how much material desire a practising devotee should have, and when demigod worship began.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:29 (auto-transcript): “Questions? Comments? Thank you very much. In this material world, to sustain ourselves, we need some amount of material desires, for example, shelter, house. Some amount of material desires should be there. Yes, he mentioned in the verse that it is the cause of the greatest…”

children.topic: Q1 · How much material desire is okay?
children.note:
To live we need some things — shelter, a house, work. If material desire is the greatest cause of misery, where does a practising devotee draw the line?

🎙 Question from the floor at 46:50 (auto-transcript): “In this material world, to sustain ourselves, we need some amount of material desires, for example, shelter, house. Some amount of material desires should be there. Yes, he mentioned in the verse that it is the cause of the greatest unhappiness. So how do we, practicing…”

Maharaj's answer is zero — not even a fraction of a percent. — “Zero. We are taking zero. Zero.”

🎙 Maharaj at 48:00 (auto-transcript): “Zero. We are taking zero. Zero. Zero. Zero. But with point percent. Point zero percent. Zero. We don't understand that renunciation is one of the six populaces of Krishna. Renonciation is opulence, it is not starvation.”

Renunciation is one of Krishna's six opulences; it is opulence, not starvation. We make a mistake thinking renunciation means looking poor.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:19 (auto-transcript): “We don't understand that renunciation is one of the six populaces of Krishna. Renonciation is opulence, it is not starvation. Starvation is not poverty. Opulence.”

In the Himalayas rags may be fine, but to preach in Kali-yuga we wear clean clothes, cook nice prasadam and build magnificent temples — all for Krishna, not for oneself.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:19 (auto-transcript): “To think that renunciation means that you put on So, if you are going to stay at the Himalayas, it's okay, but if you are going to preach in Kali Yuga, you have to wear fresh, clean dress, nice prasada, for Krishna, cooking”

Rupa and Sanatana were so renounced they did not sleep under the same tree twice, yet on Mahaprabhu's order they built temples. There was no material desire in it.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:23 (auto-transcript): “That Rupa Goswami, Sanatana Goswami, they are brothers, they are brothers, Sanatana Goswami. They are completely renounced. Up to the point that they don't sleep under one tree. They sleep secretly. That's how serious the religion is.”

Raghunatha dasa Gosvami threw away a bigger cup a servant filled for him and asked for his own small one. Yet when he needed money to dig Radha-kunda, Krishna sent a devotee from afar with the funds. That is not material desire.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:46 (auto-transcript): “Raghunadas Goswami He drinks all the bottle milk and the quantity he drinks a day is measured he doesn't drink more than that One day, the servant, thinking that he's going to do a wonderful service. So he changed Raghunada Goswami's cup. A big one.”

children.topic: Q2 · When did demigod worship begin?
children.note:
At what point did living beings start worshipping demigods?

🎙 Question from the floor at 66:40 (auto-transcript): “At what time a living entity started worshiping demigods? At what time? When do we have the 20 days?”

There is no demigod worship in the kingdom of God. It begins when we fall from our position — a secondary thing, not the primary one. Confused, we grab the nearest thing we see.

🎙 Maharaj at 68:02 (auto-transcript): “There is no worshiping of demigods in the kingdom of God. In the local Vietnam, there is no demigods worshiping. Demigods worship begins when we fell from our position. At this point, we begin worshiping them in the world. Not in the spiritual world, it's in the material…”

children.topic: Shiva himself says Vishnu is best
children.note:
It is not an insult: Krishna says it in the Gita, and Lord Shiva himself says that of all worshippable persons Vishnu is the best. Brahma says the same.

🎙 Maharaj at 70:17 (auto-transcript): “Krishna said it very clearly in Babagita. And the persons who are worshipping themselves, they say it themselves, Lord Shiva. This is said by Lord Shiva, not by Krishna, Lord Shiva said this, of all the worshippable personalities in this world the best is Vishnu. If we want…”

A friend preferred Shiva's temple because there he could do as he liked. Maharaj replies that doing whatever we like is the life of a baby; without discipline, life is animal life. — “A responsible person will have rules and regulations in his life.”

🎙 Maharaj at 72:23 (auto-transcript): “One friend told me see my friend I don't like your Krishna because don't do this. say I'm on jeans trouser I enter into Lord Shiva temple but I cannot do that in I am a Krishna. I am a Shiva.”

children.topic: Where did she get the strength?
children.note:
Pingala cut off her sinful desires — but where did that strength come from? From the mercy of a devotee, which is very powerful.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:03 (auto-transcript): “We see in the verse, Pingala has been able to cut off her sinful desires. So the question is, where does she got the strength? How she got the strength to cut off her sinful desires? God, the mercy of a devotee, the mercy of a devotee is very powerful.”

Only the mercy of a pure devotee could carry her beyond her desires; by that mercy she gave up all material desire.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:42 (auto-transcript): “God, the mercy of a devotee, the mercy of a devotee is very powerful. But the mercy of a devotee, she was able to give up all the material desires. She had the mercy of Dr. Treya.”

Narada as a boy heard from the Bhaktivedantas for four months and Krishna's pastimes became attractive. He had faith and attachment, was not frivolous, and listened with full attention; seeing this, the sages gave him knowledge unasked.

Bhakti has a formula; we should learn the formula and apply it. Pure devotees are merciful to one who serves them sincerely, without prestige, as a menial servant. — “Bhakti is a science, he has formula.”

🎙 Maharaj at 62:35 (auto-transcript): “Bhakti has science, formula. Bhakti is a science, he has formula. We should learn the formula and apply the formula.”

children.topic: Those with ears, let them hear
children.note:
When the bell rings, do we feel angry, disturbed, frustrated? Those who have ears to hear will hear.

🎙 Maharaj at 65:15 (auto-transcript): “when the bell is a bear when the bell sounds what would you do lamenting angry frustrated, disturbed. Why? Because we are here. So those who have ears, let them hear. Guys who don't have the ear, stay here, let's go.”

maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 17 · Pingala Day 08 · Protecting Oneself

nodeData.topic: Class 17 · Pingala Day 08 · Protecting Oneself
nodeData.note: SB 11.8.42 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Pingala sees that the whole world lies in the jaws of time, and that sight makes her detached and able to protect herself. Maharaj contrasts selfish 'salvation' and mixed devotion with her pure turn to Krishna, shows how imperceptibly time takes everything, and describes how a devotee prepares for death — with the holy name, Krishna's pastimes, and a life that lets the spiritual master see his training has borne fruit. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Pingala's verse is about the soul who sees the whole universe swallowed by time, becomes sober and detached, and so can protect itself.

Maharaj explains that seeking salvation is self-centred — 'my own deliverance' — and the same is true of most pious works.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:02 (auto-transcript): “salvation salvation or liberation is the same thing salvation is selfish selfish self-centered my own idea just my situation my deliverance is salvation which includes all the auspicious activities all the specific activities like giving charity providing water for people to…”

People give charity, plant trees, open hospitals and free schools not because they care for you but to be promoted to the heavenly planets. Krishna's call to abandon all varieties of religion means giving up such self-interested dharma.

Kapila Muni describes devotion in the modes: approaching Krishna out of fear of sin is devotion in goodness; approaching him for protection, health or power is devotion in passion or ignorance. None of it is pure.

Most people come to Krishna for their own sake — money, mystic power, promotion, protection. It is not about Krishna; we simply use him.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:04 (auto-transcript): “they're taken to Krishna consists for our own sake so so we are using Krishna for our own personal gratification so it's not really for Krishna and majority of people are like this we are looking for Christians but for linear Christians a properties the mystic power promotion…”

Pingala is not in that category: the mercy of a pure devotee turned her away from sense gratification toward Krishna, without any desire to merge.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:00 (auto-transcript): “so pingala is not in this category because she has been blessed by that i three influence is messy affected her to take the christian consciousness so she turned away from sense gratification positively not to look for something as as a person merging into krishna that is the…”

children.topic: A pure devotee won't bless merging
children.note:
A pure devotee never merges into Krishna and will not give that blessing; he is after the Personality of Godhead and has a direct relationship with him.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:34 (auto-transcript): “as a person merging into krishna that is the the special quality of having the mission of a pure devotee the beauty which will not give us the blessing to merge into krishna because he's not merged into krishna and he's against that so he will not give us that kind of…”

First one realises the self, then one can speak of realising God. Seeing oneself as separate from the Lord was the illusion that distracted us from our real duty.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:40 (auto-transcript): “after self-realization self-realization then there is god realization we have to be so realized then we can talk about god realization civilization is compulsory necessary realizing the self so automatically one would like in the money said in the first counter this is a…”

When we say 'time', what comes to mind? Time takes away everything, but imperceptibly. Only a self-realised soul sees it; a conditioned soul never does.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:55 (auto-transcript): “and when we when we look at time when we say the word time what are we doing at the same time time what come to the mind when they say time that we are looking at that name takes away everything but imperceptibly imperceptibly we don't see how time is taking away everything”

children.topic: Parents don't see the child grow
children.note:
A visitor says, 'How the child has grown!' The parents never noticed — they see the baby every day, lying, then crawling, then standing.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:14 (auto-transcript): “how time is taking away everything. A conditioned soul will never see. For example, the parent will not see how the child is growing. You don't see. Someone who has not seen a child will tell you oh this child has grown so much they are growing so fast but the parents will…”

children.topic: We cannot eat or run as before
children.note:
Quietly, time changes us: we can no longer eat, digest or run the way we once did.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:00 (auto-transcript): “we don't see that and a certain is is changing everything that you will not be able to eat the way we're eating before yeah the quantity of food you used to eat in you know you to eat that again this time you know you to run the way you surround before if you you cannot you…”

Morning becomes afternoon, evening becomes night, and one day is out of our life. 2023 is nearly finished — one more year gone.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:44 (auto-transcript): “different but very very slowly that we don't see that time is changing everything the morning has become afternoon and afternoon has become evening light is night and one one day is out of our life then one year is out so 2023 is finished in few days now we are counting 20…”

If a conditioned soul is told the end is near, the next thing is the doctor: what can you do, how much money, can I get an extension?

🎙 Maharaj at 31:49 (auto-transcript): “soul if if a conditional soul inform that the days are very close the next thing is to ask a doctor what can you do how much money you need can i stand i need extension but when we look at the life of this civilized devotee what did you do the moment pressure when i was…”

Told he had seven days to live, Maharaja Parikshit did not seek more time; he gave up everything at once and went to hear. — “he didn't ask for extension immediately he abandoned everything”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:17 (auto-transcript): “life of this civilized devotee what did you do the moment pressure when i was informed they're living in seven days he didn't ask for extension immediately he abandoned everything and he went to us so what is the duty for a person who will leave this is a a save realized…”

What should my thinking and activity be now? There is no time for fear or procrastination or looking for remedies. The only remedy is to turn to Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:53 (auto-transcript): “should be my activities what should I remember what should I do now understand there's not it did not time for fear did not time for procrastinating there's no time for looking for remedy the only one remedy to turn to krishna that one is very fortunate to get your notice get…”

Every living being is on the roll call: Chitragupta marks the register each day. If we are fortunate, Krishna lets us know our days are few so we can prepare.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:30 (auto-transcript): “role let's call it register we have register quick chitra gupta marks every day chitra gupta Marks the register. He marks the register every day. He is marking for us. If we are very fortunate, a Christian will arrange that we will be informed according to your register. You…”

Krishna may come directly, as for Bhishmadeva or for Haridasa Thakura through Mahaprabhu, or he comes as the holy name, with devotees chanting kirtan as one leaves the body.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:12 (auto-transcript): “like bismadev the supreme position of body will come before before us who come before us directly or he comes as the holy name the devotees this is the two ways the devotee so he leaves the body the two ways the devoted to live the body the christian come directly like…”

When medicine stops working, that is the message: resign from everything and take shelter of the holy name. Maharaj describes how his spiritual master left his body at Gita Nagari.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:06 (auto-transcript): “level that we are taking medicine and nothing is working we are taking all the necessary medicine nothing is working that is the message there's a message just resign from everything and resign and take shelter the holy name let the name be chanted and like he's only about…”

children.topic: Only the name and the pastimes
children.note:
In those final hours there was not a pin drop of other sound — only the holy name and a senior sannyasi reading Krishna's pastimes.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:34 (auto-transcript): “this time not even a pin drop when they pin nothing no nothing only the holy name and his Holiness Radha Maharaj is reading pastimes of Krishna. Only two things. The pastimes of Krishna and the Holy Name. Nothing else. There is no sound, no extra sound than the Holy Name and…”

Two devotees from Barsana arrived uninvited at a forest village in America just before the departure — a sign Maharaj takes to heart. The time a soul appears and disappears is very important.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:08 (auto-transcript): “narration of Krishna. Only two things. That's how he learned about teacher Maharaj. Unfortunately, two devotees from Barasana came to America. Without any invitation, they were not informed that someone was leaving the border. Gitanagri is not a famous place. People are from…”

children.topic: The only doctor is the holy name
children.note:
At that stage we should not keep calling 'doctor, doctor'. The only medicine left is the holy name and hearing Krishna's pastimes. — “there's only doctor the holy name”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:56 (auto-transcript): “gets get himself i said prepare not not that we all continue to oh doctor doctor the only doctor now is the holy name of christian there's only doctor the holy name and hearing persons of christian no no no no time for anything else at his height is what happened the…”

Devotees long to leave the body in a holy place. His spiritual master said he would make Vrindavan at Gita Nagari and left his body there; Maharaj has heard godbrothers say the same of their own places.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:47 (auto-transcript): “So he said, I will create Vrindavan in Gita Nagiri, so that people can also testify. It's the proper statement that he has created Vrindavan in the way. So he decided to leave his body there. He becomes a place of people with his brothers. And I heard from two of his…”

children.topic: Don't leave the guru a failure
children.note:
Being a disciple is more than a new name. The spiritual master should be able to leave the world happy, seeing what his investment in us has produced.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:39 (auto-transcript): “is has any meaning and as disciple we have we also have to put ourselves in the situation the special masters will see us and and be happy with where we are spiritually that is part of it to be a disciple you're not just the changing name to be a disciple has a lot of meaning…”

Do not come to the departing guru miserable, so that he sees how useless we are and that he leaves with no representative. Srila Prabhupada said if he could make one pure devotee, he would consider his attempt a success.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:28 (auto-transcript): “so he can be happy to so krishna told you this time don't go to the grandfather lamenting don't go to me in the miserable way for him to see how useless you are that he's leaving the body without having a representative this is a failure the disciples should not be like that…”

As with a child, the teacher wants to see that we can now stand and carry on what he established after he disappears. Those who take the teaching seriously have the power to maintain it. — “now we can stand on our feet.”

🎙 Maharaj at 41:22 (auto-transcript): “This is what the special master wants, you want to see that now we can stand on our feet. When you train the child, you can stand on the feet and you can invest more to continue with what you have established. So you feel very happy that, yes, the establishment you have…”

Not every day complaining and calling ourselves failures. If there is crying, let it be crying for Godhead — a prayer, not lamentation.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:22 (auto-transcript): “not every every single moment is complain I say failure every day is a lamentation you should cry at the pillar for Godhead not lamentation what we we are not as a failure so in that condition the living entity is qualified to be his own protector our own protector means what…”

To be one's own protector means knowing clearly what to do and what not to do. It is not an amulet: one sees illusion and reality side by side and cannot be deviated, so maya cannot disturb him.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:38 (auto-transcript): “are not as a failure so in that condition the living entity is qualified to be his own protector our own protector means what now we know what to do and what not to do we have come to that level it's protection protection not a amulet that is different it's different one can…”

children.topic: No time in the spiritual world
children.note:
Everything with duration is within time; the soul has no duration. In Goloka there is no past, present and future, because time there is Krishna himself — here everything deteriorates and is ruled by the clock.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:13 (auto-transcript): “gray serpent of time everything is controlled by time there is nothing good outside nothing so anything that has duration is within the time the duration means time they can count the soul the soul there's no duration you're not at it is not within the time that's why in the…”

When the Pandavas knew it was time, they did not even call their wives or mother; they simply left. Elders like Gandhari also departed without fuss, following that science.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:36 (auto-transcript): “when the panda was with they know the time has it's time to they didn't even call their wife they didn't even call their their mother just left if we have sense after follow they follow on their own singer like gandari the husband didn't call him he just left he said no i…”

Maharaj describes celestial airplanes carrying devotees away in jubilation. Our leaving the world should give joy to others. — “our departure should be spiritually celebrated”

🎙 Maharaj at 47:55 (auto-transcript): “seeing that oh i see them they're going to seven day flowers jubilating their success this is how our life should be our our departure should be spiritually celebrated it should give joy to into the another woman again that is uh the message yes yes yes every devotee likes to go”

A question about inner guidance, and a closing remark on goodness.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:40 (auto-transcript): “Is there any difference between the voice of the Supersoul and the Conscience which is built? Because Pingala was getting the realisation, so was it her own Conscience speaking or the voice of the Supersoul guiding? When we say conscience is the individual soul, that means…”

When Pingala received her realisation, was it her own conscience speaking or the Supersoul guiding her?

🎙 Question from the floor at 50:40 (auto-transcript): “Is there any difference between the voice of the Supersoul and the Conscience which is built? Because Pingala was getting the realisation, so was it her own Conscience speaking or the voice of the Supersoul guiding? When we say conscience is the individual soul, that means…”

The conscience belongs to the individual soul; the Supersoul is a different person who instructs it. When the soul is realised it hears that voice clearly, and the pure devotees are guided by it, so their acts are perfect.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:11 (auto-transcript): “When we say conscience is the individual soul, that means that the voice of the super soul is different, because the individual soul is a person, and the super soul is a person, so both of them are conversing. So the voice of the super soul is different, instructing the…”

In Mumbai devotees wanted a busy place; Srila Prabhupada pointed to an empty jungle at Juhu. Today long queues come there from morning to midnight. He accepted hardship there without complaint — that is acting on the Supersoul's message.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:10 (auto-transcript): “mumbai they were they were telling the prophet they wanted the akash akash because it's a post place and many people are there the proper was pointing hand to where we have temple now then nobody was there it's a jungle nobody lives there proper this we have preacher we need…”

It is much easier to rise from goodness than from passion or ignorance, so Prabhupada places us in goodness to begin from there.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:38 (auto-transcript): “activity no confusion yes if you continue if you continue because the mode of goodness is very conducive to rise very easily than to rise from ignorance and passion so goodness is best therefore better for us to raise our standard to goodness and you see this is what prophet…”
