nodeData.topic: Class 03 · Training of a Disciple by a Bona Fide Guru
nodeData.note: SB 11.3.21–24 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Taking shelter of a bona fide spiritual master is compulsory for anyone who wants real happiness; the guru speaks from scripture and realisation, and the disciple, after testing, accepts him in full surrender and serves him without duplicity. Maharaj explains why Krishna reveals himself through his pure devotees, how a disciple deals with all beings, and the qualities — cleanliness, forgiveness, simplicity, non-violence, tolerance — needed to serve the guru; questions follow on hearing from non-devotees and on telling the truth. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Prabuddha tells King Nimi that one who seriously wants real happiness must take shelter of a spiritual master who knows the scriptures, can convince others and has taken shelter of the Lord.

For those with no attraction to Krishna because of addiction to sense gratification, the recommendation is to take shelter of a bona fide guru. Maharaj stresses it is not 'if I like'. Just as light is necessary for one in darkness, the guru is necessary for one in illusion.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:02 (auto-transcript): “due to addiction the sanctification so the recommendation is that we should take shelter of a bonafide spiritual master this compulsory in the Punisher the word a big a big it is not an option if I like I can or if I don't like it can”

The guru speaks from scripture, not his own brain; and not just philosophy but realisation, with full conviction and faith in Krishna. That conviction is what affects the audience. — “he is speaking from the scripture, not from his brain”

🎙 Maharaj at 23:05 (auto-transcript): “compulsory for a person in illusion so it is compulsory the qualification is that he is speaking from the scripture, not from his brain, from the scripture, and he is not just speaking the philosophy, he is speaking the realization, he is fully”
The disciple accepts the bona fide guru as his life and soul and worshipable deity, and learns from him to serve the Lord so faithfully that Krishna gives himself.

As the Gita says, one approaches the guru in full surrender and serves him as a menial servant without false prestige — that is why there is guru-puja. — “not half not 99.9 hundred percent full surrender”

Without confidence nothing works. If doubts sit in the mind — will he take me back to Godhead, is he the right person? — the transmission stops flowing. Subtle as it is, the disconnection has a serious effect.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:22 (auto-transcript): “so the proper was asked yes I have to train them in that way because if the fate is not there if they don't have confidence in the special master nothing will work the teams don't have confidence in we are not going to give”

Before full surrender there must be testing: the guru tests the disciple and the disciple tests the guru. Once he is confirmed bona fide, he is served as good as God.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:04 (auto-transcript): “before doing that we have to check before accepting in full surrender we have to check The Guru must test the disciple, the disciple must test the Guru He is a bona fide disciple He is a bona fide Guru”

Guru-puja is spiritual, not material, and its result will be experienced. — “It is not a hero worship. It is not a personality cult.”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:15 (auto-transcript): “It is not a hero worship. It is not a personality cult. Guru Puja is spiritual, not material. And the result will be experienced. Why Guru should be accepted like that? The Supreme Personality of Godhead Hari, the soul of all souls, is inclined to give himself to his pure…”

children.topic: Krishna lives in his pure devotee
children.note:
Why accept the guru this way? Because Hari, the soul of all souls, is inclined to give himself to his pure devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:48 (auto-transcript): “Why Guru should be accepted like that? The Supreme Personality of Godhead Hari, the soul of all souls, is inclined to give himself to his pure devotees. Krishna to Narada Muni If you go to Vaikuntha, you won't see me If you go to the heart of the yogis, you won't see me Where…”

children.topic: Not in Vaikuntha, not in yogis' hearts
children.note:
Krishna tells Narada Muni: you will not find me in Vaikuntha or in the hearts of yogis; you will find me where my devotees are singing my glories.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:03 (auto-transcript): “Krishna to Narada Muni If you go to Vaikuntha, you won't see me If you go to the heart of the yogis, you won't see me Where will you see me? When my devotees are doing what? That is where Krishna is”

Nityananda Prabhu saw the Deities in every temple on his pilgrimage, yet said all the temples were empty — until he met Madhavendra Puri and saw Krishna in his heart. They embraced and fell unconscious, and Nityananda declared his pilgrimage now successful.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:19 (auto-transcript): “He said, I visited many temples, every year was entered.”

Disciples learn to serve without duplicity: no cheating, transparent dealings. If something is hidden, the guru–disciple relationship will not be sweet. The word is arjavam — straightforward, simple.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:36 (auto-transcript): “should learn from the special master to serve the Lord without duplicity Service without duplicity, no cheating, transparent dealing, the relationship between Guru and disciples should be clean”

Maharaj compares duplicity to slipping something bad into food that is otherwise cooked very nicely: nobody will enjoy it. Whatever we give out, we get back; if there is duplicity, we will be cheated.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:46 (auto-transcript): “just like when you cook it very tasty is to try me to hear what I know how to cook very nicely food I know how to cook very nicely so if you put some in the skin for us about all the world will enjoy it duplicity means something nobody will like it because whatever we give out we”

Isvara Puri and Ramacandra Puri had the same guru. Isvara Puri was blessed by him and attained love of Godhead; Ramacandra Puri was cursed and did not.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:40 (auto-transcript): “we have two types of disciples this couple this couple this couple this couple this couple is a duplicitous disciple this couple is a genuine disciple both of them have different experience. Like in Chaitanya Chaitanya, we have Ishwara Puri, Goswami, Ramachandra Puri,…”

A thief denies everything to everyone — except his own lawyer, who must defend him in court. In the same way a disciple may say no to others, but to the guru he admits everything.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:50 (auto-transcript): “faithful I gave you this example many times thief who will deny having stolen anything or denying did you steal this no no i don't know his lawyer the lawyer the lawyer of the thief”

Quoting the Upanisads, Maharaj says the meaning of scripture is revealed to one with unflinching faith in both guru and Krishna — not to brain exercise or memorising verses.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:25 (auto-transcript): “upon it yeah punishers yeah under the punishments very famous one to do disciples who have on flinching fit in both guru and Krishna the scripture be Revealed, they would know Krishna Look, Brahma didn't go to school to study the Vedas Is it true?”

Brahma received the Vedas without a school; what was difficult became simple, and he saw Vaikuntha and Krishna's energies, because Krishna was pleased with his simplicity.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:01 (auto-transcript): “Look, Brahma didn't go to school to study the Vedas Is it true? So Brahma did it is because there are nobody nobody no teacher at that time so she couldn't go to school that's not reason he didn't go to”

A scholar insisted on reading his own Bhagavatam commentary to Caitanya Mahaprabhu, who refused: one who does not respect Sridhara Svami, the original commentator, is not accepted. Study Bhagavatam from a devotee — only devotees understand it.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:51 (auto-transcript): “One day One devotee also came to Chaitanya Mahabharava So the mother of Swami didn't want to bring him to a gentleman Well, the duty was pushing pushing Finally one day he started speaking without even permission I have and you know I did not touch it they come and trust…”

Because Krishna lives in the heart of a pure devotee and reveals himself to devotees, it is by following devotees that we come to understand Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:44 (auto-transcript): “Because Krishna lives in the body of a pure devotee, Krishna reveals himself to his devotees. By following devotees, we can understand Krishna. A sincere disciple should learn to disassociate the mind from everything material and positively cultivate association with the…”
The verse teaches the disciple to detach the mind from matter, cultivate saintly association, and deal properly with those below, equal to and above him.

Being merciful to others means giving them Krishna consciousness, not exploiting anyone.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:44 (auto-transcript): “Merciful means you should teach them Krishna consciousness. We should not exploit anyone, we should be friendly, friendly dealing with others, and those who are our equals we should be friends, we should not show off, and those who are superior to us we should serve them. Now…”

Do not exploit those below, do not show off among equals, do not envy superiors — be humble, friendly and serve. This is how we become free from the threefold miseries.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:36 (auto-transcript): “We should not exploit those who are lower than us. We should not be prowled among our equals. We should not be envious of our superiors. Rather we should be humble and sound them nicely. Be friendly with our equals. Teach the genuine one Krishna consciousness. We will be free…”
To serve the guru, the disciple learns cleanliness, austerity, tolerance, silence, study, simplicity, celibacy, non-violence and equanimity in dualities.

Externally: bathe regularly, wash our clothes, keep our surroundings clean. Internally: chant Hare Krishna and keep the mind free from malice, grudges and anger. — “cleanliness is godliness”

🎙 Maharaj at 52:30 (auto-transcript): “cleanliness refers to both internal and external purity outside is clean environment is clean any person who has two pairs of dress to wash at the sometimes is dating”

children.topic: A grudge is fire in the hand
children.note:
If we do not forgive we plan revenge, and if we do not forgive we will not be forgiven. Keeping a grudge is like holding fire — who feels peaceful holding fire? It burns.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:59 (auto-transcript): “If we don't forgive, we are going to plan to revenge forgiveness. very important if you don't forgive we will not be forgiven if you want others will forgive us we should forgive if you keep grudge against any person like are holding fire who feels peaceful holding fire…”

Mauna means not speaking worthless topics but discussing going back to Godhead and how to expand Krishna consciousness — Maharaj calls this very important.

🎙 Maharaj at 58:14 (auto-transcript): “mona silence means that one should not speak worthless or fabulous topics So discuss the actual issues of human life, such as going back home, back to Godhead. Always chanting, learning how to execute every devotional activities. it is. Think how to expand Krishna…”

Not preaching Krishna consciousness is itself a kind of violence. Honesty is no licence to insult; speak the humble truth. — “non-violence means that we should preach Krishna consciousness”

🎙 Maharaj at 61:08 (auto-transcript): “non-violence means that we should preach Krishna consciousness If you don't preach Christian consciously, you are committing violence. Samatvam Dvandva, Samghyayoh, indicate that one should keep a cool head even when disturbing material dualities become manifest. why why…”

Heat and cold come and go like seasons — now it is winter, in a few months we will want the air conditioning. If we tolerate, we avoid many unnecessary problems.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:37 (auto-transcript): “why why should we do that what trespassers to come to you see just a docker to cada a gamma final details come to this as well it is not permanent they will come and go like winter and so on now we have been called after some month we'll be putting fun and air condition”

A puzzle Maharaj sets, then questions from the audience.

🎙 Maharaj at 62:53 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna, it's our philosophy that we should not hear from. And Papa said, a milk which is taught by a snake is”

Prabhupada says hearing Krishna-katha from a non-devotee is like milk touched by a serpent's lips. Yet Srivasa Pandita heard Bhagavatam from such a speaker and fell unconscious in ecstasy — poison or nectar? The answer offered: it depends on the hearer; a pure devotee cannot be affected.

🎙 Question from the floor at 62:53 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna, it's our philosophy that we should not hear from. And Papa said, a milk which is taught by a snake is”

If telling the truth will make someone feel bad, what should we do?

🎙 Question from the floor at 66:20 (auto-transcript): “My question is, if there is a situation like this, we have to say truth. But if we are to say truth, if we are to say truth, what should we do in this situation? the truth the person will feel bad but you have helped the person we don't know that we don't”

One who knows the truth must speak; staying quiet about wrong we saw makes us part of it. Maharaj recalls a leader who covered up for his disciple and called it protection — Maharaj told him covering up is no protection; protection is telling the truth so the person learns right from wrong.

🎙 Maharaj at 67:58 (auto-transcript): “the truth I couldn't we are implicated one who knows one who knows the truth it is time for you to speak if you don't speak you are implicated in the contamination even though we don't physically do it someone is this one wrong you saw it when he asked you can quiet you have…”

children.topic: Q3 · Must I read from Canto 1?
children.note:
A busy worker hears classes on different parts — must he read the Bhagavatam in order?

🎙 Question from the floor at 72:15 (auto-transcript): “So he works somewhere and he doesn't get time, he or she doesn't get time to read Bhagavatam. But he gets classes from some different, you are given from kind of element. So is it necessary to read it from the building or I can read it from anywhere, from where he gets…”

Prabhupada's idea is to start from Canto 1, Krishna's lotus feet, so that by Canto 10 we are pure enough to enter his pastimes. Reading any canto is no offence — but Krishna gave us 24 hours, so we should make time for him.

🎙 Maharaj at 73:09 (auto-transcript): “Yeah, the idea is that when we start reading from country 1, that is a lot of feet of Krishna By the time we get to canto 9 We are pure dhuti When we enter canto 10 We will participate in Krishna's nina That is the idea of course it's not happening like that in most cases but…”

children.topic: Q4 · If the truth costs a life?
children.note:
A devotee recalls hearing that one should not tell a truth that leads to someone's death, citing Yudhisthira and a sage who revealed hiding thieves.

🎙 Question from the floor at 75:36 (auto-transcript): “Thank you very much for your lecture. I didn't hear the concluding part when you were saying what if you tell the truth and then the person is killed. So I didn't hear what you said about that. I said question there's a question so yes I should tell the truth but if I tell…”

Maharaj answers that Yudhisthira passed through hell not for telling the truth but for hesitating when Krishna told him what to say — for Krishna everything is truth.

🎙 Maharaj at 77:47 (auto-transcript): “Yudhishthira Maharaj went, he didn't go to hell, but he passed through the hell. Not because he told the truth, because he didn't tell the truth. When Krishna told him to tell lies, he refused. How can I say lie?”

In the other story the sage was punished because thieves were caught in his hermitage; he survived and asked why, and was shown he had pierced a grasshopper as a child. The point stands: say the truth — the truth sets you free.

🎙 Maharaj at 79:04 (auto-transcript): “There are two chiefs who went to hit the same heritage. He was arrested, they didn't tell about the sage, it was an assumption, because they caught them in his hemitage. The king was told that this man is not a sage. He is pretending to be a sage. He is the one sending the…”

children.topic: Q5 · Preaching what we don't practise
children.note:
One who recites scripture without practising it is like a karma-kandi; his words have no effect, because people perceive what is in our heart.

🎙 Question from the floor at 82:39 (auto-transcript): “Just an understanding on this. Speak from scripture, the truth. But you know, practice it. But it is a truth given in the scripture. You can preach about it. But our practice may be different from that. So then how should we see it? One who can recite the scriptures, he's…”

maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 02 · Krishna Is Conquered Only by Love

nodeData.topic: Class 02 · Krishna Is Conquered Only by Love
nodeData.note: SB 11.6.18 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Krishna lives with sixteen thousand queens of unearthly beauty, yet nothing material or even spiritual enjoyment can disturb his mind — he is conquered only by the pure, selfless love of his devotees. Maharaj contrasts that love with lust, tells how the gopis' love held Krishna back from Mathura and how they gave the dust of their feet to cure his headache, and asks us to follow, not imitate, the gopis. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The demigods praise Krishna: though surrounded by sixteen thousand beautiful queens sending him loving glances, his mind and senses remain undisturbed.

Maharaj builds a ladder: the most beautiful person here times a hundred is heavenly beauty; that times a hundred is Brahmaloka; that times a thousand is Vaikuntha; beyond any figure is Goloka. The queens' beauty is from there and cannot be compared with anything in this world.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:26 (auto-transcript): “When you take the most beautiful person in this world, multiply that by a hundred. That is heaven. That is beauty in heaven. Take the beauty of heaven, multiplied into 100, that is Brahma, the highest material”

Like the gopis, the queens serve Krishna with pure affection — something not found in the material world.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:35 (auto-transcript): “The gopis, they serve Krishna with affection. That is what they use to serve Krishna, affection. The gopis is like that they serve Krishna. They are like that they serve, like affection. That is not in the material world. We don't serve someone with affection. We serve with…”

Here we serve others out of greed and self-interest. What the world calls love is lust — pure love contaminated, its very opposite.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:54 (auto-transcript): “We don't serve someone with affection. We serve with greed. Some interests. So it is not affection. Contaminated. And what people think affection in the world? What do you think is an affection? That is lost. Lost is a contaminated love of Godhead. Opposite of love.”

Lust says: I want to use you to fill my empty life; my enjoyment is in your body and you should give it to me. Maharaj says there is no love in it at all — only selfishness.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:50 (auto-transcript): “I want to use you to fill my empty space, my empty life. That is lost. Selfishness. There is no love at all. There is nothing like love. Selfishness. I want to enjoy. My enjoyment is in your body and you should give it to me.”

Because it is selfish desire, it does not end well: it ends in frustration, anxiety and pain. Pure love of God is different. — “That is the result of lust.”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:44 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, because it is lusty, selfish desire, it does not end well, it ends in disaster, frustration, anxiety, pain. That is the result of lust. So that is not the situation with pure love for God. Lord Krishna's queens and Lord Krishna's girlfriends, the gopis,”

children.topic: Controlled by his own spiritual energy
children.note:
The demigods say Krishna is not controlled by material or spiritual enjoyment — yet he is controlled by his internal potency. Maharaj calls this the 'interesting philosophy' of the verse.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:40 (auto-transcript): “But the demigods are saying, Lord Krishna, you are not controlled by material energy. You are not controlled by spiritual energy. That is philosophy. I told you this verse is very interesting. That is philosophy. Krishna is controlled by his energy, his spiritual energy.…”

Principally Srimati Radharani controls him. The gopis' love even made Krishna forget his duty to go and kill Kamsa.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:10 (auto-transcript): “That is philosophy. Krishna is controlled by his energy, his spiritual energy. Principally, Srimati Radharani, he controls Krishna. And Sanatana Goswami said, the love of the gopis in Brindavan, Another one, made Krishna forget his duty. Krishna forgot what he is supposed to…”

Being controlled by pure love is natural, because pure love is the supreme potency and Radharani is Krishna's own energy — his own enjoyment. — “That is the nature of love.”

🎙 Maharaj at 35:09 (auto-transcript): “So, Krishna is controlled by his spiritual potency. That is not a fault. It is natural. Because the nature of pure love that has supreme potency. So Krishna is affected by that, because it is his enjoyment, that is his enjoyment, and it is himself, in that form of Srimati…”

Because Krishna had forgotten to go to Mathura, Akrura came to bring him.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:24 (auto-transcript): “He forgot to go to Mathura to kill Kamsa. So, Akura came. Akura did two things. He has to justice Krishna. You see? Is this interesting? Akura is justiceing Krishna. Your parents, you are devoted, they are suffering in the hands of Kamsa every day.”

Akrura reproaches Krishna: your parents and devotees suffer every day as Kamsa threatens them with a sword, and you sit here with your girlfriends doing nothing.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:44 (auto-transcript): “He has to justice Krishna. You see? Is this interesting? Akura is justiceing Krishna. Your parents, you are devoted, they are suffering in the hands of Kamsa every day. Every day. Kamsa. He comes to them. With sword in his hand. I will kill you. I'll kill you. He's treating…”

As soon as Krishna and Balarama mounted the chariot, the gopis came: we cannot bear you hiding behind a tree for a moment — your going is death. Krishna stepped down and followed them into the forest, and by the power of their love not even Balarama saw him go.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:14 (auto-transcript): “As soon as Krishna and Balaram got to the chariot, the gopis came there. You are leaving us for maturation. How can we exist without you? For a moment, when we are playing, and you went behind a tree, we cannot tolerate that. And you are going to go for a long time. That is…”

Akrura found only Balarama on the chariot and begged him to find his brother. Balarama traced Krishna's footprints to the gopis in the forest and brought him back.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:54 (auto-transcript): “Krishna is not there. Only Balaram is sitting there. He came to him. Where is your brother? I don't know. Please, I beg you. Please. Only you can find him. Go and find him. Balaram got down from the chariot. only look on the ground then he saw krishna's footprints that is how…”

Not wanting Krishna to vanish again, Akrura drove off at once, skilfully steering around the gopis who fell on the ground.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:57 (auto-transcript): “This time, as soon as he sat on the chariot, Akrura doesn't want him to disappear again. Immediately he started to drive the chariot. The gopi were falling on the ground. Akrura was very expert. He was driving. He didn't want to hit. He was driving, maneuvering. He was…”

Krishna is controlled by the love of his devotees, and by nothing in this world.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:42 (auto-transcript): “So, Krishna is controlled by his love for Fiddlesticks. that Krishna is controlled by the love of his devotees. Yudhishthira Maharaj, he told Krishna, please don't go to Dwaraka now, please, at least, just for a short time, just a short time, please, I beg you. Please please,…”

Yudhisthira Maharaja begged Krishna not to leave for Dvaraka, just for a few days more — and Krishna stayed. Sukadeva Gosvami's word for it is that Yudhisthira detained him.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:52 (auto-transcript): “Yudhishthira Maharaj, he told Krishna, please don't go to Dwaraka now, please, at least, just for a short time, just a short time, please, I beg you. Please please, please. Please! Please! Don't go to Dwaraka. Please, please stay at least a little time. Even though Krishna…”

children.topic: Queens as a reminder of Vraja
children.note:
Some Dvaraka queens have very high prema. Maharaj relates Krishna saying the queens' beauty and their number gave him some compensation for missing the gopis of Vrindavan — not that material beauty attracted him.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:04 (auto-transcript): “So, there are some queens of Dwarka who has prem. Her prem is very high. that Lord Krishna also feels compelled. Krishna himself, he said, I was able to tolerate the pain of separation from gopis. When I see the beauty of Chandravali,”

Though resting with such beautiful queens, at exactly three o'clock Krishna leaves the bed. When they complain, he says: look at the time, I have to do japa. Beauty cannot control him. — “Krishna is controlled by pure love.”

🎙 Maharaj at 47:34 (auto-transcript): “But, Krishna is not controlled, Krishna is sleeping with this kind of beauty, so sweet, but exactly 3 o'clock, Krishna leaves the bed, Krishna leaves the bed, the queens complain, Where are you going? We just lie down now. Krishna said, look at time. Three o'clock. I have to…”

One question from the audience, answered at length with a story.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:39 (auto-transcript): “Comment your questions. In the beginning of our class, your holiness talked about lust. That was selfishness.”

children.topic: Q1 · Lust disguised in devotional service?
children.note:
You said lust is selfishness — how can we recognise it when it hides inside our devotional service?

🎙 Question from the floor at 49:09 (auto-transcript): “In the beginning of our class, your holiness talked about lust. That was selfishness. How can we identify our lust when it's disguised in our devotional service?”

Maharaj says it is not difficult: anything we do while expecting a result, or thinking I am the best, or putting ourselves in the middle of it, is lust.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:16 (auto-transcript): “Not difficult, not difficult, anything we are doing, and we are expecting some result, that is lost, anything we are doing, and we are thinking, I'm the best, lost. Anything we do, that we come inside it, that is lost.”

If we feel any inconvenience in what we do for Krishna, that too is lust. Tell the gopis Krishna is in the fire, and they will enter it — love can do anything.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:38 (auto-transcript): “Anything we do, that we have any inconvenience, we feel any inconvenience in anything that that we do, that is lost. The gopis, if you tell the gopi, Krishna is in this fire,”

Krishna wanted to show the world the excellence of the gopis' love, so he fell ill.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:41 (auto-transcript): “Krishna wanted to teach the world about the super-excellent nature of Godis. One day, the orchestra was in feverish condition. So, once Krishna had a fever, Narada Muni saw him. Narada Muni saw him. He said, what is happening? He said, what is happening? I am very sick. I am…”

Narada Muni found Krishna with a high fever and asked what medicine could help. Krishna said: only the dust from the feet of my devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:12 (auto-transcript): “So, once Krishna had a fever, Narada Muni saw him. Narada Muni saw him. He said, what is happening? He said, what is happening? I am very sick. I am very sick. High fever. I have a very high fever. 100 degrees. 100 degrees. 150. Naramuni said, what to do? Naramuni said, what…”

Narada, himself a great devotee, went everywhere asking other devotees, and all refused out of fear of offence. He never thought of giving his own dust. Tired, he returned, and Krishna sent him to the gopis.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:00 (auto-transcript): “Why did he not remember that he is a devotee? And why did he not remember that he is a devotee? He is not a demon, he is a devotee. He is not a demon, he is a devotee. Why did he not give? And why did he not give? Not that he didn't give, he didn't remember at all. He is…”

The gopis immediately said: take, take! Narada warned them of hell for such an offence; they answered that they do not care — let Krishna be cured. Nothing else has any meaning for them. — “Let Krishna be cured of his headache.”

🎙 Maharaj at 58:56 (auto-transcript): “And Muni said, you know what I do? He wants to give doors from my feet on Krishna's head. You know what I do? You know how long you will stay in hell? Is it not an offense? False ego. You want to give my feet to Krishna? False ego? You want to do that? The gopi said what?”

Narada, the teacher of bhakti, said he now understood it: no ego, no selfishness — ready to be condemned, killed or sent to hell. Anything less than this, Maharaj says, is lust.

🎙 Maharaj at 60:41 (auto-transcript): “Many say yes, I cannot understand. I'm teaching Bhakti. Now I understood what is Bhakti. The ego is a Bhakti. No selfishness. They can go to hell. They can be killed. They can be crucified. They can be blasphemed. Condemned. That's all.”

It is a very high standard. How can we develop such love?

🎙 Maharaj at 61:49 (auto-transcript): “It's a very high standard. How can we develop love? How can we develop pure love of the gopis for Krishna? We have to follow the example of the Gopis. We should not think we are Gopis.”

We follow the example of the gopis, but we should not imagine we are gopis. — “We should not think we are Gopis.”

🎙 Maharaj at 62:18 (auto-transcript): “We have to follow the example of the Gopis. We should not think we are Gopis. But we can follow the Gopis. Let me sacrifice my prestige. Let me sacrifice my religion, let me sacrifice my position, everything, even death, for”

The gopis' standard is to sacrifice prestige, religion, position — even life — for Krishna. We reach towards it by practising and praying constantly for the gopis' love.

🎙 Maharaj at 62:42 (auto-transcript): “Let me sacrifice my prestige. Let me sacrifice my religion, let me sacrifice my position, everything, even death, for Krishna. That is the standard of Gopi. Who can follow that? Practicing and praying constantly”

We sing every morning for this, yet act the opposite — very dangerous ignorance. If we sing consciously, convinced this is what we want, begging the gopis to make us their servant, we will get there.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:43 (auto-transcript): “You sing this every morning, or you do the opposite. Very unfortunate. This is what you sing, but you act opposite, ignorance, very dangerous.”

maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 01 · Paramatma and Guru Work Together

nodeData.topic: Class 01 · Paramatma and Guru Work Together
nodeData.note: SB 11.29.6 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Pure devotees feel they are eternal debtors to Krishna, because he guides us from within as the Supersoul and from without as the bona fide acarya — and the more we serve, the more the debt grows. Maharaj explains why the Supersoul comes outside as the guru, gives a daily practice of listening within, and shares personal experiences of being guided; in the questions he contrasts the voice of the Supersoul with the voice of the mind. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Uddhava's prayer: the wise can never fully express what they owe the Lord, who comes to the embodied soul both as the acarya outside and the Supersoul within.

Maharaj recalls Srila Prabhupada's word for the devotees of Caitanya Mahaprabhu: they are debtors who cannot pay, because they have nothing to pay with. Pure devotees carry this sense deep in their consciousness. — “This is how pure devotees see themselves.”

🎙 Maharaj at 06:34 (auto-transcript): “Piyan means we are debtors who cannot pay our debt. We are debtors who cannot pay our debt. That is our position. And pure devotees, they have this very deep in their mind, in their consciousness, that we are peers, Chetam Mahabharata is peers, or guru is peers. We are not…”

Multiply Brahma's lifespan of billions of years over and over — still the debt would not be paid. Maharaj asks why the debt is so great.

🎙 Maharaj at 07:20 (auto-transcript): “And therefore, it is mentioned that even if we have the duration of Brahma's life multiplied all over, multiply all over the brahma lives for four billion three hundred and twenty million years that is brahma's four billion three hundred twenty million years that is brahma's…”

Following Visvanatha Cakravarti Thakura, Maharaj explains that Krishna appears externally as the diksha and siksha guru and internally as the Paramatma, working two ways to bring us to him.

🎙 Maharaj at 07:54 (auto-transcript): “debt. Why? Why our debt is so powerful that we cannot pay? Bishwana Chakravati Takora explained the reason. He said, Krishna, you appeared externally as the mantra guru and”

Here 'siksha guru' does not mean anyone who teaches in the temple; it means pure devotees, initiating and instructing, who are expansions of the Supersoul's mercy and share one goal: to deliver us to Krishna by training.

🎙 Maharaj at 09:04 (auto-transcript): “both of both of them the deksha and the six group they are pure duties not just what you have in mauritsas everybody is a siksha guru that is that is different here we are talking about pure devotees not just any any there are many varieties of siksha gurus many varieties but…”
As Krishna says in the Gita, he gives the intelligence by which devotees come to him. From inside he inspires us and reveals the goal — becoming his associate in pure love.

The more we serve and think of Krishna, the more bliss we receive — and so the more we owe. Prema never stops increasing, so we remain eternal debtors. — “The debt is always increasing.”

🎙 Maharaj at 11:06 (auto-transcript): “attend krishna when we attend pure local godhead the more we serve krishna the more bliss we get, means what? Means what? We are eternally indebted to Krishna. How? Because the prayer that Krishna gives to us is increasing. So our debt is increasing. How do we do it today?…”

We should be convinced of our nature: we belong eternally to the guru and to Krishna, his children, and our position is to realise that relationship through service. — “we are eternally guru's property”

🎙 Maharaj at 13:19 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, we are eternally a guru's property we are eternally guru's property we should be convinced of our nature that we are eternally guru's property we are eternally christian's property and christian claim all of us we are eternally christian's children eternally…”

The Supersoul is Krishna's own expansion, accompanying every living being, so in one sense it is Krishna doing everything.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:22 (auto-transcript): “the super soul is expansion of Krishna so in one sense it is Krishna doing everything the supreme position of God has expanded himself as Paramatma so he can accompany all of us but he's there in the heart of everyone but not everyone of us can recognize him or realize him…”

The Supersoul speaks in every heart every day, but our senses are dulled by sense gratification and we do not hear. Seeing our helpless state, he comes outside as the bona fide acarya whom we can see face to face and identify with.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:50 (auto-transcript): “even though he speaks every day we don't hear him because we are so engrossed in sense gratification and therefore our senses have become so dull that we cannot hear what is when the super soul speaks lord christian saw our helpless situation so he has planned the super soul…”

Maharaj asks us to imagine our beloved guru calling us to his room and giving wonderful confidential instructions — but we cannot see him. We would enjoy it, yet feel uneasy and beg: can I see you?

🎙 Maharaj at 15:49 (auto-transcript): “or with her normally normally how will you feel how will you feel if um yeah on spiritual master yeah guru you love very much both of you they have good relationship he asking you hey prabhu mataji please come to come to my my room now you have gone there which you normally…”

He recalls a pastime where Krishna disappeared yet kept speaking to his beloved, who said: I know you are here, but show me your transcendental form. We too want to see.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:26 (auto-transcript): “like that i will request guru there show yourself to me i remember this this material when krishna disappeared krishna was dancing with the gopis and disappeared and he took his material away with other groupies. At a point also, Krishna disappeared from Symmetra. And they…”

A teacher who takes the student's hand to teach writing is sweeter than one who only talks. The acarya shows by his daily life how to practise devotional service.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:00 (auto-transcript): “if a teacher is taking the hand of the student and teaching him how to write very sweet we feel very happy his presence is there has effect on us then if you're just talking and not doing anything practical so the the physical manifestation of the super soul is a specialness…”

Following the acarya purifies us until we can also hear the Supersoul in the heart. The one outside prepares us to connect with the one inside, and finally with Sri Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:08 (auto-transcript): “follow the instruction of the Acharya we will be able to get purified to the point we also be hearing the instruction of the super soul in the heart so the one outside is to prepare us to lead us to guide us to help us connect what they want inside and ultimately the supreme…”

Maharaj gives a practical exercise for realising this relationship.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:47 (auto-transcript): “exercise if you want to realize that we can do some practical exercise that every day Every day in our life. Every day. We should have a spare time. Spare time. 20 minutes, 30 minutes. When we're not chanting, we're not reading, we're not doing anything, we simply try to…”

Set aside 20 or 30 minutes daily — not chanting, reading, talking or sleeping — in a quiet place, simply attentive to the inner voice of the Supersoul. — “We simply listen to the inner voice.”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:56 (auto-transcript): “Every day in our life. Every day. We should have a spare time. Spare time. 20 minutes, 30 minutes. When we're not chanting, we're not reading, we're not doing anything, we simply try to listen to the inner voice. We listen to the inner voice. We simply listen to the inner…”

Great personalities, material and spiritual, made such listening part of their day. If we do it, Maharaj says, our practice will advance very fast, since the Supersoul accompanies us precisely to instruct us for our benefit.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:00 (auto-transcript): “If we practice this regularly, all the great personalities in the world, both materially or spiritually speaking, all of them, they practice this. a time when they start to listen to the super soul to hear what the super soul is teaching what the message coming from the super…”

The Supersoul speaks directly within, and also arranges for others — even non-devotees, senior devotees, or dreams — to bring us his message, often warning us before trouble comes.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:55 (auto-transcript): “i have i have practical life practical experience how the super source speaks he speaks directly inside the super source took directly inside that is one way the super soul speaks and a super also super soul also will arrange that somebody else will talk with us the same…”

children.topic: The stranger at the book shop
children.note:
During a painful conflict with a temple president he had tried to advise, a stranger came to Maharaj's BBT book counter, looked at every book, then sat and described his whole worry, told him not to worry and that Krishna would protect him — and left without buying anything. Maharaj never saw him again and understood the Supersoul had sent him.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:32 (auto-transcript): “sometimes back i was having i was having a very serious challenge with my temple president the temple president i out of out of out of my own my own sweet will my own nature as as i say as a devotee considering that we should help each other which is normal so i i advise one…”

Sometimes guidance comes before an event: an instruction, a caution, a warning to stop. Before we are 'charged' for anything, we have been warned one way or another.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:51 (auto-transcript): “Sometimes, the Special Master will inform us about something before it takes place. that's a super soul doing that something is going to take place it may be instruction maybe guidance maybe caution warning yes don't continue to do like this because it's not helpful you will…”

When Maharaj was condemning himself for years as a useless devotee, a senior sannyasi called him over after prasadam at a festival and said Srimati Radharani had told him to speak to him. He narrated Maharaj's hidden thoughts, even that morning's envy of a scholarly devotee reciting poetry, and sent him to offer obeisances to Radharani and ask her help.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:02 (auto-transcript): “ago in my school i was in my school and i was feeling i was feeling really bad i'm not making advancement i'm not a good devotee i i was looking at myself and remember i was i was condemning myself seriously look what can you offer as a you call yourself a devotee but what…”

Maharaj recalls his Gurudev's book of prayers asking the Lord where he was during tragedies such as worshippers killed in a church during war in Liberia. The Supersoul's reply turns it round: I was always with you — where were you? — “i have always been with you talking to you all the time”

🎙 Maharaj at 42:08 (auto-transcript): “with you can see this is just one my dear lord where were you and the good devil is asking the lord where were you when if so many incidences he mentioned so many i just i just will just mention one or two and people in liberia one of the countries saying was africa liberia…”

He also mentions an account of Srila Prabhupada, after his departure, coming again and again to tell a devotee to leave home and take sannyasa.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:08 (auto-transcript): “speak. I also remember Shilapapad is mentioning how Shilapapad is talking to tell him to take sannyas. But then Shilapapad was not physically on the planet. He has disappeared. But he came in to tell him, hey, my friend, take sannyas. He came quiet. He came again. I see you,…”

We, our acaryas and the Supersoul share a sweet eternal relationship; as we advance it becomes more meaningful and visible before our eyes.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:44 (auto-transcript): “So this will help us to understand that we have a very sweet relationship with the super soul and our acharyas. And our acharya have the same sweet relationship with the super soul and the supreme soul. Luxury Krishna. This relationship is eternal. And as we make advancement…”

The more we advance, the more we appreciate this relationship, and faith, determination and affection all increase with it.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:23 (auto-transcript): “As we continue to make advancements, you will see it before our faces, our eyes, and we will appreciate it more. The more we make advancements, the more appreciation we have for this relationship we have. And the more our faith will increase, the more determination will…”

Have full confidence in the spiritual masters and give your life to them: take me and use me. They smile and say: you were always mine, only foolish — now by causeless mercy you have become wise.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:05 (auto-transcript): “very nice so we have everything with us we should have a confidence in our special masters and follow them very nicely we follow them should give our life to them in full confidence check i'm giving myself to take and use me yes like and in that way they will smile smile at…”

Questions from devotees on the call, from chat and from YouTube.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:17 (auto-transcript): “Guru Maharaj, you mentioned that the Supersoul is speaking to us at all times. Yes. Unfortunately, because our senses are very dull, we cannot capture the message. So the question is, What are the things that make the senses become dull, that we become, we cannot hear the…”

If the Supersoul always speaks, what makes us unable to hear? Maharaj says he will repeat the answer until we hear it.

🎙 Question from the floor at 47:17 (auto-transcript): “Guru Maharaj, you mentioned that the Supersoul is speaking to us at all times. Yes. Unfortunately, because our senses are very dull, we cannot capture the message. So the question is, What are the things that make the senses become dull, that we become, we cannot hear the…”

Strong desire for sense gratification absorbs us so fully that there is no space left for the Supersoul; its noise covers our ears. That is why Srila Prabhupada repeats the warning on every page — it steals our real self-interest. That is maya: absorption in what is not.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:04 (auto-transcript): “it is our strong desire for sense gratification our we have become absorbed in trying to gratify the senses you know what what we mean the word absorbed absorbed means that we are fully we are fully merged into sense gratification that there's no time for yet the super soul…”

How can we tell guidance from the Supersoul from the voice of our own mind and conditioning?

🎙 Question from the floor at 51:31 (auto-transcript): “It is said that we should be able to differentiate when the super soul is speaking and when the mind is also speaking. So, So sometimes it is due to the conditioning or sometimes due to our psychological conditioning, it becomes very, very difficult for us to be able to…”

Whenever we are about to act, voices arise. The Supersoul says: don't do this, it will put you in trouble — your spiritual master is watching. The mind says: just for today, everyone does it, God gave it to enjoy. That is contaminated intelligence justifying our weakness.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:22 (auto-transcript): “any given time we want to do something these voices will come every time the voices will come hey my friend please do not do this that is a super show the super show will say do not do this because it will put you into trouble that is super so and we don't listen to that one…”

The Supersoul tells us the hard thing; the mind tells us the easy one. As other scriptures say, the road to hell is smooth and the road to Goloka is rough. Ask the mind: has its way ever made you successful? — “the road which is leading us to hell is very smooth”

🎙 Maharaj at 56:52 (auto-transcript): “the one which is hard the mind will tell you the one which is easy i wish you know today in the bible is there in other scriptures the road leading to hell is very very smooth the road which is leading us to hell is very smooth there is no for the greater principle for the…”

children.topic: Q3 · My guru is very busy
children.note:
My guru is far away and busy; how do I keep him in mind and stay serious when he is not physically present?

🎙 Question from the floor at 58:58 (auto-transcript): “and then my question is basically like uh our group is very busy and do we initiated by him but uh they are its association is not available uh in a physical so how do we think of him all the time that uh in case my consciousness that we practice as per his instruction and…”

Maharaj worries whenever he hears 'my guru is very busy'. How would a wife or children feel if told every time, I'm busy, see you next year? Intelligent people take only what they can chew — cut your coat according to your size.

🎙 Maharaj at 59:56 (auto-transcript): “Every time we hear this, we hear devotees every time i i still hear devotees say this to my guru is very busy my good mother is very busy my mother is very busy i always hear this word and i always get worried in my mind when i hear what you say this my good man is very busy…”

The relationship with the guru who gives Krishna-prema is eternal and transcendental. Nothing stops us thinking of him, praying to him, keeping his picture, hearing his lectures and following his instructions. A son has the right to approach his father. — “Our relationship is beyond the physical.”

🎙 Maharaj at 62:42 (auto-transcript): “Now, the second thing is our vision, our consciousness, our understanding about our spiritual master. The spiritual master is not just a material being that our relationship will just end with the physical body. No. Our relationship is beyond the physical. So we are thinking,…”

children.topic: Q4 · What to pray before japa
children.note:
First pray for strength and protection to chant purely and to become Krishna's pure devotee and servant. Praying for protection from danger is not wrong, but it comes second.

🎙 Question from the floor at 69:34 (auto-transcript): “Next question is from Jayesh Prabhu. Hare Krishna Gurudev, please accept my humble obeysences. Thank you for the wonderful class. What should our prayers be to Krishna daily before we start our japa? Should we pray for solutions to material problems? Can you please teach us…”

children.topic: Q5 · The purer, the more indebted?
children.note:
Yes: those who are purer appreciate more, feel more indebted and become humbler. We feel little debt because we do not yet appreciate.

🎙 Question from the floor at 73:10 (auto-transcript): “Next are questions from YouTube. The first question is from Ramchurran Prabhu. Hare Krishna, Dandavats Shra Gurudev. Is the relationship with brain we get directly related to our indebtedness? So those who are more pure are more indebted. Is it that way? Thanks. Can you…”

To a devotee saddened by lifetimes wasted: it is good to realise it, but do not become despondent. Use the remaining time seriously; no moment in Krishna consciousness is wasted.

🎙 Maharaj at 74:29 (auto-transcript): “next is a comment from sometimes devotees become very sad thinking I have wasted so much my time, life after life and now I have very little time and whatever devotional thing they do the excitement and happiness is missing. It is good for us to feel that we have wasted our…”

nodeData.topic: Class 5 · Preparing to Enter the Merciful Kartik Month
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Before Kartik 2025, Maharaj explains why it is the best month for advancement and how to offer the lamp to Damodara with eyes and mind fixed on the Lord, not mere waving. He guides devotees to choose their own vows (rounds, bathing, hearing, fasting, avoiding gossip), take a sankalpa praying to Mother Radharani, serve a devotee daily and give a gift at the end. In the Q&A he stresses commitment, real rather than imagined service, outreach with Tulsi-stick lamps, and fasting by a self-designed plan to please Damodara. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Maharaj calls Kartik the best month of the year: the best time for prayer, meditation and devotional activity. Everything culminates in Kartik, so any devotee who wants to advance should give this period special attention.

🎙 Maharaj at 10:33 (auto-transcript): “I was saying that this is the best of months. Karthik. Best of the time in the year. The best of the months in the year. The best of activities in the year. The best of prayers in the year. The best meditation in the year. The best memory. Everything everything ends in…”

children.topic: A good time to get serious
children.note:
In Kali-yuga our minds, senses and intelligence are dull under the mode of ignorance. Maharaj cites the Padma Purana: if even an unserious person reaches Krishna's personal service by regulated devotion in Kartik, isn't this the time for us to get serious?

🎙 Maharaj at 12:14 (auto-transcript): “If even an unserious person, unserious person, could applicable to most of us because in Kali Yuga we have dull brain, dull head, dull mind, dull senses, dull intelligence. Everything we do is full of dullness because we are predominated by the mode of ignorance. The mode of…”

What Kartik offers is great: the Puranas say a lamp offered to Damodara in this month destroys the sins of countless births in an instant. Maharaj adds that even seeing someone offer a lamp brings Krishna's mercy, and lighting a lamp for another to offer, and offering oneself, frees one from rebirth. — “What is available is great.”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:53 (auto-transcript): “Because of what is available. What is available is great. So great that when one offers a lamb during the month of Karthik, His sins of many thousands and millions of birds perish in half an eye blink. Millions of sins they won't commit. For sin sign in memory can be terminated.”

Simply waving a lamp is not Damodara's offering. Maharaj asks us to recognise we are offering to a person and to see Damodara with both eyes and mind, then offer carefully: four times to the lotus feet, two to the navel, three to the face and seven to the whole body. The benefit cannot be calculated. — “I am doing this for a person.”

🎙 Maharaj at 25:11 (auto-transcript): “But I'm telling you, I'm telling you, waving lamb, that is not Damodara's offering. It should be done with concentration. We should recognize that I am doing this for a person. I should see that person. That means we should see the Damodara. We should see him both ways. both…”

For years Maharaj has watched crowds in Vrindavan wave lamps in every direction with no concentration, so he avoids crowded offerings. By Kartik's glory Damodara still accepts, but that is no reason not to do it properly. — “someone almost burnt my ear”

🎙 Maharaj at 26:05 (auto-transcript): “I've seen many times for many years how people offer the lamp in Brindavan someone almost burnt my ear in Brindavan So I don't go to a heavy crowded place for opening, no concentration, no concentration for the people and you yourself, no concentration. Everybody is waving,…”

In Lagos Maharaj has devotees sit quietly and all recite the prayers attentively first, then offer the lamp with full concentration. Out of dullness we often do not even look at the One we offer to, do not join the singing, or sing only for pride.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:54 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, to help devotees facilitate this, maximize this benefit, I used to tell devotees, let us sit down quietly, attentively, recite the prayers first with full concentration. Everybody should participate to recite the prayers fully. Then we can do the second thing, open…”

A Puranic verse says one's ancestors are liberated when a family member offers Keshava a lamp, by the mercy of the Lord who holds the Sudarshan chakra. Maharaj unpacks the name: su-darshan is the most auspicious sight of the Lord, and the chakra destroys, so true darshan destroys our sins. — “To see Lord Krishna is very, very auspicious.”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:28 (auto-transcript): “Let us look at it, sudarsan, and then chakra. Sudarsan, sudarsan. Sudarsan means that we are having the vision. We are seeing. It is su, su, very, very auspicious. To see Lord Krishna is very, very auspicious. And more auspicious is that chakra. Chakra does what? Chakra has…”

children.topic: A gold ring and its stone
children.note:
Darshan is not only admiring the deity's outfit, though appreciating the pujari's devotion is good. A gold ring is complete, but set with a precious stone it becomes far more valuable; darshan with the prayer that the Lord remove all inauspiciousness changes everything in the same way.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:25 (auto-transcript): “Let me have darshan of the Lord, darshan. It's not to see the zeal. the deity put on that day. In order to appreciate the experience, it's good. It's good to appreciate the experience of the pujari, the bhav, the pujari has put into his or her service to the Lord. It's good.…”

Fortunate devotees take full advantage of Kartik and set aside their worries, which the mode of ignorance puts on us. Concentrating on the Lord's darshan, we let him destroy our so-called worries and imperfections and give the lasting blessing of pure love and service.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:42 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, fortunate devotees who take full advantage of this period abandon all our worries about whatever varieties of worries you have. That will just keep them aside. They have nothing to do with us. The worries, everything we have has nothing to do with us. But…”

For Kartik, Maharaj lists daily essentials: bathe every morning whatever the weather, wear fresh clothes, rise early for japa, and increase one's rounds. Asked later about timing, he says bathe whenever you get up, then begin.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:29 (auto-transcript): “so this this period we should try to do certain things for those of us who are not living in the temple and and for those of us who live in the temple i must bet every morning compulsorily. I must bet every morning compulsorily. Either it is winter and sick. Whatever the…”

No one should impose a number of rounds: 20, 25, 32, 50, 64 or 108, each devotee decides. Once decided, make a sankalpa by praying to the acharyas and Srimati Radharani.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:29 (auto-transcript): “I must increase. I must increase the number. And nobody should impose any number. You should decide. I can do with 20. I can do with 25. I can do with 32. I can do with 34. I can do with 50. I can do with 64. I can do with 108. You should decide. We should decide. And when it…”

Maharaj gives a prayer: a mother does not count her baby's offences, even when it wets or kicks her, so please do not reject me; keep me tied to your lotus feet so I keep my vows and become a good devotee.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:23 (auto-transcript): “And we should offer this prayer. My dear mother, Yes, order, Maria, Sumatya Radharani. A mother never considered the offenses of the children. So please, don't take my offenses seriously. Don't reject me. Please maintain me even though I pass water on your body. I kick you…”

Choose in advance what to hear and chant daily: Bhagavatam, a Gita chapter, Sri Radha Kripa Kataksha Stotra, acharyas' ashtakas to Radharani. Food vows such as no grains or one meal a day are chosen too; these acts can be done any time, but in Kartik they are different, as a deity worshipped daily is specially present on its appearance day.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:47 (auto-transcript): “As you hear Bhagavatam, or as you hear Bhagavad Gita, a chapter, or some bhajans, which we keep, and Sissi Radha, Kripa, Kataksa, Krishna, Stotra, We want to hear this regularly, every day. And some other bhajans and other asakam of our acharyas for Sumatera Dharani, we want…”

Alongside what we will do, decide what we will not do: speaking badly about anyone, gossip of every kind and idle talk. Married couples abstain from sex, and many give up sweets and sugar. Use the time to talk and hear about Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:36 (auto-transcript): “and we should also have the things we shouldn't do for these people so they do or they don't I'm going to hear Krishna, I'm going to hear Bajan I'm going to hear narrations I'm going to try to avoid try to avoid talking bad about people so try to avoid talking bad about…”

Someone told Maharaj that every festival is about fasting and he would rather feast. Maharaj lets him, but says the better way is to sacrifice now as preparation, because in Goloka there is no fasting, only an eternal feast. — “There's no fasting in Goloka.”

🎙 Maharaj at 42:03 (auto-transcript): “too dry. One day what he told me, Mahara, you know, all our festival is about fasting, fasting. I don't want to take away in the country because the only festival which was not fasting God and Prussia I don't want to fast so I can feast that's okay if I would okay you can do…”

Take a vow to do something for a devotee each day, even a small thing or a gift. — “Before a day passes, I must do something to help a devotee.”

🎙 Maharaj at 43:49 (auto-transcript): “Take a vow that I must try to do good things for devotees. At least one day I must do something. One day I must do something. Before a day passes, I must do something to help a devotee. Something. and they call it what you seek or do something, give a gift. And at the…”

At the end of Kartik it is compulsory to give a gift and, for householders, to feed devotees; this offsets mistakes made through inattention and dullness, and the more advanced the devotee, the better. If no devotees live nearby, keep an item each day and give thirty at the month's end.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:14 (auto-transcript): “And at the completion of our critique, it is compulsory for us to give a gift. It is compulsory to give a gift, somebody. To, as householders, feed a gift to Brahman. That will nullify some mistakes which we made accidentally or unintentionally or due to inattentiveness, due…”

After reading from The Nectar of Devotion about worshipping Damodara, Maharaj explains that pilgrimage, sacrifice, full-moon charity and new-moon fasting all culminate in Kartik, the final stop for every pious act. He asks each devotee to make Kartik 2025 the best of their life. — “everything ends here”

🎙 Maharaj at 46:48 (auto-transcript): “So many quotations from the Purana. Prophet Putin is next to the devotion. In this month, all the activities which we do for either Kuskara or Kursetra or Holy Sacrifice or the Full Moon Charity or the New Moon Fasting, everything, everything that we do other times, they…”

Devotees ask about the lamp offering, vows and service.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:38 (auto-transcript): “Gurudev, I have a peculiar problem. You started saying that, you know, when we do the lamp offering, you need to have a full concentration of mind and eyes. But my problem is when I'm concentrating, I'm concentrating more on the number of offerings and rounds that we have to…”

While offering the lamp, a devotee finds himself concentrating on counting the circles rather than on the deity.

🎙 Question from the floor at 49:38 (auto-transcript): “Gurudev, I have a peculiar problem. You started saying that, you know, when we do the lamp offering, you need to have a full concentration of mind and eyes. But my problem is when I'm concentrating, I'm concentrating more on the number of offerings and rounds that we have to…”

Looking at the feet while counting four is itself meditation and helps focus; if the mind is not on the Lord's form it will wander elsewhere. — “So look at the feet and count.”

🎙 Maharaj at 50:13 (auto-transcript): “Well, if you are offering four to the feet, so you are looking at the feet. But I'm counting. Oh, is it four? Is it three? It's okay. You're counting. Yes, you're counting, but you're looking at the feet. So look at the feet and count. That is meditation. It is called Ruk…”

Afraid of breaking a month-long vow, a mataji asks whether occasional extra rounds or austerities without a vow still count.

🎙 Question from the floor at 51:30 (auto-transcript): “a person like me couldn't take much of the vows for the entire month but sometimes like it's not like I couldn't take but out of the fear that it will broke so is it correct to do austerity like odd number of days that you try maximum number of rounds more that will be…”

Taking a vow makes it serious and committed; changing the number from day to day makes practice random, not regulated.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:05 (auto-transcript): “if you take the vow, make it serious if you take the vow I'm going to do 22 if you take the vow or I'm going to do 18 if you take the vow, then it becomes serious otherwise, okay I will do I told you I would do 18 to mark and do 20 and do 16 to that day. Then it means no…”

If one cannot help a devotee on some day, is praying for them mentally enough?

🎙 Question from the floor at 54:10 (auto-transcript): “My question is that you told we should try to do something to help a devotee daily. So if any day if we don't get chance can we pray mentally for them? Well, we yes, I know I know that in this material world there is always a chance for mistake and take but we should not be…”

Do not plan around failure. A hungry belly is not filled by meditating on food; plan something real, like calling and greeting a devotee. — “you should make it real”

🎙 Maharaj at 54:27 (auto-transcript): “Well, we yes, I know I know that in this material world there is always a chance for mistake and take but we should not be meditating on mistakes. we shouldn't be meditating on that let us plan I want to maybe call a devotee and greet okay today I'm not able to I just…”

children.topic: Q4 · Empower me to rise early
children.note:
A mataji confesses laziness and asks Maharaj to empower her to rise early and chant sixteen rounds in Kartik.

🎙 Question from the floor at 57:01 (auto-transcript): “I want to pray to you please empower me that in this Karthik month I get up early and do 16 rounds only I know you always empower me I am only lazy I am not only able to do it but please pray for me and please empower me for this getting up early in the morning ok thank you I…”

Maharaj promises to come and knock on her door, on one condition: once woken, she must not go back to sleep. — “I'm going to knock on your door.”

🎙 Maharaj at 57:30 (auto-transcript): “I will come to your house I'll knock on your door. Don't worry. I'm going to knock on your door. Are you ready? I'll wake you. Yeah. Please empower me. Please come in. If I wake you, if I wake you, you should not sleep again. I won't sleep again. Okay. Okay. I will come.…”

Can lamps made with Tulsi sticks be offered to Damodara, and is there extra benefit?

🎙 Question from the floor at 62:51 (auto-transcript): “So both of them are asking that can we offer Tulsi stick lamp to Damodar and is there any extra benefit of doing that? Yes, it is a standard Lagos standpoint. We only offer Tulsi stick. And Tulsi is so suspicious, it's in the Padma Purana, Skanda Purana, it is mentioned…”

In Lagos only Tulsi sticks are used; the Puranas say a sacrifice with a Tulsi stick has incalculable merit, all the more when offered to Krishna. When you find something good, share it, and give guests sticks too. — “You are expanding their fortune.”

🎙 Maharaj at 63:02 (auto-transcript): “Yes, it is a standard Lagos standpoint. We only offer Tulsi stick. And Tulsi is so suspicious, it's in the Padma Purana, Skanda Purana, it is mentioned there. Any Jagia which we do, and the Tulsi stick is offered there, there is no calculation to the merit of that Jagia.”

Further questions, mostly on fasting and inviting others.

🎙 Maharaj at 65:24 (auto-transcript): “how should we maintain the fast and diet which is to be followed in the Dhamudar month how do we get the determination to maintain the fast and the diet that we decide to take up? Determination will come from understanding what is the purpose of fasting? Why am I doing this?…”

children.topic: Q6 · Determination to keep the fast
children.note:
How do we find the determination to keep the fast and diet we choose?

🎙 Question from the floor at 65:24 (auto-transcript): “how should we maintain the fast and diet which is to be followed in the Dhamudar month how do we get the determination to maintain the fast and the diet that we decide to take up? Determination will come from understanding what is the purpose of fasting? Why am I doing this?…”

Determination comes from understanding why we fast and what we hope to achieve; if the goal matters, we put our full effort in. Srila Prabhupada wrote all this in The Nectar of Devotion because he knew it was good for us.

🎙 Maharaj at 65:40 (auto-transcript): “Determination will come from understanding what is the purpose of fasting? Why am I doing this? What do I help to achieve? What is the purpose? If you don't have a purpose for what we do, we cannot put our best into it. If we don't understand what we are doing, we cannot put…”

Is it necessary to call new people for the lamp offering?

🎙 Question from the floor at 67:38 (auto-transcript): “is it necessary to call new people for Deept Dhani yes every day you should do that I know one friend in Dubai her name is Madhuri Lila as they say, Kattu, Pahus, the disciples, even Dubai. For the whole of this month, she take a vow and will visit 350 houses for this month.…”

Yes, every day. Maharaj tells of a devotee in Dubai who vowed to visit hundreds of homes in one Kartik, carrying lamps and showing families how to offer late into the night. This is Krishna consciousness; we expand by bringing new people. — “This is how we expand.”

🎙 Maharaj at 67:43 (auto-transcript): “yes every day you should do that I know one friend in Dubai her name is Madhuri Lila as they say, Kattu, Pahus, the disciples, even Dubai. For the whole of this month, she take a vow and will visit 350 houses for this month. Introduce the Dhammadara offering to her. Every day…”

Devotees feel ashamed comparing their austerities with those of the parampara's acharyas.

🎙 Question from the floor at 70:10 (auto-transcript): “A lot of questions are on the theme of fasting and austerities. So, like, Ragini Mataji was asking, how should we take food stuff and Charan Padma Mataji did not understand the importance of fasting in Karthik. Similarly, Gurdayanath Prabhu is asking, when we think about…”

Raghunatha dasa Goswami threw away his cup when a servant replaced it with a bigger one. We need not fast like that; design your own plan, one meal a day, or two without grains, and keep to it. — “You know, it shouldn't be an imposition.”

🎙 Maharaj at 70:42 (auto-transcript): “We don't have to fight the way our acharyas did because Rabbi Nadej Goswami was drinking Potamig, one cup. And one day, When his servant went and changed the cup, he got a bigger cup and pulled the milk there. When Raghuram Dalai Goswami came in, when he saw that, he said,…”

A mataji is still unclear why she should fast in Kartik and what she will gain.

🎙 Question from the floor at 73:04 (auto-transcript): “I am still not clear on the importance of fasting during Karthik, my mind is still thinking, why should I fast? What will I get? You should fight because you want to please Lord Damodara so that he can bless you with tickets to go back to Godhead. You see what you say here?…”

We fast to please Lord Damodara so he blesses us with a ticket back to Godhead, where service is pure and unmixed.

🎙 Maharaj at 73:15 (auto-transcript): “You should fight because you want to please Lord Damodara so that he can bless you with tickets to go back to Godhead. You see what you say here? No. So, I want to please Lord Damodara so he'll give me tickets to go back to Godhead. There I will serve him purely not mixed…”

As with Ekadashi, does a stricter Kartik fast bring greater benefit?

🎙 Question from the floor at 73:56 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna, Srila Gurudev, I have a question myself around the fasting. So on Ekadashi, we were hearing you mentioned that when one does nirjal, one gets 100%. When one takes something, fruits or something, it's just 70% and if we eat then it is just 50%. So similarly even…”

Results do differ: one meal a day cannot be equated with two meals without grains, or with no vow at all. But don't jump to someone else's height; do what you can now and rise step by step.

🎙 Maharaj at 74:42 (auto-transcript): “if a person who decided, I will take one meal a day, we cannot equate the result of it with the person who is eating two times a day. But no grain, but I'm eating two times a day. We cannot equate it. Because it's more serious. If equate it means that Krishna is special. You…”
