maps.title: Harinama Cintamani · Session 06 · Offence #1 - Blaspheming the Devotees (Part 2)

nodeData.topic: Session 06 · Offence #1 - Blaspheming the Devotees (Part 2)
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj completes the first offence: a sadhu is known by his surrender to Krishna, and traces of past faults are no reason to criticise him, since bhakti itself is received only through such Vaishnavas. He names four roots of blasphemy — birth, past sins, accidental slips and remaining traces — and warns against association that breeds disrespect, before answering questions on weakness, toxic company and food. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: Two kinds of qualities in a sadhu
children.note:
Continuing the first offence, Maharaj reads Haridasa Thakura's point that a sadhu has a primary characteristic and secondary ones. The primary one is his surrender to Krishna, and it covers everything else.

🎙 Maharaj at 06:43 (auto-transcript): “The qualities of a sadhu, he said, there are two types. One is secondary and one is primary. The primary one is our level of surrender to Krishna. He covers all other. Bhakta hote hain, jinkai doopsthatya dunh hote hain. Ek hota hai Svarubalakchana, ek hota hai…”

The svarupa-laksana, the essential sign of a devotee, is that he has taken full shelter of Krishna. Secondary signs vary with varna and ashrama and are called tatastha-laksana.

🎙 Maharaj at 07:02 (auto-transcript): “The primary one is our level of surrender to Krishna. He covers all other. Bhakta hote hain, jinkai doopsthatya dunh hote hain. Ek hota hai Svarubalakchana, ek hota hai Tatasthalakchana. So Svarubalakchana hai, voh ya hai ki Bhakta ka sabse mahanaguni ya hai, kusne Bhagawan…”

children.topic: A fault does not cancel him
children.note: Even if some fault appears in a person, if he has the chief quality of surrender he is still to be considered a sadhu and respected. Maharaj cites Krishna's words in the Gita that such a person is to be counted a sadhu because he is properly situated.

children.topic: Old traces vanish by the name
children.note:
Remnants of past sins may still show for a while, but the holy name removes them quickly. To criticise a sadhu for such traces is sadhu-ninda and brings Krishna's displeasure.

🎙 Maharaj at 10:59 (auto-transcript): “Sometimes remnants of those sins may still remain, but they will completely vanish by the influence of the Holy Name. So it is possible that there are a few senses of the whole life that can be done with us, but with the power of the name of God, all the senses and faith are…”

Maharaj calls this a very important comment: we must always be careful not to slip into judging devotees. — “Not to have the mentality of being judgmental.”

🎙 Maharaj at 13:59 (auto-transcript): “It means that we should always be cautious, we should always be careful. Not to have the mentality of being judgmental. And at the same time, it does not also make us fools.”

At the same time this teaching does not make us fools who call everybody a sadhu; discrimination is still needed. — “That is just for foolishness.”

🎙 Maharaj at 14:41 (auto-transcript): “And at the same time, it does not also make us fools. So those things, everybody has become sadhu. I don't want to make a thing, then everybody is sadhu. That is just for foolishness. If we are very, very sincere in our practice, Krishna will always guide us, so we don't”

If we are sincere in our practice, Krishna guides us so that we neither offend real devotees nor take shelter of the wrong person.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:13 (auto-transcript): “If we are very, very sincere in our practice, Krishna will always guide us, so we don't make mistakes to make our friends or to save a wrong personal side. One who is making advancement according to Vabgita, chapter 4, is glorifying the process of bhakti.”

children.topic: The fire of bhakti burns the rest
children.note: Maharaj points to the Gita's fourth chapter: one who sits in the boat of transcendental knowledge crosses over even if he was most sinful. In the same way the fire of bhakti and the power of the name burn off the remaining traces of sin in due course.

Only one fully devoted to Krishna and sincerely chanting his name is counted a sadhu in this sense. Maharaj asks how many people in the whole world even avoid grains on Ekadasi — very few.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:20 (auto-transcript): “One who is devoted to Krishna fully and sings Krishna's name sincerely says, Rather than the devotees of Krishna, no one else is considered a sadha.”

Haridasa Thakura says that even a person of poor qualities who chants the holy name is to be respected as a Vaishnava.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:21 (auto-transcript): “If a person of their poor qualities Chant the holy name Even once He is considered a voice number And should be respected If Vaishnava is a friend and spiritual leader of the universe, he is an ocean of mercy to all living entities.”

A Vaishnava is a friend of the whole world and an ocean of mercy to every living being. Whoever blasphemes him goes to hell, because there is no liberation higher than bhakti and bhakti is received only by a Vaishnava's mercy.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:50 (auto-transcript): “If Vaishnava is a friend and spiritual leader of the universe, he is an ocean of mercy to all living entities. Guru hota hai. Vah Sampoon Jagat ka Mitra hota hai. Pratek Jeeva ke liye Krapa ka Sagar hota hai.”

Maharaj asks whether bhakti is for sale in the market — perhaps an online market? No; it is given only by a Vaishnava.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:52 (auto-transcript): “Jho aise Vaisnava ki ninda can we get bhakti in the market. Online. Online market. Bhakti is given by Vaishnava. Yes.”

The hladini and samvit energies reside in the pure devotee, so by contact with him one can also receive devotion to Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:39 (auto-transcript): “In the pure Vaishnava, in the pure Vaishnava recite Krishna's energy of bhakti. Ladini and Samvit, two elegy reside in the body of the pure Vaishnava. Those by contacting a Vaishnava, one can also receive Krishna Bhakti. So powerful, Vaishnava, Vaishnava who has bhakti, so…”

So powerful is such a Vaishnava that his food remnants, the water from his feet and the dust of his feet create bhakti. If he can purify us so much, Maharaj asks, how dangerous it is to criticise him.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:19 (auto-transcript): “So powerful, Vaishnava, Vaishnava who has bhakti, so powerful that even the food remnant, the water that washes his lotus feet and the dust from his feet are a very powerful article for creating bhakti. ki vayshuna ka uchhiste, uska juthan, uske dwarah piyya gaya koyi bhi…”

children.topic: The breeze from a pure devotee
children.note:
Just staying near a pure devotee for some time, one receives the energy of bhakti flowing from him.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:34 (auto-transcript): “If one stays near a pure voice Just to stay near Near pure voice for some time One can receive the bhakti energy Flowing from his body When Janak Maharaj passed through the gate of hell, just passing through the gate of hell,”

children.topic: Janaka at the gate of hell
children.note:
Maharaj tells how a great king only passed by the gate of hell, and the breeze from his body relieved those inside. They begged him to stay a few minutes more, and he waited for them, though he was told to leave them to pay for their deeds.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:47 (auto-transcript): “When Janak Maharaj passed through the gate of hell, just passing through the gate of hell, the breeze from his body entered the head”

We are advised that even if a sadhu does not speak to us, we should sit near him and listen to what he discusses — that way we get everything. — “You get everything.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:36 (auto-transcript): “We have been advised that even if Sadhu or Vajra didn't talk to you, just sit down near them and hear what they are talking. Even if they are talking to you, just sit down with them and hear what they are discussing. You get everything.”

Maharaj asks what makes us criticise a devotee, and lists four things: birth, past sins, accidental faults, and remaining traces of old sin.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:25 (auto-transcript): “What makes you criticize or bless him? What makes you do that? Four things a day.”

We look at a devotee's birth: this one black, that one white, this one mixed. Bhakti does not depend on any of these things — one hundred percent.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:11 (auto-transcript): “We look at voice hours according to the Akats. What is the Akats by the birth? This one. Black man. Yeh kala hai, it's white. Yeh gora hai. This one, mixed. Yeh mila hua hai, kala bhiya gora bhiya hai. Bhakti does not depend on these things, 100%. Bhakti does not depend on…”

From Srila Prabhupada: two people without a common language live together and the house catches fire — how do they help each other? The audience suggests cries and hand signs; Maharaj adds Prabhupada's story of a British shopkeeper and his Bengali worker who could only explain a monkey's mess by acting it out. If you refuse your neighbour's help because he is not of your tribe, you suffer.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:20 (auto-transcript): “this you are Prabhupada gave an example in a lecture and also in a book Prabhupada gives us in a lecture we have studied two persons are living together they don't understand each other's language and the house is on fire how will you communicate with the other person to help…”

Most of us are a small minority of devotees in our own community. Can we be sure there is a pure devotee from our own group to save us? Krishna consciousness does not depend on externals. — “We are minorities in Krishna Consciousness.”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:53 (auto-transcript): “For most of us, for majority of us, we are minorities in Krishna Consciousness. We are minorities in Krishna Consciousness. Maybe your tribe, maybe your tribe, only 10 people are devotees. So are you sure that you have one pure devotee that is going to save you?”

We also capitalise on a person's past faults, on unpremeditated accidental mistakes, and on traces of old sin. One fixed steadily in practice will surely become a pure devotee, so we should not seize on little things done by mistake.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:39 (auto-transcript): “So that is one. Second thing, second thing we use to make our friends, we look at the previous sin or faults in one's life, the fault a person having from previous life activities which we're discussing. We capitalize on someone's faults or sinful acts. The third thing is I…”

We need to be careful how we relate with one another; our real security is strict shelter of the holy name. — “how we are relating with each other.”

🎙 Maharaj at 43:12 (auto-transcript): “we need to be careful how we are relating with each other. Our security is that, our security is that one who strictly takes shelter for the holy name will not make my sava palat.”

Haridasa Thakura warns that association with non-devotees inevitably produces disrespect for devotees, so materialistic company must be carefully avoided.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:15 (auto-transcript): “Association with those who are not devotees is bound to produce disrespect for devotees. Sadhu Ninda. Association where those who are not devotees will surely produce disrespect for devotees. Sadhu Ninda. Therefore, materialistic association, it should be carefully avoided.…”

This means association outside scriptural limits: outside marriage for sense enjoyment, or within marriage where one is controlled by one's wife.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:58 (auto-transcript): “Association with women means associating with women not according to Vedic tradition. This association with women that is not authorized by scripture is divided into two associations”

Association with non-devotees is of three types, all very dangerous: impersonalists, pretenders and atheists.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:13 (auto-transcript): “The association with non-devotees is of three types. association with Mayavadis association with pretenders and association with atheist”

To progress to prema one must distinguish devotee from non-devotee, and also grades among Vaishnavas: the beginner with faith but no service attitude to sadhus, the middle devotee who honours the Lord's devotees, and the topmost who sees Krishna everywhere and simply relishes the name.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:04 (auto-transcript): “according to their spiritual advancement. The materialistic Vaisava or Vaisava Praya is he who has Madhyaoka faith in Krishna but has no service attitude to Sadhus. The higher stage of Vajshava is a Madhyam Bhakt who can recognize the important position of the Lord's devotees…”

The chapter closes: one who, like a bumblebee, clings to Haridasa Thakura's lotus feet receives the touchstone of the name. If we want the pure name, Maharaj says, we must beg for it there.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:48 (auto-transcript): “That person who, like bumblebee, Lingas are the lotus feet of Haridash. Yes, yes. He will receive the toe stone of the holy name as his life and soul.”

Devotees ask about weakness in sadhana, toxic company, who counts as a sadhu, unavoidable association and food cooked by non-devotees. A question on offences to the guru is kept for that chapter.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:44 (auto-transcript): “you may unmute yourself and ask your question and then I want to ask, I am very low in bhakti and I want to become, I can't become like you But 0.00001% if I can become like you, that would be the achievement.”

A devotee confesses she cannot even keep up sixteen rounds and asks how to rise.

🎙 Question from the floor at 53:54 (auto-transcript): “I want to ask, I am very low in bhakti and I want to become, I can't become like you But 0.00001% if I can become like you, that would be the achievement. So how should I do means including everything, excuses, health issues, including everything.”

children.topic: Beg from one who has it
children.note:
If you lack something, you beg from the person who has it — that is the process. When she asks him for bhakti, Maharaj jokes that he will register her application. — “I will register your application.”

🎙 Maharaj at 55:28 (auto-transcript): “Maybe you can beg, if you don't have something, you beg the person who has it, that's the process, right?”

children.topic: Q2 · Toxic people we cannot avoid
children.note:
What to do when we are weak and surrounded by negative friends or family?

🎙 Question from the floor at 60:54 (auto-transcript): “But when we are weak in our bhakti and around us, the people like in a college or in a house or very near person who is very toxic, how we can deal with the toxicity? How we can deal with this negative friends or family whom we couldn't avoid? and we couldn't give them…”

Chant and pray in a secluded place until you are strong, and don't sit with them more than needed. If you enjoy that association Krishna leaves you there; if you pray sincerely he finds a way to release you. — “If you are enjoying that association, Krishna will leave you there.”

🎙 Maharaj at 63:25 (auto-transcript): “We have to find a way to protect ourselves. or should try not always to sit with them because there is nothing in common.”

children.topic: Q3 · Must a sadhu be pure?
children.note:
Can we too drink the foot-water of a strict follower of Rupa Gosvami, and must a sadhu be a pure devotee or simply a senior one?

🎙 Question from the floor at 65:53 (auto-transcript): “Gurudev I had two questions like firstly you said in between that anyone who is following very strictly the rules given by Sheila Rupa Goswami they should like wash the lotus feet and drink the like the remnants so Gurudev my question was that can we also do that or like if…”

It is the qualities that make a sadhu — surrender and great care to avoid offences — not age or years in the movement. And the foot-water instruction applies to everyone who finds such a person. — “It's a rule for all.”

🎙 Maharaj at 68:03 (auto-transcript): “Sadhu should have the qualities we mentioned, not those, someone who has been in a movement for one million years, is the qualities that makes one a sadhu, not age, not how many years, but the qualities. Harada Secura mentioned one who is one who is surrender to Krishna and…”

Householders, preachers and students must mix with non-devotees; can one stay unaffected?

🎙 Question from the floor at 71:09 (auto-transcript): “my first you told to avoid materialistic association but in Grahasta Ashram some way or the other will have to associate with them like while preaching also devotees have to associate with non-devotees or a student in school also have to do so so what should be done in this…”

Either we take their negative energy or, if we are strong, we give them Krishna consciousness. — “There is nothing like being neutral.”

🎙 Maharaj at 72:26 (auto-transcript): “There is nothing like being neutral. I am associating, but I am not taking negativity from others. There is nothing like that.”

Going out to preach is going to a battlefield: chant your rounds, hear and reflect first, and stay alert. Maya can attack even alone in your room through a mobile phone; our protection is how surrendered we are and crying to Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 73:34 (auto-transcript): “So while we are going to preach to people, we should know we are going on a battlefield, we are going to fight. You are going to fight, so you are well equipped.”

Quoting the Caitanya-caritamrta on food from materialists, a devotee asks how strict we should be.

🎙 Question from the floor at 82:30 (auto-transcript): “Last lecture, your holiness was discussing about one should not eat fancy food, but Chitani Mahaprabhu says in Chitani Chachamrit, Antalila 6, 278, quote, when one eats food offered by a materialistic man, the worst man becomes contaminated. When the man is contaminated, one…”

Food carries the cook's consciousness, so devotees avoid food not prepared by devotees and offered to Krishna. Maharaj recalls a great babaji who refused to speak to his servant for eating festival food from a man of questionable character.

🎙 Maharaj at 84:03 (auto-transcript): “Yes, it is already said that we should not eat food from, we not take food, not eat food cooked by nandigotis because your contaminated consciousness is inside food. So, we become also affected by their consciousness.”

maps.title: Harinama Cintamani · Session 07 · Offence #2 - Independent Demigod Worship

nodeData.topic: Session 07 · Offence #2 - Independent Demigod Worship
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj takes up the second offence: thinking the demigods equal to or independent of Vishnu. He explains the graded qualities of Krishna, Vishnu, Shiva and the jivas, the householder's way of honouring demigods with Krishna's prasada, and why denying the Lord's name, form and qualities is the impersonalists' envy — then answers questions on 'all names are one', family worship of Shiva and empowered souls. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
After the first offence, blaspheming devotees, Haridasa Thakura turns to the second: considering demigods such as Brahma and Shiva equal to Vishnu or independent of him. However powerful they are, they are neither.

🎙 Maharaj at 01:54 (auto-transcript): “Let's continue our reading from Shri Hainam Chintamani. So Haridasa Kura is a turn of fences. We have looked at my one note to Blasem, Vaishnavas were dedicated to forgetting the holy name of Krishna. And the second one.”

Haridasa Thakura speaks very humbly. Maharaj explains that a real representative does not speak because he knows; whatever he says is dictated and directed by the Lord.

🎙 Maharaj at 05:50 (auto-transcript): “Kharidash Thakur is speaking with humility. Shilhaidash Thakur ji atyant binamrabhav mein bol raha hai. He is not speaking because he knows. Ish liye nahin bol raha hai. He is speaking because he knows that the Lord is speaking to you. In the real sense of things, this is a…”

Maharaj recalls the author of Prema-vilasa telling readers: if you find a mistake in my narration, it is not mine — it comes from the master who ordered me, and I had no strength to refuse him. — “The fault is coming from a master who asked me to do this.”

🎙 Maharaj at 06:50 (auto-transcript): “The devotee Nityananda Prabhu is the one who who composed Prem Vilaas, Prem Vilaas, Prem Vilaas.”

So Haridasa first clarifies the position of Vishnu, to show that what the pure devotee writes comes from a source that cannot err. One who sees faults in a pure devotee's writings is himself at fault.

🎙 Maharaj at 08:55 (auto-transcript): “Now Haridas is going to, first of all, clarify the positional issue. First of all, we are going to show the Bhagavan Vishnu's Paramtattwa, Shila Haidash Thakur, Vishnu Tattwa, about Vishnu Tattwa.”

children.topic: Vishnu, lord of the three modes
children.note:
Vishnu is the supreme principle, full of consciousness and knowledge, beyond material nature though its absolute controller.

🎙 Maharaj at 11:10 (auto-transcript): “Brother Sikura said, Vishnu is a supreme principle, not subject to the quality of the material world. First sentence. Vishnu is a form full of consciousness and knowledge existing internally beyond the mood of the material nature, although being the absolute control of the…”

Vishnu is Tryadhisa, master of the three modes, so he stands beyond them and is not subject to mistakes or faults. — “He is a lord of the three modes.”

🎙 Maharaj at 12:28 (auto-transcript): “Vishnu is Treyadhish. A lord of the threes. He is a lord of the three modes of maternity. He is a lord of the three modes. He is a lord of the three Vishnu. So he is beyond what the three words.”

Krishna in Goloka is the original form with sixty-four transcendental qualities; the Vishnu expansions carry sixty for their functions.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:36 (auto-transcript): “Krishna in Goloka is the original Supreme Vishnu form being ornamented with 64 transcendental qualities to enhance his blissful activities. No, he performs his activities. Bhagawan Krishna, who takes his love in Goloka, The Purusha Avataras and order pulmonary avataras all…”

The Lord's separated parts are of two kinds: ordinary jivas with fifty qualities in minute degree, and demigods with the same fifty in greater degree. Shiva has five more. — “Krishna 64, Vishnu 60, Shiva 55, Jiva 50.”

🎙 Maharaj at 15:12 (auto-transcript): “as two types of conscious particles. The first is the ordinary Jeeva who has 50 quality personal degrees. The second are the Demogors who have the same 50 quality but with greater degree. Bhagawan Vishnu ke Vibhinans unki doh prakara ki shaktiyaan hoti hai. Unmeh se ek atma…”
Greater than jivas are the demigods and Shiva, and greater than Shiva is Vishnu, lord of all of them. Whoever puts Vishnu on the level of the demigods is very ignorant.

To meet a very important person you need his secretary's permission, and the secretary is powerful — but you would not seat him in his master's chair. That would be an offence; so too putting Vishnu and the demigods on one level.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:38 (auto-transcript): “If you want to see a very important person, you can do that only when you have permission of this, Secretary. Secretary can tell you, he's not around. I can't do anything.”

Some say Brahman takes on qualities when it expands as Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva; the conclusion of scripture is that Narayana is supreme and the cause of Brahma and Shiva.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:29 (auto-transcript): “Some people claim that Brahman has qualities, takes on qualities when it expands as Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva. However, the conclusion of scripture is that Narayan is supreme and is a cause of Brahman and Shiva Whoever reject Vishnu as a supreme controller and takes to worship…”

children.topic: Conch and disc are not crutches
children.note:
Vishnu carries conch and disc. Does that mean he cannot act without them? No; he does not depend on his paraphernalia, he simply uses it in his pastimes.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:12 (auto-transcript): “For example, the Vishnu takes a claw or a Chakra. Does that mean he cannot do anything without the claw? He cannot do anything without his hand but his wheel? No, he does not depend on this, but he has paraphernalia, so he can use it in his life.”

Others say Vishnu is in every demigod, so any worship is his worship. Scripture forbids this reasoning.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:01 (auto-transcript): “Other people claim that since Vishnu is all-pervading, draw out the universe and its presence in the demigods as well. One can worship demigods by worshiping all the demigods. But this is not the ruling in the scriptures. Rather, this type of activity is forbidden. So, some…”

children.topic: Water the root, not the leaf
children.note:
Pouring water on a tree's root nourishes the whole tree; watering one leaf does not. Worship of Vishnu gives everything, while demigods give limited results.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:57 (auto-transcript): “If one worship the root of a tree, the whole tree will become nourished. But if one worship the leaf of the tree, the tree will not become nourished. Under the influence of Mayabad philosophy, the living entities of Kali Yuga put Vishnu on the same level as the demigods.”

Demigod worship starts when the living entity has fallen from its natural position and become bewildered.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:48 (auto-transcript): “Actually, Demigod worship begins when the living entity has fallen from its natural platform, not one is from real senses, when we have become bewildered. That is when Demigod worship begins. So, let us quickly explain how the householder following the Valnasana system should…”

Haridasa Thakura explains how a householder in varnashrama acts perfectly: he gives up anxiety over lesser obligations and worships Krishna, using Vedic mantras in all samskaras from conception to funeral.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:23 (auto-transcript): “So, let us quickly explain how the householder following the Valnasana system should act perfectly. Generally, he should give up worrying about inferior obligations and simply worship Krishna.”

He worships Vishnu and the Vaishnavas directly, honours his forefathers with Vishnu's prasada, and offers demigods the Lord's remnants, regarding them as Krishna's dependent servants.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:56 (auto-transcript): “Once you worshipped the Vaisaavas and Vishnu directly and worship their forefathers by giving them prasad of Vishnu. Directly worship the demigod as the Mayavadi do will only shock in one's life.”

Maharaj stresses its importance: by this scientific arrangement people can work to their capacity according to nature and gradually come to devotion to Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:10 (auto-transcript): “One may ask, what is the importance of Varnashya? Why is it necessary? The answer is that everyone who has taken a human birth must follow this system because by this scientific arrangement of society,”

children.topic: Worship of Krishna is its heart
children.note:
Those outside the system should give up bad habits and start as sudras; and worship of Krishna is an essential part of varnashrama itself.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:21 (auto-transcript): “A worship of Krishna is an essential part of the Varnashram system. There is one another often derived from not accepting Vishnu as a human, one without the second, or Adhoya Tattwa.”

children.topic: Name, form and qualities are one
children.note:
Another side of the offence is not accepting Vishnu as advaya-tattva: his name, form and qualities are not separate from him, and seeing them as material is offensive. A bona fide guru removes this so the pure name is revealed.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:55 (auto-transcript): “There is one another often derived from not accepting Vishnu as a human, one without the second, or Adhoya Tattwa. Being the Advaita Tattwa, Vishnu, by his inconsiderable energies, possesses inherently name, form and qualities which can not be considered separate from him.”

Maharaj asks the audience to name any object without qualities. Say food, and you think of taste and satisfaction; one object is known from another by its qualities. — “If it is an object, it must have qualities.”

🎙 Maharaj at 34:18 (auto-transcript): “Do we have any object in this world that has no qualities? Any object in this world that has no quality? Anyone can mention any object that doesn't have quality?”

The Mayavadi's root is envy. When we see a form we think of beauty, attraction, wanting to taste it; deny Krishna a form and you deny him enjoyment. — “No form, no enjoyment.”

🎙 Maharaj at 40:41 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, the Mayavadis are envious of Krishna, deny him of enjoyment. No beauty, no enjoyment, no taste, no hunger, no feeling. That is envy. Denying you of a form means that I'm denying you of enjoyment. No form, no enjoyment. So you should finish. You finish. Chetanya…”

Maharaj recounts Caitanya Mahaprabhu's strong words about an impersonalist offender who could not even see he had been struck with leprosy, and his declaration that his name, form and pastimes are all transcendental.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:16 (auto-transcript): “Chetanya Mahaprabhu was complain about Kassananda Saraswati. That rascal! I have put leprosy in his body because it's an offender. I put leprosy in his body but still he's so foolish that he cannot see”

Vishnu has both the featureless and the personal aspects. By his inconceivable power opposites coexist, so he can have variety, beauty and pastimes — why not? — “Both features he has.”

🎙 Maharaj at 44:25 (auto-transcript): “Actually, Lord Vishnu has both features in himself. Nirvi Shesha and Savi Shesha. Both features he has. Why not? He is better, he was variety, I would have variety, yes. This is possible by the inconceivable power of Krishna, the supreme powerful. All opposites are…”

To sum up: one solely devoted to Krishna worships only him, yet does not criticise the demigods or the scriptures recommending them; he respects them as Krishna's servants.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:42 (auto-transcript): “So to summarize everything, Hariva is whoever is solely devoted to Krishna simply worship Krishna and gifts of all other worships. He does not criticize the Demigods nor the scripture that supported the worship of the Demigods, but he respects the Demigods as a servant of…”
Some scriptures present a demigod as supreme to bring different classes of people step by step to regulation and finally to faith in Krishna.

children.topic: Seeing a demigod as a Vaishnava
children.note:
On seeing a demigod's murti the devotee offers respect, seeing him as a Vaishnava. He will take Vishnu's remnants offered to a demigod.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:46 (auto-transcript): “Similarly, when the devotee sees the murkti of a demigod, He will pay respect to the Demi-God, seeing the Demi-God as the Vaishnava. However, the devotee will not accept the prosa remnant of an offering that the Mayavadji”

He will not take food a Mayavadi offered to Vishnu: the Lord does not accept it. For them the form is a means to be discarded; for Vaishnavas the form is the means and also the end. — “For Vaisnavars, the form is a means and also the end.”

🎙 Maharaj at 50:57 (auto-transcript): “Why? Although they have offered the food to Vishnu, Lord Vishnu did not accept it because of the offenses.”

children.topic: If one slips: repent and chant
children.note:
If by accident one commits this offence, one should repent, take shelter of Vishnu and remember and chant the name. No atonement is more effective, for the Lord is an ocean of mercy and forgiveness.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:15 (auto-transcript): “If by accident one should happen to turn from accepting Vishnu to sin, one should be repentant. Take the shot of Vishnu and be careful not to commit the offense again. By remembering Krishna, by remembering His name and by chanting His name, the offense will disappear.”

Questions on popular teachers who say every name is the same, offering water to Shiva at home, sharing prasada with friends at school, and the qualities of empowered souls. Maharaj also answers that one recognises a real sadhu simply by being sincere, that Mayavadis worship forms only as a means, that ignorance differs from offence (citing the Gita on the ignorant, faithless and doubting), and, smiling, that offerings brought to work after Durga Puja can be passed on to friends.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:42 (auto-transcript): “If you have any questions, devotees may ask for a few questions. You can raise your hand and ask your question. Aishar Rahu, you can unmute yourself and go ahead. And then we have Madhur Lila Mataji and Brahmini Mataji. Hare Krishna, Srila Gurudev. Yes, tell me what is your…”

children.topic: Q1 · Any name leads to one?
children.note:
A famous teacher in India tells people to chant any name since all merge in the end. Why does Krishna let such people become popular?

🎙 Question from the floor at 58:15 (auto-transcript): “You mentioned a lot about Mayawad and the people those who propagate Mayawad today so there are saints in India, those who are very famous today in India with millions of followers and there is one such saint who is having a lot of physical ailments and everything he asked…”

If everything is one, Maharaj asks, why not serve guests petrol instead of costly liquor — it too is liquid. Bad logic, no common sense. — “So do they drink gasoline?”

🎙 Maharaj at 59:56 (auto-transcript): “they say ultimately Everything leads to one. So do they drink gasoline? Do they drink gasoline? It is one. It is one. It is liquid. It is one. all coming from brahman the same brahman they don't they don't do they take that do they drink that every day”

Krishna lets them flourish because they don't disturb people's sinful desires, but the reactions come. Sukadeva Gosvami describes a hell for religious cheaters; Maharaj urges telling people from Srila Prabhupada's books.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:37 (auto-transcript): “Anyway, Krishna allows them and even makes them to be more popular. Because it doesn't interfere with our sinful desire, but the consequences also come without interruption. Sukadev Goswami described religious cheetahs, he said that the religious cheetahs, they have a special…”

Her family expects her to offer water daily to Lord Shiva and the sun; should she pretend?

🎙 Question from the floor at 66:46 (auto-transcript): “Gurudev, my question is regarding demigods. So, sometimes in my family, it happens that I have to offer to Lord Shiva and Surinara water every day. Sometimes I tell that, yes, yes, I have offered, but every day I cannot tell because they are always in front of me. So, if I am…”

A devotee of Lord Nrsimha was forced by a king to worship Shiva on pain of death. He chanted the Nrsimha mantra while offering, and the Lord emerged from the linga and killed the king and his men.

🎙 Maharaj at 67:41 (auto-transcript): “There is a person, a devotee of Nisimhadev. So he was traveling and he came to one village where the king was, he lost her. So the king discovered that he's a devotee of Nisimhadev. He told you, you must worship Shiva today.”

children.topic: Offer to Shiva as a Vaishnava
children.note:
Stand before Shiva seeing him not as Vishnu but as a great Vaishnava; he is pleased to see devotees and accepts it, and there is no offence and no need to lie. — “So you don't have to tell a lie.”

🎙 Maharaj at 70:06 (auto-transcript): “is one. Second thing is, when you go before Lord Shiva, in your mind, Lord Shiva, I'm seeing as a Vaishnava. So I'm offering this as a Vaishnava. Not that you are Vishnu. But you are Vaishnava. You should offer that to Lord Shiva as a Vaishnava. In this way, we have not made…”

children.topic: Q3 · Friends who deny God's form
children.note:
Some schoolmates don't accept Krishna's personal form; can she still give them prasada?

🎙 Question from the floor at 76:51 (auto-transcript): “Yes. Gurudev, my question was, like, in school, I know some children that they don't, like, take Krishna's personal form. Like, they don't believe that God has personal form. So I cannot tell them like anything, but can I indirectly give them some prashad or we should…”

Our duty is to make everyone fortunate. Srila Prabhupada always said take prasada; even offensive visitors had to take prasada before leaving.

🎙 Maharaj at 77:35 (auto-transcript): “Yes, you can give them prashad. If we come in contact with it, our duty is to help anyone, everyone, make them fortunate. So give them prasadha. Prabhupada always says that, take prasadha, take prasadha, take prasadha. even some of his global rights were very offensive when…”

children.topic: Q4 · Do empowered souls have more?
children.note:
Ordinary jivas have fifty qualities; what about pure devotees and saktyavesa avataras?

🎙 Question from the floor at 83:19 (auto-transcript): “First one was there was the mention of the qualities of various personalities like ordinary Jeeva, Shiva, Vishnu. So there it was mentioned ordinary jiva has 50 qualities but what about the devotees who are empowered or the shakti vishavataras they also have 50 or they have…”

They have the same fifty but of higher quality. A jiva is never promoted to become Shiva or Vishnu; avesa means extra energy has been deposited in that person.

🎙 Maharaj at 84:21 (auto-transcript): “Shatyavesh avatars, they have the same 50, but the quality is higher. The figure is the same 50, but the quality is different. A jiva is not going to be promoted to become Shiva. and cannot be promoted to become Vishnu we are Jiva but the quality”

maps.title: Harinama Cintamani · Session 08 · Offence #3 - Disobeying the Guru

nodeData.topic: Session 08 · Offence #3 - Disobeying the Guru
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj presents the third offence, disregarding the guru. The human body is the boat, the scriptures the breeze and the guru the captain, so taking a guru is compulsory; Haridasa Thakura explains a guru's real qualification, the diksa and siksa gurus, how to serve and honour him, and when either side must reject the other. Questions cover ISKCON's protection under Srila Prabhupada, the strength to obey and how the guru gives faith. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: The third offence: disregarding the guru
children.note:
Having covered blaspheming devotees and treating demigods as independent of Vishnu, Haridasa Thakura, the namacarya, now teaches the danger of disregarding, disrespecting and disobeying the guru.

🎙 Maharaj at 07:48 (auto-transcript): “Now, Nama Acharya Shriharadashtha Kuruwaiya is going to teach us a danger of disregarding, disrespecting, disobeying the Guru. A serious disciple, a bona fide disciple should never just have a school.”

children.topic: Looking back at offences one and two
children.note:
Maharaj briefly recalls the first two offences: criticising devotees engaged in the holy name, and putting demigods on Vishnu's level, though no one is independent of the Lord.

🎙 Maharaj at 06:05 (auto-transcript): “We have looked at the number one, offenses, not to blaspheme, criticize devotees, to engage in the church in the holy name and not to do the second one.”

After wandering through 8,400,000 species, the soul gets a human body through unknowing pious acts. Only in this form can it properly perform devotional service.

🎙 Maharaj at 09:12 (auto-transcript): “Having wandered from one body to another in 8,400,000 species of life. Through unintentional fire activity, a human body is obtained from a human body.”

Maharaj remembers animals at a temple: a bull that came and sat for the Bhagavatam class every single day at exactly the right time, and a rat eating offered remnants. We hear such stories, but animals cannot take up rules and regulations — only humans can.

🎙 Maharaj at 10:38 (auto-transcript): “We have had a dog Sivanala Sena by the We had a cow was coming. Every time the Bhagavatam class would start, a cow, a bull, a bull, a bull would come and sit.”

Bhaktivinoda Thakura says Ajamila went back to Godhead, but not at that moment: he first went to Haridwar and practised bhakti-yoga seriously, and only then attained the spiritual world. — “We need to know that after following all the rules, he went to Bhagavad-Dham.”

🎙 Maharaj at 16:11 (auto-transcript): “Yes, the Bhakti Nhat Chakura said, Ajayamila went back to Godhead. Yes, that's what he said. Ajayamila went back to Godhead. But how did he go back to Godhead? Not this time. He has to go and practice Harigyama. But Rick Asham, after that, he went back to Godhead. But it is…”

As a demigod one tends to enjoy, and as an animal one lacks capacity and knowledge; only the human can regain his relationship with Krishna. Wasting this body, he dies and loses the chance to escape.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:19 (auto-transcript): “As a demigod, one has the tendency to enjoy a single relationship. And as a lower animal, one has no capacity or knowledge. But in a human form, a living entity can progress back to his personal position with Krishna through devotional sex. Therefore, if one does not take…”

An intelligent person who gets a human birth takes shelter of a spiritual master, who acts as captain to take the jiva across the ocean of material existence. One who wastes this form is called a killer of the soul.

Maharaj quizzes the audience: what is the boat, the breeze, the captain? The body is the boat, the scriptures the breeze, the spiritual master the captain — so we should take full advantage of these facilities. — “The captain is the spiritual master.”

🎙 Maharaj at 21:16 (auto-transcript): “Who is a captain? Who is a spiritual master? start favorable breeze scriptures what is the boats now now what is the boats now now The water is clean. What is the name? The body.”

Not using them is very dangerous and risky, so we must approach a guru. — “It is compulsory, not optional.”

🎙 Maharaj at 23:33 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, we should, we must approach a Guru. It is compulsory, not optional. The Punisher used the word ever bigger chat. Ever bigger chat means compulsory. It's a stamp. If you have a certificate with a stamp, it's authentic. If you have a seal on a certificate, it's…”

A certificate with a seal is authentic; without one it is useless. In the same way, one without a guru has no real spiritual life.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:09 (auto-transcript): “It's a stamp. If you have a certificate with a stamp, it's authentic. If you have a seal on a certificate, it's authentic. If there is no seal on a certificate, it's useless. Bogus. One who has no guru, has no life. Worst than anyone.”
All should approach a qualified guru — a devotee of Krishna who has conquered the senses — with submission, questions and service, as the Gita teaches, and receive initiation from him.

The main qualification is how much the guru knows of Krishna. Brahmana or sudra, householder or sannyasi makes no difference; Caitanya Mahaprabhu did not say a brahmana should become guru, but one who knows the science of Krishna.

Maharaj warns that sitting near a lover of Krishna gives love of God — but not by watching him all day and noticing he is short or tall, or eats only one banana. That is not how association works.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:33 (auto-transcript): “The ones not saying, okay now. No jama. Go and sit with him. Yeah, no jama. You want to sit and look at him 24 hours. I will get the pastor Godhead, love of Godhead. No. I am not sure that we will not do this today. If you stop, don't listen to yourself. So, I'm not that old…”

If a qualified guru of higher caste is available there is no need to look elsewhere, but caste alone never qualifies; being Krishna's devotee and knowing him is what counts.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:57 (auto-transcript): “In other words, if there is a qualified guru, higher caste, there is no necessity of seeking a guru of a lower caste. But if the higher caste guru is not qualified as a doctor, one should not take the picture from him on the basis of his higher caste alone. Rather, one should…”

One who renounces household life and seeks guidance should take shelter of an acarya who has himself successfully renounced it.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:25 (auto-transcript): “In the case of a householder who cannot find proper spiritual life in the Asha Asha, he should take a bona fide guru who is not a householder. In other words, if one renounces household life and is seeking spiritual guidance, One should take shelter of an Acharya who has…”

There are two kinds of guru: the one who gives the mantra and the one who instructs. One who wants quick progress respects both equally; one has only one diksa guru but may have many siksa gurus.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:02 (auto-transcript): “Guru may be of two types. One who gives diksha or mantra and one who gives spiritual instruction. It should be considered equal in all importance by one who wants to advance quickly. A person cannot save only one Diksha Guru, but may have many Diksha Gurus who give some”

children.topic: Siksa guru is also a pure devotee
children.note:
The siksa guru meant here is a pure devotee — not simply our temple commander, president or project leader — and stands on the level of the diksa guru.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:54 (auto-transcript): “A Sikhsha Guru mentioned here is also a pure devotee, not our temple commander or president or project leader or ashram leader or whatever is there. This one is also on the level of Dikshaguru, is Sikshaguru. That is right.”

Whoever the pure devotee is, his aim is the same: to send the soul back home, back to Godhead. — “Either it's Shikshah or Diksha, the ultimate goal is one.”

🎙 Maharaj at 36:20 (auto-transcript): “Here devotees' ultimate goal is one. Either it's Shikshah or Diksha, the ultimate goal is one. So send people back home back to God. Shuddhva Bhakt koi bhi ho, uska lakch ekhi hota hai, jiyu ko bhagwad dham bhejna. To isi liye abho sikcha ho, hai dikcha ho, dono ka lakch kya…”

The teachings come down the sampradaya from its founder-acarya; one should stay loyal to them and accept as siksa guru only someone faithfully following them. Teaching from an impersonalist or self-made source is useless.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:54 (auto-transcript): “The Sambandha Gyan for teachings are handed down in the Sampradaya from the Phan Acharya of the Sampradaya. These original teachings and the Phanacharya of the Sampradaya should be worshipped with all respect. One should be loyal to his conclusions and instructions, not…”

Whether siksa or diksa, the guru is Krishna's servant and eternal associate; serving him with devotion as one empowered by Krishna, one crosses material existence.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:09 (auto-transcript): “Thus, Guru, whether shikha or diksha modi, be the servant of Krishna and an associate of the Lord eternally in Vrindavan. One should serve the Guru with great devotion, knowing him to be directly empowered by Krishna, a dear most servant of Krishna, and once upon eternal…”

In worship one first honours the guru, then with his permission worships Krishna, offering the Lord's remnants to guru, Vaishnavas, demigods and forefathers, and chants with the guru in mind.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:21 (auto-transcript): “The procedure for worshipping the rule is that first one should worship the Guru offering kathya, argya, etc. Then taking his permission”

Disobeying or disrespecting the guru is offensive and blocks progress; with faith in him, even a few names bring quick success.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:56 (auto-transcript): “Consequently, if one disobeys or disrespect the Guru, that is offensive and will block one's progress in the teaching. As in the case of showing proper respect and devotion to the Sadhu and to Krishna, similarly, by properly serving the Guru and chanting the Holy Name,”

The guru's bed, seat, shoes, vehicle, foot-water and image are to be respected. Worshipping another as guru in his presence is a devious attempt to minimise him. One obeys his words, honours his remnants and acts to please him.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:42 (auto-transcript): “How should the Guru be respected? The Guru's bed and seat, his shoes, his car, water from washing his feet and his image should be respected.”

children.topic: When a guru must be rejected
children.note:
Through bad association a guru may lose his qualification: by offences to the name and to Vaishnavas he loses knowledge and taste and falls under the control of wealth and women. Such a guru is rejected, and by Krishna's mercy the disciple finds a bona fide guru again.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:25 (auto-transcript): “When should a Guru be rejected? It may happen that through Ashar Sangha, a Guru may lose his qualifications. Starting as a big Guru, by committing Nama Paraj, he loses his knowledge. By offending other voiceovers, he loses the taste for the name and gradually falls under the…”

Ideally the relationship lasts; but if the disciple goes bad the guru must reject him, and if the guru goes bad the disciple rejects him — otherwise both may fall. — “Better one than both.”

🎙 Maharaj at 46:12 (auto-transcript): “as long as both the guru and the disciple are properly qualified the relationship will continue ideally this relationship is certain but if the disciple becomes bad the guru must reject him and if the guru becomes bad The disciple will reject this. Otherwise, both may fall.…”

To avoid the pain of rejecting a guru, examine him first to see whether he is a pure devotee — just as we check carefully before buying a material article. Disobeying a qualified guru once accepted is a grave offence.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:01 (auto-transcript): “In order to prevent the pain of hard being to reject one's Guru, one should first examine him to see if he is a pure devotee of Christian, even in receiving a material article. So there is only need for equality. Similarly, you should do the same for spiritual.”

The guru teaches about the holy name, establishes faith in it, then formally gives the name and mantra to chant as sadhana — this is diksa.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:11 (auto-transcript): “A Guru will give proper teachings concerning the Holy Name and after having established faith in the Holy Name in the person's heart, he will formally give him the name of Krishna with mantra containing the name of Krishna to chant as a sadhana. This is Diksha.”

If through bad association the disciple slips, the all-merciful guru reinstates him, and by sincere chanting he again reaches prema.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:20 (auto-transcript): “Being all merciful, the Guru would reinstate him and by again chanting sincerely he will attain prayer aur ishtrakar guru attend karpalu hai aur agar hum kabhi bhi galti se humara dush sang ho jata hai that person who thinking himself lower than the blade of grass”

The chapter ends: one who feels lower than a blade of grass and longs for the dust of Haridasa Thakura's feet will always sing the touchstone of the holy name.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:44 (auto-transcript): “that person who thinking himself lower than the blade of grass aspires for the doors from the feet of Haritha's Nama Acharya will be qualified to sing always the Toshtun of the Holili Harinaam so aysa vyakti jho apne aapko ek ghhas ke tinke se dhi chhota samaj kar jho Haidash…”

Devotees ask about householder gurus, the strength to obey, how to sit near the guru, running after siksa, and how the guru gives faith. Maharaj also answers briefly that obeisances can be offered when the guru appears on Zoom; that maya attacks harder as we advance and the mind must be trained by hearing; that daily suggestions differ from the core instructions (rounds, principles, study); that a broken guru–disciple link is re-established by taking another diksa guru; that glorifying one's guru loudly belongs in private, not in public; and that an elderly man initiated outside a bona fide line should take initiation in the sampradaya and simply keep chanting and following principles.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:54 (auto-transcript): “you may ask your questions or any comments first hand raise is by Shreta Mataji Jainanda Prabhu Jainanda Prabhu Jainanda Prabhu Jainanda Prabhu Yes. Hare Krishna. Hare Krishna. Hare Krishna. Please accept my umbrella with answers as the best of your leadership, Guru Maharaj.…”

Haridasa Thakura says a householder should take a guru not in household life, yet in ISKCON householder gurus initiate householders.

🎙 Question from the floor at 55:42 (auto-transcript): “The new question is, you mentioned that Grihastha Vaisnava should choose a Guru who is not in the Grihastha Ashram. So we've seen, Scott, we do have like Grihastha Gurus giving initiation to Grihastha. So how to reconcile this point? so I have I have I have I have I have”

ISKCON functions under Srila Prabhupada's energy; he monitors and rectifies it, covering any shortfall, so devotees in his society remain protected.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:31 (auto-transcript): “Iskona is functioning under Sala Prabhupada's energy. So everything is monitored and rectified by Sala Prabhupada. Therefore, the harder we're not speaking to Iskona devotees. you are seeking generally this con samsa ah antarafti samsa hai joki samfthapkacharya…”

How to find the strength to follow instructions without fear, say about money?

🎙 Question from the floor at 68:18 (auto-transcript): “Maharaj, I have one, my query is around that how to get that strength or power to serve the Guru's instruction. For example, I'm just saying that if Guru says, for example, give me all your belongings or money or donate somewhere or give the contribution, then at first…”

A first-class disciple acts even before being told; by following as much as we can, we rise to that class. A guru today would hardly demand a householder's whole salary. Maharaj recalls the hunter told by a sage to break his bow: he obeyed with faith and was never hungry. — “It means that he has the quality.”

🎙 Maharaj at 69:19 (auto-transcript): “Fiscal Disciple has all the qualities to follow in everything. Even before the Guru says anything, he knows you follow the right first class disciple. It means that he has the quality.”

children.topic: Q3 · How near to the guru?
children.note:
If sitting near pure devotees purifies us, what boundaries keep us from offending our guru?

🎙 Question from the floor at 77:13 (auto-transcript): “Gurudev, like you said in the lecture that when pure devotees talk or whenever gurus speak, so even if we sit there, we can get purified and we can get Krishna Pran. So Gurudev, when like our spiritual master is like present and we are also there, so we also have, we also…”

Fire cooks our food nicely when we sit near it, but put your hand in carelessly and you get burnt. Be close but attentive — that should be the mood.

🎙 Maharaj at 78:31 (auto-transcript): “When we sit, when we sit close to fire, so we know that fire can cook on my food very nicely, I have to be attentive and if I'm inattentive and put my hand inside the fire, if I want to bend me, therefore I should be careful. That should be the mood.”

If someone qualified already cares for us, why seek a different siksa or diksa guru?

🎙 Question from the floor at 80:11 (auto-transcript): “First, in this narration, Shri Haridas Thakur is telling how one should accept a Guru. So, it has been mentioned that we should look for certain qualities. And now what happens, sometimes we see somebody as qualified as Guru in terms of the knowledge he is imparting and the…”

We already hear lectures from many gurus, so they are our siksa. Maharaj recalls a devotee who wanted siksa from a sannyasi he met less than once a year and never wrote to — he could not say what siksa meant. Our seeking should be purposeful. — “It doesn't make sense.”

🎙 Maharaj at 82:35 (auto-transcript): “We are hearing lectures from many, many gurus. So they are instructing us, so they are Sikhsha. So he helps someone who is already training you, he will give you all the necessary things. So why are you running here and there? It doesn't make sense. One day a devotee asked…”

children.topic: Q5 · How the guru gives faith
children.note:
The chapter says the guru establishes faith in the name; how does that happen?

🎙 Question from the floor at 86:54 (auto-transcript): “the last question is in the end it is written that the the guru instills faith in holy name into the disciple's heart. So what makes the Guru instill the faith like we are struggling, we are trying but what will happen when”

children.topic: He watches how we meet tests
children.note:
When the guru sees genuine submission and sincere effort he blesses the disciple, as the Gita's verse on approaching a guru says. He watches how we respond to the tests he sends and then brings clarity — we must wait and pass. Our difficulty is that we take everything materially. — “but you have to wait and pass the test.”

🎙 Maharaj at 89:23 (auto-transcript): “We should be informed, let us understand that a guru is monitoring everyone and is watching how we are dealing with all the tests he's sending to us. he's watching carefully and he's watching the consciousness how we are responding to the challenges that he's sending to us…”

nodeData.topic: Session 09 · Offence #4 - Criticising the Scriptures
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj explains the fourth offence, criticising scripture. With four defects we are like someone who cannot see without glasses, and the surest way to punish a conditioned soul is to take scripture away; the Vedas are the universe's manual and our mother. He outlines the nine teachings of the Vedas, the six philosophers who rejected their purport, and the remedy of honouring the Bhagavatam. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Haridasa Thakura names the fourth offence, criticism of the scriptures, which also obstructs one's chanting.

🎙 Maharaj at 05:50 (auto-transcript): “A fourth offence is criticism of scripture. This offence will also obstruct once. This approach is not so nice this time.”

The four Vedas, the Upanishads and the Puranas emanated from Krishna's breathing, so they are perfect knowledge and the final proof, above all in spiritual matters.

🎙 Maharaj at 07:05 (auto-transcript): “Scripture means the four Vedas, the Upanishads, and the Puranas. Shastra ka matlab hai, chaar Ved, Puran, or Upanishad. Ine shastra bolte hai. Having emanated from the breathing of Krishna, the sastra constituted perfect knowledge and authority. Ye sabhi Bhagavan Shri Krishna…”

Scriptures are not mundane novels. Every machine comes with a manual; the universe, Krishna's product, has one too, showing where we belong and what our duty is. — “the universe which is the product of krishna also has a manual”

🎙 Maharaj at 08:15 (auto-transcript): “The sastras, they are not like mundane novels. just like every material product we have has a manual how to operate the machine the universe which is the product of krishna also has a manual which are the scriptures”

Every human being has four defects, so without the light of revealed description we are effectively blind.

🎙 Maharaj at 09:32 (auto-transcript): “In human life, we have four defects. Therefore, we are considered blind. To have the light, we need description. We are faced with four defects.”

Our perception is limited: even with eyeglasses we don't see, hear or act perfectly. How then can we transcend duality and reach perfection on our own? — “We need the scriptures to take us out of our illusions.”

🎙 Maharaj at 10:42 (auto-transcript): “We have limited perception. In perfect senses, in perfect senses, our senses are not perfect, even with our eyeglass. We don't see perfectly. We don't hear perfectly.”
When Krishna left this world, the Srimad-Bhagavatam rose like the sun of the Puranas for those who have lost their sight in the darkness of Kali-yuga.

The other defects: being in illusion, the tendency to cheat, and inattention of the senses. Senses cannot reach beyond matter, so Krishna gave the Vedas, which are free of these defects.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:33 (auto-transcript): “Second purpose is Brahma, not Brahma, Brahma, I mean this illusion. Vipralipsa, Desire to report something other than what is preceded. And Pramada, inattention of the senses, inattention of the senses.”

children.topic: How to punish a conditioned soul
children.note:
Maharaj asks: if you want to punish someone who cannot see without glasses, what do you do? And how would you punish a soul with four defects?

🎙 Maharaj at 15:24 (auto-transcript): “If you want to punish a person who cannot say without their glass, what do you do? What to do?”

The answer from the audience: take away his glasses. Likewise, the way to punish a conditioned soul is to remove scripture from his life — he says he is testing their hearing. — “Take away the glass.”

🎙 Maharaj at 15:24 (auto-transcript): “If you want to punish a person who cannot say without their glass, what do you do? What to do?”

Remove the Bhagavatam, the Gita and the Caitanya-caritamrta from ISKCON and what is left? The audience answers: a disaster, aimless, substanceless — a society for maya consciousness. — “Society for Maya Consciousness.”

🎙 Maharaj at 18:28 (auto-transcript): “So if you remove Bhagwatam, Chita Chita, Chita, Chita, Rita from ISKCON, what would ISKCON be? Remove Bhagwatam, remove Bhagwatam, take away Chita. Net of devotion to ISKCON. How would you call ISKCON? Indian tradition. Huh? If you remove Bhagwatam and Bhagwatam from ISKCON,…”
Krishna is very clear in the Gita: one who discards scriptural injunction and acts whimsically attains neither perfection, happiness nor the supreme goal. No scripture means no Godhead, no life.

What is a baby's life without its mother? Helpless, without shelter, full of suffering. That is our life without the Vedas; we need scripture as a baby needs its mother.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:38 (auto-transcript): “because another example another example I will give is what did they use for their child without the mother? So the life of a baby without the mother helpless completely helpless he will become man-less yes”

And when a child criticises and blasphemes its mother, how will it live? It suffers. Maharaj mentions Kamsa and his mother Padmavati: such a person's shelter is taken away and he is never happy.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:33 (auto-transcript): “So when a child starts to criticize blood-fame and crucify the mother, how will they lie? Suffer. Kamsa's mother, Kamsa's mother, Kamsa, Kamsa's mother, he was not good, no mess, Kamsa's”

Minimising, burning or tearing scripture — for any reason, even in the name of religion — brings reactions we cannot handle.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:11 (auto-transcript): “So criticizing the scripture or minimizing the scripture or sometimes I've seen someone burning the scripture or dearing the scripture. You can do that in the name of religion. whatever whatever may be the reason the reason for doing that whatever may be the reason for doing…”

Even a Vaishnava who disrespects the Quran, the Bible or the Torah faces consequences, because they too teach something about God.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:40 (auto-transcript): “Even if a Vaishnava, even if a Vaishnava disreferts Quran, Bible, Torah, its consequences because they are teaching something about God. That verse from Bhagavad Gita 1623, Lord Krishna used the word”

The Gita's word for acting outside scripture is whimsical action under the pull of desire. Such activity, conducted under ignorance, cannot be offered to Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:06 (auto-transcript): “That verse from Bhagavad Gita 1623, Lord Krishna used the word and proper translated acting whimsically in lust. Wimsical activity is dangerous.”

Anyone can say only my religion and my scripture are bona fide and yours are useless. Saying it does not change reality. — “But it does not change the reality.”

🎙 Maharaj at 29:38 (auto-transcript): “One may say, because only my religion is bona fide and my scripture is bona fide. Your scripture is a religion useless. I can say that. I can say that. Anyone can say that. But it does not change the reality. The wise man will understand that karma and gyan are secondary,…”

A wise person sees karma and jnana as secondary and bhakti as the essence. The Vedas teach nine topics, grouped as sambandha (our relationship with Krishna), abhidheya (activity in that relationship) and prayojana (the result, prema).

🎙 Maharaj at 30:44 (auto-transcript): “The Vedas has nine topics, nine subjects. Vedas stand as the authoritative guide and reference Brahmaana and they prove nine different which may be classified into”

There is one Supreme Lord Vishnu, possessor of all energies — not mere light. Even light, Maharaj shows the class, has brightness, heat, colour and a form occupying space. — “Light has qualities.”

🎙 Maharaj at 35:00 (auto-transcript): “Summary of that is, one, there is one Supreme Lord Vishnu, one. The Lord is a possessor of all energies. The Lord is not alone.”

Krishna is the fountainhead of all rasa, Rasaraja, giving joy to the jivas eternally in his abode. His abode, form, name and pastimes are all eternal.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:00 (auto-transcript): “Thirdly, Krishna is the fountainhead of all Rasa, and He is situated in His Dhan, where He eternally gives joy to the Jeevas. So sweet. Krishna is”

Quizzing the class on the Gita's 'millennium after millennium', Maharaj explains that even Krishna's creating and destroying is an eternal activity; the material world is temporary, not false. — “they are temporal but not false”

🎙 Maharaj at 40:46 (auto-transcript): “Bhagavad Gita says, What does that mean? What is the meaning of that? What is the meaning of that? What is the meaning? This is your scripture. I'm asking you from your scripture. From after millennium, after millennium. Good. Millennium after millennium. So what does it mean…”

Jivas are particles of the Lord, unlimited in number, tiny but conscious. Some are bound since time immemorial, attracted to pleasure, yet the Supreme Father punishes no one forever. — “There is a chance for us to get delivered.”

🎙 Maharaj at 43:39 (auto-transcript): “5. Some jivas are eternally bound in the material universes, being attracted by lucrative pleasure. Eternally Bound means that we have been existing here like eternity.”

children.topic: One energy, one with and different
children.note:
Some jivas are eternally liberated in Krishna's service. Krishna exists with his material, jiva and spiritual energies, simultaneously one with and different from them, by inconceivable power.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:21 (auto-transcript): “Seven, Krishna exists with his energies, the material energy, jiva energy and spiritual energy in a state of simultaneous identity and difference permeating all, yet remaining aloof which is only possible by his inconceivable power a chinted bit of that”

Six philosophers in India's history invented theories against the Vedas' real purport and came to no good end; a wise person rejects them, since following them leaves no place for real bhakti.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:47 (auto-transcript): “In the history of India, there are six personalities who invented theories and by their inventions he simply brought themselves to no good end. No good end. All of them no good end.”

Jaimini claims to follow the Vedas but does not recognise the Supreme Lord and stresses fruitive ritual as independent worship.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:52 (auto-transcript): “There are six philosophers. One, Jaymini, though claiming to follow the Vedas does not recognize the Supreme Lord, I recommend Karma Khand activity in independent worship of God. Jaymini ji says that the Karma Khand is the most stressed. But that is Yes, Srila Gurudev, I do.…”

The atheistic Kapila who concluded there is no Lord and taught yoga without its goal is a different person from Kapila, son of Devahuti. — “It's a different Kapil, not equivalent to the son of Devahuti.”

🎙 Maharaj at 50:38 (auto-transcript): “Next, Kapil, by concoction, Kapil thinks that the Lord is imperfect. I recommend the process of yoga without understanding its goal. Kapil is anuman par pohunchta hai ki param bhagawan ka asthita hi nahi hai. Not Kapil, the son of Devahuti, not that. It's a different Kapil,…”

The Jains preached against the Vedas, Carvaka Muni had no respect for Vedic knowledge, and Gautama Buddha did not worship the Lord.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:27 (auto-transcript): “Taking short of the philosophy that everything is illusion, The Jain preached against the Vedas. The 80s Charabaka Muni had no respect for the Vedic knowledge. And similarly, the Buddhist Gautam does not worship the Lord but instead thinks in terms of human beings. In the…”

Vyasadeva is the greatest philosopher, but he is not among them because he accepts the Supreme Person. Chanting the name while holding these philosophies is a serious offence.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:04 (auto-transcript): “In the least, Biasadev is not mentioned here, although he is the greatest philosopher, but his name is not yet. because his teaching is accepting the supreme person with a small bag of water.”

children.topic: Criticising the Vedas, criticising the name
children.note:
The Vedas teach chanting of the pure name as the principal process, so criticising them criticises the name. Devotees take shelter of the Vedas and taste the nectar of the name; even in the spiritual sky great souls chant it.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:36 (auto-transcript): “The purpose is this, since the Vedas are teaching chanting of the pure name as a principal process, to criticize the Vedas is to criticize the name. That is offensive. The devotees, however, take shelter of the Vedas, and by chanting the holy name, attain the nectar of the…”

The Vedas give the jiva ninefold devotional service, vaidhi and raganuga, with hearing and chanting the name as the principal means; the goal is pure prema, received by Krishna's mercy through his pure devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:43 (auto-transcript): “It's a process specifically mentioned for the jiva in the Vedas. It is the nine-fourth process of devotional service divided into Vaidhi and Raghavakti. Of the nine processes, the hearing and chanting of the Holy Name are principal means. That is the reason the chanting Aum…”

As Krishna's servant, Maya Devi punishes the erring jivas and gives only passing happiness to her worshippers, but she helps those who worship Krishna and his name to cross over.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:03 (auto-transcript): “Yes, being Krishna's servant, Maya Devi punishes the erring jivas. and gives only emotional happiness to those who worship her. But if one worship Krishna and his name, she helps him overcome the material question.”

One who commits this offence should repent and daily offer flowers and tulasi to the Bhagavatam and the Vedas; the Bhagavatam, best of scriptures and Krishna's incarnation, gives unlimited mercy. Maharaj adds that we should beg Haridasa Thakura daily for the dust of his feet and the shelter of the name.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:38 (auto-transcript): “khi If by misfortune or accident, it happens that one commits ruti ninda, one should be repentant and offer his respect to tulasi leaves and respect to the scriptures. With attention, one should offer flowers and tulasi leaves to the Bhagavatam and the Vedas. living the…”

Two questions on Ekadasi: whether the cycle of falling will ever end, and the three acaryas of sambandha, abhidheya and prayojana.

🎙 Maharaj at 60:33 (auto-transcript): “Is it possible to take someone to question? Only one or two. Okay. We will have only two questions. Devotees can raise their hand”

children.topic: Q1 · Will everyone go back someday?
children.note:
The world seems to get worse and worse. Will there be a day when no one desires or offends, and all go back to Krishna?

🎙 Question from the floor at 61:41 (auto-transcript): “Christ Guru Maharaj. Guru Maharaj, my question is, it is said that we desire to come to this material world. That's why we are here, but we don't remember because we are not, we don't belong to this place. So Maharaj, my question is, is it going to be a day which nobody is…”

children.topic: That is the purpose of this study
children.note:
We study these details to give up all offences. By the mercy of the name, of pure devotees and of Krishna, if we stick to the process we will be free and go back home, never to see these things again. — “eventually we're going to be free.”

🎙 Maharaj at 63:47 (auto-transcript): “That's why we are studying all these details so that we'll be able to give up all offenses, and by the mercy of the Holy Name, the mercy of pure devotees, the mercy of Krishna. By the mercies, we stick to this process, eventually we're going to be free. And we get a ticket to…”

children.topic: Q2 · Acaryas of the three stages
children.note:
How do Sanatana Gosvami, Rupa Gosvami and Raghunatha dasa Gosvami relate to sambandha, abhidheya and prayojana?

🎙 Question from the floor at 65:23 (auto-transcript): “Gurudev, you told in the class about the definition of sambandh, abhide and prayojana. And I heard somewhere that Sanatana Goswami is a Sambandh Acharya and Rahunadas Goswami is a Prayujan Acharya and Abhideh Acharya, I don't know. So, Gurudev, how we can understand, how we…”

Sanatana Gosvami with Madana-mohana is the sambandha acarya; Rupa Gosvami with Govinda the abhidheya acarya; Raghunatha dasa Gosvami, with Gopinatha, the prayojana acarya. The deities rise in sequence, Gopinatha dancing with the gopis being highest. — “they are higher, higher, highest.”

🎙 Maharaj at 66:29 (auto-transcript): “Madame Mohan Deity of Shri Sanatana Goswami is Sambandha Acharya and Sambandha Guruji. That means that is what they are teaching us. That's the word they taught us. In their writings, that is the teaching they gave to us.”
