maps.title: Harinama Cintamani · Session 10 · Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name

nodeData.topic: Session 10 · Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj explains the fifth offence: treating the glories of the holy name as exaggeration or interpreting them away. After a long reading of the name's glories, he tells of visiting a group devoted to the Vishnu-sahasra-nama and asking whether their envy and anger were decreasing, and stresses that the Lord has invested all his energies in his name, so we should chant rather than argue. Questions turn to the restless mind, the voices of the three modes and steady practice. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: The fifth offence: interpreting the name
children.note:
Today's offence is treating the glories of the holy name as imaginary — giving them an interpretation instead of accepting them as they are.

🎙 Maharaj at 05:14 (auto-transcript): “So, interpreting the holy name I will talk about today Naam ki mahimah ko kalpranik samajna Jaya Gora Gada Dara Sivirada Bhadava Jaya Gora Leela Sali Janaji Vaishnava”

orbit.ref: Session 10 | Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name (Apr 25, 2025) · 05:14

children.note:
Haridasa Thakura tells Mahaprabhu that the smrtis and Puranas glorify the name and warn that whoever explains its glories away out of negligence or faithlessness meets Krishna's displeasure.

🎙 Maharaj at 06:34 (auto-transcript): “The fifth offense is giving interpretation to the name and it's glorious. The similarities or Puranas glorify the holy name of Krishna, stating that if one should change the name either in negligence or in faith, Krishna would show that person great There is no knowledge as…”

orbit.ref: Session 10 | Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name (Apr 25, 2025) · 06:34

children.note:
A long list of the name's glories is read: no knowledge as pure, no vow as powerful, no meditation as effective, no renunciation, peace, piety, charity or progress greater than the name.

🎙 Maharaj at 07:17 (auto-transcript): “There is no knowledge as pure as the honey name. There is no vow as powerful as the holy name.”

orbit.ref: Session 10 | Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name (Apr 25, 2025) · 07:17

children.topic: The point of no more searching
children.note:
The name is the highest liberation, peace and destination. Maharaj dwells on it: after the name there is nothing left to search for. — “there is no more searching for anything”

🎙 Maharaj at 10:19 (auto-transcript): “the point of no more searching no more searching the point after the name there is no more searching for anything the name is the highest devotion The name is the purest inclination of the Jeeva.”

orbit.ref: Session 10 | Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name (Apr 25, 2025) · 10:19

children.note:
The name is a form of guru bringing one to the Lord. As a guru patiently treats disciples like children and gradually makes them strong, the name can lift us from any level to love of God. — “the holy name can take us from any level”

🎙 Maharaj at 11:53 (auto-transcript): “The guru treats the disciple like children. Be intolerant, intolerant with the children who gradually, gradually, gradually bring them forth to a strongest man, strongest woman, perfect person. So the holy name can take us from any level, any level, the holy name can take us from”

orbit.ref: Session 10 | Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name (Apr 25, 2025) · 11:53

children.note:
It is stated that a thousand names of Vishnu equal one name of Rama, and three names of Rama equal one name of Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:10 (auto-transcript): “It is stated that 1,000 names of Vishnu are equivalent to one name of Ram. And three names of Ram are equivalent to one name of Krishna.”

orbit.ref: Session 10 | Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name (Apr 25, 2025) · 13:10

children.note:
Maharaj recalls being invited by a group of friends who were deeply attached to chanting the thousand names of Vishnu.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:56 (auto-transcript): “some time back when when some group invited invited us to to visit them because they were friends so we went to visit So I saw that they were very, very, very attached to Vishnu Sahasanaam's fatra.”

orbit.ref: Session 10 | Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name (Apr 25, 2025) · 13:56

children.note:
Some chanted from the book, some from memory, with all their hearts. Maharaj nodded along, and they were pleased the Swami appreciated them. Afterwards they asked him to speak.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:36 (auto-transcript): “So I saw that they were very, very, very attached to Vishnu Sahasanaam's fatra. They were chanting with all their hearts. And some were chanting from their head. You were not looking at the book. from the head, it was exciting.”

orbit.ref: Session 10 | Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name (Apr 25, 2025) · 14:36

children.note:
After thanking them, he said every intelligent person does things for some benefit — heaven, merging, Brahman. Whatever the goal, we should check where we stand in what we are doing.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:14 (auto-transcript): “So I said that every intelligent person, especially some resolve from everything that we do, every intelligent person will do something with some interest, some benefit. We are spending on everything that we do.”

orbit.ref: Session 10 | Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name (Apr 25, 2025) · 17:14

children.note:
He asked them: you chant regularly — is your envy going down? Your anger, your illusion, your greed? No one looked at anyone; everybody looked down. — “Nobody looks at each other. Everybody looks down.”

🎙 Maharaj at 20:32 (auto-transcript): “So, our envy is going down. He didn't look at it again. Look down. Our anger is freezing or it's going down. Our illusion is getting played, or it is still the same?”

orbit.ref: Session 10 | Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name (Apr 25, 2025) · 20:32

children.note:
If the name is a guru bringing us to the Lord, are we getting closer, or simply babbling without potency? Those who chanted over 64 rounds on Ekadasi did so by the potency of the name and Srila Prabhupada's mercy.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:34 (auto-transcript): “It is said here, a holy name is a form of Guru to bring one to the Lord. So, are we close up to the Lord or we are simply bubbling? Blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, no potency. Some of you chanted more than 64 on yesterday, chanting for many hours yesterday”

orbit.ref: Session 10 | Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name (Apr 25, 2025) · 22:34

children.note:
One who minimises the effect of chanting stated in the Vedas and Puranas is an extreme offender. Some say the stated results are not true, only bait to attract people to the name — that itself is the offence.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:37 (auto-transcript): “One who minimizes the effect of chanting the holy name, is stated in the Vedas and Quranas, as stated in the Vedas and Quranas, is an extreme offender. A Rastal who commits artabah against a name is doomed to rot away in hell.”

orbit.ref: Session 10 | Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name (Apr 25, 2025) · 24:37

children.note:
The Vedas glorify the name as non-different from Krishna, so their statements are not exaggerations to motivate us; they describe its true effect.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:07 (auto-transcript): “The name has been clearly glorified in the Vedas as one not different from Krishna himself. Therefore, although the statements concerning the holy name are not exaggeration, meant to motivate God at the true effect of the name. A devotee does not take the name of his own…”

orbit.ref: Session 10 | Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name (Apr 25, 2025) · 26:07

children.note:
A devotee does not take the name for material enjoyment or perform karma-kanda sacrifices for results. Acting without interest in material results purifies the heart, which is karma's real purpose; then taste for bhakti begins and matures by chanting.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:44 (auto-transcript): “A devotee does not take the name of his own material enjoyment. He does not ask for the truth mentioned in the scripture. He won't perform the sacrifice he prescribes in the Karma Kanda.”

orbit.ref: Session 10 | Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name (Apr 25, 2025) · 26:44

children.note:
Even namabhasa gives all the results of karma and jnana. Then can there be any doubt about the benefit of the pure name? Not at all. — “Not at all. Not at all.”

🎙 Maharaj at 29:08 (auto-transcript): “Just by Nama Bhās, one can get all the results obtained by the process of karma and yāna. If all results can't be obtained by Nama Bhās, is there a need to doubt the great benefit one will get by chanting the pure name? Not at all. Not at all. All the glories of the name.”

orbit.ref: Session 10 | Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name (Apr 25, 2025) · 29:08

children.note:
From beginning to end the Vedas, Ramayana, Mahabharata and Puranas glorify the name. Minimising or interpreting these glories brings no good result.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:19 (auto-transcript): “From the beginning to the end of the Vedas, the Ramayan, the Mahabharata and the Puranas, the name is glorified. To minimize and interpret these glories, which are clearly stated by the authority of the Vedas, who yield no good results. The Lord and the Lord's name are one”

orbit.ref: Session 10 | Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name (Apr 25, 2025) · 30:19

children.topic: All energies invested in the name
children.note:
The Lord and his name are one, for he has invested all his transcendental energies in it and made it the supreme process.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:57 (auto-transcript): “The Lord and the Lord's name are one For the Lord has invested in the name All his transcendental energies Thus he has made something of the holy name, the supreme process.”

orbit.ref: Session 10 | Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name (Apr 25, 2025) · 30:57

children.note:
Completely independent, the Lord put his material energy into fruitive activity and his nirvana energy into impersonal knowledge, but into the holy name he put all his energies with all results.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:52 (auto-transcript): “As a lord, he is completely independent and full of energies. He has, by his will, invested in karmacal activities, his material energy, and in Brahma Gyan, his nirvana energy. But in the holy name, he has invested all energies with all results. so Bhagwan paramstantra and…”

orbit.ref: Session 10 | Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name (Apr 25, 2025) · 31:52

🎙 Maharaj at 32:48 (auto-transcript): “Why argue about why and how? Why should we waste our time to argue about why and how? Why wasting the time? Just change the name as it is. A Lord can do whatever he wants. Therefore, the intelligent, learned man who is not here to interpreting the holy name or the glorious name,”

orbit.ref: Session 10 | Offence #5 - Interpreting the Holy Name (Apr 25, 2025) · 32:48

If one commits this offence, one should humbly go before an assembly of Vaishnavas discussing Krishna and sincerely beg forgiveness at their feet.

Questions on the restless mind, praying for forgiveness, chanting near a departed person, and glorifying the name without realisation.

Moods change through the day, some blame planets; how to stay in goodness and not be carried by the mind?

children.note:
Maharaj acts out the mind in ignorance: why chant, it takes so long, show me one person who got anything, this doesn't work in Kali-yuga. In passion, two minutes for japa but hours for newspapers, sports, TV and gossip.

nodeData.topic: Session 11 · Offence #6 - Committing Sins
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj takes up the sixth offence: committing sin on the strength of the holy name. Chanting is meant to give love of Krishna, not to cancel planned sins; the devotee on the road between a sinful and a pure life must add no new sins, and finds safety in the association of pure Vaishnavas. Questions cover how to recognise progress and a pure devotee, why old sinful tastes persist, setting right a wrong report, and complacency after years in bhakti. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: The sixth offence: sinning on the name
children.note:
Some reason that because the name is so merciful they may go on sinning and let chanting clean it up. Maharaj names this as the sixth offence and asks that the name be chanted with appreciation instead.

🎙 Maharaj at 02:31 (auto-transcript): “Committing sin on the strength of the name. The name, the Harinam, is so powerful, so merciful, so kind. Therefore, let me do sinful activities and chance reform and contract and defect, sinful. One should change the holy name for appreciation.”

When Arjuna saw Krishna was about to solve his problem he gave it complete attention; when he tried to hide behind scripture Krishna did not spare him, and told him to fight while always remembering him.

🎙 Maharaj at 03:51 (auto-transcript): “When Arjun understood Krishna was going to give him a solution to his problem, he gave 100% attention to it. When Arjun tried to use scripture to hide, Krishna did not spare him.”

Maharaj explains in English and Hindi that Pariksit Maharaja did not think, now I have the answer, I can go back to my kingdom. He listened with full attention until the moment of departure, and departed successfully.

🎙 Maharaj at 05:15 (auto-transcript): “When Parashir Maharaj got to know the solution to his problem, Sugudeva Swami, he gave him 100% attention. Guru Deo Sukhdeo Goswami Unki saadi samasyan ka hal Nivaran karne wale hai Tab Raja Parichit Ne apne dono kano ko Khada karke Pumla tallinta se Apne Gurudeo ke mukh se…”

children.topic: The name gives prema, not just erasure
children.note:
Chanting is not merely a counter-measure against our sins; its purpose is to give love of Krishna. Atonement rituals can neutralise a sin but cannot redeem the soul, which is why bhakti was praised over prayascitta. — “The chanting of the holy name is not just to counteract our sinful activities.”

🎙 Maharaj at 07:04 (auto-transcript): “The chanting of the holy name is not just to counteract our sinful activities. It is to give us Krishna Prem. In the scriptures we show that all prajastita processes are meant for contracting sins but not to redeem the soul.”

Maharaj recalls that the scriptures reject atonement rituals as the final answer, since they leave the root untouched; bhakti alone is presented as the real cure.

🎙 Maharaj at 07:21 (auto-transcript): “In the scriptures we show that all prajastita processes are meant for contracting sins but not to redeem the soul. So, an intelligent disciple of Parishit Maharaj condemned the process of Prayasthita and he appreciated Bhakti as the solution.”

children.topic: Ignorance is the seed of sin
children.note:
Sinful activity comes in stages, and every stage grows from a seed of ignorance; sin then brings suffering to the soul.

🎙 Maharaj at 09:33 (auto-transcript): “Simple activities are classified into three stages. All sinful activities causes suffering and it is due to a seed originated in ignorance.”

Maharaj quotes a Christian they had remembered the day before: if everyone truly knew that what they do will make them suffer, nobody would wait to be told to stop.

🎙 Maharaj at 11:30 (auto-transcript): “we are remembering one one sincere christian he said that kal ham lo ishmaan kar rahe te ek achche isai ka wo bolte hain if everyone And everyone knows truly that what we are doing will make us suffer. We will not wait for somebody to tell you not to do it.”

Ignorance makes us sin and sin makes us suffer, so real knowledge is given to lift us out of ignorance; Krishna, unable to bear our suffering, always tries to help. — “So knowledge is meant to remove us from ignorance.”

🎙 Maharaj at 12:41 (auto-transcript): “So knowledge is meant to remove us from ignorance. Krishnan is always merciful and always looking into the welfare of his thoughts and passions. Not being able to bear the sufferings of the jivas, Krishna always tries to help us.”

children.topic: Signs that Krishna is helping us
children.note:
Maharaj asks the audience for proof that Krishna is interested in us, and they call out the answers one after another.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:45 (auto-transcript): “What are the signs of Krishna helping conditions? What are the signs? What is the proof that Krishna is really helping us? What are the signs? There are some ways that we can know that Krishna is giving us a sign. For example, Krishna's activity that shows us is interested in…”

Guru, Krishna coming personally, devotees, Deities, the holy dhama, prasadam, holy days, holy rivers, Tulasi, the holy name, the Bhagavatam, sankirtana — and even problems sent so that we reform ourselves.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:14 (auto-transcript): “give guru very good very good very good becoming personally coming personally devotees Deities. Very good. Holy Dham. Very good. Prasadam. Very good. Holy Days.”

He asks what we gain from suffering. Answers come: it brings us close to Krishna, makes us careful with sadhana, purifies, matures us, and pays off our karmic debt until we are free.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:00 (auto-transcript): “What is the importance of suffering? He gives us the assessment. What is the importance of suffering? What do we gain from suffering? What do we gain from suffering? What do we gain from suffering? You can come close to Krishna, yes. Be careful about our sadhana. Very good.”

Turning the question around, material enjoyment uses up our piety. Better to suffer, finish the karma, and go back to Godhead. — “See, better to suffer and diminish our karma.”

🎙 Maharaj at 17:56 (auto-transcript): “What is the demerit of enjoyment? I'm taking the opposite. What is the demerit of enjoyment? What is the demerit? Okay, material enjoyment. Yes, when we are enjoying our material life, we are diminishing our piety.”

children.topic: How do I know I am advancing?
children.note:
A question devotees often ask. The answer given in the text: the taste for material stimulation leaves the heart, things like a beautiful spouse or great wealth stop attracting, and service becomes tasty.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:49 (auto-transcript): “Many times devotees are asking, how do I know I am making advancement? How do I know? Who is improved? I am making advancement. I am progressing. This is the answer, this is the answer, the taste for material stimulation or the loss”

children.topic: Accept the favourable, reject the rest
children.note:
The devotee begins to appreciate giving up what is unfavourable and accepting what is favourable — even when we like the one and dislike the other. These are the first two qualities of surrender.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:12 (auto-transcript): “Then the devotees will start to appreciate how to give up on favorable things and accept favorable things, which are the two qualities of surrender. This is the stage of Karnistha Bhakta.”

Maharaj links the six qualities of surrender to the stages of devotion: the beginner has the first two, the intermediate four, the highest devotee all six, ending in feeling oneself lowest and chanting constantly.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:55 (auto-transcript): “So we see this with the khanishtha, doctor, a madhyam has four. Uttam Bhakta has the six. So, such a person, he regards Krishna alone as his protector and maintainer and leaves up all ideas of selfish concept of I and mind.”

children.topic: On the road between sin and purity
children.note:
There is unavoidably an interim period after leaving sinful life and before pure love, when traces of past sin remain. Maharaj calls it a very serious period.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:35 (auto-transcript): “However, inevitably, there is a period between sinful life and a pure state. And in this entire period, there may be some relation with past sin, that is, some diminishing trace of sin. The ultimate goal is purity, perfection.”

children.topic: Started is better than not started
children.note:
We have left the starting point but not reached the destination. In English and Hindi he explains that being on the road is already a successful step compared with one who never set out; so we tolerate this stage.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:41 (auto-transcript): “and from this side sinful activity in the middle in the middle means that we have not gotten to the end and we have also left the beginning we are on the road but we have not gotten to our destination that period is also a very very serious period so paap mein jeevan ek hai…”

In this interim state our attention is to add nothing new while the accumulated load is burned away by continuous chanting.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:44 (auto-transcript): “So, within this interim state, we should try not to add any news and photos, we should do the men are dealing with the already accumulated one because it's really too much. So, now we have to keep our attention that we don't have a new faith, we don't have a new faith. If we…”

Maharaj cites the Gita's assurance that one engaged in devotion is to be considered saintly despite faults — but not a whimsical person who compromises and minimises the opportunity of the name. Krishna, Bhakta-vatsala, removes the devotee's sins.

A devotee who falls by accident needs no separate ritual; chanting washes it away. But one who sins deliberately, thinking the name will cancel it, is called a cheater, and for this there is no remedy.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:58 (auto-transcript): “Even if by accident a devotee happens or commits a sin, he does not resort to the purificatory rite of Prayastheta and Paramakanda. That sin is temporary and by chanting it will be washed away, leaving no influence. He does not perform any karma-kandhya prashtri-vidhi for the…”

Ordinary sin can be countered by atonement; merely planning sin on the strength of the name has no remedial measure. If thinking of it brings suffering, how much more doing it.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:20 (auto-transcript): “In the case of ordinary sin, one can counteract it by Pryastita, but if one, even thinks of committing sin on the saint of the holy name, there is no remedial measure. So serious is the offense.”

Maharaj gives the parallel of one who wears the dress of renunciation yet enjoys women and wealth under that cover, in Hindi too — a disturbance to society.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:30 (auto-transcript): “In the same way, a person may give a regular work, I give the course, I take the course renunciate but still as you say with women and wealthy for sanctification using the position of an advanced renunciate as a means of enjoying as a household that is a great disturbance,…”

Householder or renunciate, nothing blocks perfection by the name if one serves by the rules without offence; the block is the idea of sinning under its shelter.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:09 (auto-transcript): “Either as a householder or as an enunciate, there is no impediment to taking the holiness and perfecting one's life, provided one carries out his devotion according to the rules without offense. But to have the idea of committing sin under the shelter of the name is a great…”

If by bad fortune one commits this offence, purification comes through association with pure Vaishnavas. Maharaj repeats it: this is our security.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:15 (auto-transcript): “What is our security? If by the fate one commit this offence, one should purify himself by association with pure Vaishnamas. Our security is association of pure Vaishnamas.”

Sinful desires are like thieves on the road of bhakti and the Vaishnavas are its guards; call out the protector's name loudly and the thief runs. The class closes with the verse that the humble servant of the Vaishnavas can sing this book.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:21 (auto-transcript): “sinful desires are like teeth on the road to bhakti and the pure vajshavas are the protectors of the road vajshava sangha taalup sangha loudly call out the name of the protector when the protector comes the teeth flees say that name love and do not fear for remembering to…”

Questions from devotees on the call, read out and answered.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:52 (auto-transcript): “We have first question from Sulit Pande Prabhuji. And then we have Shweta Mataji, I can see on my screen. Yes, that is true. You can go ahead. Hare Krishna, Shilagur Deo. Please accept my humble patience. Hare Krishna. Shilagur Deo, I am having two questions. First question…”

children.topic: Q1 · How to see my progress?
children.note:
How do we know we are moving from kanistha to madhyama to uttama?

🎙 Question from the floor at 49:14 (auto-transcript): “First question is that, as you said, that initially we start from Kanishtu Bhakta. And there are two qualities of Kanishtu Bhakta. Then after that, we are doing Bhakti. and we are following the instructions of Gurudev, Guru Maharaj sincerely, then how will we get to know that…”

children.topic: You know when you are full
children.note:
Nobody needs to tell an eater he is full. Progress shows itself: material attraction fades, giving up the unnecessary is appreciated, and in difficulty we run to Krishna, not to demigods.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:23 (auto-transcript): “If one is eating, nobody tells you to stop eating, because I barely will be full. Similarly, if we are making progress, it will be shown.”
At the start we cannot tell who is pure.

One who destroys your ignorance by his powerful speech is a pure devotee. He does not entertain the intellect; his words go to the heart, like heart surgery, and you keep thinking about yourself afterwards. — “He will not entertain your intellect, but he will hit your heart with strong words.”

Sinful activity has reduced, but I still enjoy it while knowing the result is harmful. How to get free?

🎙 Question from the floor at 63:46 (auto-transcript): “My question is that, as I still have a cheating propensity in my mind and I am doing a japa, and I also listen to your classes. After that, the mind is such a cheating propensity, and there are so many sinful activities. There is also a game. But I see one thing, when I am in…”

children.topic: Stop enjoying, then he takes it
children.note:
If we keep enjoying it Krishna leaves it with us for a long time. If we feel bad about it and pray seriously to Krishna and beg guru for help, it will be taken away. — “If you keep enjoying that, Krishna will not take it away.”

🎙 Maharaj at 65:28 (auto-transcript): “If we stop enjoying it, if we stop enjoying the result, then Krishna will take it away. If you keep enjoying that, Krishna will not take it away. it will remain there for a long time. But if we are not enjoying it again and we are feeling bad about it and we pray seriously to…”

children.topic: Q4 · I repeated a wrong report
children.note:
Trusting an authority I spoke against a devotee to many people; later it proved false. Is that an offence, and what now?

🎙 Question from the floor at 67:06 (auto-transcript): “Another question is relating to the question of a Prat. If a devotee is following the authority faithfully, with full faith, and the authority says that devotee A has wrong reacted or is doing something wrong. And you repeat the same thing because you have full faith in the…”

Stop and rectify. Confess sincerely to the Deities, and if the person can be met, apologise to them directly. Repentance is very powerful when we really feel bad.

🎙 Maharaj at 68:12 (auto-transcript): “When we have come to realize the mistakes you have made, it is better for us to rectify it, to stop and rectify it. Let us close it to Him, and let us do it fine, let us do it. Who can sincerely confess it to the Deatists?”

children.topic: Q5 · Why do we grow casual?
children.note:
Early years are full of japa, mangala-arati and service; after some years everything slackens, as in a marriage.

🎙 Question from the floor at 71:26 (auto-transcript): “Actually, I have a question. In the starting years, we are very active in Japa, Mangala Arati, and the Seva at the temple, and other activities which are there in the temple. But after the time passes, like three to five years, or ten years, you can say, then we take it very…”

The first fire of bhakti puts out our anxiety and we think we are now perfect — now I am temple president, guru, director. Maharaj ties this to the Gita's description of the self-complacent, which makes us forget the purpose of Krishna consciousness.

nodeData.topic: Session 12 · Offence #7 - Instructing a Faithless Person
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. The seventh offence is giving the holy name to a faithless person. Maharaj stresses that faith alone qualifies one for the name, illustrates how doubt destroys with stories of Lord Shiva's gift to a beggar and the rakshasas crossing the sea on Rama's name, and explains the guru's responsibility. In the questions he speaks on preparing before anger strikes, the jaundiced tongue, why loud street harinama matters, and fear as a first step towards love. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:

nodeData.topic: Session 13 · Offence #8 - Equating Holy Name with Rituals
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. The eighth offence is to put the holy name on the level of Vedic pious rituals and atonements. Maharaj contrasts atonement, which only cuts the grass or patches the tube, with the name, which uproots sin and is always fresh; he tells the story of the monkeys' Ekadasi to show the danger of faithlessness, and explains that the name comes from Goloka and is both the means and the goal. In the questions he speaks on why a guru is compulsory, atoning by confession, chanting loudly while healthy, and humility. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: The eighth offence: name as ritual
children.note:

🎙 Maharaj at 06:22 (auto-transcript): “Haridas Thakur has said, Oh Lord, please note that the holy name is not to be equated with the first activities mentioned in the Vedas. While we are chanting, let us be fully conscious that the name Krishna and Krishna himself are non-different.”

nodeData.topic: Session 14 · Offence #9 - Inattentiveness
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Opening chapter 12, Maharaj explains the ninth offence, inattentive chanting, which can block love of God even when the other offences are avoided. He takes its three forms — indifference, laziness and distraction — with their remedies: holy places, Tulasi, the association of devotees with a taste for the name, quiet focused chanting, and constant prayer for help. Questions cover past-life desires, work worries during japa, chanting in the office, chanting while walking, and chanting with a recording. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:

🎙 Maharaj at 07:01 (auto-transcript): “Even if one successfully overcomes all the other offenses in chanting, and one is chanting continuously, the love of God may not come. One should know that the reason for that is that one is committing the offense, known as Brahman or inattention. If someone could do all the…”
In the Bhagavatam pramada is used for madness, as in Rishabhadeva's teaching to his sons; here it means inattention and carelessness.

On the expressway there is always a sign warning against careless driving. Careless japa is the same — and from this offence all the others spring. — “Careless driving is dangerous.”

🎙 Maharaj at 10:05 (auto-transcript): “On the expressway, an express road, there's always a sign. Careless driving is dangerous. Similarly, careless japa. It is from this offense that all other offenses bring.”

The wise recognise three: indifference, laziness and distraction.

🎙 Maharaj at 11:08 (auto-transcript): “The wise men recognize three types of inattention. One is indifference. Indifference or no attention. The second is laziness. And the third one is distraction.”

Something else seems more important — chanting while discussing other subjects, or answering a phone call. That is pramada.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:05 (auto-transcript): “Distraction means that some other things are more important that is taking our attention away from Jap. Just like one is chanting and having discussion. We are not discussing about the name. We are discussing about some other objects. or we are answering a phone call.”

Attached to material things, one chants while the heart is absorbed in some object; chanting all day this way brings no benefit, because not one drop of taste has entered the heart.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:34 (auto-transcript): “Naturally, the common man having attachment to material things will be attracted to those things, even while chanting. Though chanting Japa Delhi, if his taste is so weird, he will show indifference to the name. His heart will not be absorbed in chanting the name, but in some…”

Maharaj counts them with the audience: chant where Krishna had his pastimes — Vrindavan, Puri, Mayapur; near Tulasi Devi; in the company of Vaishnavas; and gradually increase the quality and quantity.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:57 (auto-transcript): “How many items? Remedy? How many items? How many items? One is what? Chants in the places where Krishna performed, Paisan, Vrindavan, Haridva, Jagannathpuri, Maya Purudham, etc. Two chants near Tulsi Devi. And look at Tulsi A.B.”

Chanting alone in a locked room with the senses covered is for senior devotees; a junior person will simply fall asleep. — “A junior person will sleep.”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:39 (auto-transcript): “Fifth remedy, fifth one. Paanchma, paanchma hal kya hai? He shall carefully turn in a room by oneself with the door locked or concentrate on the name by covering the eyes, the ears, the nose, with a clot or like or the like to prevent stimuli from the exterior. so five is…”

A sluggish mind, or stopping before the round is finished and starting again later.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:25 (auto-transcript): “Second, laziness. If one chants with a sluggish mind, or after chanting a little, one has to stop before finishing the round, it is called laziness.”

children.topic: Two rounds and back to sleep
children.note:
Chanting a couple of rounds, sleeping, then a few more, so that the whole day passes without finishing — that is lazy chanting, and taste will not develop.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:18 (auto-transcript): “Then you start again. Two runs, go and sleep. We chant like this the whole day, we're not finished. It's laziness, chanting.”

Laziness means a weak, dull mind that calculates how much time this will take when there are so many other things to do. — “It means the mind is very weak, the mind is dull.”

🎙 Maharaj at 26:09 (auto-transcript): “It means the mind is very weak, the mind is dull. The mind calculates how long will you spend in this thing. There are so many things to do. Chanting in laziness, the taste for the name will not develop.”

children.topic: Follow those who waste no time
children.note:
The remedy is association with devotees who chant constantly and waste no time; seeing them, enthusiasm comes and one resolves to increase one's chanting.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:03 (auto-transcript): “What is the remedy for this? Take association of wise and wise who do not waste time in material activity but constantly chant. that I remember the holy name, being absorbed only in the name. One should follow in the footsteps of those who does not waste time in chanting.”

The third kind, from which all inattention is born.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:30 (auto-transcript): “Now we look at distraction. Distraction. One should be careful to eliminate the third type of inattention, which is destruction. From destruction, all types of inattention are born. This thought resides in attraction for women or men.”

Attraction to the opposite sex, desire for wealth, for prestige and position, and the cheating propensity: if any of these is in the heart, the mind will wander from the name.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:07 (auto-transcript): “This thought resides in attraction for women or men. Desire for wealth. Attraction for material sources of victory. desire for possession”

Following proper Vaishnava behaviour: on Ekadasi and appearance days stop thinking of eating, and spend day and night chanting with devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:36 (auto-transcript): “Once you be careful to eliminate these suggestions by following the proper Vaishnava behavior, On all ecadases and appearance days, all ecadases and appearance days, One should stop thinking of eating and all day and night, chants and association of devotees.”

Hear about Krishna from devotees — bhajans, kirtan, lectures. Maharaj stresses these activities are for all of us; by them low desires fade and the heart is fixed on the name.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:52 (auto-transcript): “So here about Krishna from devotees and here Bhajan, Kirtan, here lectures, here Krishna activities, from devotees. This is activities for all of us.”

Complete the prescribed rounds every day, avoiding all three faults, but give up the urge to push up the number; first concentrate on what one can manage.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:30 (auto-transcript): “When chanting this prescribed sound, one should avoid the different types of inattentiveness. We should also give up the desire to increase the number of rounds for sure.”

Begin with short periods of fully concentrated chanting in a peaceful place, praying for clear rounds with the mind on Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:24 (auto-transcript): “One should attempt to first concentrate nicely on what one can manage. Therefore, the devotees start by chanting with a full concentration in a peaceful place for a short time. He will always be praying to the Lord that he will chant clear, attentive rounds with a mind fixed…”

On our own we accomplish nothing; Krishna's mercy is needed. Every day pray, please Krishna, help me to chant your pure name.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:19 (auto-transcript): “Every day, every day, to pray, please, Krishna. help me to change your pure name. Please Krishna help me to change your pure name.”

Asked to say something about the holy name, Maharaj reads its glories: Krishna has invested all his potencies in it, it is never material, and it delivers one who chants even once.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:41 (auto-transcript): “What is the holy name? Yes, this is Lagurdeo. Yes, this is Lagurdeo. So, Gurdeo is saying that we should hear something about Hainam Prabhu. The holy name of Krishna is trans-dentally blissful. It bestows all spiritual benedictions, all, all spiritual benedictions. Because…”

The name is always liberated and spiritual because the name of Krishna and Krishna himself are identical — the sweetest and most auspicious of all.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:31 (auto-transcript): “This is because the name of Krishna and Krishna himself are identical. Krishna's name is the sweetest of the sweet things. The most auspicious of all auspicious things, the transcendental fruit of the vine of all Vedic literature.”

Questions from devotees on the call.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:13 (auto-transcript): “Thank you, Shilagur Deo. Staurav Prabhu Ji, you may ask your question. Then we have Pajtama. Hare Krishna. Hare Krishna. Maharaj, I have one question that as you said to those who while there's a distraction while taking the holy name. One distraction is persons who have the…”

Desires for wealth, women and position come automatically while chanting. How to erase them?

🎙 Question from the floor at 48:26 (auto-transcript): “Maharaj, I have one question that as you said to those who while there's a distraction while taking the holy name. One distraction is persons who have the desire for wealth, woman or the position. But Maharaj, people like me who have these desires, now how can I or how can I…”

Chant with devotees superior to us, near Tulasi, in a holy place; forget food on Ekadasi; pray to Krishna for help; give up pretension and cheating. These desires are there from association, and now we work on counteracting them.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:09 (auto-transcript): “Chant with devotees, especially devotees who are superior to us. Chant with Tulsi Devi. Chant in a holy place, Jagannath Puri, Mayapuru, etc. On the Kadasi days and appearance days, don't remember food.”

Don't chant, sleep, chant again. Rise early and complete the rounds before the day so it becomes meaningful. God helps those who help themselves. — “wake up early and finish before the day”

🎙 Maharaj at 53:26 (auto-transcript): “And he said, we should not chant, go and sleep, chant, go and sleep, chant, go and do this. No, we should focus and make sure we complete our Ciceroan. That is why we emphasize, wake up early and finish before the day, so that the day will become meaningful, the taste will…”

Office problems keep coming back while chanting. What category is this?

🎙 Question from the floor at 58:59 (auto-transcript): “Today you have depicted the mind. Our mind is focusing on what different material objects, so you have clearly depicted it. But I would like to know, like we working in the workplace, so very often we get carried by like problems as a work and then when we chant later then…”

It is distraction. At work we hear only talk of men, women and money, and the mind records it all. So chant the prescribed rounds before leaving home, and hear lectures and bhajans attentively — heard nicely, they protect us. — “If you hear them nicely, they will protect us.”

🎙 Maharaj at 62:06 (auto-transcript): “So in your midst, what do you hear? You will hear all kinds of garbages. So the next day, you want to chant. The men have only recorded all this. But you want to chant the next day, they will all come. So when we are in the office, what do we do? Ishtri Purudhan. We know this…”

Must we leave our job to remember the name all the time?

🎙 Question from the floor at 69:15 (auto-transcript): “it's not it's a muted yes i have a question like when we go to office there's a lot of office politics or there's a lot of engagement with the material things and i am i am particularly run a business for a company so obviously there's a lot of uh discussion around wealth…”

Most cannot give up their job. Chant and hear nicely and seriously, use our earnings for devotional activities, and pray constantly — Krishna will protect us.

🎙 Maharaj at 70:53 (auto-transcript): “We should chant nicely. That is the solution. Let us chant nicely. Let us hear nicely. We are doing this thing, but we are not doing them with seriousness. Let us chant nicely. So we hear nicely. Our salary, which we get, we do devotional activities with them and constantly…”

Recite Haridasa Thakura's prayer daily. A parent attends to a crying child; when Krishna sees we are sincere and helpless, he helps. Just keep begging.

🎙 Maharaj at 72:33 (auto-transcript): “Dr. Sekhira made a prayer, which all of us should try to repeat every day. Haydash Thakur Ji has said one person here to do this, which we should always do daily daily. You should always say it. I am materially minded. I am materially minded. And I just chant. But I never get…”

Some devotees object to chanting while walking; sitting, I fall asleep.

🎙 Question from the floor at 77:50 (auto-transcript): “My question is that, a very short question is there. Most of the time we chant while walking or while sitting. So I just want to ask that which one is better means should we have to chant while sitting only or should we have to chant while walking only or we can switch in…”

Sitting is first class — unless you sit and sleep. The issue is where the mind is. Srila Prabhupada chanted japa walking every day; Rupa Gosvami warns against following rules without their essence. Use the intelligence Krishna gave.

🎙 Maharaj at 79:42 (auto-transcript): “Sitting down and chanting is first class. But I am in first class if I am sitting down and sleeping. I am in first class. It is not sitting that is the issue. No chanting is the issue. It is not. It is where our mind is. That is the issue.”

My japa is better alone with a recording of Maharaj or Prabhupada than in a loud group. Is that approved?

🎙 Question from the floor at 84:50 (auto-transcript): “Maharaj, my question was, I feel my drapa of a little quality. when I chant with yours or Prabhupada's recording with me in solitude. But when I chant in the association of devotees, then I get a lot of disturbance. And I am not able to hear my own chanting properly. Because…”

Our principle: anything that helps us progress in Krishna consciousness should be accepted, so go ahead.

🎙 Maharaj at 86:04 (auto-transcript): “Our system is, anything that helps us make progress in Christian consciousness should be accepted. That's our principle. So, anything that I am helping you to do, I jump nicely, please go ahead with it. Alright, Hare Krishna.”

maps.title: Harinama Cintamani · Session 15 · Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine

nodeData.topic: Session 15 · Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. The tenth and lowest offence is attachment to 'I and mine', the exact opposite of surrender. Maharaj goes through the six qualities of surrender with sharp examples — the devotee who throws out spouse and job, amulets for the stars, the servant whose only word is yes, Krishna as the supreme sanctioning officer — and shows that freedom comes through association, repentance and constant chanting. In the questions he explains how office work becomes service, loyalty in family rituals, serious chanting, honest Ekadasi, and accepting the unfavourable favourably, with SB 10.14.8. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: The tenth offence: I and mine
children.note:
Chapter 13 opens with the danger of attachment to I and mine, which Haridasa Thakura calls the lowest of all the offences.

🎙 Maharaj at 05:31 (auto-transcript): “We are looking at the danger of attachment to I and mind. Today we are going to see how dangerous it is possible to make me and me of the peace.”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 05:31

children.note:
It can never bring good, because it is exactly opposite to surrender to the Lord. Having removed the other nine, a devotee should come to full surrender to the name. — “I am mine is opposite, is opposite to surrender.”

🎙 Maharaj at 07:13 (auto-transcript): “Why? Because it is an attitude exactly opposite to surrender to the Lord. I am mine is opposite, is opposite to surrender.”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 07:13

children.note:
Maharaj recalls Srila Prabhupada often saying surrender is difficult for us because we lack mercy, austerity, cleanliness and truthfulness.

🎙 Maharaj at 09:31 (auto-transcript): “Don't forget, we have quoted Shila Prabhupada many times saying that Surrender is difficult because we are lacking for qualities. So surrender is not very easy because of us.”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 09:31

children.note:
Haridasa Thakura explains the six qualities that decorate a surrendered soul. We have heard them many times; here they are explained more deeply.

🎙 Maharaj at 11:01 (auto-transcript): “So, let us look at what are these six qualities that decorate the Bodhi of a Saranda soul. We have heard about it many times. But Haidash Thakur would give us more explanation for better understanding. In brief, they are accepting everything favourable for service to the Lord.”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 11:01

children.note:
First, accept everything favourable for service; second, reject everything unfavourable. Maharaj says it sounds simple but is very deep.

🎙 Maharaj at 11:41 (auto-transcript): “In brief, they are accepting everything favourable for service to the Lord. He is very deep, accepting all favourable things we service to the Lord, very deep. Two, the opposite of that, number two, he is rejecting everything on favorable to the service of the Lord.”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 11:41

children.topic: Get out of my way, husband!
children.note:
Who is ready to tell the husband, wife or office, you are useless maya, I want only Krishna? Maharaj acts out the scene to ask how favourable these things really are — and we still keep our head there.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:37 (auto-transcript): “Let's just give an example. Who is ready to give up your parents, your hostile time? So tell the husband, get out of my way, it's only Krishna I know, get out, husband, useless,”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 12:37

children.note:
Haridasa Thakura admits it is difficult: whatever does not support our bhakti is rejected and whatever supports it is accepted — anything.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:43 (auto-transcript): “So Ardha Sequeira said it is difficult. Anything that does not support our bhakti will be rejected. and anything that supports our bhakti should be accepted. It means anything. Kiri, having faith in Krishna as most protective.”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 15:43

children.note:
Third, faith in Krishna as protector: no rings or charms to balance the stars, no fear of Jupiter against one's marriage. Only Krishna — Harinama Prabhu ki jaya.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:21 (auto-transcript): “Kiri, having faith in Krishna as most protective. Krishna will keep us in all circumstances. Don't be a dhran buddhi. No rings. No kawach. No kawach. No kawach. For moderating our, for balancing our stars, no more. Finish. Oh, I have seen some dosas standing in Jupiter.”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 16:21

children.note: Fourth, Krishna as maintainer; fifth, feeling oneself low and worthless; sixth, self-surrender. In Hindi too, Maharaj places the first two with the beginner, three and four with the intermediate, five and six with the uttama devotee.

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 18:20

children.note:
All six are visible in Haridasa Thakura. He feels he is nobody — naturally, not by quoting scripture and not as pretence.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:28 (auto-transcript): “Look at Haidash Thakur. Haidash Thakur doesn't think he is somebody. He feels himself to be useless. Naturally, not scripturally and not pretentiously. He feels literally. I am nobody. Haidash Thakur ji, I know many devotees, they always sign, that's what's me, that's what's…”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 20:28

children.note:
Many devotees sign 'dasosmi' yet get angry with other devotees. How is that dasosmi? A servant cannot be angry with or dictate to the master.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:49 (auto-transcript): “I know many devotees, they always sign, that's what's me, that's what's me, that's what's me. But they are getting angry with another devotee. How is that DASOSMI?”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 20:49

children.note:
A servant has only one word in his mouth: yes. Without cultivating this while chanting, we simply accumulate material life. — “a servant has only yes”

🎙 Maharaj at 21:57 (auto-transcript): “a servant has only yes in his mouth. Yes. Yes. That is Das was me. Yes. I'm your servant. If one does not culture this attitude while chanting when we simply accumulate material in life.”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 21:57

children.note:
Relationships are difficult because everyone thinks, I am master. Where all are dasa and dasi and Krishna alone is Prabhu, relationships become very sweet. — “Relationship will be very sweet.”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:42 (auto-transcript): “If all of us think, if all of us fully, if all of us fully convince and act as that's what's me why relationship with each other is difficult relationship is difficult because i am master”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 22:42

children.note:
Rupa Gosvami offers Pradyumna as the perfect example: ready to do whatever Krishna wants, liked or disliked, his eyes always full of tears of love.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:07 (auto-transcript): “The perfect example Rupa Goswami gave us is Pradyumna. And Shri Rupa Goswami Ji has given a beautiful prayer of Shri Pradyumna Ji. Pradyumna is ready to do anything Krishna has said to you. And even if he doesn't like it, and he is ready to accept everything, even if he likes…”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 25:07

children.note:
The principle: accept what we dislike with relish because it favours bhakti, and reject what we like without disgust.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:20 (auto-transcript): “It is easy for us to give us something we don't like and accept something that we don't like. The principle here is that we should accept things we don't like without relish.”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 26:20

children.note:
Other than Krishna there is no one to depend on. Birth in a rich family, money and education do not guarantee even a meal if Krishna does not sanction it.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:29 (auto-transcript): “One should believe that other than Krishna, there is no one on whom to depend and that Krishna alone is one's maintainer. Perfect example.”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 27:29

children.note:
We pay the doctor's full fee and get perfect medicine — and still die.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:57 (auto-transcript): “Or the doctor will give us perfect medicine and we have paid the full fee. We'll pay the full medical charge, we'll pay fully and the doctor will give perfect medicine, still we die. I know one lady who was in coma for 12 years.”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 28:57

children.note:
Maharaj knew a lady who lay in hospital in a coma for twelve years, with huge sums spent, before she left her body. So who maintains? Krishna provides and sanctions. — “Krishna is the supreme sanctioning officer.”

🎙 Maharaj at 29:30 (auto-transcript): “I know one lady who was in coma for 12 years. 12 years in coma in the hospital. They lie in the hospital for 12 years. Before she left the body. 12 years. The woman was spending money. Spending. After spending so much money, she died.”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 29:30

children.note:
As Krishna's eternal servant one is ready to do whatever he wants, rejecting the idea of being doer, owner and protector. In pain or rejoicing, I am Krishna's servant.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:06 (auto-transcript): “As an eternal servant to Krishna, one would be willing to do anything that Krishna did. To believe that one is a doer, a giver, a protector, that one owns his body, house, wife and husband. To think oneself to be a brahmana or sutra, husband or wife, king or citizen, he…”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 31:06

children.note:
Without the six qualities one has the intelligence of I and mine: doer, owner, protector of family, proud of one's knowledge — chanting only for social show. Maya binds such a person tightly.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:42 (auto-transcript): “When these six types of saranagathe full sarana are not present in an individual, he possesses the intelligence of I and mind. Such a person is considered a low rascal because he believes that he is a doer, that the world”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 34:42

children.topic: Serve those who gave it up
children.note:
Seek out devotees who have given up material attachment and humbly sing the name; serve them, and I and mine gradually go away, leading to full surrender and prema.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:16 (auto-transcript): “One should seek out this type of person, take his association and serve him with the desire to give of material attachment. Gradually, one will become fixed in the names and I and mine will go away as one can send attachment to Maya. Giving of the false mentality, one will…”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 39:16

children.note:
Whoever chants without offence attains prema; whoever keeps the offences never reaches pure bhakti despite practice. Careful sadhana means sadhana without the ten offences.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:52 (auto-transcript): “All right. While chanting the holy name very soon by Christ's message, that person will come to the level of bhava and prem. The Lord has stated himself that whoever takes the name without offense will attain prem and whoever takes the name without giving up the offense”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 41:52

children.note:
Maharaj's summary: practise repentance, and chant regularly and seriously in good association. No ritual atonement releases one from offences — only taking shelter of the name again, day and night. — “We should practice repentance.”

🎙 Maharaj at 46:11 (auto-transcript): “That means that we should repent. We should practice repentance. We should regularly and seriously chant the holy name. In the association of pure devotee, one can never be released from offenses against the name by prayaschita or prayaschita, but only by again taking shelter…”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 46:11

children.note:
Before questions Maharaj reads verses glorifying the name: available to all, even the lowest, identical with Krishna, not waiting for initiation or prior rituals — and prays to collect and count the names as a miser counts his money.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:04 (auto-transcript): “the holy name of Lord Krishna is an attractive future for many simply liberated people. The holy name of Krishna is the annihilator of all sinful reactions and is so powerful”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 50:04

children.note:
Questions from devotees on the call.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:09 (auto-transcript): “yes, what is your question? Lalit Pandey Prabhu Ji you may unmute yourself and ask the question Hare Krishna Shila Gurudev Thank you so much for this wonderful class Prabhu Ji so my question is that just you said that we have to do all the activities in service of Krishna…”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 54:09

children.topic: Q1 · Is office work for Krishna?
children.note:
I work for a company; how is that serving Krishna? Should one rather give it up for direct service?

🎙 Question from the floor at 54:34 (auto-transcript): “just you said that we have to do all the activities in service of Krishna only in our day to day activities like I'm going to office doing my job in Delhi not not for the result but in Delhi activities how to identify that I am doing that activity for Krishna Lalit Prabhuji…”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 54:34

children.note:
Using the salary for devotees, family, Deities, pilgrimage and chanting is the connection. Such work is indirect devotional service — making the best use of a bad bargain.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:22 (auto-transcript): “Krishna? That is the result you are going to do you are using it to serve devotees, your family you are devotees, you are deities, you go to the dham, you are chanting. That is the results. That is how it is connected with Krishna because you are using the result for Krishna.…”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 56:22

children.note:
Maharaj acts it out: tell your family it is all maya and go to chant under a tree — and people will call you a lazy failure every day. Only a realised soul can do that.

🎙 Maharaj at 59:47 (auto-transcript): “We have already discussed. We have already discussed. We have already discussed. Tell your wife and children, all this is Maya, this is the Maya destruction. So now it's Naam and Krishna, all of you, destructions. I want to focus on Him and Krishna only. tell your wife like…”

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 59:47

children.note: For most of us, follow what Prabhupada gave: use everything in Krishna's service. He has a passage read from the Gita purport about members who work hard and give their earnings to the mission.

orbit.ref: Session 15 | Offence #10 - Considering I and Mine (May 02, 2025) · 63:44

children.note:
Home pujas and rituals do not come from my heart, but refusing would hurt the family.

Like we are performing our rituals at home, many pujas and all. But from inside, from my heart, if I'm not able to do it, So how should I forcefully do that thing and if I…”

That is what is said. Whatever support us, you should do it. We should do it based on the instruction. It's due to loyalty, not because…”

You give the explanation about careful means that we have to avoid all the ten offences. But when we say seriously in the context of chanting, what do you…”

Avoid all distractions: don't sit with people who talk during japa, don't keep a ringing phone near you. Being serious means planning; no planning means we are not serious.

maps.title: Harinama Cintamani · Session 16 · Offences to the Deities

nodeData.topic: Session 16 · Offences to the Deities
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Haridasa Thakura begins the second-last chapter, on offences in serving the deity, after showing that one should not refuse a service the Lord requests. Maharaj walks through the list with practical illustrations: barefoot feet that carry dirt, Uddhava bowing to the dust of the gopis' feet, never-dry prayer, the same Lord at every hour, and the best articles for Krishna. Questions cover food at relatives' homes, home deities, living near the temple and the value of every service. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Mahaprabhu asks Haridasa Thakura to describe the offences in serving the deity. Haridasa first says the deity servants know this better, then agrees to speak. Maharaj draws the lesson: one should not be so humble that one refuses a service the Lord himself is requesting.

🎙 Maharaj at 10:38 (auto-transcript): “That means that one should not be too humble not to do service when the Lord is requesting. You saw the same thing with Kalab Maharaj. Allah Maharaj, pray to Allah Nusimha there. First of all, I love Brahma.”

Maharaj recalls Prahlada Maharaja before Lord Nrsimhadeva: Brahma and the great sages know how to glorify you, what can a boy from a demon family say? Yet he prays because he is asked, and his simple heartfelt prayer pleases the Lord more than ornate praise.

Not scholarship, opulence or fame but devotion is what controls the Lord. When the servant speaks on request, it is really the Lord speaking through him. — “This is the devotion that the Lord is controlled by.”

🎙 Maharaj at 13:26 (auto-transcript): “So, it is not the squirture, it is not the opulence, it is not the fame, This is the devotion that the Lord is controlled by. So Haridasa Kura says, I will elaborate because you're asking me. That means that it's the Lord speaking and the servant is simply the medium, the…”

Many offences against the deity are listed in scripture, in one place 32 and elsewhere 50. Haridasa groups them into four: offences in directly serving the deity, in establishing a deity, in taking darshan, and general offences.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:36 (auto-transcript): “Concerning service to the Murti of the Lord, there are many offences listed in the scriptures. He won't place 32 offences unmentioned and elsewhere 50. And then I have divided these offenses into four types.”

The first offence is entering the temple with shoes on. Maharaj puts a question to the audience: if one walks to the temple barefoot, is that wearing shoes into the temple or not?

🎙 Maharaj at 17:15 (auto-transcript): “So I want to ask a question. 1. Should not walk into the temple with the shoes. So, my question is, if one walks with bare feet, no shoes, and you walk to the temple like that, is it wearing shoes to the temple or not wearing shoes?”

Most devotees reply that walking in with unwashed bare feet is the same as wearing shoes, since the dirt of the road is carried inside.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:48 (auto-transcript): “So, the majority of devotees mention that if one is walking with their feet and walking to the temple is the same as wearing shoes to the temple. Many devotees agree to that. So, this was the question of Guruji, and many people have given me that if there is no temple outside…”

One devotee answers that we should wash our feet before entering; Maharaj accepts this as correct, and says most of us who do not wash are in effect wearing shoes into the temple.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:06 (auto-transcript): “Vishwam brother Prabhu asked Aksa the question. He said we should wash our feet before entering the temple. temple. That means Krishna was washing his feet before he entered the temple. So Krishna is correct. Most of us who are not washing feet before entering, we are wearing…”
Krishna sent Uddhava from Dvaraka to Vrindavan. Overwhelmed by the gopis' devotion, Uddhava offered his prayers not to the gopis themselves but to the dust of their feet.

It was the gopis, not the cowherd boys, whose foot-dust Uddhava honoured. Their love cannot be equalled, and Mahaprabhu confirms there is no better way to worship Krishna than the way they established.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:19 (auto-transcript): “That means what? The Gopis' love is supreme. It cannot be equal. Confirmed by Lord Jitam Mahaprabhu. that there is no better way to serve Christa than depart established by the Gopis. Okay, let's continue. Number two, entering on the palanquin.”

Devotees often complain that their prayers feel dry and repetitive. Maharaj answers with Uddhava, who prayed again and again in ecstasy: prayer itself is never dry, our prayers are dry because there is no feeling in them. — “So prayer is never dry”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:49 (auto-transcript): “Most of us, many devotees have told me many times, when I pray, sometimes it becomes so dry because I will repeat the same thing. It becomes very dry. What to do? Thank you very much.”

The dust of a pure devotee's feet, the feet themselves and the water that washes them all nourish pure bhakti. So a pure devotee may walk anywhere barefoot and purify the place, while those not on that level should wash their feet before entering.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:06 (auto-transcript): “That means what? We have already discussed that the doors from the feet of a pure Bhakti, the foot of them and the water that washes their feet, these three things are conducive for pure Bhakti. so whatever they do from the supreme president”

Further offences: arriving in a palanquin, neglecting festivals, and not offering obeisances.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:02 (auto-transcript): “Number two, entering on the palanquin. That means false ego. The only king is Krishna. Every one of us is Saravan. So walking with the palanquin means we are trying to compete with Krishna. So, it is not correct.”

Entering on a palanquin is false ego. Krishna is the only king and all of us are servants; riding in is an attempt to compete with him. — “The only king is Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 29:09 (auto-transcript): “That means false ego. The only king is Krishna. Every one of us is Saravan. So walking with the palanquin means we are trying to compete with Krishna. So, it is not correct. Number three, not observing festivals.”

All festivals should be fully observed, beginning with the fast, and devotees should always take part.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:52 (auto-transcript): “Number three, not observing festivals. All festivals should be fully celebrated, means we should do the first thing first, the first thing is fasting, we should do that, we should do that, we should do that first.”

Devotees bow to the deity during the program but walk past without obeisances at other times. Maharaj asks: is he not the Lord when there is no program? He is the same person at every hour. — “He is the same Lord”

🎙 Maharaj at 31:24 (auto-transcript): “Number four, not paying obeisances. When we have a program, devotee comes to temple over obeisances, but during the day, when there is no program, devotee will walk past the dating without obeisances. He is not the Lord”
The list continues: bowing with one hand, stretching the legs, sleeping, eating, lying, loud talk, gossip, harsh words and more before the deity.

Maharaj acts out a devotee crying before the altar: Krishna, I have served you so long, why give me cancer? Lamenting like this before the deity is an offence, as if his energy were stronger than he is.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:39 (auto-transcript): “Krishna why do you give me sickness I have cancer why you give me cancer Krishna why I've been serving you for 100 years now you will give me cancer Krishna why why you do this to me Criticizing orders Covering oneself in a blanket before the date Preciating order before the…”

Not offering the best articles available is an offence. Maharaj gives the example of buying the deity an inferior cup while keeping an expensive golden one for oneself.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:50 (auto-transcript): “Not offering the best article is possible. We buy deity from an inferior one, but we have very expensive golden cup ourselves. That is wrong. Eating food, not offered to the deity.”

Eating food not offered to the deity is an offence, even when it has no meat, fish or eggs. Food bought outside and simply eaten is not prasadam.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:27 (auto-transcript): “Eating food, not offered to the deity. Even though he doesn't have to meet his or his inside. Yes, Shilagur Deo, I could not hear. Even though there is no meat, fish or eggs inside. In holy places, you will see chapati does not have meat or fish inside, but they are not…”

Seasonal fruits should be offered. A devotee's consciousness is such that in the market, on seeing something lovely, the first thought is: this is good for Krishna, I will get it for him. — “I will get it for Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:52 (auto-transcript): “Not offering seasonal fruits. Seasonal fruits. Devotates should be so conscious that whenever we see something like this, I will get this for Krishna. Yeah, yes, yes, yes, we will get this for Krishna. Oh, look at this beautiful love. This is good for Rajeshama. Yeah, I will…”

Not glorifying the guru and praising oneself before the deity or the guru are offences.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:39 (auto-transcript): “Not paying respect to others before the date, not glorifying the Guru, Pracing oneself before the date. Or before the Guru. Guru Deh.”

Maharaj mimics a disciple boasting before the guru that he demolished the impersonalists in today's lecture. Even if said in the guru's name, such self-praise is an offence.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:23 (auto-transcript): “Guru Deh. I dismantled the Maya Buddies. In this lecture, I went today. I dismantled the Maya Buddies, Guru Deh. That's an offense. Even if he hears the Guru's name, Guruji by a mercy, I conquer them by a mercy.”

Haridasa lists many points of etiquette for those who worship: approach cleanly, do not eat a materialist's food, keep silence during puja and do not leave in the middle.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:38 (auto-transcript): “Touching the deity in the dark room. Approaching the deity without proper etiquette. For example, not being clean.”

Food that a dog has looked at should not be offered; Maharaj explains that the dog has, in a sense, already eaten it by seeing it.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:43 (auto-transcript): “Offering food seen by a dog It's not offered a food because the dog is already eating it by seeing Speaking unnecessarily during puja”

Flowers without fragrance should not be offered in worship.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:51 (auto-transcript): “Offering flowers without a fragrance. Offering incense without a fragrant flower. Offering a suitable flower during puja means flowers that have no aroma. Bina kisi sugandh ke pushp arpit nahin karne chahiye.”

children.topic: Avoid both seva and nama offences
children.note:
These offences obstruct bhakti, so anyone who worships the deity should avoid offences both in service and to the holy name.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:30 (auto-transcript): “All these offenses in serving the deity will obstruct one's bhakti. Anyone worshipping the deity should avoid these offences. A devotee should avoid both seva and naama parades.”

When a devotee commits an offence in service he should rectify it immediately; with offences to the name the work of correcting, improving and avoiding goes on constantly.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:28 (auto-transcript): “When a devotee commits a seva aparad, he should rectify it immediately. For the Nama Paraj, him was constantly the rectifying, improving and avoiding. One who is on the level of bhava worship the deity day and night in solitude.”

One on the level of bhava worships the deity day and night in solitude, in his mind, and so commits no offences either in service or to the name.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:55 (auto-transcript): “One who is on the level of bhava worship the deity day and night in solitude. He makes no offences against the name or in service because his service is performed in his mind. On the order of Haridash Thakura, the devotees change the stone of the Gulli name.”

Devotees ask how these rules apply in daily life. Other questions also come up: whether inattentive Gayatri is an offence (Maharaj names indifference, distraction and laziness and says pure devotees weep in private, as Mahaprabhu did in the Gambhira), and whether one may eat or sleep in the temple hall when the altar curtain is closed (yes, cleaning before the program, and with a separate blanket for winter).

🎙 Maharaj at 57:00 (auto-transcript): “please accept my humble Maharashtra, my question is, I have two, three questions, but I'll ask on Friday. One is, Maharashtra, when we go to some close relatives place or a close friends place, they know that we will not be taking anything that they have put, but they offer…”

Relatives offer unoffered food or juice; refusing seems rude.

🎙 Question from the floor at 57:12 (auto-transcript): “One is, Maharashtra, when we go to some close relatives place or a close friends place, they know that we will not be taking anything that they have put, but they offer us food juice or fruits, but they don't have details at their place, so that is not offered. But if we…”

Maharaj mimics a devotee scolding his hosts for trying to make him fall down, and says we should never speak to them like that. Fruit can be accepted and kept, as such visits are not a daily matter.

🎙 Maharaj at 58:04 (auto-transcript): “He says, oh, you, you, you, Kalanis, don't you know that I cannot eat these things? You don't know that Buddha, you're supposed to know these things. Why can't you, want to fall me down from my, from my boxing party? You don't tell them like that. You don't tell them like that.”

Must one bow every time one passes the deities at home?

🎙 Question from the floor at 60:10 (auto-transcript): “One more question, like we should go down in front of DTs, that is for temple or home duty is as well like in home like if home duty is in main hall so we just pass by some time from this room to that room so do we have to every time go down in front of duty uh or what should…”

children.topic: Same Krishna as in the temple
children.note:
Maharaj bows to his deities when he leaves his room and when he returns. The temple has more worship, but the deities at home are the same person, and as we are conscious of them they are conscious of us. — “Don't go past them because it's the same person.”

🎙 Maharaj at 61:05 (auto-transcript): “Shishi Radha Shamsundar is in my room. So if I'm going at the open business you can come back here open business before I sit. So when I go out of my room I will name Vigre and bring it to him. And when I come back I will name Vigre and bring it to him. I will name Vigre and…”

Should one live near the temple, or farther away to preach?

🎙 Question from the floor at 68:01 (auto-transcript): “I just want, I wanted to know that if, if a person, if, if, if you're living near to the temple, should we live near to the temple or should we live a little far from the temple so that if we can preach, you know, to the farther areas also, because near the temple, the…”

Not everyone can live by the temple; if Prabhupada had stayed home, who outside India would know Krishna? Maharaj recalls Prabhupada wanting each disciple to open a temple. The temple is for training, then we go everywhere. — “The temple is for training.”

🎙 Maharaj at 70:52 (auto-transcript): “The temple is fine, but not that everybody must live there. We should live everywhere, everywhere, and make everywhere a temple. If I remember correctly, it was in San Francisco, the prophet said, I want all of you, each of you, to want open temple.”

The great preacher returns from converting the world to a temple with no prasadam, a dirty floor and neglected deities. We need pujaris, cleaners, cooks and preachers alike; no one can claim to be best.

🎙 Maharaj at 72:49 (auto-transcript): “If you are a good scholar, as preaching to the president of the whole world, and scientists, so many people, and then after your heavy preaching, they come back to the temple, no prasada. So what will you do?”

children.topic: Q4 · News of a death mid-service
children.note:
A devotee hears that a close relative has died while doing service. Maharaj says that if he has neither touched nor seen the body he should complete the service, and if no one can replace him next day he should still serve, because love is above rules and regulations.

🎙 Question from the floor at 82:35 (auto-transcript): “From today's session is, suppose a devotee is doing service at the temple while doing service he receives the news that one of his close relatives has passed away so in that situation when he leaves the service or what he should do and if on the next day he has another…”

children.topic: Q5 · Glorifying others before the deity
children.note:
Is this rule absolute? Maharaj says the one exception is one's guru, to whom one must offer obeisances even before the deity.

🎙 Question from the floor at 87:47 (auto-transcript): “Your Holiness mentioned that we should not glorify or offer obeisances to anyone in front of the deities. Maharaj, my question was that is this an absolute principle or are there any exceptions to this point? Aman Prahujji ka prashnah hai Shad se pahal hai wuh dhannawaat dhe…”
