maps.title: Harinama Cintamani · Session 17 · The Method of Bhajana (Part 1)

nodeData.topic: Session 17 · The Method of Bhajana (Part 1)
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Opening the final chapter, Maharaj shows that rasa is the pure nature of the Absolute, not worldly emotion, and that it needs the spiritual world as its setting. With playful analogies (a director turned doorman, a boxer's shame) he explains why the tiny soul is mercifully covered by illusion. The name then blossoms like a flower, revealing Krishna's form, qualities and pastimes right here, and rasa is cooked from its ingredients by the descent of Bhakti-devi. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: How does one qualify for rasa?
children.note:
In the final chapter, on the method of bhajana, Mahaprabhu asks Haridasa Thakura to explain the rasa in the holy name and how the jiva becomes qualified for it. Maharaj asks whether it comes by forming a club or by jumping straight to the Tenth Canto.

🎙 Maharaj at 08:29 (auto-transcript): “How does the Jeeva get qualification to the Rasa in the name? Is it by forming a club? Is it by jumping from to one to nine and to ten? Is that the process?”

Some abandon the Gita as mere fighting and jump to the Tenth Canto's fifth chapters. Haridasa will instead give the real key for entering bhakti-rasa, not secret shortcuts.

🎙 Maharaj at 09:19 (auto-transcript): “By abandoning our Gita, this is Kuru Chetra, fighting, this is not dirty. They were jumping Gita to 10-5 chapters. Paradas is going to give us the key how to enter into the realm of Baktilas.”

Rasa is the highest, purest state of the Absolute, not the sentiments of this world.

🎙 Maharaj at 11:17 (auto-transcript): “This Rasa is not the emotions or sentiment in the material world. But it is the inherent nature of the Absolute Pure.”

What passes for romance in films is a perverted reflection of real rasa. Iron and gold, heaven and hell, cannot be compared. — “There is no comparison.”

🎙 Maharaj at 12:17 (auto-transcript): “Perverted reflection is a Bollywood. That's a perverted demonic reflection of Dr. Lars. There is no comparison. Iron and gold cannot be compared. Heaven and hell cannot be compared. They are completely opposite. It is undimited, full of bliss.”

Maharaj asks what is needed for enjoyment; the answer is a suitable environment. For bhakti-rasa the spiritual world is that natural setting. — “Yes, environment for enjoyment is necessary.”

🎙 Maharaj at 16:02 (auto-transcript): “What is your prerequisite for enjoyment? What is it? What is the prerequisite for enjoyment? Toh kya yogta honi chahi hai anand uthane ke liye? Environment is conducive, environment is necessary. Yes, environment for enjoyment is necessary. So, for Bhakti Rasa, the spiritual…”

Why does Krishna call the gopis to the forest? A secluded place on a full-moon night in autumn is the setting for rasa, just as the full moon naturally affects our senses.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:43 (auto-transcript): “For example, Krishna is calling the gopis to the forest. Why? as a prerequisite for Russia, what is secluded place a forest on a full moon day, salat season, yes. When the moon is full, it has an effect on our senses.”

The supreme truth is Krishna in his eternal Syamasundara form, residing in Goloka, revealed through his spiritual energy with his name, abode and activities.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:26 (auto-transcript): “His supreme truth is known as Krishna, with Shama Sundara form, residing in Gulupadham. This is the original, eternal form of Krishna.”

Maharaj notes, in Hindi, that Lord Brahma confirms Krishna's original dark, beautiful form in the Brahma-samhita.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:41 (auto-transcript): “Shri Brahma Ji, Brahma Samhita Me Pushti Karate Hai Bhagavan Ka Vaashtrik Sharoop Unka Vaashtrik Roop Waha Shyam Varn Ka Hai Shyam Sundar Unka Varn Hai And Shyam Sundar It is citing Gulukadam Sanatana Goswami said, Krishna kept Goloka very far away from Bhaikuntha, very far,…”

Citing Sanatana Gosvami, Maharaj says Krishna keeps Goloka far beyond Vaikuntha, where he enjoys his sweetest pastimes with his most intimate associates. — “Krishna kept Goloka very far away from Bhaikuntha, very far, not near.”

Maya is the shadow of the Lord's spiritual energy and creates the material world by his will. Through his jiva energy he creates countless souls, placed between the two worlds.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:16 (auto-transcript): “The shadow energy of the Lord's spiritual energy is called Maya. By the will of Krishna, this energy creates the material world outside of the spiritual dimension. That means Maya is a person, full of sentiments, he has created this material world.”

The jivas stand at the borderline between spirit and matter, which is why they are called tatastha, marginal.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:50 (auto-transcript): “So the Jeevas are between, in between spiritual and material. It is called Tatastha, Tatastha, Tatastha. Yes, living entity is similar in quality for Krishna, but very, very small in size, very small in size.”

The soul is like Krishna in quality but tiny in size. Maharaj asks the audience their height, then gives the soul's: one ten-thousandth of the tip of a hair. What does Krishna mean by telling us this? That we are insignificant.

Who can even see a soul that small? Yet we think we are the mighty Brahma. Maharaj corrects it with a laugh. — “I am the mighty fool.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:31 (auto-transcript): “I am the mighty Brahma. But we feel like we are Brahmaji. We are the mighty Brahmaji. I am the mighty Brahma. No, no, I am the mighty fool. I am the mighty fool. That's the reality, but Maya covers or not precedents?”

The first covering placed over the soul is illusion, the mind. Maharaj asks why this is mercy, and answers that it lets us forget how small we really are.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:21 (auto-transcript): “That is the first uniform the Brahma created. First uniform? Yeah, that is the first uniform, the dress. The Brahma created illusion. So Brahma Ji has put the first push on our soul on our soul, it is the mind. The mind has kept on our soul, the first push on our soul. That…”

A company director demoted to a factory worker must open the door for the people who once opened his car door. How would he feel? He would die. So we are covered, to forget what we were.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:38 (auto-transcript): “So, if you are a director in the company, and then you have been removed and made a worker, a factory worker in that company. You are the director, now you become a worker, a worker in the first company, now you are”

A proud heavyweight boxer was knocked down by a young newcomer and nearly died, not from the punches but from the shame of losing to a boy. Illusion spares us that pain and lets us play out our pride.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:43 (auto-transcript): “so some years ago there was two heavyweight boxing champion So, one of them has been very proud of being the specialist in knocking out his opponent. So, at one time, a very young boxer. came to the ring”

Because of their marginal nature, jivas are either eternally liberated, serving Krishna in the spiritual world, or bound and suffering in the material shadow. Those in this world are of two kinds too: those taking the name with devotees, who go back to rasa, and those who ignore Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:11 (auto-transcript): “Because of your borderline quality, the jivas are of two types, eternally bound jivas and eternally liberated jivas. but you know I could have mentioned also the same thing in Jaiva Dharma Those who are eternally liberated”

children.topic: The newcomers who are laughed at
children.note:
Maharaj relates a teaching from Sanatana Gosvami: the residents of Goloka may laugh at the new devotee who, unable to tell the real abode from its reflection, wanders into the wrong house.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:17 (auto-transcript): “So Sanatana Goswami said all of you who are taking into your Krishna consciousness, you are a new devotee.”

Yet Krishna loves the newcomer more, because of the austerity he undergoes to reach him. Maharaj urges new devotees to hurry and make room for others. — “Krishna loved the new devotee more than the old devotee.”

🎙 Maharaj at 43:15 (auto-transcript): “But I think Goswami said, well, Krishna would love you more than them. Krishna loved the new devotee more than the old devotee. But Krishna loved the new devotee more than the old devotee. Because the austerity which you are taking to go there, the old devotees, they are…”

children.topic: The name blossoms like a flower
children.note:
Realisation of rasa in the name is gradual, like a flower opening from bud to full bloom.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:02 (auto-transcript): “The graduate realization of Rasha in the name, is compared to the blossoming of a flower the name is compared to a flower in god when it is spread to the general mass of people in the world”

children.topic: Bud stage: taste keeps us going
children.note:
At first the name is a closed bud; there is little taste yet, but some taste is there, and it keeps us chanting, just as taste is what keeps someone eating. — “To keep eating is the taste”

🎙 Maharaj at 46:26 (auto-transcript): “So when we get connected with the name there is rasa, there is rasa in chanting the Holy That is how we can continue, even though it is not so test yet, but we can continue because the test is there being gone on.”

Steady chanting reveals Krishna's form (the partly opened flower), then his qualities (its fragrance), and finally his eternal pastimes (full bloom). All of Krishna is loaded in the holy name.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:09 (auto-transcript): “So when one realizes a dutiful form of Krishna in Goloka Vandavan through a controller chanting of the name that is compared to the partially opened flower. Continuing sadhana further, when Krishna's 64 quality become revealed in the name, that”

The name will show the spiritual world, Krishna's associates and his pastimes, and we will take part, not after death but here in this world. — “It will happen right here before we go there.”

🎙 Maharaj at 52:06 (auto-transcript): “Right here in the material world, before we go there, not going there to go and see, It will happen right here before we go there. Vishwana Chakravarti Thakura said when you inhale the fragrance of Krishna, you fall. Shilavishtana Chakwarthi Thakurji kahte hain, ki jaisi aap…”

Following Rupa Gosvami, when all our activities and senses are engaged for Krishna, one is already living in Goloka while in this world.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:38 (auto-transcript): “That is, that is, that is why Rupa Goswami told us, In this world, you are already living in Goloka, when our activities, when our senses, when everything it is, All the peace in Krishna consciousness. There is one right here in this martial world. So, Krishna conscious is…”

children.topic: Bhakti-devi and the ingredients of rasa
children.note:
By the name's mercy the spiritual energies unite as Bhakti-devi and descend on the jiva, revealing the full rasa.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:18 (auto-transcript): “spiritual energy is 3 Adhyatmics Shaktiyaan 3 Prakati hain How do you call it? Samvid Chit Sat Chit Ananda Sat Ananda Sat Chit Ananda Is Excuse me”

Sat, cit and ananda are maintained by three energies: sandhini for eternity, samvit for consciousness and knowledge, and hladini, the pleasure potency, fully controlled by Srimati Radharani.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:34 (auto-transcript): “Samvit, Sandhini and Ladhini. Ladhini, he's mentioned here at least, that is Simati Radharani, he's in control, full control. When we say pleasure potency, that's what we say, pleasure potency. What does it mean? Pleasure potency means what? Krishna, Krishna who gives himself…”

Pleasure potency means Krishna's own pleasure, and that pleasure is a person, Srimati Radharani, not merely a word. — “So pleasure is a person, not just words.”

🎙 Maharaj at 58:11 (auto-transcript): “What does it mean? Pleasure potency means what? Krishna, Krishna who gives himself pleasure. That's Krishna's pleasure as a person. It's material. So pleasure is a person, not just words. is a person. That person is Matiradharani. Then Samvit, Samvit is going to say the…”

To enjoy a tasty dish you need ingredients: vegetables, milk, spices, oil, a pot and fire, or banana, avocado and strawberry for a smoothie, plus cooking skill. Rasa too has four ingredients.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:01 (auto-transcript): “So Bhakti Devi, Translanta Rasa, Lelo, it has ingredients, it has ingredients. If you want to taste something tasty, if you want to taste something tasty, something tasty things, you want to taste, you want to enjoy.”

No one enjoys alone; one needs others and paraphernalia. Worldly people take drugs; our intoxication is Krishna, his devotees and their activities. — “Our own drugs, our drugs, Krishna and Krishna devotee and activities they perform.”

🎙 Maharaj at 66:02 (auto-transcript): “If you want to enjoy what to do, will you enjoy yourself by yourself? If you want to enjoy what to do, will you enjoy yourself by yourself? Yes, yes, yes, you need some ingredients, somebody, some paraphernalia, low class people, they will go to take some drugs and things.…”

Questions after class. A last question, on how much a bona fide guru knows and how guru compares with the Lord, Maharaj says he will research and answer later.

🎙 Maharaj at 67:53 (auto-transcript): “Atanu Prabhu, you can unmute and ask your question. Maraja, here it is mentioned that the name of Livila's, Krishna's past time and his group and Guru So, what exactly does it mean that the name will reveal us Krishna's past time and his guna and his beauty? Here it is…”

children.topic: Q1 · How does the name reveal?
children.note:
What actually happens when the name reveals Krishna's pastimes and qualities?

🎙 Question from the floor at 68:00 (auto-transcript): “the name of Livila's, Krishna's past time and his group and Guru So, what exactly does it mean that the name will reveal us Krishna's past time and his guna and his beauty? Here it is mentioned that Krishna's name will reveal Krishna's past time. So, actually what does it…”

Not only seeing the deity, Krishna himself talks and plays with you; you follow him to the forest and take part. Maharaj playfully sets the scene of a lunch on the Yamuna bank with the questioner among the cowherd friends, and urges giving priority to japa.

🎙 Maharaj at 68:56 (auto-transcript): “as we are following Krishna we are chanting we are going to show you Krishna face of face that we are doing especially now the name will show you Krishna not just the deity like Krishna fully talking with you you play with him that's what it means that is that's what it means…”

children.topic: Q2 · Flower stages and nama levels?
children.note:
Can bud, half-open and full flower be compared to suddha-nama, bhava-nama and prema-nama? Maharaj agrees, and adds that namabhasa is like fog, clouded.

🎙 Question from the floor at 73:27 (auto-transcript): “My question is, it was said that Krishna manifests in three times, like first the form, then the qualities, then the pastime, it's compared to the flower opening, like slightly open, half open. and fully open so is this can we compare this to uh shoulda nama bhava nama and…”
How does a disciple know he has passed? Maharaj: when the guru is pleased, you get strength to overcome bad habits and obstacles you could not overcome before.
The Bhagavatam calls Siva the best of Vaishnavas. Maharaj says his category is different, and the gopis and gopas are closer to Krishna even than Vishnu.
Maharaj cites Krishna telling Uddhava that not Siva, Brahma, Sankarsana, Lakshmi or even his own self is as dear as Uddhava; Sanatana Gosvami explains Krishna meant all his devotees.

Rati is pure love; ananda is what one experiences in rasa. Saying 'let's enjoy' means nothing in an empty room, but with gulab jamun and prasadam in front of us it makes sense.

🎙 Question from the floor at 86:05 (auto-transcript): “Ananda, Rasa and Rati or are they interchangeably used? Thank you so much. Ananda. Ananda, Rati and Rasa. Rasa. So Aman Prabhu Ji, Krita Gheha Shila Gurudev ko itnei achi kata dene ke liye aur unka eek prashna hai ki kya aap ispe prakashit kar saktay hai ki anand, rati aur…”

maps.title: Harinama Cintamani · Session 18 · The Method of Bhajana (Part 2)

nodeData.topic: Session 18 · The Method of Bhajana (Part 2)
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Completing Harinama-cintamani, Maharaj likens rasa to a meal: our struggles in chanting are the ingredients, and tasting is the perfection beyond dharma, artha, kama and moksa. Faith is given by the sadhu, the guru gives Krishna in the mantra, loud kirtan is more powerful than silent remembrance, and we should chant convinced that Radha and Krishna stand before us. Haridasa outlines the eleven items and five stages of perfection, and in the questions Maharaj urges planning one's Krishna consciousness and compassion for others. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
After the ingredients of rasa are combined, initial love turns into full rasa, the highest perfection. Maharaj compares it to cooking: gather the ingredients, cook, offer to Krishna, and then comes the enjoyment of what you have prepared.

🎙 Maharaj at 08:00 (auto-transcript): “When one starts to cook, when one starts cooking, you get all the ingredients and then you start cooking all the different ingredients. when you put all together you finish cooking what everything is finished and offer to Krishna what is the next thing? Enjoyment, relation…”

The Vedas give four human goals: dharma, artha, kama and moksa. They are meant to lead to the supreme goal, rasa; as there is no meal without cooking, there is no liberation without the earlier steps.

🎙 Maharaj at 10:56 (auto-transcript): “For a person who is not cooking, they have no enjoyment. So, if our vegetables are in the bhojan, if they are not good enough, then we will not be able to eat in prasad. Therefore, one who has no dharma, there is no religious activities in his life, there is no artha, there…”

As one who does not cook has nothing to eat, one who does not chant the maha-mantra has no real life. — “So one who is not chanting Hare Krishna Mantra has no life.”

🎙 Maharaj at 12:26 (auto-transcript): “So one who is not chanting Hare Krishna Mantra has no life. Ultimately, you would want to pull Parama Purushanta Rasa. That is, one who is truly liberated is qualified for Rasa, one who has been engaged in practicing”
All the difficulties in our chanting and the austerities we accept are the ingredients; they culminate in liberation and in tasting rasa.

The path to rasa begins when a jiva with faith receives a pure Vaishnava guru. Maharaj cites Rupa Gosvami: the beginning of bhakti is taking shelter of the guru.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:22 (auto-transcript): “Shuddha Vaisna Guru Praathto Hotei Hai Shrubh Goswami Medhi Virke Adho Adho Tata Adho Sadhu Shrubh Goswami Ji Ne Is Ki Suruaat Ne Bata Diya Hai Ki Guru Ka Padashray He Suruaat Hai Bhakti Ki Aisa Ruph Goswami Ji Boltei Hai It bring us to a sadhu”

It is often said one gets a sadhu after getting faith; Maharaj says that earlier faith is only a shadow. Real faith is given by the sadhu through knowledge of one's relationship with Krishna. — “it is a shadow fate, not fate”

🎙 Maharaj at 16:06 (auto-transcript): “bring us to a sadhu that actually that is not fate it is just it is just shadow it is a shadow fate, not fate it is a shadow jaisa ki sastras me likha hai ke jab ek vyakti ko sraddha hoti hai tab ja ke ushe sadhu praapta hota hai lekin gurudev bol raha hai yaha sahih baat…”

When the guru gives the maha-mantra and the beads, he gives Krishna himself, not an ordinary thing. How we keep that Krishna is our own duty. — “Not just a standard thing, he has given Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 17:49 (auto-transcript): “When a Guru gives a Mahamantra, the bead, he has given Krishna. Not just a standard thing, he has given Krishna. How we are keeping that Krishna is our own duty.”

The name is taken either as smarana, remembering, or kirtan, chanting aloud, regulated by counting on tulasi beads and gradually increased. Kirtan is the more powerful, combining hearing, chanting and remembering, so that the senses dance in joy.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:15 (auto-transcript): “Jaap is the best, other day too, Jaap is the best, Kirtan is the best. Because Kirtan has a lot of potency. Ismaran is meant for advanced devotees. In the Kirtan,”

Silent remembering is meant for advanced devotees. Haridasa Thakura taught that loud chanting is a thousand times better than silent chanting.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:48 (auto-transcript): “Ismaran is meant for advanced devotees. In the Kirtan, which is recommended by Haridash Chakura. Haridash Chakura said, loud chanting a thousand times better than smarana. Silent chanting. Kirtan is the more powerful, for in that process, I combine shravanan hearing, kirtan…”

When someone makes noise, we shout 'keep quiet!' Chanting loudly is like that: we are shouting at our own senses to quiet them. — “So when you chant loud, we are shouting on our senses.”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:59 (auto-transcript): “Kirtan is shouting. to our senses. If someone is making noise,”

Other beings who cannot chant hear the name when we chant aloud. So those who chant loudly are magnanimous, and those who keep it silent are misers.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:27 (auto-transcript): “Other entities who cannot chant, they will hear when you chant loud. Those who turn loud are magnanimous and those who turn shocked are misers. By taking short of any of the nine processes to bhakti, one progresses in devotion.”

Those drawn to deity worship progress only if they also hear and chant the name.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:37 (auto-transcript): “Yes. Your deity worship is not perfect without chanting at least minimum four rounds. dating worship before cooking your cooking is not complete yes your service is not complete without chanting so shiragurdeo bata ra hai ki archa vigra ki sewa yaha bhojan pakana yaha tab tak…”

Maharaj adds that deity worship, cooking or any service is incomplete unless one has first chanted, at least four rounds.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:43 (auto-transcript): “Your deity worship is not perfect without chanting at least minimum four rounds. dating worship before cooking your cooking is not complete yes your service is not complete without chanting so shiragurdeo bata ra hai ki archa vigra ki sewa yaha bhojan pakana yaha tab tak…”

One who takes exclusive shelter of the holy name becomes perfect in everything, worship and preaching included; the example is Haridasa Thakura.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:29 (auto-transcript): “dating worship for the training or whatever if you take exclusive shelter of the holy name you will be a perfect dating worship, a perfect preacher, perfect in everything A tough example is Haridash Kulahim Shah Because everything is in the name.”

Hearing, chanting and remembering the name done well accomplish all nine processes of bhakti. — “Because everything is in the name.”

🎙 Maharaj at 27:56 (auto-transcript): “Because everything is in the name. But those who have exclusive attraction to the name need only engage in hearing, chanting”

Chanting with faith that the name and Krishna are not different, and avoiding the ten offences, one perceives the name's effect. Maharaj asks: from tomorrow, when we take our beads, can we be fully convinced that Radha and Krishna are right before us now?

🎙 Maharaj at 30:10 (auto-transcript): “So that means that, that means that from tomorrow, from tomorrow, when we take our beads, we want to chant. All of us will be fully convinced that Hare Krishna means Radha and Krishna are right before me now and I am”

If Radha and Krishna, or Gauranga, were standing personally before you, what would you do? Would you sleep or let the mind wander? That is exactly what is happening.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:05 (auto-transcript): “How will we behave if Radha and Krishna you are right personally before us how will we behave how will we behave”

We lack this awareness because Maya tells us the name and the person are separate; so our attention is incomplete.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:38 (auto-transcript): “Why we don't have this consciousness? Maya tells us that the name and creation, they are different. You just want writing you have. The person is not here. Therefore, our attention is not complete. If we want to taste the rasa in the name, then we should be fully convinced of…”

Tulasi Devi, the acaryas and one's guru are all present while we chant. This conviction is powerful enough to bring us to the taste of rasa in the name.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:11 (auto-transcript): “Tulsi Devi right before me, all our acharyas are right present here and I'm chanting with them. So, the fact that Krishna and Krishna's name is one is so powerful that it will help”

Careful chanting begins with understanding the name, then the form of Radha and Krishna in the mantra, then Krishna's qualities and pastimes. When all four become one, rasa in the name begins.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:40 (auto-transcript): “First of all, it begins by understanding the name. Then, the form of Radha and Krishna, the four parts, when you say Hare Krishna, this is Radha and Krishna.”

While chanting one may look at the deities or Tulasi Devi; by chanting carefully we come closer and closer to the realm of rasa.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:29 (auto-transcript): “Or look at the deities or Tulsi Devi. Chanting carefully, we are going closer and closer and closer to entering into the realm of Rasa. When one has succeeded in realizing the form of Krishna in the name,”

Haridasa describes the specific process for the spiritual body and conjugal rasa: eleven items of one's identity (relationship, age, name, colour, group, dress, order, residence, service and the guiding gopi) perfected through five stages.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:34 (auto-transcript): “A specific process is now described. To receive the spiritual body and conjura rasa, one must call to 11 specific items. 11 specific items. In one's identity, one's relationship, age, name, bodily color,”

The first stage is hearing from a realised guru. That is why the series has stressed attentive hearing; everything starts with the quality of our hearing. — “The beginning is the quality of our hearing”

🎙 Maharaj at 45:12 (auto-transcript): “It's the first Sravana Das. That is why we have been emphasizing on hearing, attentive hearing. The beginning is the quality of our hearing, how we are hearing. A guru will then choose the particular spiritual identity of the disciple according to the tendency and attraction…”

The guru gives an identity suited to the disciple's taste, and the disciple vows never to give it up. Maharaj explains varana as taking it into one's soul.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:29 (auto-transcript): “When finally one spiritual identity fits, he vows to the Guru never to give it up. This is called Varanadas.”

Remembering matures from a wandering mind to steadiness, meditation, continual remembrance and finally samadhi.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:54 (auto-transcript): “This marriage, the stage of remembering is divided into five levels. First, one tries to remember the eightfold past times but the mind wanders. This is Maran. When one's practice becomes steady, it is called dharana.”

One busy with an exterior show who does not fix the identity within cannot reach perfection; as remembrance grows, material identification fades.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:28 (auto-transcript): “If one is busy making an exterior show, but does not cultivate fixing one's identity within, he cannot perfect the stage. For fixing one's identity is natural since the Jeeva had simply forgotten his perfect”

Through either raganuga or vaidhi practice one reaches apana-dasa, where the eleven items become one's natural state, and finally sampatti-dasa, appearing in the spiritual body to serve Radha and Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:13 (auto-transcript): “One can reach Apan Dhaas, either from Raganuga Sarana, where scriptural rules are minimal or through Vaidhi sadhana. Where relying on suitable rules from scripture is predominant. If one progresses through the stages of faith, practice, purification, steadiness, taste and…”

The chapter closes with Haridasa Thakura's humble plea for mercy and Mahaprabhu's blessing on the teaching, the holy name as the dharma of the age, and his longing for even a particle of that nectar.

🎙 Maharaj at 58:15 (auto-transcript): “Harida Sekura said, I am low, mean-minded, and absorbed in material enjoyment, always refusing good association. Still, I am begging for costless mercy to progress today. there is a stage of bhakti. Saying this Arda's fellow conscious of the lotus field of Sri Chaitanya Mahathir.”

Questions after the final chapter, and a garland offered on behalf of everyone.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:44 (auto-transcript): “Dr. Prabhu, you may unmute yourself and ask your question. Hare Krishna, Guru Dev, please accept my humble obeisances. Hare Krishna. As you have said, Guru Dev, that Radha and Krishna will be seen in front of us when we started our Japa. But how should we be able to see them…”

At the start of japa we feel Radha and Krishna are present, but then sleep or distraction come. How can we hold it?

🎙 Question from the floor at 64:00 (auto-transcript): “As you have said, Guru Dev, that Radha and Krishna will be seen in front of us when we started our Japa. But how should we be able to see them continuously? As we start our our japa in the starting we can we can think about them that yes they are in front of us but after some…”

Some devotees keep the written maha-mantra before them and follow word by word; the mind stays fixed. A temple in New Town, Kolkata surrounds Tulasi Devi with the written mantra.

🎙 Maharaj at 65:16 (auto-transcript): “In a Chaupati Mantra and some other places I saw people, they keep this before them. and they will go one by one Hare Krishna they go one by one like this”

Businesspeople study markets and plan; we claim to be transcendental yet are casual and unplanned. If we do not plan, Maya will. — “If you don't do that, Maya will plan it for you.”

🎙 Maharaj at 69:35 (auto-transcript): “From my experience, I feel that we are too casual in our practice, in our devotional life. We are not planning our Christian consciousness. It is our duty to do that. The materialists are successful because they are planning their business and they are making their material…”

children.topic: A ticket to the right city
children.note:
Maharaj cites Srila Prabhupada: you cannot buy a ticket for Calcutta and go to Bombay. 'Any way' is the monkey's way; be purpose-driven.

🎙 Maharaj at 72:59 (auto-transcript): “Prabhupada said you cannot buy a ticket for Kalkatya and go to Bombay. If you want to go to Bombay, buy tickets for Bombay, you are purposeful. If you are going to Calcutta, get tickets for Calcutta, you are purposeful. You cannot get tickets for Calcutta and go to Mumbai. If…”

Is the spiritual body only for Krishna-lila? The same principle applies to Mahaprabhu.

🎙 Question from the floor at 73:52 (auto-transcript): “the attainment of the Siddha Dehra, is it only for Krishna Lila or does the devotee also get a Siddha Dehra to participate on Gora Lila as well? The same thing, the same principle, they can apply for Mahaprabhu, they can apply for Krishna, the same principle, because they are…”

children.topic: All five stages in one place
children.note:
Everything is simplified in Caitanya-lila. By chanting and following Mahaprabhu, all the stages and eleven items manifest automatically; we need not work at them separately. — “Just chant alone.”

🎙 Maharaj at 74:34 (auto-transcript): “All these details are easily simplified in Chaitanya Lila, easily simplified in Chaitanya Lila. Just chant alone. All these things we are discussing, they will spontaneously follow us to the end. We are automatically doing everything in Chaitanya Lila, Sarabana das, Varana…”

children.topic: Q3 · Why are people not attracted?
children.note:
Following the Nectar of Devotion on bhakti's auspiciousness, a devotee asks how to overcome a neophyte focus on one's own practice and reach others.

🎙 Question from the floor at 79:49 (auto-transcript): “Gurudev, please, I would like to ask about the very beginning of Nectar of Devotion. Rupa Goswami explains that the very second characteristic feature of pure devotional service is that it creates auspiciousness. It is the beginning of all auspicious conditions. And then Rupa…”

Maharaj cites Srila Prabhupada: violence is not only harming someone; when the world is suffering, not giving Krishna consciousness is also violence, and thinking only of one's own salvation is selfish.

🎙 Maharaj at 83:53 (auto-transcript): “Yes, so the Prophet mentioned in one of his poppots that violence is not just limited to not harming someone. Violence also means that the whole world is in trouble, like you mentioned. The whole world is in trouble. So if we are not preaching Krishna consciously to people,…”

No one gets Krishna's mercy by being selfish, only by being merciful to others. A sign of advancement is how much compassion grows in the heart; when we try to help people, Krishna helps us.

🎙 Maharaj at 86:04 (auto-transcript): “Who cannot get Krishna's missing by being selfish? Who can get Krishna's missing only by being merciful to order living in Jesus? So if you want to get Krishna's mercy, then we should preach Krishna consciousness to others.”

maps.title: Harinama Cintamani · Session 19 · Gratitude and Offerings

nodeData.topic: Session 19 · Gratitude and Offerings
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. On Mohini Ekadasi the devotees close the series with lamps, garlands and offerings of what they learned: chanting in good association, treating the name as a person, the science of graded surrender, planning one's Krishna consciousness and unlearning careless japa. Many are moved by Maharaj's daily 2 a.m. japa. Maharaj closes by reminding them that the holy name and service are eternal and blesses them to develop taste for the name. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: A festival of the holy name
children.note:
On Mohini Ekadasi the devotees gather to thank Maharaj for the eighteen sessions, with lamps, garlands and spoken offerings of what each has learned and will practise.

🎙 Maharaj at 06:38 (auto-transcript): “On behalf of all the devotees, Shrila Gurudev, we are very, very happy, with great, happy heart with lot of gratitude and enthusiastically we welcome you for our today's small session of gratitude for what you have given us in this last 18 days. Shrila Gurudev, we will have…”

The host recalls first hearing Maharaj on Harinama-cintamani for three days at Govardhan in 2016, a drop compared with this ocean, ending with a calm 64-round parikrama.

🎙 Maharaj at 07:53 (auto-transcript): “We start today's session in 2016 when I was in Vrindavan. I was blessed to hear Srila Gurudev first time Hainam Chintamani and that was for three days, for a few hours. And that time we were very new and it was in Govardhan. And we were coming from Vrindavan to attend those…”

A devotee from another line marvelled that this sannyasi comes for japa at 2 a.m. every day, in good health or bad, in any country; the host sees him as a true representative of Haridasa Thakura.

🎙 Maharaj at 09:58 (auto-transcript): “A few days back, one devotee, disciple of holiness, Gira Swami Maharaj, she called me And she was sharing her experience that this Guru, this Sanyasi, he everyday comes at 2 o'clock for Japa. He never fails, unfailing in all circumstances. And she was very wonderstruck, also…”

Reflecting on the tenth offence, he admits trying to make the name do what he wants for his own taste, rather than being a puppet in the hands of the name.

He was moved by Maharaj's answer describing what actually happens when the pure name reveals Krishna's pastimes and qualities.

children.note:
A devotee from Indore now completes sixteen rounds before office and finds the name coming from her heart all day, without effort, which she attributes to this association.

A devotee from Pune used to doubt whether it was all true or just brainwashing; Maharaj's step-by-step presentation showed her it is a science.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:11 (auto-transcript): “First of all, Gurudev, the biggest thing which I realized is that I used to get very much, sometimes very much my mind used to say that that is this correct that is that that really Krishna is there is this all true is that not your mind brainwashed or like many doubts used…”

Hearing that the six aspects of surrender come gradually, beginner to advanced, she can now answer her doubting mind: it will happen.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:44 (auto-transcript): “step you gave so nicely that okay if you are not feeling this uh like you explained that if you are uh if you are practicing uh only accepting favorable things for krishna and rejecting unfavorable things then those two steps are for kanisha then next if if you're believing…”

She once saw Maharaj unwell and sleepy yet standing and walking while chanting; when she feels sleepy she recalls it.

A devotee from Delhi quotes Kabir's couplet: if guru and Govinda stand before you, bow first to the guru, because through the guru one knows the Lord.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:12 (auto-transcript): “Guru Gobind which means if Guru and Krishna are standing in front of you whom will you choose so here Kabir Das ji says we should choose Guru because through Guru only we are able to know the Lord so over Krishna I choose my Guru spiritual master my Guru Maharaj and because…”

Having promised sixteen rounds daily and not kept it, she asks for three months to reach sixteen rounds without a break.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:59 (auto-transcript): “regarding my commitment I committed you 3 days back that I will chant 16 round daily but I am not a promise breaker person but I couldn't make my promise fulfilled so i take more time that in three months i will reach a level where i will chant 16 rounds daily without any…”

A devotee in Mayapur describes days framed by japa with Maharaj in the morning and class at night, with the god-family on screen so no one feels alone.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:45 (auto-transcript): “Thank you Today I take opportunity to tell you thank you for everything Srila Gurudev what you did for me you have changed me a lot still I am on this stage that is my ignorant condition first of all Srila Gurudev nowadays you are taking Japa in the morning two hours and in…”

She recalls Maharaj's answer that a pure devotee is one whose words enter your heart; his question of how we would behave before Radha-Syamasundara woke her at morning japa.

So I want to also set my gratitude because sometimes,…”

As it is rightly said, failing plan is planning to fail. Without a sincere spiritual plan, I risk being carried away by the destruction of the material world.…”

His second: when chanting sincerely, Radha and Krishna, Mahaprabhu, the associates, acaryas and guru are all present, witnessing the effort.

🎙 Maharaj at 82:34 (auto-transcript): “Maharaj explained that if I chant sincerely, I am not alone. Shri Krishna is present along with his eternal consort, Shri Mati Radharani, his expansions, Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, his dear associates, the Acharyas and our beloved Guru Jan. 🎙 Maharaj at 88:43 (auto-transcript): “to share your offering. Hari Krishna, my dear Sheila Gurudev, please accept my most humble lobby sciences onto a lotus feet. Gurudev, today I want to thank you from the bottom of my heart and especially for taking these classes on Harinam Chintamani, which was like an…”

Maharaj thanks everyone for their interest in the dynamics of the holy name and closes the series. — “Thank you all very much, first of all, for participating.”

🎙 Maharaj at 93:35 (auto-transcript): “Thank you all very much, first of all, for participating. And for having interest to understand the dynamics of the Holy Name. In the beginning, we were saying that the holy name and the service, these two things are the only primary thing which we have in our Christian…”

The holy name and service are the only primary things in Krishna conscious life; both are eternal, and everything else is unnecessary or comes automatically. — “Harinam is eternal and service is eternal.”

🎙 Maharaj at 94:29 (auto-transcript): “Harinam is eternal and service is eternal. Other things are not necessary or they will come automatically if you have these two things. nodeData.topic: Session 01 · CC Antya 3.94–100
nodeData.note: CC Antya 3.94–100 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. The series opens on the glories of Haridasa Thakura, who chanted before tulasi in the Benapola forest. Maharaj stresses that the process is simple and cheap — what is missing is desire, a clear goal and the right attitude — and teaches how to chant with Tulasi Devi and the name as persons. Questions bring out how pure devotees see the name, with the story of Srinivasa Acarya absorbed in Radha-Krishna's pastime. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: The chapter: glories of Haridasa Thakura
children.note: Caitanya-caritamrta, Antya-lila chapter 3, on the glories of Haridasa Thakura, read in Vrindavan with Hindi translation. This first class covers verses 94 to 100.
Mahaprabhu delights in glorifying his devotees, and Haridasa's qualities are said to be beyond any full count.
The author notes that Vrindavana dasa Thakura described some of Haridasa's qualities in Caitanya-mangala, and that one speaks of them only for self-purification.
The narration begins with Haridasa leaving home and living for a time in the forest of Benapola.
The verse describes Haridasa's life of chanting before tulasi day and night; Srila Prabhupada's purport turns it into a practical lesson for members of the movement.

children.topic: Simple: a plant, a seat, a tongue
children.note:
Maharaj asks what a tulasi plant costs — fifty rupees — and whether anyone here lacks fifty rupees. No gold or diamonds are required: a plant, a place to sit, a tongue and ears. So Prabhupada calls the process simple.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:49 (auto-transcript): “We have tulasi plants. How much tulasi costs? Tulasi plants. How much tulasi costs? 50 rupees. Anyone here doesn't have 50 rupees? Anyone? We have 50 rupees. That means that it is possible.”

The difficulty is not the process but our lack of desire. Ignorance makes the desire weak, the tongue heavy and the mind restless; goodness is peaceful and has time. — “no desire to do it.”

🎙 Maharaj at 26:57 (auto-transcript): “The problem is no desire to do it. Why no desire? The mode of ignorance is prominent. Because of the mode of ignorance,”

Where Haridasa lived there was a very dangerous snake whose poisonous breath could be felt from a distance, yet he sat and chanted peacefully, not even noticing it.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:38 (auto-transcript): “Not even a place for Harada Sakur, where he stays, a very dangerous snake, the vapo alone, without biting, very dangerous. You have seen the refinery, you have seen the refinery, that is exactly the power of this snake, the wap of this snake is like that, from distance, you…”

Haridasa is an internal devotee, connected with Krishna, so his senses are not outside. Ours are mostly outside: we see the snake, the poison, and get distracted. — “All his senses are turned inside.”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:11 (auto-transcript): “Haritās is an internal devotee. All his senses are turned inside. In other words, he is connected with Krishna So his senses are not outside Most of his senses are outside Therefore we see the environment We see the snake”

That is why Prabhupada says we cannot imitate Haridasa, but we can follow him — at least with our sixteen rounds.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:57 (auto-transcript): “We see the poison, and we get distracted from it, and this is the difference, so Prabhupada says we cannot imitate it, we can follow, for his minimum 16 and 20. Shri Rastakudegh Goswami back bottom sorry”

Quoting the instruction to chant in the footsteps of the previous teachers, Maharaj says the standard is how our acaryas chanted, not how we happen to be chanting. — “We should chant the way they chanted.”

🎙 Maharaj at 31:55 (auto-transcript): “He said, Harinama Anukirtanam. He should chant the holy name after the ways of all this. As our acharyas chant. Not as we are chanting. We should chant the way they chanted. How did Haridash Thakur chant?”

children.topic: Why the name was sweet for Haridasa
children.note:
He sat before tulasi, seeing nothing else and not worrying about the time — not because he had no office to go to, but because of his qualities. He knew the position of the holy name, its benefit, and what he was looking for.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:39 (auto-transcript): “How did Haridash Thakur chant? I was chanting. Sitting, Tulsi plant, you don't see anything, not worrying about the time, it is not because Harida was not going to the office, it is because of the qualities he has.”

Most of us chant, but not for love of Godhead, so we cannot expect the experience and success Haridasa had.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:05 (auto-transcript): “The majority of devotees are chanting Hare Krishna Mantra. Not because we want to go to Godhead. It's not for Godhead. We are not doing different reasons for God's sake. Therefore, we will not have the experience and the success that Haridas could have.”

For Haridasa the name was sweet: he took full shelter, the name was with him, and they were intimate, because he wanted only pure love of Godhead.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:51 (auto-transcript): “The holy name for Haridas was very sweet. Because of his consciousness, he was one with the name, taking full shelter. Therefore, the name was with Haridas. They were together, very intimate, that is how Harita Sakura was chanting, he knows the whole name, he knows what is…”

Being told to chant and simply chanting is not enough. Maharaj urges everyone to define what they expect from chanting, and to check it, or progress will be difficult. — “We should know why we want to chant”

🎙 Maharaj at 35:50 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, we should sincerely define what is our goal by chanting the Holiness. We should define what is our goal, what are we expecting. We have been told that chant Hare Krishna mantra Okay, so we are chanting”

Chanting before Tulasi Devi means Narayana is present, and Narayana is never alone — he is always with his devotees. So we are in the association of elevated personalities, and should consciously see ourselves chanting with them.

Maharaj has the room repeat a prayer he learned from another devotee: I am the most fortunate person in the universe because I have Krishna's name, which connects me with the Lord. What else could we want? — “I am the most fortunate person in the universe”

🎙 Maharaj at 38:48 (auto-transcript): “Mahatma Prabhu said please repeat I am the most fortunate person in the universe I am the most fortunate person in the universe because I have the holy name of Krishna which connects me with the Supreme Lord. So chanting the holy name means what? We are connected with the…”

Give the best of our life to the holy name, and pray to Haridasa: as you chanted and attained pure love, bless me to chant that way.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:10 (auto-transcript): “Make prayer to Haridashtha. As you have chanted. I attended the ultimate, professional chanting, pure of our Godhead. May you bless me to chant this way. and then beautiful God here this message we read”

Mahaprabhu glorifies Haridasa because of the way he chanted — he captured the Lord by the name. Without the correct attitude, even sixty-four rounds a day bring little result; with a pure, respectful attitude the result comes.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:57 (auto-transcript): “Chaitanya Mahaprabhu is glorifying her in us Because of the way he chanted the holy name. He captured the Lord by chanting the holy name. The Lord is very pleased with him. So, Shri Bhagawan Chaitanya Mahaprabhu Atyantya Prashanam Is the attitude of Haridash Thakur Let's have…”

A second prayer to repeat: when I chant, I chant. It means full absorption, with nothing between us and the holy name. — “Nothing in between us and the Holy Name.”

🎙 Maharaj at 42:12 (auto-transcript): “another prayer from Mahatma Prabhu Please repeat. When I chant, I chant. Does it make sense? When I chant, I chant. Means what? Nothing in between us and the Holy Name. Nothing in between us and the holy name, nothing.”

Because the holy name is a person, he knows what is in our mind and responds to it. So give him full attention, just as we cook when we cook and eat when we eat.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:21 (auto-transcript): “The holy name is a person. Therefore he knows What is in our mind He knows And he will respond to that Therefore Let us chant when we chant Give full attention to the Holy Name Not in between. If we want to cook.”

Three questions about Tulasi Devi and how pure devotees see the holy name.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:05 (auto-transcript): “there is a possibility to ask like, why you say, because sometimes you concentrate on the ordinary, I have the habit to close the eyes. But then, one place to say that, in front of pure devotee, if you close your eyes, it does not take so much since something that sources are…”

children.topic: Q1 · Eyes closed, or on Tulasi?
children.note:
A devotee who closes her eyes to concentrate asks why Maharaj recommends gazing at Tulasi Devi, as one looks at a pure devotee.

🎙 Question from the floor at 45:05 (auto-transcript): “there is a possibility to ask like, why you say, because sometimes you concentrate on the ordinary, I have the habit to close the eyes. But then, one place to say that, in front of pure devotee, if you close your eyes, it does not take so much since something that sources are…”

By looking we connect, and their energy flows to us and gives strength. If we are not consciously looking, the mind wanders and the current does not flow.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:43 (auto-transcript): “By looking at them, we connect with them. What is your experience? Flow to us. If you are not watching, the mind will go somewhere. And then, this condition. The current will not flow to us. But if we are consciously looking,”

Krishna blessed Tulasi to remain in this world so that people could easily reach pure love for him through her; hence she is worshipped throughout the universe. Chant with her consciously and we progress faster.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:59 (auto-transcript): “When Krishna, Tundra Krishna was ending the person between himself and Tulsi, When Krishna gave her a blessing. He should stay here in this material world. So people will easily attain pure love for me by Gashvishish.”

children.topic: Q2 · I only see a plant
children.note:
A devotee feels the presence of the deities but sees Tulasi only as a plant.

🎙 Question from the floor at 49:47 (auto-transcript): “I can see that they are living, but Tulsi, I cannot get so much same energy, the same consciousness as the Kewati Vulti. I see it as a plant. Yes. Tell him. When I look at Tulsi, I see two things. I am seeing the plant”

children.topic: See the plant and the person
children.note:
Maharaj sees two things: the plant and the person. Small as she is beside a banyan tree, she is powerful; we should practise seeing the person whose body is the plant. — “we should see the person whose body is the plant.”

🎙 Maharaj at 50:28 (auto-transcript): “When I look at Tulsi, I see two things. I am seeing the plant and I see the person. The beauty is sweet. Not just the plant alone. Yes, somebody plant all over here. Banyan tree, bigot and Tulsi Devi.”

children.topic: Q3 · How do pure devotees chant?
children.note:
What does it mean that pure devotees are so absorbed when they chant?

🎙 Question from the floor at 52:08 (auto-transcript): “So the first question is that when you say that the pure devotees are very mature, so what do you tell us? What kind of name is this very mature? How does it feel mature?”

As with tulasi, they see both the syllables and the person of the name, and Krishna sits listening to their chanting. They are not in the material world but with him in the spiritual world, where there is no anxiety.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:01 (auto-transcript): “The pure devotees, they see, like we are talking about the plant, they see their name and they place their name, the sea boat. Bhagawan ke Shuddha Bhakti, jab naam ka jab karte hain, we naam akchhar ko dekhte hain, uske saath saath naam vyakti ko bhi dekhte hain, jayise tulsi…”

Before his deity worship Srinivasa Acarya entered, in his spiritual form, Radha and Krishna's water play in the Yamuna. Radharani lost a tiny ornament in the dark water, and he helped search until it was found. All day he sat motionless; the household grew alarmed, until Virabhadra Gosvami entered the same pastime and assured them he was not dead.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:27 (auto-transcript): “There is a pastime. You want to look at the consciousness of pure good. They are wanting to see what is happening in Narutandashthaku.”

Etiquette asks that we sit and eat mindfully. Eating carelessly leads to offences to prasadam and makes others offend too; eaten with anxiety, even plenty of food does not nourish.

🎙 Maharaj at 66:10 (auto-transcript): “Why? Attitude. If you eat, etiquette demands which you sit and eat. The first reason is attitude. His Holiness Bachchan Maharaj calls it mindful eating. If we are not mindfully eating,”

In the same way, approaching the holy name with pride is the wrong attitude: then the name is not there, only its letters. — “The name will not be there, only the alphabet you get”

🎙 Maharaj at 68:45 (auto-transcript): “The same way, if our attitude towards chanting is, to us chanting is, we are offending the name. So how will we get delivered? Not possible. attitude is very important, how we understand the name, how much we approach the name, we approach the name with pride, it's wrong…”

The ten offences describe how our mind should be towards the name. A careful, respectful person cannot offend anyone — others may envy him — but a bad attitude creates havoc for ourselves and others.

🎙 Maharaj at 69:59 (auto-transcript): “But when we discuss the offenses to avoid the world chanting the name, what are we talking about? Attitude So when we are talking about these 10 names, what is it? How should our name be our mind and soul be? These are the 10 names. The person who is very careful, who is very…”

nodeData.topic: Session 02 · CC Antya 3.101
nodeData.note: CC Antya 3.101 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. One verse — Haridasa begging a little food at brahmanas' homes — opens a whole class on what devotees eat and accept. Maharaj explains that such saints visit homes only to bless and preach, that gifts and food carry the giver's karma, and that knowledge shows itself as renunciation. He asks why ISKCON is called a kitchen religion rather than vairagya-vidya, and answers questions on invitations and re-cooked offerings. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The verse tells how Haridasa maintained his body with a little food from brahmanas' houses and was honoured by everyone around. Srila Prabhupada's purport draws out where devotees should take their food.

Maharaj says Haridasa did not really go for food. Like Sukadeva Gosvami, such saints visit householders only to preach to them; they have all their nourishment with them. — “Only to preach to them”

🎙 Maharaj at 09:17 (auto-transcript): “Shri La Haidash Thakur actually it is not for begging for food. That is pretense. The only reason Nama Acharya Haridasa Kura This is Goswami Shukadeva Goswami They go to the houses or the house of us Only to preach to them”

Raghunatha dasa Gosvami took almost nothing — a little buttermilk — yet suffered indigestion. The cause was that Srimati Radharani was feeding him. What would such a person need from a householder's kitchen?

🎙 Maharaj at 10:41 (auto-transcript): “We heard about Raghunath Das Goswami. He was constipated. Butter milk will constipate somebody. Butter milk. You know the quantity Haridaz was taking? That will constipate somebody.”

Gaura Kisora dasa Babaji went nowhere; when hungry he took a little Ganga mud on his finger, ate it and went on chanting. If such a saint visits a home, it is only to preach.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:15 (auto-transcript): “Personality is like Gaur Kishoda Babaji Maharaj. He doesn't go anywhere. When he's hungry, this finger this finger he will take a mud from Ganga like this so he will eat and he will continue what would he do in someone's house he is only to preach So, Prabhupada has warned…”

Prabhupada warns that taking food from others means sharing their qualities; Maharaj adds that we also become part of their karma.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:59 (auto-transcript): “So, Prabhupada has warned all of us, if we take food from the houses of others such as We shall have to share the qualities of those from whom we take arms. So we will also become a part of the karma of such people. Kurkishwota Baba Ji Maharaj. Shilagor Kshwota. Jagadant,…”

Jagannatha dasa Babaji received a donation of one rupee and had his servant return it: it was loaded with karma and he could not bear it. Maharaj turns to the room — and you carry millions of them. Are we ready to share that load? — “I cannot bear to take it.”

🎙 Maharaj at 13:52 (auto-transcript): “Jagannath Da Baba Ji Maharaj. Vaishnamasar Bhuma, Jagannath Da Baba Ji Maharaj. Jagannath, he got a donation of one rupee. He got a donation of one rupee. I told the servant, return it. Please, please, go and give it back. This one rupee is fully loaded with karma.”

Our process is vairagya-vidya, renunciation and knowledge. How do you know someone is knowledgeable? By how detached he is from material thinking — and by his gentleness, for knowledge does not make one proud. — “A knowledgeable person is not proud.”

🎙 Maharaj at 15:45 (auto-transcript): “ready? Prabhupada said here, our process is vairagya vidya. The process of vairagya and knowledge. How do you know someone has knowledge? What is the proof? This person has knowledge. This person is knowledgeable. How can you say it? What is the proof? What can you say? What…”

Knowledge winds this way and that, and many quotations can be taken in any direction; bhakti goes straight.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:39 (auto-transcript): “So, this current movement, we always, you know, in our system, in our system, if you, you know how knowledge works, knowledge, you know how it works, knowledge is like this, it's like this, it's like this, it's like this, it's like this, it's like this. Bhakti is straight…”

Everyone quotes Prabhupada calling ISKCON a kitchen religion; how many lectures quote him calling it vairagya-vidya? What we prominently preach is what we become — we do not want renunciation, so we preach food.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:09 (auto-transcript): “Srila Prabhupada said Iskand is a kitchen religion. That has been loudly proclaimed. How many of us have quoted this? How many lectures have you heard this? The Iskorn movement is a part of Vairagya Vidya. Have you heard this in any lecture? No.”

Prabhupada's purport is clean and plain; it is our lives that are crooked. There is nothing confusing in the point that a devotee must be careful about what he eats. — “Hare Krishna devotee should be careful with what we eat.”

🎙 Maharaj at 21:29 (auto-transcript): “When we look at Prabhupada's purpose, what I see is that everything is clean, but our life is crooked, our life is different from what Prabhupada has put in this purpose. A lot of confusion, but what is confusion here? What is confusion here?”

Maharaj recalls Mahaprabhu announcing that anyone who wanted to invite him must pay an enormous sum. The devotees despaired — none of them had it. Then he explained: whoever chants one hundred thousand names is qualified to feed him.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:13 (auto-transcript): “He said, one day, Chitanya Mahaprabhu told the devotees, from today onward, anyone who wants to invite me to the house, you have to pay 10,000 coins, 100,000, 100,000, all”

Chanting purifies the consciousness; food cooked in that consciousness is fit to be offered to the salagrama, and a devotee can happily accept it.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:49 (auto-transcript): “What is the purport of that? 100,000 names One who chants 100,000 names The consciousness will be purified Without purifying the consciousness When one cooks It is suitable to be offered to Salagamshila Then, a devotee should take that happily. Any house without deity, please…”

Do not eat in a house without deity worship — and even in houses with deities, be careful.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:31 (auto-transcript): “Any house without deity, please don't eat in an house. Not all adults. Even the houses that have did this, please, be careful. Some years ago, we were on a safari tour. And we went to Malda. So, we were there for a few days. And the servant was pushing me to take prasad.”

children.topic: The plate he could not wash
children.note:
On a preaching tour in Malda, among devotees with shining threads, Maharaj's servant pressed him to take prasadam there; he quietly declined. Later the servant searched far for a place to wash the plates — he had seen meat in that kitchen. Maharaj looks at him: you wanted me to eat where you could not even wash a plate?

🎙 Maharaj at 25:56 (auto-transcript): “Some years ago, we were on a safari tour. And we went to Malda. So, we were there for a few days. And the servant was pushing me to take prasad. I said, no, no, no. The whole of this place is full of devotees. All initiated devotees, their thread is silver.”

In Nectar of Instruction Rupa Gosvami speaks of the one who chants nicely. Maharaj asks why he added that word: not just to chant, but to do it well. — “Devotion has quality, and we have to look for the quality.”

🎙 Maharaj at 29:28 (auto-transcript): “One of the verses in the Lecture of Instruction, Rupa Goswami says, the essence of all advice is that Wants who nicely chant the holy name. Why he didn't say wants to chant the holy name? Why he didn't say that? It's a complete English, right? Wants who chant the holy name of…”

Everyone knows the leaf, flower, fruit and water verse; Maharaj points to its last word. The items are available to anyone — Krishna looks for the consciousness of the one offering. We are a society for Krishna consciousness.

Haridasa goes to Vaishnava homes to benefit the householders, not from hunger: his spiritual body is nourished by the holy name alone.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:06 (auto-transcript): “Haridash Thakurji is going to the houses of Vaishnavas. And they will take something just to benefit the householders. Not because he is hungry. Haridash Thakur doesn't have a hungry body. He has a spiritual body that is spiritually being nourished. The holy name nourishes…”

children.topic: We want to eat — eat nicely
children.note:
We are not on his level and we do want to eat; then let us at least eat nicely, avoiding needless luxury.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:05 (auto-transcript): “Yes, we are not on that level. We want to eat, but eat nicely. Therefore, all devotees are warned not to live unnecessarily No serious lives are the cost of others. As far as possible, this should be avoided.”

Falldowns are happening, Maharaj says, so we should be careful in everything we do.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:45 (auto-transcript): “It is happening. Therefore, we should be careful about everything that we do. We should be careful. How do we balance the relationships that we have with devotees?”

Two questions about eating in devotees' homes and about offerings.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:04 (auto-transcript): “How do we balance the relationships that we have with devotees?”

children.topic: Q1 · Accepting invitations from close devotees?
children.note:
Close devotees invite us and cook what we like. How do we keep these relationships while eating nicely?

🎙 Question from the floor at 36:04 (auto-transcript): “How do we balance the relationships that we have with devotees?”

children.topic: Not at the cost of our sadhana
children.note:
It is better not to please people at the cost of our own spiritual life. Once in a while can be accommodated, not regularly. A host who is a devotee should know what to offer — why cook a hundred preparations at eleven at night?

🎙 Maharaj at 38:03 (auto-transcript): “It is better not to to please people at the course of our own spiritual life.”

Our consciousness is not changing because we minimise the process in the name of preaching. The purpose of coming together is to support each other.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:59 (auto-transcript): “We are in Krishna consciousness but our consciousness is not changing because we are minimizing the process in the name of preaching. It shouldn't be like that.”

children.topic: Not as strong as they are
children.note:
A friend once phoned: after a meeting the leaders were feasting on food cooked by non-devotees. Maharaj advised him to tell them he was not as strong as they were and would eat at the temple — and it worked. — “you are not as strong as they are”

🎙 Maharaj at 42:10 (auto-transcript): “A few years ago, one of my friends is here in this class. So he called me. Some leaders have come for a meeting. and at the end of the meeting he prasad cooked by non-devotives all the leaders are feasting”

Maharaj says anything that enters his mouth reacts immediately, and he wonders at those who can eat anything and feel nothing.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:14 (auto-transcript): “I always wondered when I see how people eat and feel comfortable. Anything, anything that enter my mouth, it will react, you know, immediately. Anything, anything that I put in my mouth, I will know exactly what is going on. I also wonder how we have so many transdental…”

Some cook the leftover offered bhoga into a new dish and offer it again the next day. Is this authorised?

🎙 Question from the floor at 46:26 (auto-transcript): “they will offer bhoga to the Lord, then part of it will remain. Then tomorrow they will cook it again and make a new dish out of it. Like kind of new bhoga and then they will offer again. So I just wanted to know is this authorized or is this a bogus practice? My question is…”

Maharaj answers in one word — laziness, the mode of ignorance. Those in goodness do things straight. We claim no time for Krishna yet find time for maya; make time for Krishna and there is none left for maya. — “Better to have time for Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 47:15 (auto-transcript): “Laziness. Noting else, laziness. A mode of ignorance. Ignorance. Those in satyagun, they will not do like that. Everything is straight, straight. We don't have time for Krishna, but we don't have time for Maya.”
